sum: Simulating long-term, fully elastodynamic sequences of earthquakes and aseismic slip (SEAS) on complex fault networks is computationally expensive. This paper introduces a divide-and-conquer 2D antiplane boundary integral framework that separates fault self-interactions from fault-to-fault interactions. Self-effects along planar fault segments are computed via a non-replicating spectral boundary integral equation method (SBIEM) with mode-dependent time-window truncation. Stress transfer between arbitrarily oriented or intersecting faults is evaluated in the space-time domain and accelerated using hierarchical matrices (H-matrices) with fault-wise binary cluster trees and causality-based time truncation. Validated against the SCEC BP1-FD benchmark, a two-fault system, an intersecting X-fault, and a 44-fault network from the Gulf of Corinth, the method reduces interaction complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2 log N). This yields up to three orders of magnitude speedup and one order of magnitude memory reduction, enabling fully dynamic multi-cycle fault network simulations on workstation hardware.
针对复杂断层网络全动力学地震与无震滑动序列（SEAS）模拟计算成本高的问题，本文提出一种2D反平面混合边界积分分治框架。该方法将断层自相互作用与断层间相互作用解耦：平面断层自效应采用无周期复制谱边界积分法（SBIEM）结合模态相关时间窗截断计算；任意取向或相交断层间的应力传递则采用基于断层独立二叉树……

t: A hybrid 2D antiplane boundary integral method evaluates planar fault self-interactions using a non-replicating spectral formulation and computes inter-fault stress transfer using a space-time formulation accelerated by fault-wise hierarchical matrices (H-matrices) and physics-based time-window truncations.
混合2D反平面边界积分法：用无复制谱方法计算平面断层自效应，用断层独立H矩阵加速时空法计算互作用。

Evaluated using synthetic 2D antiplane benchmarks: the single-fault SCEC BP1-FD verification, a two-fault dynamic rupture test, a 100-year intersecting X-shaped fault cycle test, and a 32-year simulation of 44 normal faults in the Gulf of Corinth.
采用SCEC BP1-FD基准、双断层、X型相交断层及科林斯湾44条断层网络进行二维反平面数值模拟验证。

Reduces computational complexity of interaction calculations from O(N^3) to O(N^2 log N), achieving up to three orders of magnitude speedup in computation time and one order of magnitude reduction in memory usage without loss of accuracy.
复杂度从O(N^3)降至O(N^2 log N)，计算时间减少达三个数量级，内存占用减少约一个数量级且无精度损失。

Currently restricted to 2D antiplane (mode III) deformation in an unbounded homogeneous elastic medium without a traction-free surface, using SVD low-rank compression and fault-pair-level time truncation.
仅限无界均匀介质2D反平面变形，未含自由地表，且依赖SVD压缩和断层对级别时间截断。

Combines non-replicating spectral BIEM with H-matrix space-time BIEM via a selective fault-wise dual-tree compression that excludes self-interactions from the hierarchical structure while preserving near-field accuracy.
首次结合无复制谱方法与基于断层独立双树H矩阵的时空BIEM，将自效应排除在层次压缩外。

kc: Developed a divide-and-conquer hybrid boundary integral framework combining non-replicating spectral BIEM for fault self-effects and H-matrix-accelerated space-time BIEM for fault-to-fault interactions.
Introduced a fault-wise dual-tree H-matrix decomposition that excludes self-interactions from hierarchical compression and targets low-rank approximations to far-field inter-fault stress transfer.

Implemented physics-informed time-window truncations (mode-dependent for spectral self-effects and causality-based for space-time interactions), achieving O(N^2 log N) complexity and up to 1000x speedup.
开发了分治混合边界积分框架，结合无复制谱边界积分法（计算断层自效应）与H矩阵加速时空边界积分法（计算断层间相互作用）。
提出了按断层独立构建双树的H矩阵分解策略，将自相互作用排除在层次压缩之外，并对远场断层间应力传递进行针对性低秩近似。
引入物理启发式时间窗截断策略（谱自效应采用模态相关截断，时空相互作用采用因果律截断），实现O(N^2 log N)复杂度及高达三个数量级的加速。
me: Non-replicating spectral boundary integral equation method (SBIEM) in displacement formulation with domain padding (2L) and mode-dependent time convolution truncation.
Space-time boundary integral formulation accelerated via SVD-based hierarchical matrices (H-matrices) using fault-wise binary cluster trees and dual-tree traversal.
Causality-cone-based truncation of elastodynamic interaction histories and second-order adaptive predictor-corrector explicit time integration with rate-and-state friction.
采用含虚拟填充域（2L）和模态相关时间卷积截断的位移格式无复制谱边界积分方程法（SBIEM）。
基于断层独立二叉簇树和双树遍历，利用奇异值分解（SVD）构建层次矩阵（H矩阵）以加速时空边界积分格式。
基于因果律锥的弹性动力学相互作用历史截断，以及结合速率-状态摩擦定律的二阶自适应预测-校正显式时间积分方案。
de: SCEC BP1-FD single-fault community benchmark verification against BICycle, GARNET, Thrase, FDCycle, and sem2dpack.
2D antiplane numerical benchmarks: a two-fault dynamic rupture problem and a 100-year intersecting X-shaped fault system.
Large-scale 32-year SEAS simulation on a realistic 44-fault network modeled after the Gulf of Corinth extensional rift system.
利用SCEC BP1-FD单断层社区基准算例，与BICycle、GARNET、Thrase、FDCycle和sem2dpack代码进行对比验证。
二维反平面数值基准实验：双断层动态破裂问题以及100年尺度的X型相交断层系统模拟。
基于希腊科林斯湾伸展裂谷系统构建的包含44条主断层的真实断层网络32年尺度SEAS大规模模拟。
li: Restricted to 2D antiplane (mode III) deformation in a homogeneous, isotropic, unbounded linear elastic medium without explicit free-surface boundaries.
Uses an explicit adaptive time-stepping scheme without step-by-step error control, and relies on SVD compression which can be slower than algebraic alternatives like ACA in 3D.
目前仅限于均匀、各向同性、无界线弹性介质中的二维反平面（III型）变形，未显式包含自由地表边界。
自适应显式时间步进方案缺乏单步误差控制，且H矩阵压缩依赖计算成本较高的SVD而非自适应交叉近似（ACA）。

tm.why: The paper develops an elastodynamic boundary integral method to simulate dynamic earthquake ruptures and wave-mediated stress transfer across complex fault networks.
The numerical framework simulates sequences of earthquakes and aseismic slip (SEAS) governed by rate-and-state friction over multi-year earthquake cycles.
The core contribution is a computational acceleration strategy combining spectral boundary integral methods and hierarchical matrices to reduce computational complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2 log N).

ev.notes: Full 40-page preprint PDF (including Appendices A-D, 15 figures, and 3 tables) was analyzed in detail.

sum: Temporal variations in earthquake rates are widely studied as indicators of stress evolution or precursory processes, yet their observability is constrained by finite counts, clustering, and testing design. This study reformulates seismic rate-change assessment as an explicit statistical detectability problem: determining the minimum fractional rate change resolvable for a given baseline rate, window length, significance level, and target power. Exact detectability thresholds are derived for Poisson and overdispersed Negative Binomial (NB) models, incorporating Bonferroni corrections for sliding-window multiplicity. Synthetic experiments and Monte Carlo validations show that overdispersion and multiple testing substantially inflate detection thresholds. Applied to the global USGS ComCat catalog (M ≥ 5.5, 1973–2025), empirical NB thresholds vastly exceed Poisson predictions across sub-annual to decadal timescales. While rolling-window rate fluctuations frequently surpass Poisson limits, they rarely exceed NB thresholds, demonstrating that most apparent global rate anomalies reflect intrinsic clustering variability rather than true non-stationarity.
本研究将地震发生率变化评估重构为统计可检测性问题，推导了泊松和负二项（NB）模型下考虑窗口长度、过度离散及多重检验的精确最小可检测相对率变化阈值。基于蒙特卡洛模拟和USGS全球地震目录（M≥5.5，1973–2025）的分析表明，过度离散和滑动窗口多重检验大幅提高了检测阈值。在亚年至十年尺度上，实际……

t: Formulates controlled hypothesis testing under Poisson and Negative Binomial distributions, solving exact numerical root-finding equations for minimum detectable fractional rate changes given baseline rate, window duration, significance level, target power, and Bonferroni multiplicity corrections.
基于泊松和负二项分布建立受控假设检验，通过精确数值求根计算给定显著性、目标功效及多重检验校正下的最小可检测相对率变化。

Uses the global USGS ANSS Comprehensive Catalog (ComCat) for events with M ≥ 5.5 from 1973 to 2025 without declustering, alongside synthetic Monte Carlo Poisson and Negative Binomial count realizations.
使用1973–2025年M≥5.5的USGS全球未去丛集地震目录（ComCat），并结合泊松和负二项过程的蒙特卡洛合成实…

In the global catalog (λ0 ≈ 471 yr^-1), empirical NB detectability thresholds at T = 1 yr (δmin ≈ 0.570, r ≈ 45.2) far exceed Poisson thresholds (δmin ≈ 0.140), and observed rolling-window deviations almost never surpass NB bounds.
全球目录1年窗口的经验NB检测阈值（0.570）远高于泊松阈值（0.140），实际滑动窗口速率波动几乎从未超出NB阈值。
The empirical overdispersion parameter r is globally and temporally averaged, and the NB model does not explicitly encode physical triggering cascades or transient perturbations.
经验离散参数r在时间和全球空间上取平均，且NB模型未显式编码物理触发级联或渐变扰动。

Reformulates earthquake rate-change assessment from binary stationarity testing to an explicit statistical detectability problem unifying finite counts, NB overdispersion, and multiple-testing penalties.
将地震率变化评估从平稳性二元检验重构为统一有限计数、NB过度离散和多重检验的显式可检测性问题。

kc: Formulates an exact, non-asymptotic statistical framework for the minimum detectable fractional earthquake rate change as a function of baseline rate, window duration, significance level, and statistical power.
Extends rate-change detectability analysis from Poisson processes to overdispersed Negative Binomial (NB) models and accounts for family-wise error rates in sliding-window scans.
Demonstrates using the global USGS catalog (M ≥ 5.5, 1973–2025) that apparent global rate anomalies exceeding Poisson bounds vanish when evaluated against empirical NB thresholds.
构建了非渐近的精确统计框架，将最小可检测相对地震率变化表示为基线率、窗口长度、显著性水平和统计功效的函数。
将地震率变化可检测性分析从泊松过程扩展到过度离散的负二项（NB）模型，并量化了滑动窗口扫描中的多重检验误差惩罚。
利用USGS全球地震目录（M ≥ 5.5，1973–2025）证明，超出泊松界限的表观全球地震率异常在经验NB阈值下几乎完全消失。
me: Exact numerical root-finding of hypothesis test power equations for one-sided rate increases under Poisson and Negative Binomial distributions.
Empirical scale-dependent estimation of the NB dispersion parameter r from nonoverlapping time windows without prior declustering.
Bonferroni multiple-testing correction for sliding-window analyses and Monte Carlo simulations (50,000 realizations per configuration) for validation.
对泊松分布和负二项分布下的单侧地震率增加假设检验功效方程进行精确数值求根。
在不进行去丛集处理的情况下，利用非重叠时间窗口经验估计尺度相关的NB离散参数r。
针对滑动窗口分析引入Bonferroni多重检验校正，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟（每组配置5万次实现）验证解析阈值。
de: Synthetic stationary Poisson and Negative Binomial catalogs across wide ranges of expected counts and dispersion parameters (r from 1 to 100).
Global USGS ANSS Comprehensive Catalog (ComCat) for M ≥ 5.5 from 1 January 1973 to 31 December 2025 (mean rate ~471 yr^-1), plus a shallow subset (depth ≤ 70 km).
涵盖不同期望事件数和离散参数（r从1到100）的合成平稳泊松和负二项分布地震目录。
1973年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间M ≥ 5.5的USGS全球综合地震目录（ComCat，平均发生率约471次/年）及浅源子集（深度≤70 km）。
li: Assumes a constant, time-invariant dispersion parameter r within each analysis timescale, neglecting dynamic temporal variations in clustering and aftershock productivity.
Global spatial aggregation mixes heterogeneous tectonic regimes, and the NB model does not explicitly encode physical triggering mechanisms or long-range correlations.
Focuses strictly on stepwise rate perturbations within fixed windows rather than gradual or transient rate changes.
假设每个分析时间尺度内的离散参数r为常数，忽略了丛集性和余震生产力随时间的动态变化。
全球空间聚合混合了不同构造环境，且NB模型未显式编码物理触发机制或长程时间相关性。
分析仅针对固定时间窗口内的阶跃式地震率扰动，未直接建模渐变或瞬态速率变化。

tm.why: The paper explicitly analyzes statistical detectability limits of earthquake rate changes in synthetic and global USGS ComCat earthquake catalogs.
It evaluates non-Poissonian Negative Binomial count distributions and statistical power for detecting seismic activation and quiescence relevant to hazard forecasting.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF of the Seismological Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including equations, synthetic Monte Carlo validations, USGS ComCat global catalog application, and all 7 figures.

sum: Slip distribution along tectonic faults is highly heterogeneous, often thought to be controlled by nonplanar fault geometry, yet experimental validation of theoretical models has been lacking. This study combines high-resolution slip measurements from controlled laboratory earthquakes on PMMA plates—captured via ultrahigh-speed photography and Digital Image Correlation—with analytical scaling models. The authors test interfaces ranging from simple restraining and releasing double-bends (5° to 25°) to multiscale self-similar rough faults. Results confirm that local slip gradients are directly proportional to local fault curvature under both Mode I (opening) and Mode II (contacting shear) conditions. Furthermore, spectral analysis of self-similar rough faults shows that while fault geometry power spectral density scales with wavelength with an exponent of 3, the resulting slip distribution scales with an exponent of 1. This provides the first direct experimental evidence that slip variability can be mechanically predicted from known fault geometry.
针对断层几何形态如何控制同震滑移分布这一问题，本研究结合受控实验室地震实验与解析标度模型进行了验证。作者在具有双弯曲（5°至25°）及自相似粗糙界面的有机玻璃（PMMA）板上诱发动态剪切破裂，利用超高速摄影和数字图像相关技术（DIC）获取高分辨率滑移演化数据。结果证实局部滑移梯度与断层曲率成正比。功……

t: Spontaneous shear ruptures are nucleated along CNC-milled nonplanar PMMA interfaces under 15 MPa uniaxial load, imaged at 1 µs intervals with Digital Image Correlation to compare measured slip gradients against analytical curvature scaling laws.
在15 MPa单轴加载的非平面PMMA板上诱发动态破裂，用1微秒超高速摄影和DIC测量滑移并与解析曲率标度律对比。

Laboratory experiments on 2 cm wide restraining and releasing bends (5° to 25° angles) and 10 cm wide self-similar rough patches (H = 1, α = 0.004–0.012, minimum wavelength 2–10 mm) imaged at 58–112 µm pixel resolution.
2厘米宽双弯曲（5°–25°）及10厘米宽自相似粗糙界面（H=1，α=0.004–0.012，最小波长2–10毫米）实验…

Normalized slip gradients match analytical curvature predictions for bends ≥10° and rough faults; rough fault geometry PSD scales as wavelength cubed (exponent 3) while shear slip PSD scales linearly with wavelength (exponent 1).
归一化滑移梯度与曲率预测吻合（弯曲≥10°）；粗糙断层几何PSD幂律指数为3，而滑移分布PSD幂律指数为1。

Scaling fails for small bend angles (5°), underestimates releasing bend slip gradients by factors of 1.5–3 due to mixed-mode contact, and produces artificial extrema at restraining-releasing transitions.
5°小角度弯曲无法分辨，拉张弯曲滑移梯度被低估1.5–3倍，且挤压与拉张转换带存在不连续伪影。
First direct experimental validation of the mechanical link between fault curvature and slip gradient, proving that rough fault geometry and slip follow power laws with distinct exponents (3 vs. 1).
首次实验验证断层曲率对滑移梯度的控制，证明粗糙断层滑移分布服从不同于断层几何的幂律指数（1对3）。

kc: Provides the first experimental validation that local fault slip gradients are directly proportional to local fault curvature.
Demonstrates both experimentally and analytically that self-similar rough faults (PSD slope of 3) produce fractal slip distributions with a smoother PSD slope of 1.
Validates distinct analytical scaling formulations for restraining (Mode II frictional contact) and releasing (Mode I opening) fault geometries.
首次通过实验证实局部断层滑移梯度与局部断层曲率成正比。
从实验和解析两方面证明自相似粗糙断层（功率谱斜率为3）会产生更平滑的分形滑移分布（功率谱斜率为1）。
验证了挤压弯曲（II型摩擦接触）和拉张弯曲（I型张开）断层几何形态的不同解析标度公式。
me: Laboratory shear rupture experiments on uniaxially loaded PMMA plates (15 MPa) with CNC-milled nonplanar interfaces.
Ultrahigh-speed imaging (1 microsecond frame rate) coupled with Digital Image Correlation (DIC) to resolve full-field displacements and on-fault shear slip.
Analytical stress equilibrium scaling linking shear slip gradients to fault curvature for contacting (Mode II) and opening (Mode I) fault limbs.
Power Spectral Density (PSD) analysis connecting the wavelength scaling of fault geometry height to shear slip profiles.
在单轴加载（15 MPa）且具有数控铣削非平面界面的PMMA板上进行实验室动态剪切破裂实验。
结合超高速摄影（1微秒帧率）与数字图像相关技术（DIC），解析全场位移演化和断层剪切滑移。
应用静态应力平衡解析标度律，将接触（II型）和张开（I型）断层段的剪切滑移梯度与断层曲率联系起来。
利用功率谱密度（PSD）分析建立断层几何高度与剪切滑移剖面之间的波长标度关系。
de: Restraining and releasing double-bend PMMA fault interfaces (2 cm wide) with bend angles ranging from 5° to 25°.
Multiscale self-similar rough fault interfaces (10 cm wide, Hurst exponent H = 1) with roughness prefactors α = 0.004–0.012 and minimum wavelengths λ_min between 2 and 10 mm.
Full-field displacement maps captured at FOV sizes of ~10x8 cm² and ~5x4 cm² (pixel sizes of 112 and 58 microns).
弯曲角度在5°至25°之间的2厘米宽挤压型和拉张型双弯曲PMMA断层界面实验。
10厘米宽的多尺度自相似粗糙断层界面实验（Hurst指数H=1，粗糙度前因子α=0.004–0.012，最小波长λ_min为2至10毫米）。
在约10×8平方厘米和5×4平方厘米视场下获取的全场位移图（像素尺寸分别为112微米和58微米）。
li: Analytical scaling cannot be reliably resolved for very small bend angles (e.g., 5° deviation from planarity; requires at least 10°).
Transition zones between restraining and releasing limbs exhibit mixed-mode (Mode I and II) displacements, creating artificial extrema and discontinuities in predicted slip gradients.
In releasing bends, the pure-opening analytical formulation underestimates the measured slip gradient amplitude by a factor of 1.5 to 3 due to partial contact.
对于极小的弯曲角度（如偏离平面5°），解析标度律无法可靠分辨（实验中需至少10°）。
挤压段与拉张段过渡区存在I型和II型混合位移，导致预测的滑移梯度出现不连续和人为极值伪影。
在拉张弯曲实验中，由于部分区域保持接触，纯张开解析公式将实测滑移梯度低估了1.5至3倍。

tm.why: The paper investigates how fault geometry and roughness control slip distribution during dynamic laboratory earthquake ruptures.
The study validates analytical mechanical scaling relationships linking fault curvature, frictional contact/opening modes, and local slip gradients.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including equations, experimental methods, and all 4 figures.

sum: This study investigates how fault interactions control slip behavior using 3-D quasi-dynamic earthquake sequence simulations of two parallel faults with uniform rate-weakening friction, accelerated by hierarchical matrices. The authors identify four distinct slip regimes—periodic earthquakes, coexisting slow slip events (SSEs) and earthquakes, only SSEs, and complex sequences—whereas a single planar fault produces only fast earthquakes. They introduce a normalized Coulomb stress metric to quantify interaction based solely on geometry, independent of friction or nucleation length. The simulations successfully reproduce observed moment-duration scaling and demonstrate that geometric complexity alone can generate both slow and fast earthquakes through evolving traction heterogeneity.
本研究利用分层矩阵加速的三维准动态地震序列模拟，探讨了具有均匀速率弱化摩擦的两个平行断层之间的相互作用如何控制滑动行为。研究发现了四种滑动状态：周期性地震、慢滑事件（SSE）与地震共存、仅有SSE以及复杂序列，而单一平面断层仅产生快地震。作者引入了一种标准化的库仑应力指标来量化仅取决于几何形状的相互……

t: 3-D quasi-dynamic earthquake sequence simulations of parallel faults with uniform rate-weakening friction, accelerated using hierarchical matrices.
采用分层矩阵加速的、具有均匀速率弱化摩擦的平行断层三维准动态地震序列模拟。
Synthetic earthquake sequences generated from numerical simulations of parallel fault systems under varying geometric configurations.
在不同几何配置下，通过平行断层系统的数值模拟生成的合成地震序列数据。
Identification of four slip regimes and quantification of interaction using a normalized Coulomb stress metric, reproducing observed moment-duration scaling.
确定了四种滑动状态，并利用标准化的库仑应力指标量化了相互作用，重现了观测到的矩-持续时间标度。
The simplified parallel fault setup and quasi-dynamic approximation limit direct application to highly irregular natural fault networks.
简化的平行断层设置和准动态近似限制了其在高度不规则自然断层网络中的直接应用。
Demonstrating that geometric complexity alone, without frictional heterogeneity, can generate both slow and fast earthquakes on rate-weakening faults.
证明了仅靠几何复杂性（无需摩擦非均匀性）即可在速率弱化断层上产生慢地震和快地震。

kc: Demonstrated that 3D geometric interactions between parallel faults can generate slow slip events (SSEs) under uniform rate-weakening friction.
Identified four distinct slip regimes controlled by the degree of fault interaction.
Developed a geometry-only metric based on normalized maximum Coulomb stress to quantify fault interactions independent of friction parameters.
证明了在均匀速率弱化摩擦条件下，平行断层之间的三维几何相互作用可以产生慢滑事件（SSE）。
确定了受断层相互作用程度控制的四种不同滑动状态。
开发了一种基于标准化最大库仑应力的纯几何指标，用于量化独立于摩擦参数的断层相互作用。
me: 3-D quasi-dynamic earthquake sequence simulations on parallel rate-weakening faults.
Hierarchical matrices (H-matrices) acceleration for computational efficiency.
Quantification of fault interaction using maximum Coulomb stress induced by a spatially uniform unit stress drop.
在平行速率弱化断层上进行三维准动态地震序列模拟。
采用分层矩阵（H-matrices）加速以提高计算效率。
利用空间均匀单位应力降引起的最大库仑应力来量化断层相互作用。
de: Numerical simulations of two parallel faults under varying spatial separations and geometric configurations.
Analysis of synthetic moment-duration scaling relationships compared against real-world observations.
在不同空间间距和几何配置下对两个平行断层进行数值模拟。
分析合成的矩-持续时间标度关系，并与实际观测进行对比。
li: The model uses a simplified parallel fault geometry which may not capture the full complexity of natural anastomosing or rough fault networks.
The simulations are quasi-dynamic rather than fully dynamic, neglecting inertial wave propagation effects.
该模型采用了简化的平行断层几何结构，可能无法完全捕捉自然界中分叉或粗糙断层网络的全部复杂性。
模拟是准动态的而非完全动态的，忽略了惯性波传播效应。

tm.why: The paper models slow slip events and fast earthquakes on parallel faults to understand how geometric interactions control slip behavior.
It uses 3-D quasi-dynamic earthquake sequence simulations to study slip regimes and rupture behavior on complex fault geometries.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from ESS Open Archive, as no full PDF text was available in the input.

sum: The origin of mid-mantle seismic discontinuities (700–1400 km) is debated between dehydration partial melting and compositional heterogeneity from subducted oceanic crust. Standard time-domain stacking of SS and PP precursors struggles to resolve true reflection polarity due to interfering multiples and source wavelet sidelobes. This study introduces a novel two-stage processing framework combining curvelet-based wavefield separation with extended-time multitaper spectral deconvolution to recover true reflectivity and polarity. Validated on AxiSEM global synthetic waveforms derived from Perple_X mineral physics models, the method is applied to over 100,000 broadband SS and PP waveforms beneath the Central Pacific. The authors detect a coherent 800-km discontinuity across both plume ('Melt') and background ('NoMelt') regions with a sharp positive shear velocity contrast (+4% to +5.2%) and negligible density contrast (~0%). This rules out partial melting and instead supports a layer of stagnant, eclogitized oceanic crust in thermal equilibrium with the ambient mantle.
本研究针对地幔中部（700–1400 km）地震间断面的成因争议（脱水部分熔融或俯冲洋壳组分异质性），提出了一种结合曲波变换波场分离与扩展多锥度谱反褶积的两步信号处理框架，有效消除了多次波干扰与震源子波旁瓣导致的极性模糊。研究利用基于Perple_X矿物物理约束的AxiSEM合成波形验证了该方法，并……

t: A two-stage signal processing framework combining multiscale directional curvelet filtering to mute interfering multiples with extended-time multitaper spectral deconvolution to remove source wavelet sidelobes, followed by a 2-D grid search amplitude inversion.
结合曲波变换波场分离与扩展多锥度谱反褶积的两步法，配合反射振幅二维网格搜索反演。

Over 100,000 broadband SS and PP waveforms (0.005–0.05 Hz) from M ≥ 6 earthquakes at 100°–180° epicentral distances recorded by USArray and GSN, sampling 'Melt' and 'NoMelt' subregions in the Central Pacific.
USArray和GSN记录的中太平洋超10万条宽频带SS和PP波形及AxiSEM合成数据。

Detects a coherent 800-km discontinuity in SS precursors with positive shear velocity contrast (+4.0% in Melt, +5.2% in NoMelt) and negligible density contrast (+0.5% and -0.4%), ruling out partial melt in favor of stagnant eclogitized crust.
800公里间断面在熔融和背景区均呈正剪切波速跃变（+4.0%和+5.2%）及近零密度对比。
Empirical PP precursors lack a clear P800P signal due to low SNR and interference, restricting real-data inversion to SS precursors and leaving density contrasts subject to trade-offs.
实测PP前驱波信噪比低且缺乏P800P震相，导致实测反演仅限SS数据，密度约束受限。

Integrates curvelet wavefield separation and extended multitaper deconvolution into a unified workflow for joint SS/PP precursor imaging, resolving source-sidelobe polarity ambiguity in mid-mantle reflections.
首次将曲波去噪与扩展多锥度反褶积结合用于SS/PP前驱波成像，解决旁瓣极性模糊问题。

kc: Introduces a unified two-stage signal processing workflow combining curvelet wavefield separation and extended-time multitaper (ETMT) deconvolution to resolve polarity ambiguity in SS and PP precursors.
Demonstrates through AxiSEM synthetic tests that joint SS and PP amplitude inversion breaks the velocity-density trade-off and discriminates between basalt enrichment and dehydration melting.
Detects a coherent 800-km discontinuity beneath both plume and background regions in the Central Pacific with a +4.0% to +5.2% shear velocity contrast and near-zero density contrast.
Provides direct seismic evidence for a 'density paradox' explained by thermally equilibrated, neutrally buoyant delaminated oceanic crust stagnating above a ~1000-km viscosity barrier.
提出了一种结合曲波波场分离和扩展时间多锥度（ETMT）反褶积的统一两阶段信号处理流程，解决了SS和PP前驱波中的极性模糊问题。
通过AxiSEM合成测试证明，联合SS和PP振幅反演可打破速度-密度折衷，区分玄武岩富集和脱水熔融。
在中太平洋的地幔柱和背景区域下方均检测到相干的800公里间断面，具有+4.0%至+5.2%的剪切波速度对比和接近零的密度对比。
为“密度悖论”提供了直接的地震学证据，将其解释为在约1000公里粘度屏障上方停滞的热平衡、中性浮力的拆沉洋壳。
me: 1-D thermochemical modeling using Perple_X and Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging for pyrolite, harzburgite, and basalt mixtures, plus PREM low-velocity zones.
Global spectral-element synthetic wavefield simulation down to a 4-s minimum period using AxiSEM.
Curvelet-based directional wavefield separation to mute crossing interfering phases (e.g., ScS, PcP multiples) without global smearing.
Extended-time multitaper (ETMT) frequency-domain spectral deconvolution using orthogonal Slepian tapers to collapse source wavelets.
Deterministic 2-D grid search inversion of linear-stacked (N=1) reflection amplitudes using exact Aki-Richards solid-solid reflection coefficients.
使用Perple_X和Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均法对地幔岩、方辉橄榄岩和玄武岩混合物以及PREM低速带进行一维热化学建模。
使用AxiSEM进行最短周期达4秒的全球谱元法合成波场模拟。
基于曲波变换的方向性波场分离，在不产生全局涂抹的情况下压制交叉干扰震相（如ScS、PcP多次波）。
利用正交Slepian锥度进行扩展时间多锥度（ETMT）频域谱反褶积，以压缩震源子波。
利用精确的Aki-Richards固-固反射系数，对线性叠加（N=1）反射振幅进行确定性二维网格搜索反演。
de: Synthetic global SS and PP record sections (100°–180° epicentral distance, 0.005–0.05 Hz) for 40% basalt enrichment and -2.6% dehydration melt models.
Over 100,000 broadband SS and PP waveforms (M ≥ 6, 100°–180° distance) from the USArray Transportable Array and Global Seismographic Network sampling the Central Pacific.
Division of Pacific bounce points into a Hawaiian plume 'Melt' subset and a southern background 'NoMelt' control subset based on GLAD-M35 tomography.
针对40%玄武岩富集和-2.6%脱水熔融模型的全球SS和PP合成记录剖面（震中距100°–180°，滤波0.005–0.05 Hz）。
来自USArray流动台阵和全球地震台网（GSN）采样中太平洋的超过10万条宽频带SS和PP波形（M ≥ 6，震中距100°–180°）。
基于GLAD-M35层析成像模型，将太平洋反射点划分为夏威夷地幔柱“Melt”子集和南部背景“NoMelt”对照子集。
li: PP precursors (especially P660P and P800P) exhibit low signal-to-noise ratios and complex phase interference in real Pacific data, preventing empirical joint SS-PP inversion.
Because empirical inversion is restricted to SS precursors alone, the recovered density contrast suffers from vertical trade-off elongation and is less constrained than shear velocity.
在实际太平洋数据中，PP前驱波（尤其是P660P和P800P）信噪比低且震相干扰复杂，阻碍了实测数据的SS-PP联合反演。
由于实测反演仅限于SS前驱波，恢复的密度对比存在垂向折衷拉长，其约束程度弱于剪切波速度。

tm.why: The paper develops a signal processing framework combining curvelet filtering and extended multitaper deconvolution to image mid-mantle seismic discontinuities using SS and PP underside reflection precursors.
The study investigates the thermochemical origin of an 800-km mid-mantle discontinuity beneath the Central Pacific, distinguishing between dehydration melting and stagnant subducted oceanic crust.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF analysed, including methodology equations, synthetic AxiSEM tests, USArray/GSN Pacific data processing, 13 main figures, and 12 supplementary figure captions.

sum: This study conducts ultrasonic wave-speed measurements on rock samples from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone (Olympic Subduction Complex), an exhumed analog of the Cascadia megathrust. The laboratory results reveal that lithology, structural fabric, and deformation styles control seismic properties, yielding high anisotropy (up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs). Upscaled composite velocities match in-situ geophysical observations, demonstrating that the subduction low-velocity zone is primarily driven by the intrinsic elastic properties and fabric of accreted metasediments. Furthermore, the derived shear moduli (20.0–30.1 GPa) are lower than geophysical estimates, suggesting that fabric development acts as a critical weakening mechanism offsetting burial-related stiffening.
本研究对卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲断裂带的露头模拟样品（奥林匹克俯冲杂岩体）进行了超声波速度测量。实验结果表明，岩性、结构面理发育和变形样式控制着地震波速，产生高达25.6%的Vp各向异性和31.6%的Vs各向异性。按比例加权获得的复合速度与原位地球物理观测高度吻合，表明俯冲带低速区主要由增生变质沉积物及其……

t: Ultrasonic wave-speed measurements on exhumed fault-zone samples combined with volumetric upscaling based on mapped lithologic abundance.
对露头断裂带样品进行超声波速测量，并结合基于填图岩性丰度的体积放大估算。
Metasedimentary rock samples from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex, serving as a Cascadia megathrust analog.
采集自奥林匹克俯冲杂岩体Lakes of the Gods断裂带的变质沉积岩样品（卡斯卡迪亚类比）。
Measured seismic anisotropy up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs, with directional shear moduli ranging between 20.0 and 30.1 GPa.
测得纵波各向异性达25.6%，横波达31.6%，定向剪切模量介于20.0至30.1 GPa之间。
Extrapolating exhumed, dry, or depressurized laboratory samples to active, fluid-rich in-situ subduction conditions at 13-14 km depth.
将露头、干燥或卸压的实验室样品外推至13-14公里深度富含流体的实际活动俯冲带环境存在局限。
Directly linking laboratory-measured lithologic fabric anisotropy to the observed low-velocity zones in subduction megathrusts without solely relying on fluid overpressure.
直接将实验室测得的岩性面理各向异性与俯冲带低速区联系起来，而不仅依赖于流体超压解释。

kc: Quantified high seismic anisotropy (up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs) in exhumed Cascadia megathrust analog rocks.
Demonstrated that the subduction low-velocity zone can be explained by the intrinsic elastic properties and fabric of accreted metasediments rather than solely high fluid pressure.
Identified fabric development as a critical weakening mechanism that lowers shear moduli (20.0–30.1 GPa) and offsets burial-related stiffening.
定量化了卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲断裂带模拟岩石的高地震各向异性（Vp达25.6%，Vs达31.6%）。
证实了俯冲带低速区可由增生变质沉积物的固有弹性性质和面理来解释，而非完全取决于高流体压力。
确定了面理发育是降低剪切模量（20.0-30.1 GPa）并抵消埋藏硬化效应的关键软化机制。
me: Ultrasonic wave-speed measurements on exhumed fault-zone rock samples under laboratory conditions.
Upscaling of laboratory measurements to composite larger-scale velocities by weighting according to mapped fault-zone unit abundance.
在实验室条件下对露头断裂带岩石样品进行超声波速度测量。
根据制图的断裂带单元丰度进行加权，将实验室测量结果外推至大尺度复合速度。
de: Rock samples collected from the Lakes of the Gods fault zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex, USA.
Laboratory measurements of directional P-wave and S-wave velocities to calculate anisotropy and directional shear moduli.
采集自美国奥林匹克俯冲杂岩体Lakes of the Gods断裂带的岩石样品。
定向纵波（P波）和横波（S波）速度的实验室测量，用于计算各向异性和定向剪切模量。
li: Laboratory measurements on exhumed samples may not fully capture the in-situ pore pressure and fluid conditions of the active modern Cascadia megathrust.
对露头样品进行的实验室测量可能无法完全捕捉现代活动卡斯卡迪亚巨型逆冲断裂带的原位孔隙压力和流体状态。

tm.why: The paper investigates the elastic properties and fabric development of an exhumed subduction fault zone to understand weakening mechanisms and earthquake source physics.
The study measures ultrasonic wave-speeds to characterize seismic anisotropy (up to 25.6% for Vp and 31.6% for Vs) in fault-zone rocks.
It links laboratory-measured elastic properties of accreted metasediments to the low-velocity zones observed in subduction zone crustal structures.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Meteoroids entering Earth's atmosphere generate shock waves that couple into the ground and are recorded by seismic networks. However, open datasets of labeled meteoroid seismic waveforms are scarce. This study introduces the Seismo-acoustic Meteoroid Observation Recording Database (SMORD v1.0), compiled by cross-referencing IMO and NASA CNEOS fireball catalogs with global seismic archives. SMORD contains 310 meteoroid events (plus 6 space-debris re-entries) and 3,295 manually labeled air-to-ground coupled arrivals across 1,772 stations, graded with a three-level quality scheme. Using SMORD with station-level splits and data augmentation, the authors train a PhaseNet picker from scratch in SeisBench. On test data, the picker achieves 91% precision, 94% recall (AUC 0.89), and a median absolute timing error of 0.02 s. Finally, the authors demonstrate automated arrival picking and 3D ray-tracing particle swarm optimization (infraGA) to reconstruct the trajectory of an April 2025 Adriatic fireball.
流星体进入地球大气层产生的冲击波耦合到地下并被地震台网记录，但目前缺乏公开的标注数据集。本文通过交叉比对IMO和NASA CNEOS火流星目录与全球地震波形档案，构建了流星体震声观测记录数据库（SMORD v1.0），包含1,772个台站记录的310个流星体事件（及6个太空碎片再入事件）和3,295……

t: A PhaseNet convolutional neural network in SeisBench is trained from scratch on 100 Hz 3-component waveforms using an 80/10/10 station-level split and three data generators (centered onsets, rotated/noisy augmented onsets, and noise windows).
采用80/10/10台站级划分和三种数据增强生成器，在SeisBench中基于100 Hz三分量波形从头训练PhaseN…

SMORD v1.0 compiles 3,295 manually quality-graded seismo-acoustic phase picks from 310 meteoroid and 6 space-debris re-entry events across 1,772 global seismic stations, cross-referenced from IMO and NASA CNEOS catalogs.
SMORD v1.0汇编了全球1,772个地震台站记录的310个流星体和6个再入事件共3,295个手动分级震声初至拾取。
On the unseen test split, the PhaseNet picker achieves 91% precision, 94% recall (F1 = 0.93) at a 0.5 threshold, an AUC of 0.89, and a median absolute timing error of 0.02 s.
在测试集上（阈值0.5），模型达到91%精确率、94%召回率、AUC为0.89，中位绝对拾取时间误差仅0.02秒。

Eyewitness-driven IMO reports bias the dataset toward Europe, North America, and waking hours, while unmodeled atmospheric variability and outlier picks still require manual curation for trajectory fitting.
目击报告导致欧美及昼间采样偏差，且未建模大气风场变化及少量离群拾取仍需人工核查校正。
Introduces the first open, globally curated waveform dataset and deep-learning phase picker specifically trained for meteoroid-generated air-to-ground coupled seismic waves.
构建了首个针对流星体气-地耦合地震波的全球开放标注波形数据库及专用深度学习震相拾取器。

kc: Compiled SMORD v1.0, an open global dataset of 310 meteoroid events (plus 6 re-entry events) and 3,295 manually labeled air-to-ground coupled seismic phase arrivals across 1,772 stations.
Trained a PhaseNet deep-learning phase picker from scratch in SeisBench using station-level splits and on-the-fly augmentation, achieving 91% precision, 94% recall, and 0.02 s median timing error.

Demonstrated a 4-step workflow combining automated PhaseNet picking with 3-D acoustic ray tracing (infraGA) and particle swarm optimization to reconstruct the trajectory of the April 2025 Adriatic fireball.
构建了公开的全球数据库SMORD v1.0，包含1,772个台站记录的310个流星体事件（外加6个再入事件）和3,295个手动标注的气-地耦合地震初至。
在SeisBench中使用台站级数据划分和实时数据增强从头训练了PhaseNet深度学习震相拾取器，取得91%精确率、94%召回率和0.02秒中位时间误差。
展示了结合PhaseNet自动拾取、三维声学射线追踪（infraGA）和粒子群优化的四步工作流，成功重建了2025年4月亚得里亚海火流星轨迹。
me: Manual phase picking of impulsive negative-polarity vertical-component W-shaped wavelets (1–20 Hz) around a 330 m/s acoustic moveout window, graded into quality classes 0, 1, and 2.

Deep learning phase picker training using SeisBench PhaseNet architecture from scratch with an 80/10/10 station-level split, three data generators (centered, rotated/noisy augmented, and noise-only), AdamW, and cosine annealing.
Meteoroid trajectory reconstruction via bootstrapped Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) coupled with 3-D acoustic ray tracing (infraGA) through heterogeneous wind-bearing atmospheric models.
围绕330 m/s声波时距窗口，手动拾取垂直分量上1–20 Hz的脉冲型负极性W形子波，并按清晰度和信噪比分为0、1、2三个质量等级。
基于SeisBench中的PhaseNet架构从头训练深度学习拾取器，采用80/10/10台站级划分、三个数据生成器（居中正样本、水平旋转加噪增强样本、纯噪声样本）、AdamW优化器及余弦退火。
结合三维声学射线追踪（infraGA，考虑含风场的非均匀大气模型）与自助法粒子群优化（PSO）反演重建流星体轨迹。
de: IMO Fireball Program catalog (2010–2024 events with ≥100 observer reports, searched within 3° radius) and NASA CNEOS catalog (1988–2024 events with yield ≥0.3 kt TNT, searched within 5° radius).
Continuous seismic waveforms retrieved via public FDSN services (EIDA, IRIS, NCEDC, SCEDC, Raspberry Shake), resampled to 100 Hz for SeisBench packaging.
Case study application on the 12 April 2025 Adriatic Sea fireball (IMO Event 2025-2077 / FRIPON Event 24644) using regional stations within 2.5°.
IMO火流星目录（2010–2024年间目击报告≥100次的事件，搜索半径3°）和NASA CNEOS目录（1988–2024年间当量≥0.3千吨TNT的事件，搜索半径5°）。
通过公共FDSN服务（EIDA、IRIS、NCEDC、SCEDC、Raspberry Shake）获取的连续地震波形，重采样至100 Hz并封装为SeisBench数据集。
对2025年4月12日亚得里亚海火流星事件（IMO 2025-2077 / FRIPON 24644）开展案例研究，使用2.5°范围内的区域地震台站数据。
li: Strong spatial and diurnal biases in SMORD due to reliance on human eyewitnesses (IMO), clustering in North America and Europe and during human waking hours.
Trajectory reconstruction from purely automatic picks remains sensitive to false-positive outlier picks, requiring slight manual curation or expansion of SMORD training data.

Atmospheric state variability (winds and temperature stratification) was not explicitly modeled during initial phase identification, and individual waveforms cannot easily discriminate fragmentation point sources from Mach cone line sources.
由于依赖目击者报告（IMO），SMORD存在明显的空间和昼夜偏差，事件主要集中在北美和欧洲以及人类清醒时段。
纯自动拾取结果的轨迹重建对假阳性离群拾取较为敏感，仍需少量人工核查校正或进一步扩充训练数据集。
初始震相识别未显式模拟大气状态变化（风场和温度分层），且单道波形难以区分流星体碎裂点源与马赫锥线源。

tm.why: The paper trains and evaluates a deep-learning PhaseNet phase picker in SeisBench specifically for meteoroid-generated seismo-acoustic arrivals.
The study focuses on atmospheric meteoroid impacts (fireballs/bolides) and air-to-ground coupled acoustic-seismic waves.
The authors compile a global labeled catalog (SMORD) of 3,295 phase arrivals from 310 meteoroid events and demonstrate trajectory localization.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§7), all 6 figures, and all 4 tables.

sum: This study systematically investigates membrane (in-plane stretching/shear) and flexural (bending/twisting) stresses in doubly curved subducting slabs. Using idealized boundary-element method (BEM) viscous flow models interpreted via thin-shell theory (TST), alongside a realistic 3D finite-element (ASPECT) viscoplastic model of the Mariana slab, the authors analyze how stresses vary with depth and Gaussian curvature (G). The Mariana slab features adjacent regions of positive and negative G. Key findings show that along-strike (hoop) membrane stress transitions from tensile at shallow depths to compressive at greater depths where G > 0, and reverses where G < 0. Additionally, downdip flexural stress on the slab's upper surface is tensile near the trench and compressive deeper down (unbending). Comparing realistic model predictions with stresses inferred from Global CMT earthquake focal mechanisms in the Mariana slab reveals good agreement for downdip membrane stresses, though along-strike hoop stress agreement is poor.
本研究结合理想边界元（BEM）数值粘性流动模型、薄壳理论（TST）以及马里亚纳俯冲带的真实三维有限元（ASPECT）粘塑性模型，系统研究了双曲率俯冲板片中的薄膜应力和弯曲应力随深度及高斯曲率（G）的变化。研究表明：（1）当G>0时，沿走向（环向）薄膜应力随深度从拉张转为压缩，而G<0时则相反；（2）……

t: The authors combine 3D boundary-element Stokes flow models interpreted via thin-shell theory with a realistic 3D finite-element (ASPECT) viscoplastic model to compute membrane and flexural stresses in subducting slabs.
结合三维边界元流动模型与薄壳理论，以及真实三维有限元（ASPECT）粘塑性模型，计算俯冲板片薄膜和弯曲应力。

Four idealized BEM shell models and a realistic 3D Mariana slab model (using Slab2 geometry, Müller et al. plate motions, and Goldberg & Holt mantle flow) compared against Global CMT earthquakes (Mw > 5.5).
四个理想边界元模型与基于Slab2几何的真实三维马里亚纳板片模型，并与全球CMT地震（Mw>5.5）对比。

Hoop membrane stress transitions from tensile at shallow depths to compressive at greater depths when G > 0, and reverses when G < 0; downdip flexural stress is tensile near the trench and compressive deeper.
G>0时环向薄膜应力随深度从拉张转为压缩，G<0时相反；顺倾向弯曲应力在浅部拉张、深部压缩。
BEM models lack a yield stress and are restricted to isoviscous fluids, while CMT stress comparisons use thickness-averaged membrane stresses that cancel out finite-depth flexural contributions.
边界元模型限于等粘度且无屈服应力；震源机制对比仅用了厚度平均薄膜应力，忽略了弯曲分量。
First systematic study of the state of stress in doubly curved subducting slabs that quantifies both membrane and flexural stress contributions across positive and negative Gaussian curvatures.
首次系统量化了具正负高斯曲率的双曲率俯冲板片中薄膜应力与弯曲应力的共同贡献。

kc: Systematically quantified both membrane and flexural stress distributions in doubly curved subducting slabs using thin-shell theory and 3D numerical models.
Demonstrated that along-strike (hoop) membrane stress transitions from tensile to compressive with depth for positive Gaussian curvature (G > 0), and the reverse for G < 0.
Validated realistic 3D Mariana slab model predictions against CMT earthquake focal mechanisms, finding strong agreement for downdip stresses.
利用薄壳理论和三维数值模型，系统量化了双曲率俯冲板片中的薄膜应力和弯曲应力分布。
证明了当高斯曲率G>0时，沿走向（环向）薄膜应力随深度从拉张变为压缩，而G<0时则相反。
将真实三维马里亚纳板片模型预测结果与CMT地震震源机制进行验证，发现顺倾向应力具有良好的一致性。
me: Thin-shell theory (TST) in lines-of-curvature and general covariant coordinates to decompose velocity fields into membrane and flexural stresses.
3D boundary-element method (BEM) for inertia-free Stokes flow of idealized isoviscous shells.
3D finite-element method (ASPECT) with composite diffusion-dislocation creep and viscoplastic yield stress (100 MPa) for the realistic Izu-Bonin-Mariana slab.
在曲率线坐标系和一般协变坐标系下应用薄壳理论（TST），将速度场分解为薄膜应力和弯曲应力。
利用三维边界元法（BEM）求解理想等粘度壳体的无惯性斯托克斯流动。
使用三维有限元法（ASPECT），结合复合扩散-位错蠕变流变学和100 MPa屈服应力，模拟真实的伊豆-小笠原-马里亚纳板片。
de: Four idealized BEM shell models: axisymmetric shell of revolution (G > 0), 3D bounded shells with G > 0 and G < 0, and an idealized Mariana slab with both G > 0 and G < 0.
Realistic 3D Mariana slab geometry derived from Slab2 and seismic tomography, driven by plate motions and global mantle convection boundary conditions.
Earthquake focal mechanisms (Mw >= 5.5) from the Global CMT catalog rotated into local slab coordinates.
四个理想BEM壳体模型：轴对称旋转壳体（G>0）、具有G>0和G<0的三维有界壳体，以及兼具正负高斯曲率的理想马里亚纳板片模型。
基于Slab2和地震层析成像构建的真实三维马里亚纳板片几何模型，由板块运动和全球地幔对流边界条件驱动。
来自全球CMT目录的板内地震震源机制解（Mw >= 5.5），并旋转至局部板片坐标系。
li: The BEM/TST models are restricted to isoviscous fluids and lack a yield stress, resulting in unrealistically high flexural stresses (~1 GPa).

Comparing thickness-averaged membrane stresses to earthquake CMTs neglects finite-depth flexural stress contributions at actual hypocenters and complex southern boundary tectonics (Caroline plate/Yap trench).
BEM/TST模型局限于等粘度流体且不包含屈服应力，导致预测的弯曲应力过高（约1 GPa）。
将厚度平均的薄膜应力与地震CMT对比忽略了震源有限深度处的弯曲应力贡献，且未包含南部复杂的构造背景（卡罗琳板块/雅浦海沟）。

tm.why: The paper investigates the state of membrane and flexural stresses in doubly curved subducting slabs using 3D viscous flow numerical models and thin-shell theory.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations in Appendices A and B, all 12 figures, and Table 1.

sum: This study uses 2-D time-dependent numerical subduction models to investigate how evolving plate velocities control the timing and spatial distribution of metamorphic rock exhumation and underplating. By imposing velocities from a freely evolving model onto kinematically driven models, the authors isolate the effects of velocity variations. They find that exhumation is consistently initiated by detachment events following decreases in subduction velocity. Shallow exhumation (<50 km) occurs via corner flow, whereas deeper underplating (<140 km) involves crustal slicing. Weak interfaces promote continuous exhumation, while strong interfaces restrict it to brief, punctuated episodes.
本研究利用二维时变俯冲数值模型，探讨了板块运动速度演化对变质岩折返和底侵时空分布的控制作用。研究通过将自由演化模型中提取的板块速度施加于运动学驱动模型，隔离了速度变化的影响。结果表明，俯冲速度降低后触发的剥离事件一致性地启动了折返过程。浅部折返（<50 km）通过增生楔内的角流进行，而深部底侵（<1……

t: 2-D time-dependent subduction modeling combining kinematically driven boundary conditions extracted from freely evolving models with variable interface rheologies.
结合从自由演化模型中提取的时变边界速度与可变界面流变学的二维数值模拟方法。
Synthetic velocity and rheological datasets generated from 2-D numerical simulations of subducting slabs and plate interfaces.
基于二维俯冲带数值模拟生成的合成板块速度、流变学参数及地壳变形演化数据。
Exhumation initiates during detachment events following subduction velocity decreases, with shallow corner flow (<50 km) and deep crustal slicing (<140 km) controlling transport.
俯冲减速触发剥离并启动折返，浅部表现为角流，深部表现为地壳切片与底侵。
The simplified 2-D geometry isolates velocity effects but excludes complex 3-D slab dynamics and along-strike rheological variations.
采用二维简化模型，未考虑三维板块边缘效应及复杂的沿走向流变学非均匀性。
Demonstrating that realistic, time-dependent plate velocity variations naturally produce the punctuated exhumation and underplating observed in the metamorphic rock record.

kc: Demonstrated that time-dependent plate velocity variations exert primary control on the timing of exhumation and underplating.
Identified distinct mechanisms for shallow exhumation (corner flow, <50 km) versus deep underplating (crustal slicing, <140 km).
Revealed that interface strength dictates whether exhumation is continuous (weak interface) or punctuated (strong interface).
证明了随时间变化的板块速度波动对折返和底侵的时机具有主要的控制作用。
识别出浅部折返（角流，<50 km）与深部底侵（地壳切片，<140 km）的不同物理机制。
揭示了界面强度决定了折返是连续的（弱界面）还是间歇性的（强界面）。
me: 2-D time-dependent numerical modeling of subduction zones.
Kinematically driven modeling using plate velocities extracted from a freely evolving dynamic subduction model.
Parametric variation of interface rheology and composition to test interface strength.
俯冲带二维时变数值模拟。
利用从自由演化动力学俯冲模型中提取的板块速度进行运动学驱动模拟。
改变界面流变学和成分的参数化实验，以测试界面强度的影响。
de: Synthetic velocity profiles extracted from a 2-D freely evolving geodynamic model of subduction.
Numerical simulations of crustal deformation, slicing, and transport along the plate interface.
从二维自由演化地球动力学俯冲模型中提取的合成速度剖面。
沿板块界面地壳变形、切片和运移的数值模拟。
li: The study is based on 2-D models, which neglect 3-D along-strike variations and oblique subduction complexities.
该研究基于二维模型，忽略了三维沿走向的变化以及斜向俯冲的复杂性。

tm.why: The paper uses 2-D time-dependent subduction models to investigate plate interface processes, exhumation, and underplating during subduction zone evolution.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from G3, as no full PDF was available in the input.

sum: This study investigates the crust and upper mantle structure beneath the North China Craton (NCC) using teleseismic full-waveform inversion (TeleFWI) of P waves and their codas (100–10 s). By applying a hybrid AxiSEM and SPECFEM3D-Cartesian modeling approach to recordings from 231 broadband stations and 6 teleseismic events, the authors simultaneously invert for 3-D P-wave velocity, S-wave velocity, and density in three multi-scale stages. The novel exploitation of scattered P-coda waves enables high-resolution multiparameter constraints down to 350 km depth using very few earthquakes. Results show a sharp Moho depth contrast from ~25 km in the east to >40 km in the west, and a thinned lithosphere (80–100 km) with an elevated lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) beneath the Datong volcano group (DVG). Importantly, the model resolves two distinct asthenospheric low-velocity upwelling channels converging beneath the DVG, shedding light on cratonic destruction and intraplate volcanism.
本研究利用231个宽频带台站记录的6个远震事件P波及其尾波（100–10秒），采用AxiSEM+SPECFEM3D混合模拟与远震全波形反演（TeleFWI）方法，分三阶段反演了华北克拉通壳幔三维纵波速度、横波速度和密度结构。创新性地利用富含散射信息的P波尾波，仅用少量远震便实现了对岩石圈和软流圈深度……

t: Hybrid AxiSEM + SPECFEM3D-Cartesian box tomography and three-stage adjoint full-waveform inversion (100–10 s) using L-BFGS to simultaneously invert teleseismic P and coda waves for Vp, Vs, and density.
采用AxiSEM+SPECFEM3D混合盒式层析成像，对远震P波及尾波进行三阶段多参数伴随全波形反演。

Vertical- and radial-component teleseismic P and coda waveforms from 6 earthquakes (Mw > 6.2, distance 30°–90°) recorded by 231 portable broadband stations deployed across North China during 2008–2009.
2008–2009年华北231个流动宽频带台站记录的6个Mw>6.2远震事件的垂直和径向波形。
Moho depth varies sharply from ~25 km in ENCC to >40 km in TNCO; lithosphere is 80–100 km thick with an elevated LAB and two converging low-Vs upwelling channels beneath Datong volcano group.
莫霍面从东部约25 km向西加深至>40 km，大同火山群下方LAB抬升且存在两条地幔上涌低速通道。
Density resolution degrades below the lithosphere, structures below 350 km cannot be constrained, and station coverage misses the southern ENCC and shallow sedimentary details.
深部密度分辨率低，无法约束350 km以下结构，且台网未覆盖东部陆块南缘及浅层沉积。

Applies multiparameter teleseismic P-coda FWI with only 6 events to resolve fine-scale asthenospheric dual magma upwelling channels and lithospheric density-constrained LAB depths beneath North China.
仅用6个远震的P波尾波实现多参数FWI，首次清晰分辨出大同火山群下方的双软流圈上涌通道。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3-D multiparameter model (Vp, Vs, density) of the crust and upper mantle beneath North China using teleseismic P and coda full-waveform inversion.
Resolved a sharp Moho depth contrast (~25 km to >40 km) across the boundary between the Eastern North China Craton and Trans-North China Orogen, plus a V-shaped elevated LAB zone.
Identified two converging asthenospheric low-velocity upwelling channels feeding the Datong volcano group, linking Pacific subduction-driven mantle flow to cratonic lithospheric thinning.
利用远震P波及尾波全波形反演，构建了华北地区壳幔高分辨率三维多参数（Vp、Vs、密度）模型。
揭示了华北克拉通东部与中部造山带边界处急剧的莫霍面深度反差（约25 km至>40 km）以及呈V字形的LAB抬升带。
识别出大同火山群下方汇聚的两条软流圈低速上涌通道，将太平洋俯冲驱动的地幔流动与克拉通岩石圈减薄联系起来。
me: Hybrid 3-D wavefield modeling coupling global 1-D AxiSEM outside the target box with 3-D SPECFEM3D-Cartesian inside the target region.
Station-averaged apparent source-time-function wavelet (ASW) estimation to mitigate out-of-the-box source and path heterogeneity errors.
Three-stage multi-scale adjoint full-waveform inversion (100–10 s) updated via L-BFGS optimization for P-velocity, S-velocity, and density.
Thermochemical LAB depth estimation using inverted S-wave velocity and lithospheric density-derived pressure.
采用目标区外一维AxiSEM与目标区内三维SPECFEM3D-Cartesian耦合的混合波场数值模拟方法。
估计台站平均视震源时间函数子波（ASW），以消除研究区外震源和路径横向不均匀性带来的误差。
采用L-BFGS优化算法进行三阶段多尺度（100–10秒）伴随全波形反演，同时更新纵波速度、横波速度和密度。
结合反演得到的横波速度与岩石圈密度导出的压力，利用热化学经验关系估算岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度。
de: Vertical- and radial-component teleseismic P and coda waveforms from 6 earthquakes (Mw > 6.2, epicentral distance 30°–90°) plus 1 test event for validation.
Recordings from 231 portable broadband stations deployed in 2008–2009 across the TNCO and ENCC (2-D grid spacing ~35 km and two linear dense arrays at ~12 km spacing).
Five-layer vertically variable checkerboard resolution test evaluating recovery of Vp, Vs, and density down to 300 km depth.
选用6个远震事件（Mw > 6.2，震中距30°–90°）的垂直向和径向P波及尾波记录进行反演，并用1个独立事件进行波形验证。
使用2008–2009年布设在华北中部造山带和东部陆块的231个流动宽频带台站数据（二维台网间距约35 km，两条密集测线间距约12 km）。
开展了五层垂向变尺度检测板分辨率测试，评估了至300 km深度处Vp、Vs和密度的恢复能力。
li: Density anomalies become barely resolvable below the lithospheric mantle (at 200–300 km depths), and all parameters lose sensitivity below 350 km.
Station coverage does not fully capture the southern ENCC or the subsurface connectivity between the WNCC and TNCO.
Exclusion of surface waves and ambient noise limits resolution of shallow sedimentary structures.
岩石圈地幔以下（200–300 km深度）密度异常几乎无法分辨，且所有参数在350 km深度以下缺乏约束能力。
台站分布未能完全覆盖华北东部陆块南缘以及西部陆块与中部造山带之间的深部连接区。
未联合面波和背景噪声数据，限制了对浅表沉积层结构的分辨率。

tm.why: The core methodology is teleseismic full-waveform inversion (TeleFWI) using adjoint-wavefield gradients and hybrid AxiSEM+SPECFEM3D modeling.
The paper investigates crustal thickness, LAB elevation, lithospheric thinning, and mantle upwelling beneath the North China Craton.
A primary scientific finding is imaging two deep asthenospheric magma upwelling channels beneath the Datong volcano group.

ev.notes: All metadata, methodology, quantitative results, source anchors, and figure analyses were extracted directly from the 11-page GRL PDF.

sum: Seismic full waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from significant non-uniqueness, requiring Bayesian uncertainty quantification. This study systematically compares a linearized locally-Gaussian method (using L-BFGS and randomized SVD of the Gauss-Newton Hessian) against two fully nonlinear variational inference algorithms—Physically Structured Variational Inference (PSVI) and Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD)—on 2D acoustic FWI benchmarks (a layered anomaly model and a modified Marmousi model). While all methods recover accurate posterior mean velocity models, their posterior uncertainty structures differ starkly in partially constrained regions and near high-impedance interfaces. Nonlinear methods capture wave-interference effects, producing higher uncertainties on the low-velocity sides of interfaces and extending sensitivity deeper beneath strong reflectors. Furthermore, posterior samples from nonlinear methods accurately fit observed waveforms and yield unbiased volumetric estimates via interrogation theory, whereas linearized samples yield poor waveform fits and biased meta-property estimates.
针对全波形反演（FWI）的不确定性量化，本文系统对比了局部高斯线性化方法（基于L-BFGS和随机奇异值分解）与两种完全非线性变分推断算法（物理结构化变分推断PSVI与Stein变分梯度下降SVGD）。基于二维声波层状模型和改进Marmousi模型的合成测试表明：虽然两类方法均能准确恢复后验均值速度模……

t: Compares linearized Gaussian FWI (using L-BFGS and randomized SVD of the Gauss-Newton Hessian) against two nonlinear variational inference methods: Physically Structured Variational Inference (PSVI, optimizing a logit-transformed sparse Gaussian) and Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD).
对比基于随机SVD的高斯线性化FWI与两种非线性变分方法（PSVI和SVGD）的后验不确定性。

Evaluated on 2D constant-density acoustic synthetic datasets: a 90x200 cell layered model with rectangular anomalies (at 10 Hz, 17 Hz, and sparse geometry) and a noisy 110x250 cell modified Marmousi model with a strong impedance interface.
采用二维声波合成数据：90×200层状异常体模型与含强阻抗界面的110×250改进Marmousi模型。

Nonlinear uncertainty maps show higher consistency (SSIM 0.358 between PSVI and SVGD vs 0.158–0.180 with linearized), opposite velocity-uncertainty trends near interfaces, superior posterior waveform fits, and unbiased anomaly size estimates via interrogation theory.
非线性不确定性图一致性更高（SSIM达0.358），后验样本波形拟合更佳，且异常体面积估计无偏。
The study is restricted to 2D constant-density acoustic FWI with simple Gaussian priors, and SVGD suffers from cycle-skipping errors when limited to 600 particles in 25,000 dimensions.
仅限于二维常密度声波FWI和简单高斯先验，且SVGD在600粒子下出现周波跳跃。

Provides the first systematic comparison of linearized versus fully nonlinear Bayesian uncertainty quantification in FWI, isolating the effect of wave-physics nonlinearity by comparing Gaussian-based linearized FWI directly with Gaussian-kernel PSVI.
首次系统对比FWI中线性化与非线性不确定性估计，直接揭示了波动物理非线性的影响。

kc: First systematic comparison between linearized locally-Gaussian and nonlinear variational (PSVI and SVGD) uncertainty estimates in Bayesian FWI.
Demonstrated that nonlinear FWI reveals loop-like uncertainty structures around anomalies and opposite velocity-uncertainty trends near interfaces compared to linearized FWI.
Showed that full nonlinear wave physics extends uncertainty reduction deeper beneath high-impedance interfaces where linearized Born approximation fails.
Proved via forward modeling and interrogation theory that nonlinear posterior samples accurately fit waveform data and yield unbiased geological body volume estimates, unlike linearized samples.
首次在贝叶斯全波形反演中系统对比了局部高斯线性化方法与非线性变分方法（PSVI和SVGD）的不确定性估计。
证明了非线性FWI能在异常体边界揭示环状不确定性结构，且在界面附近呈现出与线性化方法相反的速度-不确定性变化趋势。
展示了完全非线性波动物理能够将不确定性降低延伸至高波阻抗界面深部，克服了线性化玻恩近似的局限。
通过正演模拟和审讯理论证明，非线性后验样本能准确拟合波形数据并提供无偏的地质体体积估计，显著优于线性化样本。
me: Linearized Bayesian FWI finding the MAP model via multiscale L-BFGS and approximating the posterior covariance via randomized SVD of the prior-conditioned Gauss-Newton Hessian.
Physically Structured Variational Inference (PSVI) using a logit-transformed Gaussian distribution with a sparse, wavelength-based spatial covariance matrix optimized via ELBO.
Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) iteratively updating 600 non-parametric model particles to minimize KL divergence.
2D time-domain finite-difference acoustic wave modeling and adjoint-state gradient computation.
Interrogation theory to estimate the unbiased area of a subsurface low-velocity anomaly from posterior ensembles.
线性化贝叶斯FWI：利用多尺度L-BFGS求解最大后验（MAP）模型，并通过先验预处理高斯-牛顿Hessian矩阵的随机奇异值分解（SVD）近似后验协方差。
物理结构化变分推断（PSVI）：采用logit变换的高斯分布及基于主导波长的稀疏空间协方差矩阵，通过最大化证据下界（ELBO）进行优化。
Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）：迭代更新600个非参数化模型粒子以最小化KL散度。
二维时域有限差分声波正演模拟与伴随状态法梯度计算。
利用审讯理论（Interrogation theory）从后验模型集合中无偏估计地下低速异常体的面积。
de: 2D synthetic layered velocity model (90 x 200 grid cells, 20 m spacing) with low- and high-velocity rectangular anomalies, tested with 10 Hz, 17 Hz, and sparse (2 sources, 10 receivers) surface acquisition.
2D modified Marmousi model (110 x 250 grid cells, 20 m spacing) featuring a strong shallow impedance contrast, 12 surface sources, 250 seabed receivers, 10 Hz Ricker wavelet, and 1% Gaussian noise.
含高低速矩形异常体的二维合成层状速度模型（90×200网格，间距20米），分别使用10 Hz、17 Hz及稀疏观测系统（2个震源、10个接收器）进行测试。
具有强浅层波阻抗对比的二维改进Marmousi模型（110×250网格，间距20米），配置12个地表震源、250个海底接收器、10 Hz雷克子波及1%高斯随机噪声。
li: Restricted to 2D constant-density acoustic FWI; 3D and multi-parameter elastic FWI remain to be tested.
Relies on simple Gaussian prior distributions rather than complex geological or deep generative priors.
SVGD suffered from cycle skipping on the left side of the Marmousi model due to using only 600 particles in a 25,000-dimensional space.
仅限于二维常密度声波FWI，尚未在更高维和更非线性的三维或多参数弹性波FWI中测试。
仅采用了简单的高斯先验分布，未结合复杂的多点地质统计或深度生成网络先验。
在25,000维的Marmousi模型空间中，SVGD仅使用600个粒子，导致模型左侧出现周波跳跃误差。

tm.why: The paper directly compares linearized Gaussian and fully nonlinear variational Bayesian inference methods for uncertainty quantification in seismic inversion.
The core application is 2D acoustic seismic full waveform inversion using the adjoint-state method to compute gradients.
The study investigates fundamental inverse theory concepts including forward problem nonlinearity, posterior covariance approximation, and interrogation theory.

ev.notes: Full 29-page preprint PDF analyzed, including main text, equations, 19 main figures, and 2 appendix figures.

sum: Deep learning models trained on local seismic datasets often suffer from degraded performance when applied to new regions due to distinct waveform characteristics. This study introduces a Siamese neural network (SNN) based on metric learning to classify blasts, collapses, and natural earthquakes across regions. The SNN is trained on three-component broadband waveforms from northeastern China and tested on an out-of-region dataset from Inner Mongolia and Gansu Province. While five-fold in-domain cross-validation shows comparable performance between the SNN (AUPRC 0.984) and a baseline CNN (AUPRC 0.961), the SNN paired with 20 target-region anchors per class achieves an AUPRC of 0.842 on out-of-region data, outperforming direct CNN application by 7% and transfer-learned CNN by 4%. Grad-CAM analysis reveals that the SNN focuses on early P- and S-wave trains and is robust against background noise, offering a flexible solution without costly model retraining.

利用双分支权重共享一维CNN提取配对三分量波形的128维特征并计算L1距离，通过与每类20个锚点的平均相似度实现事件分类…

Unfiltered 60-s 3-component broadband waveforms (100 Hz) from CENC: trained on northeastern China (156 blasts, 97 collapses, 163 earthquakes; 1,995 traces) and tested out-of-region on Inner Mongolia and Gansu (80 blasts, 61 collapses; 1,459 traces).

In 5-fold in-domain cross-validation, SNN achieves a mean AUPRC of 0.984 versus 0.961 for CNN. On out-of-region data, SNN with target-region anchors achieves an AUPRC of 0.842, outperforming direct CNN (0.772) by 7% and transfer-learned CNN (0.806) by 4%.
域内五折交叉验证SNN与CNN的AUPRC分别为0.984和0.961；跨区域测试中结合目标锚点的SNN达0.842，比…

Due to data pairing and multi-anchor comparisons, SNN requires 3.4 times more training time per epoch (26.27 s vs 7.68 s), more GPU memory (2085 MB vs 132 MB), and higher inference latency (~71.1 ms vs 0.67 ms) than CNN.

Adapts a Siamese neural network with target-region anchors to seismic source discrimination, enabling superior cross-regional generalization without the costly relabeling and retraining required by conventional transfer learning.
将孪生神经网络与目标区域锚点机制引入非天然地震分类，无需繁琐的迁移学习重训练即可实现跨区域高泛化性识别。

kc: Proposed a Siamese neural network (SNN) framework with a balanced per-epoch data pairing scheme to discriminate blasts, collapses, and natural earthquakes.
Demonstrated that using SNN with a small number of target-region anchors (20 per category) improves out-of-region AUPRC by 7% over direct CNN and 4% over transfer-learned CNN.
Applied Grad-CAM interpretability analysis to show that SNN focuses on early-arrival P- and S-wave trains and remains insensitive to strong background noise.
提出了结合均衡动态数据配对策略的孪生神经网络（SNN）框架，用于区分爆破、塌陷与天然地震。
证明在跨区域测试中，利用少量目标区域锚点（每类20个）的SNN比直接应用CNN和迁移学习CNN的AUPRC分别提升了7%和4%。
通过Grad-CAM可解释性分析表明，SNN主要依赖早到的P波和S波波列特征，对强背景噪声不敏感。
me: Siamese neural network (SNN) with two weight-sharing 4-block 1D CNN subnetworks, L1 norm distance layer, and sigmoid output.
Dynamic balanced data pairing scheme generating 24,576 pairs per epoch (4,096 for each of the 3 positive and 3 negative pair combinations) with ±1 s random time-shift augmentation.
Anchor-based inference comparing test waveforms against 20 predefined reference anchors per category and averaging similarity scores.
Grad-CAM importance weight analysis and ablation studies on anchor count, loss functions (BCE vs. contrastive), and data augmentation.
构建包含两个共享权重的4块一维CNN子网络、L1范数距离层和Sigmoid输出层的孪生神经网络（SNN）。
采用动态均衡数据配对方案，每个训练轮次生成24,576对样本（3种正样本对和3种负样本对各4,096对），并结合±1秒随机时移数据增强。
基于锚点的推理机制，将测试波形与每类20个预定义锚点样本计算相似度并取平均以确定类别。
利用Grad-CAM进行重要性权重分析，并对锚点数量、损失函数（二元交叉熵与对比损失）及数据增强开展消融实验。
de: In-domain dataset from northeastern China (2012–2019, 109 broadband stations): 156 blasts (451 3C waveforms), 97 collapses (833 waveforms), and 163 earthquakes (711 waveforms), ML 2–3, distance 0–200 km.
Out-of-region test dataset from Inner Mongolia and Gansu Province: 80 blasts (1,059 3C waveforms) and 61 collapses (400 waveforms), ML 2–3.5, distance 0–210 km.
Unfiltered 60-second 3-component waveforms sampled at 100 Hz (6000 × 3 points), demeaned, detrended, normalized by standard deviation, with SNR >= 2.
中国东北地区域内数据集（2012–2019年，109个宽频带台站）：包含156次爆破（451条三分量波形）、97次塌陷（833条波形）和163次天然地震（711条波形），震级ML 2–3，震中距0–200 km。
内蒙古与甘肃跨区域测试数据集：包含80次爆破（1,059条三分量波形）和61次塌陷（400条波形），震级ML 2–3.5，震中距0–210 km。
采用未滤波的60秒三分量波形（采样率100 Hz，尺寸6000×3），经去均值、去趋势、标准差归一化处理，并筛选信噪比SNR>=2的数据。
li: SNN requires ~3.4x longer training time per epoch (26.27 s vs 7.68 s), ~15.8x more GPU memory (2085 MB vs 132 MB), and ~106x higher inference latency (~71 ms vs 0.67 ms per sample) than CNN.
Direct cross-regional generalization without target-region anchors still suffers significant performance degradation due to regional shifts in frequency content and P/S amplitude ratios.
Event labels reviewed by CENC experts may still contain certain uncertainties.
相比传统CNN，SNN每轮训练时间长约3.4倍（26.27秒 vs 7.68秒），GPU显存占用高约15.8倍（2085 MB vs 132 MB），单样本推理延迟高约106倍（~71毫秒 vs 0.67毫秒）。
若不使用目标区域锚点，受不同区域频率成分和P/S振幅比差异的影响，跨区域直接泛化性能仍会显著下降。
尽管事件标签经台网中心专家审核，但仍可能存在一定的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates a Siamese neural network (SNN) architecture against a convolutional neural network (CNN) for seismic event classification.
Discriminating non-natural events (blasts and collapses) from natural earthquakes is directly aimed at constructing accurate earthquake catalogs.
The study specifically targets anthropogenic seismic events such as mining blasts and collapses associated with mineral resource exploitation.

ev.notes: Full 63-page manuscript PDF (GJI advance article ggag247) including all sections, equations, and 25 figures was used.

sum: NASA's InSight mission detected an intracrustal seismic discontinuity at ~24 km depth above the ~38 km Martian Moho, whose petrological nature remained unresolved. This study integrates phase equilibrium modelling (MAGEMin), mineral physics, and Bayesian hypothesis testing using 883 Martian geochemical compositions to evaluate the lithology of crustal layers 3 (10–24 km) and 4 (24–38 km). Comparing forward-modelled seismic velocities against probabilistic velocity profiles derived from meteoroid impact waves and receiver functions, the authors show with 90.8% posterior probability that the ~24 km boundary marks a transition from mafic to ultramafic rocks. They interpret the ~14-km-thick basal layer as melt-depleted ultramafic cumulates, making ~24 km the seismic Moho and ~38 km the petrologic Moho. Thermal modelling demonstrates that forming this layer required elevated heat flow from mantle upwelling and magma intrusion, providing the first seismic evidence for vertically integrated transcrustal magmatism on a stagnant-lid planet.
NASA洞察号在火星约24 km深处发现壳内地震间断面（莫霍面位于约38 km），其成因尚不明确。本研究结合相平衡建模（MAGEMin）、矿物物理与贝叶斯统计分类，利用883个火星岩石地球化学样本正演地震波速，并与洞察号反演速度剖面对比。结果显示，在均匀先验下，第3层（10–24 km）为镁铁质（后……

t: Integrates thermodynamic phase equilibrium modelling (MAGEMin) and mineral physics with Bayesian model selection and Latin hypercube sampling to classify Martian crustal layers as mafic or ultramafic based on InSight seismic velocities.
结合MAGEMin相平衡建模、矿物物理计算与贝叶斯模型选择，利用洞察号波速对火星地壳层进行岩性分类。

Uses the probabilistic P- and S-wave velocity model of Drilleau et al. (2023) beneath InSight (from meteoroid impacts and receiver functions) and a compiled geochemical database of 883 Martian rock samples.
采用洞察号陨石撞击波与接收函数联合反演的速度剖面，以及汇编的883个火星岩石地球化学成分数据。

Under uniform priors, layer 3 (10–24.5 km) has an 85.9% posterior probability of being mafic, whereas layer 4 (24.5–38.4 km) has a 90.8% probability of being an ultramafic melt-depleted cumulate zone.
均匀先验下第3层有85.9%概率为镁铁质，第4层（24.5–38.4 km）有90.8%概率为超镁铁质熔体亏损堆晶层。

Sensitivity kernels from the original geophysical inversion were unavailable, requiring uniform depth averaging within each layer; furthermore, the ultramafic cumulate layer may be regionally variable rather than globally uniform.
缺乏地球物理反演敏感度核，只能对层内深度取算术平均；且该超镁铁质堆晶层可能仅呈区域性分布。

Provides the first quantitative seismic-petrophysical evidence for a melt-depleted ultramafic lower crust and vertically integrated transcrustal magmatism on Mars, demonstrating tertiary crust formation without plate tectonics.
首次给出火星熔体亏损超镁铁质下地壳与跨地壳岩浆系统的地震岩石物理证据，证实无板块构造也能形成演化地壳。

kc: Demonstrates that the ~24.5 km Martian intracrustal seismic discontinuity marks a lithological transition from mafic (layer 3, 85.9% probability) to ultramafic (layer 4, 90.8% probability) rocks.
Distinguishes the Martian seismic Moho at ~24 km (top of ultramafic cumulates, Vp > 7.6 km/s) from the true petrologic crust–mantle boundary at ~38 km.
Shows via 1D thermal and solidus modelling that ambient Noachian heat flow (5–45 mW/m²) could not induce in situ lower-crustal melting, requiring mantle upwelling and magmatic intrusion.
Establishes that vertically integrated transcrustal magmatic systems and tertiary crust differentiation can operate on stagnant-lid planets without plate tectonics.
证实火星约24.5 km深处的壳内地震间断面代表了从镁铁质（第3层，概率85.9%）到超镁铁质（第4层，概率90.8%）的岩性转变。
区分了火星约24 km处的地震莫霍面（超镁铁质堆晶岩顶部，Vp > 7.6 km/s）与约38 km处的岩石学莫霍面。
通过热模拟证明诺亚纪背景热流（5–45 mW/m²）无法引起下地壳原位部分熔融，必须依赖地幔上涌与岩浆侵入。
确立了在没有板块构造的停滞盖层行星上，依然可以发育垂直贯通的跨地壳岩浆系统并形成演化地壳。
me: Thermodynamic phase equilibrium modelling using MAGEMin with metabasite and extended ultramafic equations of state along early (16 °C/km) and modern (10 °C/km) Martian areotherms.
Forward seismic velocity calculation via Voigt–Reuss–Hill averaging of constituent mineral phases using PerpleX shear modulus databases.
Bayesian model selection integrating Gaussian log-likelihoods across candidate geochemical compositions to compute posterior lithological probabilities.
Latin hypercube sampling (1,000 realizations) across thermal gradients, water content (0–5 wt%), and ferric iron ratios to quantify parameter uncertainty.
1D conductive and radiogenic crustal thermal modelling compared against dry and water-saturated basaltic solidii.
使用MAGEMin软件及变基性岩和超镁铁质状态方程，沿早期（16 °C/km）和现代（10 °C/km）火星地温梯度进行热力学相平衡建模。
结合PerpleX剪切模量数据库，采用Voigt–Reuss–Hill平均法正演矿物集合体的P波和S波速度。
采用贝叶斯模型选择框架，在高斯误差假设下对候选成分似然函数进行积分以计算岩性后验概率。
利用拉丁超立方抽样（1000组参数）评估地温梯度、含水量（0–5 wt%）及铁氧化态不确定性对后验概率的影响。
开展包含放射生热和底部热流的一维地壳热传导模拟，并与干、湿玄武岩固相线进行对比。
de: Seismic P- and S-wave velocity profiles beneath InSight from Drilleau et al. (2023), derived from joint probabilistic inversion of meteoroid impact body/surface waves and receiver functions.
Curated geochemical database of 883 calculated and measured Martian rock compositions split into mafic (45–52 wt% SiO2) and unaltered ultramafic (<45 wt% SiO2) subsets.
采用Drilleau等（2023）基于陨石撞击体波、面波及接收函数联合概率反演得到的洞察号下方P波和S波速度剖面。
汇编包含883个火星岩石计算与实测成分的地球化学数据库，划分为镁铁质（45–52 wt% SiO2）和未蚀变超镁铁质（<45 wt% SiO2）子集。
li: Original geophysical inversion sensitivity kernels were unavailable, requiring layer velocities to be approximated as simple arithmetic means over discrete depths.
Single-station InSight constraints represent local structure beneath the lander, while lower global path-averaged S-wave velocities suggest the ultramafic cumulate layer is regionally variable.
Gravity-topography trade-offs arise from the higher density of ultramafic cumulates if laterally extensive.
由于缺乏原始地球物理反演的敏感度核，各层理论波速只能通过对离散深度点取算术平均来近似。
洞察号单台约束仅代表登陆点下方的局部结构，全球大圆路径平均S波速度较低表明超镁铁质堆晶层可能具有区域局域性。
高密度超镁铁质下地壳若在横向上广泛分布，将在重力-地形反演中引入与地壳厚度的折衷不确定性。

tm.why: The paper interprets Martian intracrustal seismic discontinuities observed by NASA's InSight mission to reveal ancient transcrustal magmatism on Mars.
It characterizes the compositional stratification of the Martian lower crust (~24–38 km depth) and links it to mantle upwelling and crustal differentiation.
Bayesian model selection and Latin hypercube sampling are used to evaluate compositional hypotheses (mafic vs. ultramafic) against observed seismic velocities and uncertainties.

ev.notes: Full 17-page Nature Astronomy article PDF including main text, Methods, 3 main figures, 1 main table, 3 Extended Data tables, and 6 Extended Data figures. Note that in the published PDF pages 12–16, the images and captions for Extended Data Figs. 1–5 are cyclically shifted by one position; both the visual content and captions were cross-checked against main-text references.

sum: Geophysical observations reveal that igneous plumbing systems are dominated by crystal-rich mush reservoirs containing sparse, crystal-poor melt sills. However, thermo-kinetic models of submarine magmatic systems often omit magma convection within these melt-rich bodies. This study presents 2-D numerical thermal models (multiporo-magma) applied to the fast-spreading East Pacific Rise at 9°50'N, coupling hydrothermal circulation with stochastic melt sill emplacement and parameterizing magma convection via a magmatic Nusselt number approach. While magma convection barely alters the overall thermal regime of the mush reservoir, it accelerates heat extraction and reduces the lifespan of individual eruptible melt pockets by two orders of magnitude to <2 years. Furthermore, convective heat transfer from newly injected sills triggers local mush remelting and unlocking, increasing eruptible melt volume by up to 30% and promoting geochemical homogenization. These findings explain the highly transient nature of seismically imaged magma lenses.
地球物理观测表明岩浆系统主要由富晶晶粥主导，但海底热动力学模型常忽略富熔体岩浆房内的岩浆对流。本研究针对东太平洋海隆9°50'N，开发了二维数值热模型（multiporo-magma），将热液循环、随机熔体岩床侵位与基于努塞尔数的岩浆对流参数化相耦合。结果表明，浅部偏向的熔体结晶模式可重现地震观测到……

t: 2-D finite-volume thermo-kinetic modeling (multiporo-magma) coupling Darcy hydrothermal circulation with stochastic sill emplacement, parameterizing magma convection via a Rayleigh- and Nusselt-number conductive enhancement factor.
二维有限体积热动力学模型耦合达西热液循环与随机岩床侵位，用努塞尔数参数化岩浆对流。

18 test configurations with and without magma convection varying sill emplacement depth decay (β = 0–4 m⁻¹) and hydrothermal depth (ZH = 0–3 km), plus Monte-Carlo single-sill injection simulations constrained by EPR 9°50'N data.
受EPR 9°50'N约束的18组改变结晶深度与热液深度的算例，以及蒙特卡洛单岩床注入模拟。

Magma convection reduces eruptible melt pocket lifespans by two orders of magnitude to 0.1–2 years, while convective remelting of surrounding mush increases eruptible magma thickness by 110%, area by 130%, and melt volume by 30%.
岩浆对流使可喷发熔体寿命降两个数量级至0.1–2年，晶粥重熔使可喷发熔体体积增加30%。
The model only accounts for thermally induced convection and omits compositional convection from melt-crystal density contrasts, so estimated magma lifespans represent upper bounds.
仅考虑热诱导对流而忽略熔体-晶体密度差引起的成分对流，寿命估计值为上限。

First 2-D thermo-kinetic ridge model coupling hydrothermal circulation with Nusselt-parameterized magma convection in discrete sills within a crystal-rich mush reservoir, quantifying melt transience and mush unlocking.
首次在洋中脊晶粥储层模型中耦合热液循环与离散岩床的努塞尔数岩浆对流，量化熔体瞬态性。

kc: Developed 2-D thermo-kinetic numerical models (multiporo-magma) incorporating a Nusselt-number parameterization for magma convection coupled with hydrothermal circulation.

Demonstrated that a shallowly-biased melt crystallization distribution (concentrated in the upper-gabbroic layer at 1.5–2.5 km depth) is required to match seismic observations at the East Pacific Rise 9°50'N.
Showed that magma convection reduces the lifespan of eruptible crystal-poor melt pockets by two orders of magnitude to less than 2 years.

Revealed that convective heat transfer from newly emplaced sills triggers local mush remelting and unlocking, increasing eruptible melt volume by up to 30% and facilitating geochemical homogenization.
开发了结合努塞尔数岩浆对流参数化与热液循环的二维热-动力学数值模型（multiporo-magma）。
证明了浅部偏向的熔体结晶分布（集中在1.5–2.5 km深度的上部辉长岩层）对于匹配东太平洋海隆9°50'N的地震观测至关重要。
表明岩浆对流将可喷发贫晶熔体囊的寿命缩短了两个数量级，降至不足2年。
揭示了新侵位岩床的对流传热会触发周围晶粥的局部重熔和解锁，使可喷发熔体体积增加达30%，并促进地球化学均一化。
me: 2-D finite-volume numerical modeling (multiporo-magma) solving conservation of mass and energy for porous hydrothermal flow (Darcy's law) and crustal heat transport.
Parameterization of convective heat transfer in mobilizable magma bodies (crystal fraction X < 0.6) using an analytical Rayleigh- and Nusselt-number conductive enhancement factor.
Stochastic emplacement of horizontal melt sills (1000 m wide, 50 m thick) every 200 years following an exponential depth probability density function.
Monte-Carlo analysis of single-injection events across 50 quasi-steady-state thermal fields to quantify eruptible magma lifespan.
采用二维有限体积数值模拟（multiporo-magma）求解多孔介质热液流动（达西定律）和地壳热传输的质量与能量守恒方程。
利用解析瑞利数和努塞尔数导热增强因子，对可流动岩浆体（晶体分数 X < 0.6）内的对流传热进行参数化。
按照指数深度概率密度函数，每200年随机侵位水平熔体岩床（宽1000米，厚50米）。
在50个准稳态温度场上对单次注入事件进行蒙特卡洛分析，以量化可喷发岩浆的寿命。
de: 36 systematic 2-D simulation test cases varying melt emplacement depth decay rate (β = 0 to 4 m⁻¹), hydrothermal layer thickness (ZH = 0, 1.5, 3 km), and presence/absence of magma convection.
Non-linear temperature-crystallinity (T-X) relationship calibrated for primitive MORB composition using the Rhyolite-MELTS thermodynamic model.
Geophysical constraints (seismic tomography, reflection imaging of axial melt lenses, and magnetic polarity boundaries) from the East Pacific Rise at 9°50'N.
1800 Monte-Carlo forward simulations per model configuration (50 thermal fields × 36 injection depths from 1.5 to 5 km) to track post-injection crystallinity and remelting evolution.
36组系统性二维模拟测试算例，改变熔体侵位深度衰减率（β = 0至4 m⁻¹）、热液层厚度（ZH = 0, 1.5, 3 km）以及有无岩浆对流。
使用Rhyolite-MELTS热力学模型针对原始洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）成分校准的非线性温度-结晶度（T-X）关系。
来自东太平洋海隆9°50'N的地球物理约束（地震层析成像、轴部熔体透镜体反射成像和磁极性边界）。
每种模型配置1800次蒙特卡洛正演模拟（50个温度场 × 1.5至5 km的36个注入深度），以追踪注入后的结晶度和重熔演化。
li: The Rayleigh number parameterization only accounts for thermally induced convection and omits compositional convection from melt-crystal density contrasts, making lifespan estimates upper bounds.
The model uses a 2-D cross-sectional geometry and neglects dike intrusions and off-axis melt emplacements.
Magma convection is approximated via an effective thermal conductivity enhancement (Nusselt number) rather than explicitly resolving multiphase fluid-crystal Navier-Stokes flow.
瑞利数参数化仅考虑了热诱导对流，忽略了熔体-晶体密度差引起的成分对流，因此岩浆寿命估计值为上限。
模型采用二维横截面几何结构，忽略了岩脉侵入和离轴熔体侵位。
岩浆对流通过有效热导率增强（努塞尔数）进行近似，而非显式求解多相流体-晶体纳维-斯托克斯流动。

tm.why: The paper conducts 2-D numerical thermal modeling of crustal accretion, hydrothermal circulation, and magma-mush reservoir dynamics at fast-spreading mid-ocean ridges.

sum: This study addresses methodological challenges in inferring lowermost mantle (D") anisotropy from Sdiff splitting, such as apparent splitting from isotropic structures. Leveraging global wavefield simulations, the authors develop an automated measurement workflow that excludes strongly SVdiff-polarized waves. Applying this to ~20 million three-component seismograms yields a highly consistent, curated dataset of ~4,300 high-confidence Sdiff splitting measurements. These are projected onto 237 geographic bins in the D" layer, revealing clear splitting in 55 bins (notably beneath the northern Pacific). The study also characterizes directional dependence using backazimuth binning and provides open-source codes and datasets.

sum: Correlating late earthquake coda waves yields stable inter-station core phases, yet non-ideal wavefield conditions question their travel-time accuracy as true Green's functions. This study introduces a perturbation-based theoretical framework decomposing the wavefield into a solvable homogeneous reference model and a travel-time perturbation component. The authors define a critical angular threshold based on the ratio of wave period to inter-station travel time, proving that travel-time reconstruction errors scale with the cube of this threshold. Because core phases have long travel times and steep incidence angles, their threshold angles are small, ensuring negligible travel-time bias under locally uniform wave incidence. Numerical simulations and empirical tests using 205 global earthquakes (M >= 6.8) recorded by USArray confirm that stacking ~50-100 events stabilizes ScS and PKIKP2 travel times across diverse source deviation angles, reconciling the debate between true phase retrieval and biased correlation features.
大震晚期尾波互相关可提取稳定的台站间地核震相，但非理想波场条件使其走时准确性存疑。本文提出一种微扰理论框架，将问题分解为可解的均匀参考模型与走时微扰项。研究定义了由地震波周期与台站间走时之比决定的临界角阈值，证明走时重建误差与该阈值的立方成正比。由于核相传播路径长、入射角陡，其临界角很小，在局部均匀……

t: Decomposes coda cross-correlation into a solvable homogeneous reference model and a Taylor-expanded travel-time perturbation, deriving a critical angular threshold from a 2pi phase non-interference criterion.

Travel-time errors scale with the cube of the threshold angle (18.0 deg for ScS, 11.0 deg for PKIKP2). Empirical ScS and PKIKP2 travel times stabilize when stacking >= 50–100 earthquakes.

Requires a smooth velocity structure so higher-order derivatives of the travel-time deviation function are negligible, which cannot yet be independently verified in the real Earth.

Replaces asymptotic stationary-phase approximations with a rigorous perturbation expansion, proving cubic error scaling and reconciling the debate between true Green's function retrieval and biased I2* wavefields.

Introduced a geometric parameter Gamma comparing the threshold angle to phase incidence angle, explaining why steep core phases like PKIKP2 converge tightly across all off-great-circle source azimuths.

建立了尾波干涉的微扰分析框架，将走时差函数分解为余弦参考模型和高阶泰勒展开微扰项。

sum: The paper introduces Flow Annealing Posterior Sampling (FAPS), a novel function-space posterior sampling framework that unifies stochastic-process regression and PDE inverse problems. Built on pretrained function-space flow-matching priors, FAPS enables likelihood-guided posterior inference from sparse and noisy observations without requiring explicit prior-density evaluation. It incorporates a Langevin correction with a low-rank covariance preconditioner to handle dominant function-space correlations across variable query discretizations. Evaluated on Gaussian/non-Gaussian stochastic processes and PDE inverse problems, FAPS delivers coherent posterior samples and accurate uncertainty quantification, outperforming existing functional regression baselines and matching or exceeding diffusion-based samplers at a lower computational cost.

sum: This paper introduces a pure-viscoacoustic wave equation designed for simulating pure anisotropic P-wave fields in attenuating media. Building on a decoupled fractional Laplacian (DFL) formulation, the proposed method eliminates S-wave artifacts and utilizes a fixed-order anisotropic fractional Laplacian operator to simultaneously capture directional velocity and attenuation variations. Numerical validations on 2D models and the 3D Salton Trough model demonstrate high accuracy, computational efficiency, and feasibility for crustal-scale seismic imaging and inversion.
