sum: Supervised deep learning for seismic resolution enhancement struggles with synthetic-to-field distribution mismatch due to scarce high-resolution field labels. This paper introduces a physics-guided self-supervised diffusion model (PG-SSDM) that learns directly from observed field data. First, a progressive multi-stage self-supervised strategy generates training pairs by low-pass filtering observed data and iteratively refining high-resolution targets. Second, Robinson's seismic convolution model is embedded as a physical constraint into both a composite training loss (with MSE, L1 sparsity, and total variation) and the reverse diffusion sampling process via gradient-based correction. Third, stochastic reverse sampling enables spatial uncertainty quantification. Validated on Overthrust synthetic data contaminated with Gaussian and field DAS coupling noise, as well as a 3D land post-stack seismic volume with well logs, PG-SSDM outperforms sparse spike inversion and deterministic self-supervised deconvolution in RMSE, SSIM, thin-layer recovery, and noise robustness.
针对监督深度学习地震高分辨率处理缺乏实际标签及泛化差的问题，本文提出物理引导的自监督扩散模型（PG-SSDM）。方法通过低通滤波构建自生成训练对，采用多阶段渐进策略迭代提升目标分辨率；将Robinson褶积模型结合L1稀疏与全变分正则化嵌入复合损失函数及反向采样梯度修正中；利用扩散模型随机采样生成系……

Evaluated on Overthrust 2D synthetic data (801 traces, 80 Hz Ricker wavelet) with Gaussian and real DAS coupling noise, plus a 3D land post-stack volume (76 inlines, 64 crosslines) validated with three wells.

Ensemble uncertainty quantification across M independent stochastic sampling trajectories.
基于含自注意力机制的5层U-Net，构建直接预测干净数据（x0）的自监督条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）。

Ablation studies evaluating physics-guided sampling convergence over 1000 DDIM steps and individual contributions of the four loss components.

开展1000步DDIM采样物理引导收敛速度对比及四项损失函数组件的消融实验。

Requires tuning four hyperparameter weights in the composite loss function across training stages.
Multi-step reverse diffusion sampling and ensemble generation incur higher computational costs than single-pass deterministic networks.

复合损失函数包含四个超参数权重，需要在高维参数空间中进行自适应或分阶段调优。
多步反向扩散采样及多实现系综生成相比单次前向确定性网络计算成本更高。

Uses the stochastic reverse sampling of diffusion models to generate an ensemble of high-resolution outputs and compute spatial uncertainty maps.
Formulates seismic resolution enhancement as an inverse deconvolution problem constrained by Robinson's convolution model, L1 sparsity, and total variation.

sum: This study introduces AutoBETA (Auto-Biscale Empirical Transformation Application), an open-source Python tool designed to fully automate the replenishment of incomplete earthquake catalogs, particularly early aftershocks. Building on previous semi-automated methods, AutoBETA integrates grid-based density analysis with flexible missing region identification, supporting user-defined polygons and hybrid expert-knowledge strategies. The tool was validated on one synthetic catalog and four real earthquake sequences (Wenchuan, Noto, Baja California, and Norcia). After 100 automated iterations, AutoBETA successfully replenished 40.0% to 44.8% of the final catalogs, significantly improving catalog completeness for robust statistical modeling.
本研究开发了AutoBETA（自动双尺度经验变换应用），一个用于自动补全不完整地震目录（尤其是早期余震）的开源Python工具。该工具在半自动方法基础上，融合了基于网格的密度分析与灵活的缺失区域识别，并支持用户自定义多边形与混合专家知识策略。通过在1个合成目录和4个真实地震序列（汶川、能登、下加利福……

AutoBETA通过结合网格密度分析、双尺度经验变换与灵活的缺失区识别，实现了目录自动补全。
The tool was evaluated using one synthetic catalog and four real earthquake sequences: Wenchuan, Noto, Baja California, and Norcia, with varying magnitude thresholds.
使用了一个合成目录以及汶川、能登、下加利福尼亚和诺尔恰四个真实地震序列进行测试。
After 100 automated iterations, AutoBETA successfully replenished 43.9%, 40.0%, 40.5%, and 44.8% of the events in the four real-world catalogs, respectively.
在100次自动迭代后，该方法成功补全了四个真实目录中40.0%至44.8%的地震事件。
Performance and completeness gains are constrained by the initial catalog quality and the selected magnitude thresholds.
补全效果和完整度提升受限于初始目录的质量以及设定的震级阈值。
Provides a fully automated, open-source Python workflow that replaces previous semi-automated approaches and supports hybrid expert-knowledge spatial strategies.
实现了完全自动化的开源Python工作流，替代了先前的半自动方法，并支持混合专家知识策略。

sum: SeedPSD is an open-source software tool designed for integration into the EPOS-France seismological data center (Résif-DC) workflow. It processes metadata and daily seismic data streams to calculate hourly segmented power spectral densities (PSDs) using the McNamara (2004) method via ObsPy's PPSD class. These PSDs are aggregated into probabilistic distributions of seismic noise levels and stored in a database, enabling on-the-fly rendering of PDF and spectrogram plots. Inspired by EarthScope's Mustang API, SeedPSD is optimized for automated, non-interactive data center quality control and offers extensive configuration options for deployment in other seismological repositories.
SeedPSD是一款专为EPOS-France地震数据中心（Résif-DC）工作流设计的开源软件。它通过处理元数据和每日地震数据流，利用ObsPy的PPSD类（基于McNamara 2004方法）计算每小时分段的功率谱密度（PSD）。计算结果存储在数据库中，支持实时渲染概率密度函数（PDF）和时频……

t: Calculates hourly segmented power spectral densities (PSDs) using the McNamara (2004) method implemented via the PPSD class of ObsPy.
利用ObsPy的PPSD类，采用McNamara (2004) 方法计算每小时分段的功率谱密度（PSD）。
Processes daily seismic data streams and metadata from seismological networks to compute noise statistics.
处理来自地震台网的每日地震数据流和元数据，以计算噪声统计信息。

sum: Global U-Pb detrital zircon ages and continental large igneous provinces (LIPs) exhibit concordant long-term periodicities (~400 Myr) linked to supercontinent cycles, yet their driving mechanism has remained unclear. Using 3-D spherical thermochemical mantle convection models (CitcomS) with imposed plate motion histories spanning the past 2000 Ma (combining EDRG-90E and EarthByte reconstructions) and a deep-origin plume detection scheme, this study investigates the co-evolution of supercontinent cycles, Large Low-Shear-Velocity Provinces (LLSVPs), and mantle plumes. Results demonstrate that circum-supercontinent subduction modulates LLSVPs and drives periodic ~400 Myr variations in mantle structure and plume activity. Specifically, peaks in degree-2 mantle convection power directly correlate with detrital zircon age peaks associated with subduction-driven arc magmatism, whereas higher-degree (degrees 4 and 5) mantle structures and plume heat flux synchronize with the temporal distribution of LIPs. This provides a unified deep-mantle geodynamic mechanism linking surface tectonic cycles to geological proxy records.
全球碎屑锆石U-Pb年龄和大陆大火成岩省（LIPs）表现出与超大陆旋回相关的约400 Myr周期性。本研究利用三维全球地幔热化学对流模型（CitcomS），结合过去2000 Ma的板块运动重建边界条件（EDRG-90E和EarthByte模型）及深源地幔柱识别算法，模拟了超大陆旋回、大型低剪切波速省……

t: 3-D spherical mantle thermochemical convection simulations using CitcomS under the extended-Boussinesq approximation, coupled with imposed 2000-Ma plate velocity boundary conditions and an automated deep-origin plume detection and spherical harmonic analysis scheme.
利用CitcomS进行三维全球地幔热化学对流模拟，施加2000 Ma板块速度边界条件并结合深源地幔柱检测与球谐分析。

Ten 2000-Myr numerical convection models forced by EDRG-90E (2000–940 Ma) and EarthByte (940–0 Ma) plate reconstructions, compared against global compilations of continental LIP sites and detrended detrital zircon U-Pb ages.
由EDRG-90E和EarthByte板块重建驱动的10组2000 Myr数值模型，并与全球LIPs和碎屑锆石U-Pb年…

Degree-2 mantle convection power peaks at 1800, 1400, 1100, 600, and 150 Ma (~400 Myr period) correlating with detrital zircon peaks, while degree-4/5 power and plume heat flux match LIP abundance peaks.
2阶地幔结构功率呈现约400 Myr周期并与碎屑锆石峰值吻合，4-5阶功率及地幔柱热流则与LIP丰度峰值一致。

Supercontinent cycles are imposed via kinematic surface boundary conditions rather than emerging from a self-consistent lithosphere, and model resolution limits simulating thin upper-mantle plume conduits.
超大陆旋回由运动学边界条件施加而非自洽产生，且网格分辨率限制了上地幔细地幔柱通道的模拟。

First 2000-Ma 3-D thermochemical convection study across multiple complete supercontinent cycles quantitatively linking ~400-Myr periodicities in degree-2/higher-degree mantle structures and deep plumes to zircon and LIP records.
首次通过跨越多个完整超大陆旋回的2000 Ma三维对流模拟，定量揭示锆石和LIP约400 Myr周期的深部地幔机制。

kc: Simulated 2000 Ma of 3-D global thermochemical mantle convection incorporating 660-km phase transitions, basal LLSVP chemical layers, and reconstructed plate motion histories.
Demonstrated that supercontinent cycles drive ~400 Myr periodic variations in mantle thermal structure and deep-origin plume activity, mediated by LLSVP evolution.

Established a unified mechanism linking deep mantle dynamics to surface records: degree-2 convection power correlates with detrital zircon age peaks, while degree-4/5 power and plume heat flux match LIP peaks.
开展了跨越2000 Ma的三维全球地幔热化学对流模拟，耦合了660公里相变、核幔边界LLSVP化学层以及板块运动重建历史。
证明了超大陆旋回通过LLSVP的演化驱动地幔热结构和深源地幔柱活动产生约400 Myr的周期性变化。
建立了连接深部地幔动力学与地表地质记录的统一机制：2阶对流功率与碎屑锆石年龄峰值相关，而4-5阶结构功率及地幔柱热流与LIPs峰值同步。
me: 3-D spherical thermochemical mantle convection modeling using CitcomS under the extended-Boussinesq approximation with temperature-, depth-, and composition-dependent viscosity.
Imposed surface plate velocity boundary conditions over 2000 Ma by combining the EDRG-90E (2000–940 Ma) and EarthByte (940–0 Ma) plate reconstructions.

Automated deep-origin plume detection scheme tracking plume number, excess temperature, and convective heat flux at 700 km above the CMB and 350 km depth, coupled with discrete Fourier filtering (>200 Myr) and spherical harmonic analysis.
采用CitcomS在扩展Boussinesq近似下进行三维球壳地幔热化学对流模拟，包含依赖温度、深度和成分的粘度定律。
结合EDRG-90E（2000–940 Ma）和EarthByte（940–0 Ma）板块重建模型，施加跨越2000 Ma的地表板块速度边界条件。
应用自动化的深源地幔柱检测方案追踪核幔边界以上700 km和地表以下350 km处的地幔柱数量、过剩温度和对流热流，并结合离散傅里叶滤波（保留>200 Myr周期）和球谐分析。
de: Plate motion reconstruction models: EDRG-90E (2000–940 Ma) and EarthByte (940–0 Ma).
Global geological time-series datasets of continental LIP abundance and detrended detrital zircon U-Pb ages (from Puetz and Condie, 2019; Condie et al., 2021).

Ten numerical simulation cases (M1–M8, M1a, M1b) testing sensitivity to grid resolution, free-slip vs. plate boundary conditions, Rayleigh number, LLSVP buoyancy number, internal heating ratio, intrinsic viscosity ratio, and secular cooling.
板块运动重建模型数据：EDRG-90E（2000–940 Ma）和EarthByte（940–0 Ma）。
全球大陆大火成岩省（LIP）丰度和去趋势碎屑锆石U-Pb年龄的地质时间序列数据集（源自Puetz and Condie, 2019; Condie et al., 2021）。
10组数值模拟实验（M1–M8, M1a, M1b），测试网格分辨率、自由滑移与板块边界条件、瑞利数、LLSVP浮力数、内生热率比、本征粘度比及地幔长期冷却的敏感性。
li: Supercontinent cycles are incorporated via imposed kinematic surface velocity boundary conditions rather than emerging self-consistently from a dynamically coupled lithosphere-mantle system.
The EDRG-90E reconstruction includes True Polar Wander, introducing spurious relative rotation between the surface and Earth's interior.
Model grid resolution constrains the absolute values of detected plume numbers and heat flux, limiting the ability to resolve thin plume conduits in the upper mantle.
超大陆旋回是通过施加运动学地表速度边界条件引入的，而非由自洽演化的岩石圈-地幔动力学耦合系统自然产生。
EDRG-90E重建模型包含真极移（TPW），在作为边界条件时会引入地表与地球内部之间的虚假相对旋转。
模型网格分辨率限制了检测到的地幔柱数量和热流的绝对数值，制约了模拟上地幔细窄地幔柱通道的能力。

sum: This study analyzes the complex rupture process of the 2023 shallow earthquake sequence that occurred in the Tirpul Basin, Afghanistan. By modeling seismic waveforms, the authors resolve the source parameters and rupture characteristics of the sequence. The findings reveal intricate faulting behavior within a sedimentary basin environment and highlight how such shallow tectonic events interact with, and pose hazards to, local energy exploitation and reservoir stability.
本研究分析了2023年阿富汗Tirpul盆地发生的浅源地震序列的复杂破裂过程。通过地震波形建模，作者解析了该序列的震源参数和破裂特征。研究揭示了沉积盆地内部复杂的断层活动行为，并重点探讨了此类浅部构造事件如何与当地能源开采及储层稳定性产生相互作用并带来潜在危害。

采用地震波形反演和震源参数建模方法解析浅源地震序列的破裂过程。
Seismic waveforms from regional and global networks capturing the 2023 Tirpul Basin earthquake sequence.
记录2023年Tirpul盆地地震序列的区域和全球台网地震波形数据。
Delineation of a complex, shallow rupture sequence within the Tirpul Basin and its spatial correlation with energy exploitation zones.

Potential lack of dense local seismic station coverage in western Afghanistan to resolve high-frequency rupture details.

First detailed seismological analysis linking the 2023 Tirpul Basin sequence's complex rupture directly to energy exploitation implications.
首次将2023年Tirpul盆地序列的复杂破裂与能源开采影响直接联系起来进行详细地震学分析。

Evaluated the relationship between shallow tectonic faulting and local sedimentary basin structures.
Assessed the implications of shallow seismicity on regional energy exploitation and reservoir integrity.
表征了2023年Tirpul盆地地震序列的复杂破裂过程和震源参数。
评估了浅部构造断裂与当地沉积盆地结构之间的关系。

sum: This study analyzes He-Ne-Ar isotopes from pristine glassy samples of the Fani Maoré submarine volcanic edifice (2018-2021 eruption offshore Mayotte) to resolve the geodynamic origin of Comoros magmatism. The noble gas signatures are strikingly MORB-like, contradicting a significant chemical contribution from a deep mantle plume. Instead, the authors propose a tectonically triggered, shallow origin. Rifting combined with edge-driven convection at the lithospheric base likely induced low-degree partial melting of a metasomatized, fertile upper mantle, explaining both the MORB-like noble gases and non-MORB lithophile isotopes.
本研究分析了马约特岛近海Fani Maoré海底火山（2018-2021年喷发）新鲜玻璃样品的He-Ne-Ar同位素，以探讨科摩罗岩浆作用的动力学起源。结果显示，惰性气体同位素特征与洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）高度相似，排除了深部地幔柱的显著贡献。研究表明，该区岩浆作用源于构造触发的浅部机制：裂谷作用与……

t: Step-crushing extraction and isotopic analysis of He, Ne, and Ar on pristine submarine volcanic glassy samples.
对新鲜海底火山玻璃样品进行分步压碎及氦、氖、氩同位素分析。
Pristine glassy lava samples from the 2018–2021 Fani Maoré submarine eruption offshore Mayotte.
采集自马约特岛近海Fani Maoré海底火山2018-2021年喷发的新鲜玻璃质熔岩。
Fani Maoré lavas exhibit MORB-like He-Ne-Ar isotopic signatures, arguing against a significant chemical contribution from a mantle plume.
熔岩表现出类似MORB的惰性气体同位素特征，否定了显著的地幔柱物质贡献。
Explaining the discrepancy between MORB-like noble gases and non-MORB lithophile isotopes requires preferential melting of metasomatized lithospheric heterogeneities.
需要引入交代岩石圈不均匀体的选择性熔融来解释MORB型惰性气体与非MORB型亲石同位素的矛盾。

sum: This paper proposes an implicit full waveform inversion imaging (IFWIM) workflow to address the non-linearity and noise sensitivity of joint velocity inversion and seismic imaging. By utilizing the vector reflectivity-based acoustic wave equation, the method simultaneously reconstructs velocity and impedance models. Crucially, these models are implicitly parameterized by the weights of a neural network, allowing continuous representation and resampling at arbitrary resolutions or irregular grids. Reflectivity is subsequently computed from the inverted impedance. Synthetic and field data applications demonstrate that IFWIM successfully recovers high-resolution velocity models and sharp reflectivity images, offering a robust, neural-network-driven alternative to sequential FWI and least-squares reverse time migration (LSRTM) workflows.
本文提出了一种隐式全波形反演成像（IFWIM）工作流，以解决联合速度反演和地震成像中的非线性和噪声敏感性问题。该方法基于矢量反射率声波方程，利用神经网络权重隐式表示速度和阻抗模型，从而允许在任意分辨率或不规则网格上对模型进行重采样。反射率分量直接由反演的阻抗计算得出。合成与实际数据应用表明，IFWI……

Synthetic datasets and field seismic data are utilized to test the joint velocity inversion and reflectivity imaging capabilities.

sum: Quantifying shear wave velocity (Vs) uncertainty is critical for probabilistic seismic hazard analysis. The Vantassel and Cox (2021) (VC21) procedure develops Vs profiles whose uncertainty matches experimental surface wave dispersion uncertainty, but requires a full dispersion data matrix to compute inter-wavelength phase velocity correlations. This limitation prevents its direct use when multiple arrays of different sizes observe distinct wavelength bands. This paper extends VC21 via two approaches to estimate the full correlation matrix: Approach 1 samples theoretical dispersion curves from an initial minimum-misfit global-search inversion (requiring only summary statistics), while Approach 2 combinatorially combines raw band-limited observations across arrays with variance-preserving imputation. Tested on 3-layer and 5-layer synthetic models and field data from the Garner Valley Downhole Array (GVDA), both approaches accurately recover correlation structures, Vs30, and site frequency (f0), yielding better 1D small-strain site amplification fits than traditional inversions or Toro randomization.
剪切波速（Vs）不确定性量化对场地概率地震危险性分析至关重要。VC21方法虽能反演与实验频散不确定性一致的Vs剖面，但需完整频散数据矩阵来计算波长间相速度相关性，无法直接用于不同尺寸阵列观测不同波段的情况。本文提出两种构建替代矩阵的扩展方案：方法1利用初始全局搜索反演的理论频散曲线（仅需统计均值和标……

t: Extends the VC21 uncertainty-consistent surface-wave inversion to incomplete data matrices via two surrogate correlation estimation methods: a physics-informed minimum-misfit global inversion (Approach 1) and combinatorial splicing of raw multi-array observations with variance-preserving imputation (Approach 2).
通过最小拟合差全局反演（方法1）和原始多阵列数据组合及保方差插补（方法2）估计不完整频散矩阵的相关性。

Evaluated on two synthetic datasets (3-layer and 5-layer geostatistical models truncated into three array bands) and field data from Garner Valley Downhole Array (GVDA) combining six active MASW lines and six circular passive MAM arrays (3–1200 m wavelengths).
采用3层和5层合成数据集，以及GVDA场地的6条主动源MASW和6个被动源微动阵列实测数据（波长3–1200 m）。

Both approaches capture experimental dispersion means and variances within 2–3%, accurately recover Vs30 and f0, and improve GVDA small-strain site amplification fits (Pearson r ≈ 0.85, transfer function misfit mTF ≈ 1.1) over traditional inversions (r ≈ 0.8, mTF ≈ 1.5).
频散均值和方差恢复误差在2–3%内，GVDA场地放大传递函数相关性达0.85、拟合差降至1.1，显著优于传统方法。

Dispersion data insensitivity to deep layer boundaries inflates inversion-derived Vs uncertainty at depth (e.g., bimodal Vs distribution below 70 m at GVDA), requiring external geological or resonant frequency constraints.
面波对深部层界面不敏感导致深部反演不确定性偏高，需结合钻孔或场地共振频率等先验信息约束。
Solves the incomplete dispersion data matrix problem for multi-scale surface wave arrays, enabling the first application of uncertainty-consistent Vs inversions at a borehole array site (GVDA).
解决了多尺度阵列频散数据矩阵不完整的问题，首次在井下台阵场地实现不确定性一致的Vs反演。

kc: Extends the VC21 uncertainty-consistent surface wave inversion workflow to handle incomplete dispersion data matrices from multi-scale active and passive arrays.
Proposes Approach 1 (physics-informed surrogate matrix from minimum-misfit inversion) applicable to historical datasets having only mean and standard deviation statistics.
Proposes Approach 2 (combinatorial splicing of raw sub-array dispersion curves with variance-preserving imputation), which is ~6x faster than Approach 1.
Demonstrates on synthetic and Garner Valley Downhole Array (GVDA) field data that resulting Vs suites achieve superior small-strain site amplification predictions (r ≈ 0.85, mTF ≈ 1.1).
将VC21不确定性一致的面波反演流程扩展至处理多尺度主动源和被动源阵列产生的不完整频散数据矩阵。
提出方法1（基于最小拟合差反演构建物理约束替代矩阵），适用于仅有均值和标准差统计量的历史数据集。
提出方法2（组合拼接各子阵列原始频散曲线并结合保方差插补），计算速度比方法1快约6倍。

1D analytical damped elastic ground response analysis (theoretical transfer functions) compared against empirical transfer functions.

基于估计的波长间相关矩阵和按层数（LN）参数化方案，对频散实现进行多元正态抽样与反演。
计算一维解析阻尼弹性场地响应（理论传递函数），并与经验传递函数进行定量拟合优度对比。

Complex 5-layer synthetic model (100 realizations split into 3 wavelength bands) testing deep boundary sensitivity and non-uniqueness.

简单3层合成模型实验（100个模型实现分为1–14 m、13–50 m和50–200 m三个波段）。
复杂5层合成模型实验（100个模型实现分为三个波段），测试深部界面敏感性与反演非唯一性。
Garner Valley井下台阵（GVDA）实测数据，结合6条主动源MASW测线（每条14个三分量节点仪）和6个圆形被动源微动阵列（直径20至450 m，波长范围3–1200 m）。

Surface wave dispersion alone has limited sensitivity to deep impedance contrasts (e.g., below 30 m in the 5-layer model and >70 m at GVDA), inflating layer-boundary uncertainty without a priori constraints.

sum: Precariously balanced rocks (PBRs) constrain historical earthquake ground motion upper bounds, but traditional discrete element method (DEM) fragility modeling is computationally expensive. This study introduces Virtual Shake Robot 2 (VSR2), a physics-engine simulation platform integrating PyBullet and Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2). Using a lidar-derived 3D mesh of a natural granitic PBR and 582 recorded strong-motion displacement histories from physical shake-table experiments, the authors iteratively calibrate five contact-physics parameters and benchmark VSR2 against experimental outcomes and 3DEC DEM simulations. VSR2 achieves slightly higher overturning prediction performance (F1-score 0.86 vs. 0.85 for DEM) while reducing wall-clock runtime by 10^2 to 10^5 times. Logistic regression fragility sensitivity analyses reveal that lateral friction strongly controls the 95% overturning probability boundary, whereas restitution and spinning friction have minor effects. This computational efficiency enables uncertainty-aware PBR fragility modeling for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment.
危岩（PBRs）可用于约束长周期地震动上限，但传统的离散元法（DEM）易损性建模计算成本极高。本研究开发了结合PyBullet物理引擎与ROS2的虚拟振动台平台（VSR2）。利用天然花岗岩危岩的激光雷达三维网格模型及582条实测强震位移记录的物理振动台实验数据，研究校准了5个接触物理参数，并将VSR……

VSR2结合PyBullet脉冲物理引擎与ROS2模拟单轴地震动下的危岩倾覆，通过最大化准确率、精确率和召回率均值迭代优…

Benchmark dataset from Saifullah and Wittich (2023) comprising a FARO lidar 3D mesh of a 353.8 kg granitic PBR, 582 scaled earthquake recordings from NGA-West2 and CESMD, physical shake-table results, and 3DEC DEM outputs.

VSR2 achieved 0.88 accuracy, 0.87 precision, 0.85 recall, and 0.86 F1-score (slightly outperforming DEM's 0.85 F1-score) while running 10^3 to 10^5 times faster for the mesh PBR and >10^2 times faster for a prism.

Calibration used a single natural PBR specimen under single-axis rigid-body excitation without splitting the 582 motions into separate calibration and validation sets.

First quantitative calibration, DEM benchmarking, and contact-parameter sensitivity analysis of a physics-engine virtual shake table (PyBullet/ROS2) against physical overturning experiments on a natural PBR.

kc: Developed Virtual Shake Robot 2 (VSR2) integrating PyBullet and ROS2 for high-precision, parallelized virtual shake-table simulations of PBRs.
Calibrated and benchmarked physics-engine contact parameters against 582 real shake-table experiments and DEM, achieving comparable accuracy (F1 = 0.86) with 10^2 to 10^5 speedup.
Quantified sensitivity of 95% overturning fragility boundaries to individual contact parameters, identifying lateral friction as the dominant control under single-axis shaking.

sum: This paper introduces DoubleF, a novel method for phase association and earthquake location, a critical step in constructing earthquake catalogs, especially when combined with deep learning phase pickers. DoubleF employs adaptive Sobol sampling, matrix parallelization, and GPU acceleration to achieve significant speedups, reducing computation time by dozens of times compared to existing methods. Evaluated on real data from the Jishishan earthquake aftershocks and Baihetan reservoir seismicity, as well as synthetic data, DoubleF demonstrated superior recall (1-4% improvement) and robustness to noise, even associating events with up to 80% noise in synthetic tests. Its insensitivity to parameter settings ensures broad applicability for real-time monitoring with both dense and sparse networks.
本文提出了一种新颖的地震相关联和定位方法DoubleF，这是构建地震目录的关键步骤，尤其与深度学习震相拾取结合时。DoubleF采用自适应Sobol采样、矩阵并行化和GPU加速，实现了显著的加速，与现有方法相比计算时间缩短了数十倍。在2023年积石山地震余震序列、白鹤滩水库诱震活动真实数据及合成数据……

sum: This Zenodo repository provides a high-frequency seismic dataset and four self-contained Python scripts. The dataset covers 19 seismic stations recording four major earthquake sequences: the 2023 Kahramanmaraş (Turkey) earthquake, the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake, the 2016 Kumamoto earthquake, and the 2024 Hualien (Taiwan) earthquake. The provided scripts allow users to read per-station data and regenerate corresponding figures, facilitating open-science reproduction of high-frequency wavefield analyses near major fault zones.
该数据集包含19个地震台站记录的四次重大主震（2023年土耳其、2019年里奇克莱斯特、2016年熊本和2024年花莲地震）的高频地震数据。仓库提供了四个独立的Python脚本，用于读取单台数据并重新生成对应的分析图表。该资源为研究大震近场高频波场特征及强地面运动提供了开放、可复现的数据与工具支持。

t: Self-contained Python scripts designed to read per-station seismic data and regenerate corresponding figures.
用于读取单台地震数据并重新生成对应图表的独立Python脚本。
High-frequency seismic data from 19 stations spanning four major mainshocks (Turkey 2023, Ridgecrest 2019, Kumamoto 2016, Hualien 2024).

An open-access, reproducible dataset and codebase for analyzing near-source high-frequency ground motions of major earthquakes.
提供了一个用于分析大震近源高频地面运动的开源、可复现的数据集与代码库。

数据集仅限于19个台站和四个特定的地震序列。
Provides a packaged, easily reproducible high-frequency dataset combining multiple significant global earthquake events.

涵盖2023年土耳其、2019年里奇克莱斯特、2016年熊本和2024年花莲地震的19个台站的地震波形数据。

High-frequency near-source data from major earthquakes are critical for understanding earthquake source and rupture processes.

sum: Accurate wavefront directionality measurements at seismic arrays are crucial for locating small-scale mantle scatterers, yet near-receiver crustal structure can distort incoming wavefields. This study combines 3-D Snell's law ray-tracing synthetics and teleseismic array beamforming across Alaska (complex Moho) and the central US (flat Moho control) to evaluate how dipping Moho interfaces affect slowness and backazimuth measurements. Using automated prominence-based peak detection on multi-phase vespagrams, the authors observe systematic backazimuth offsets mostly within 5° across 300–550 km aperture Alaskan sub-arrays. Synthetic optimization shows that modest Moho tilts (~6°) reproduce these deviations and dominate over intra-crustal lateral velocity variations (~80% larger effect on backazimuth). Because a 5° backazimuth error can shift inferred mid-mantle P-to-P scatterer locations by up to ~500 km, the authors introduce a Snell's law back-projection correction to remove receiver-side Moho refraction effects from vespagrams prior to deep-Earth interpretation.
地震台阵波束形成测量的波前方向对定位地幔小尺度散射体至关重要，但台站下方的浅部地壳结构会扭曲波场。本研究结合三维斯涅尔定律射线追踪合成实验与远震台阵波束形成方法，对比分析了阿拉斯加（复杂莫霍面）和美国中部（平坦莫霍面控制区）的地壳厚度变化对慢度和反方位角测量的影响。结果表明，阿拉斯加子台阵存在约5°……

t: The authors trace rays through mantle, tilted Moho, and crust, estimating array apparent backazimuth and incidence angle via Nelder-Mead optimization, and apply automated prominence-based peak picking to multi-phase slowness-backazimuth vespagrams.
结合三维斯涅尔定律射线追踪与Nelder-Mead平面波前优化，并利用突出度峰值拾取算法自动分析多震相聚束图。
Teleseismic P, pP, sP, and PP arrivals (distances 65°–120°, depths >60 km) recorded across 300–550 km aperture Alaskan sub-arrays and a flat-Moho control region in the central US.
阿拉斯加300–550 km子台阵与美国中部平坦莫霍面控制区记录的震中距65°–120°、深度>60 km远震数据。

Alaskan backazimuth offsets (mostly within 5°) show 62% polarity agreement and Spearman correlation rho = 0.25 with directional Moho gradients; a 10% lateral crustal velocity contrast yields up to 1.2° offset.
阿拉斯加反方位角偏差（<5°）与莫霍面梯度极性一致性达62%（ρ=0.25）；10%地壳横向速度差异仅引起1.2°偏差。

Ray-theory synthetics neglect finite-frequency Fresnel-zone averaging, large sub-array apertures smooth small-scale Moho heterogeneity, and 1-D crustal velocity assumptions omit intra-crustal lateral variations.
射线理论忽略了有限频菲涅尔带平均效应，且大孔径子台阵平滑了小尺度莫霍面起伏。

Extends single-station dipping-Moho analytical formulations to modern regional-scale (~500 km) arrays, automating multi-phase vespagram peak picking and demonstrating receiver-side back-projection corrections for deep mantle scattering.
将单台倾斜莫霍面校正推广至500公里级区域台阵，提出了多震相聚束图自动拾取与浅部折射反投影校正方法。

kc: Quantified the impact of dipping Moho topography on single-station and large-aperture (~300-550 km) seismic array slowness and backazimuth measurements using 3-D ray tracing and Nelder-Mead planar wavefront optimization.

Demonstrated systematic receiver-side backazimuth offsets (mostly within 5°) across Alaskan sub-arrays that correlate statistically with directional Moho gradients (62% polarity agreement, Spearman rho = 0.25), contrasted against a flat-Moho control region in the central US.
Evaluated intra-crustal lateral velocity heterogeneity (10% contrast), showing Moho tilt dominates backazimuth deviations while slowness is sensitive to both.
Developed a Snell's law ray back-projection workflow to correct multi-phase vespagrams for near-receiver Moho refraction, preventing mid-mantle scatterer mislocations of up to ~500 km.
利用三维射线追踪与Nelder-Mead平面波前优化，量化了倾斜莫霍面地形对单台及大孔径（300-550 km）地震台阵慢度和反方位角测量的影响。
揭示了阿拉斯加子台阵中主要在5°以内的系统性接收端反方位角偏差与莫霍面方向梯度的统计相关性（62%极性一致，Spearman相关系数0.25），并与美国中部平坦莫霍面控制区进行了对比。
评估了地壳内部10%横向速度非均质性的影响，证明莫霍面倾斜主导了反方位角偏差，而慢度对两者均敏感。
提出了基于斯涅尔定律射线反投影的聚束图（vespagram）浅部结构校正流程，避免了高达约500公里的中地幔散射体定位误差。
me: 3-D ray tracing across tilted Moho interfaces using Snell's law coupled with Nelder-Mead optimization to fit planar wavefront backazimuth and incidence angle across synthetic cross and circular arrays.
Grid-search time-domain beamforming in slowness (0-10 s/deg) and backazimuth (±50 deg) space with station elevation travel-time corrections (Vp = 3 km/s).
Automated vespagram quality control using a Max/Mean coherence ratio threshold of 20 and prominence-based peak selection (amplitude >25% and prominence >10% of global maximum).
Receiver-side vespagram correction via Snell's law ray back-projection to the base of the crust using Vcrust = 5.8 km/s and Vmantle = 8.0 km/s.
结合三维斯涅尔定律射线追踪与Nelder-Mead优化算法，拟合合成十字形与圆形台阵的平面波前反方位角和入射角。
在慢度（0–10 s/°）和反方位角（±50°）空间进行网格搜索波束形成，并加入台站高程走时校正（Vp = 3 km/s）。
基于最大/平均相干比阈值（>20）和突出度峰值拾取算法（振幅>全局最大值25%，突出度>10%）实现聚束图自动质量控制。
采用地壳（5.8 km/s）和地幔（8.0 km/s）P波速度模型，通过斯涅尔定律将射线反投影至地壳底部以校正聚束图的接收端折射效应。
de: Teleseismic earthquakes at epicentral distances of 65°–120° and source depths >60 km recorded by regional sub-arrays (apertures 300–550 km) across Alaska.
Control dataset from a flat-Moho region in the central United States recorded by US Transportable Array stations.
Synthetic ray-tracing experiments for single stations, 5°-aperture cross/circular arrays above a tilted Moho, and a flat-Moho crust with a 10% lateral velocity contrast (Vp = 5.5 vs 6.0 km/s).
阿拉斯加地区子台阵（孔径300–550 km）记录的震中距65°–120°、震源深度大于60 km的远震波形数据。
美国中部平坦莫霍面控制区的US Transportable Array台阵记录数据。
单台、倾斜莫霍面上方5°孔径十字/圆形台阵，以及含10%横向速度差异（Vp = 5.5与6.0 km/s）平坦莫霍面地壳的合成射线追踪实验。
li: Synthetic tests rely on infinite-frequency ray theory and neglect finite-frequency wavefront healing and Fresnel-zone averaging, representing an upper bound on Moho-induced deflections.
Large sub-array apertures (300–550 km) spatially smooth smaller-scale Moho topography variations.

Empirical beamforming parameters (aperture, frequency band, Max/Mean ratio of 20, prominence thresholds) are tuned for Alaska and may require retuning for other array geometries or noise environments.

Moho refraction corrections assume a constant-velocity crust (5.8 km/s), leaving residual slowness and backazimuth scatter from lateral crustal heterogeneity, anisotropy, sediments, and slab structure.
合成测试基于高频射线理论，未包含有限频波场效应和菲涅尔带空间平均，因此代表莫霍面地形影响的上限估计。
大孔径子台阵（300–550 km）在空间上平滑了小尺度莫霍面地形起伏。
波束形成与自动拾取经验参数（孔径、频带、相干比阈值20等）针对阿拉斯加数据集调优，推广至其他台阵需重新调整。
莫霍面折射校正假设地壳速度均匀（5.8 km/s），未完全消除地壳横向不均匀性、各向异性、沉积层及俯冲板片引起的残余散射。

tm.why: The paper focuses on seismic array beamforming (vespagrams) across Alaskan sub-arrays and Central US Transportable Array stations to measure backazimuth and slowness deviations.
The primary implication of the work is demonstrating how receiver-side Moho tilt biases inferred mid-mantle P-to-P scatterer locations by up to hundreds of kilometers.
The study quantifies the influence of 3-D crustal thickness variations (dipping Moho topography) and lateral crustal velocity contrasts on incoming teleseismic wavefronts.

ev.notes: The provided PDF is the complete 24-page peer-review and author response dossier published alongside the Seismica article, containing extensive verbatim excerpts, updated text passages, equations/parameter details, and embedded figures (including the revised Fig. 2, Fig. 9, and permutation test histograms), combined with the full paper abstract.

sum: Forecasting induced seismicity is hindered by an observational impasse: statistics-based, physics-based, and machine-learning-based (ML) models can retrospectively fit historical data equally well due to trade-offs with aftershock triggering, yet yield drastically different future forecasts. To resolve this, the authors propose a 'model differencing' framework that uses Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization and an adversarial log-likelihood metric to design fluid injection protocols that maximize forecast divergences between competing model paradigms. Calibrated on the Basel enhanced geothermal system catalog, the optimal injection protocols consistently emerge as two-phased: first forcing one model to dominate seismicity production, then flipping dominance to the competing model by exploiting underlying assumptions like rate-independence or convolutional lags. Synthesizing these results, the authors prototype the Seismogenic Fault Injection Test (SFIT), a standardized two-period diagnostic test to discern true physical forcing mechanisms and refine forecasting models before major injections begin.
针对统计、物理和机器学习三类诱发地震预测模型在回溯拟合中表现相似但未来预测差异巨大的观测困境，本文提出“模型差分”框架。基于巴塞尔地热系统数据校准的传染型诱发地震（ETIS）模型，利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（McMC）方法和对抗对数似然目标函数，搜索能最大化模型间预测差异的注水方案。优化方案呈两阶段特征……

t: The authors define an adversarial log-likelihood metric between pairs of Epidemic Type Induced Seismicity (ETIS) models and use Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization to find injection rate profiles that maximize forecast differences.
定义成对ETIS模型间的对抗对数似然指标，利用McMC优化搜索能最大化预测差异的注水速率方案。
The three ETIS models are calibrated using the injection rate and seismicity catalog from the enhanced geothermal system at Basel, supplemented by the Utah FORGE dataset.
使用巴塞尔增强型地热系统（EGS）的注水与地震目录数据校准三类模型，并辅以Utah FORGE数据集验证。

Retrospective fits to Basel show ~0.4% relative log-likelihood difference and 0.01%–1.0% cumulative event count error across models, whereas McMC model differencing yields distinct two-phased injection protocols that separate model forecasts.
三类模型回溯拟合巴塞尔数据的对数似然相对差异仅约0.4%，而模型差分获得了可有效区分模型的两阶段注水方案。
The surrogate models neglect non-linear physical processes like poroelasticity, the Kaiser effect, and spatial propagation, and the method cannot constrain non-stationary parameters.
代理模型忽略了孔隙弹性和凯泽效应等非线性物理过程，且无法约束随时间演化的非平稳参数。
First framework to actively optimize fluid injection protocols via adversarial model differencing to test hypotheses and discriminate between induced seismicity forecasting paradigms.
首次通过对抗模型差分主动优化注水方案，构建可检验假设以鉴别不同诱发地震预测范式。

kc: Introduced the 'model differencing' framework using adversarial log-likelihood and McMC to design experiments that maximize divergence between competing seismicity forecast models.

Demonstrated that optimal discriminative injection protocols are two-phased, sequentially exploiting differences in rate-independence (ML), instantaneous proportionality (statistical), and convolutional lag (physical).
Developed a practical two-period prototype and pseudo-algorithm for the Seismogenic Fault Injection Test (SFIT) to standardize pre-injection fault characterization.
提出“模型差分”框架，结合对抗对数似然与McMC优化设计出最大化不同地震预测模型差异的注水实验。
证明最优鉴别性注水方案具有两阶段特征，可依次利用速率独立性（机器学习）、瞬时正比（统计）和卷积滞后（物理）的假设差异。
开发了包含两个周期的致震断层注水测试（SFIT）实用原型及伪算法，推动大规模注水前断层特征测试的标准化。
me: Formulated Epidemic Type Induced Seismicity (ETIS) point-process models combining ETAS aftershock triggering with three surrogate injection forcing functions (statistical, physical convolutional, and ML on/off).
Defined an adversarial log-likelihood (aLL) objective function measuring the absolute piecewise difference between two models' conditional intensity forecasts.
Applied Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization (20 realizations of 1,000 iterations) to find injection rate histories v(t) that maximize aLL for fixed model parameters.
构建传染型诱发地震（ETIS）点过程模型，将ETAS余震触发与统计、物理卷积和机器学习开关三类代理注水强迫函数相结合。
定义对抗对数似然（aLL）目标函数，量化两个模型条件强度函数预测之间的绝对分段差异。
应用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（McMC）优化（20次实现，每次1000步迭代），在固定模型参数下搜索最大化aLL的注水速率历史v(t)。
de: Retrospective fitting of the three ETIS models to the 2006 Basel Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) injection rate and seismicity catalog data.
Synthetic McMC optimization experiments for three adversarial pairings: statistics vs. ML (SvM), physics vs. ML (PvM), and statistics vs. physics (SvP).
Supplemental validation on alternative datasets including the Utah FORGE hydraulic stimulation catalog.
利用2006年巴塞尔增强型地热系统（EGS）的注水速率和地震目录数据对三类ETIS模型进行回溯性拟合。
针对统计与机器学习（SvM）、物理与机器学习（PvM）、统计与物理（SvP）三种对抗组合开展合成McMC优化实验。
在Utah FORGE水力压裂目录等替代数据集上进行了补充验证。
li: The surrogate models are overly simplistic and neglect complex physical processes such as the Kaiser effect, poroelasticity, slip-dependent permeability, fluid migration, and spatial heterogeneity.
The framework assumes stationary model parameters and forcing functions, making it insufficient to constrain temporally evolving fault properties during injection.
Practical execution of SFIT requires tight hydraulic control over fault injection and relies on having a sufficiently wide span of seismically discernible injection rates.
代理模型过于简化，忽略了凯泽效应、孔隙弹性、滑移相关渗透率、流体运移和空间非均质性等复杂物理过程。
框架假设模型参数和强迫函数平稳，无法约束注水过程中随时间演化的非平稳断层属性。
SFIT的实际执行需要对断层注水进行精细水力控制，且依赖于足够宽的可观测致震注水速率范围。

tm.why: The paper develops a standardized fluid injection test (SFIT) to improve induced seismicity rate forecasting and model discrimination.
The framework directly targets earthquake rate forecasting to manage and mitigate induced seismicity risks prior to large-scale operations.
A Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization approach is used to search for optimal injection protocols that maximize adversarial log-likelihood.

ev.notes: Full 11-page GRL article PDF (plus ETH cover page) used for all analysis, equations, figure breakdowns, and verbatim quotes.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides teleseismic arrival-time pick files (in .ttr format compatible with the FMTOMO tomography package) for a seismic tomography study of Macquarie Island. The dataset includes three versions of the pick files: completely unfiltered picks, manually filtered picks, and picks that have undergone manual filtering, minimum pick filtering (at least 8 picks per event), and preliminary tomography filtering. This dataset is valuable for reproducing or extending crustal and upper mantle velocity structure imaging beneath Macquarie Island.
该Zenodo数据库提供了用于麦夸里岛地震层析成像研究的远震走时拾取文件（FMTOMO软件兼容的.ttr格式）。数据集包含三个版本：未过滤的原始拾取、经人工筛选的拾取，以及经过人工筛选、单事件最少8个拾取过滤及初步层析成像过滤的最终拾取。该数据集对于重现或扩展麦夸里岛地壳与上地幔速度结构成像具有重要……

t: Manual and automated filtering of teleseismic travel-time picks for fast-marching tomography.
对远震走时拾取进行人工和自动过滤，以用于快速行进层析成像。
Teleseismic arrival-time pick files (.ttr format) in unfiltered, manually filtered, and fully filtered versions.

A clean, multi-stage filtered dataset of teleseismic picks ready for FMTOMO tomography of Macquarie Island.
一套经过多阶段过滤、可直接用于麦夸里岛FMTOMO层析成像的远震拾取数据。

Provides the first open-access, FMTOMO-compatible teleseismic pick dataset specifically for Macquarie Island tomography.
首次为麦夸里岛层析成像提供了开放获取、兼容FMTOMO的远震拾取数据集。

kc: Provides a curated dataset of teleseismic travel-time picks specifically formatted for FMTOMO software.
Offers multiple levels of data filtering (unfiltered, manually filtered, and tomography-filtered) to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
提供了一套专门为FMTOMO软件格式化的远震走时拾取数据集。

Minimum pick filtering requiring at least 8 picks per event.

单事件最少8个拾取的最小拾取数过滤。

Tomography of Macquarie Island targets the crustal and lithospheric structure of this unique oceanic setting.

sum: This study presents an explainable hybrid machine learning framework to classify global earthquakes as tsunamigenic or non-tsunamigenic. Utilizing a dataset of 782 events (2001–2022) with seismic, geophysical, and intensity parameters (e.g., magnitude, focal depth, CDI, MMI), the authors evaluate SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression. Hyperparameters are optimized using Optuna. The hybrid SVM-Optuna model achieves outstanding performance with a recall of 0.98 and an F1-score of 0.98. To address the "black box" nature of ML, SHAP and LIME are integrated, revealing that shallow focal depth, magnitude, and intensity parameters are the most critical predictors. This framework serves as a rapid screening tool for early-stage tsunami warning workflows.
本研究提出了一种可解释的混合机器学习框架，用于全球海啸源地震的二分类。研究利用2001-2022年间782个地震事件的数据集（包含震级、震源深度、CDI和MMI等参数），评估了SVM、随机森林、XGBoost和逻辑回归模型，并利用Optuna进行超参数优化。结果表明，SVM-Optuna模型表现最佳……

t: A hybrid machine learning framework combining SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression, optimized via Optuna and interpreted using SHAP and LIME.
结合了SVM、随机森林、XGBoost和逻辑回归的混合机器学习框架，利用Optuna优化并使用SHAP和LIME进行解释…
A global empirical dataset of 782 earthquake events (2001–2022) containing seismic, geophysical, and intensity-related parameters (magnitude, depth, CDI, MMI).
包含782个地震事件（2001-2022年）的全球经验数据集，具有震级、深度、CDI和MMI等地震与烈度参数。
The hybrid SVM-Optuna model achieved the best performance, reaching a recall of 0.98 and an F1-score of 0.98 in identifying tsunamigenic earthquakes.

sum: This paper evaluates surface-wave full-waveform inversion (SWFWI) for fine-scale characterization of shallow geological structures under short-offset acquisition constraints, which are common in urban environments. Through synthetic and field-data applications, the authors demonstrate that SWFWI successfully recovers target anomalies and stratigraphic features where conventional multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) fails. Because short-offset configurations yield simpler waveforms with less dispersion, the conventional L2-norm objective function remains effective under amplitude-consistent conditions. However, the global correlation norm (GCN) and trace-by-trace normalized L2-norm show superior robustness when dealing with amplitude inconsistencies caused by source-receiver coupling. The field-data application successfully reconstructs a three-layer subsurface framework, confirming the practical viability of SWFWI for shallow engineering and environmental investigations.
本文研究了短偏移距条件下的表面波全波形反演（SWFWI）方法。在城市等受限空间中，常规MASW因偏移距不足而失效。数值模拟和实测表明，SWFWI能有效重建浅部地层和异常体。在振幅一致时，常规L2范数表现良好；在存在耦合振幅不一致时，全局相关范数（GCN）更具鲁棒性。实测应用成功重建了三层地下框架，证……

t: Surface-wave full-waveform inversion (SWFWI) utilizing L2-norm, global correlation norm (GCN), and trace-by-trace normalized objective functions to invert short-offset seismic waveforms.
利用L2范数、全局相关范数和逐道归一化目标函数的表面波全波形反演。
Synthetic short-offset seismic datasets modeling shallow anomalies and a real-world field dataset acquired under urban-like short-offset constraints.
模拟浅部异常体的合成短偏移距地震数据集，以及城市受限环境下的野外实测数据集。
SWFWI successfully resolved shallow stratigraphic features where MASW failed, with GCN showing high robustness against coupling-related amplitude inconsistencies.
SWFWI成功解析了常规MASW无法分辨的浅部特征，且GCN对振幅不一致具高鲁棒性。
Probing depth is highly dependent on the lowest usable frequencies, and amplitude inconsistencies require specialized objective functions.
探测深度依赖最低可用频率，且对耦合引起的振幅不一致敏感。
Demonstrating the viability of SWFWI for short-offset acquisitions and comparing L2-norm versus GCN under amplitude-inconsistent coupling conditions.
证实了短偏移距下SWFWI的可行性，并对比了不同目标函数。

Evaluated the performance of L2-norm, global correlation norm (GCN), and trace-by-trace normalized L2-norm under amplitude-consistent and inconsistent conditions.
Validated the short-offset SWFWI workflow on real-world field data, recovering a consistent three-layer subsurface model.

评估了L2范数、全局相关范数（GCN）及道归一化L2范数在振幅一致和不一致条件下的表现。

L2-norm objective function optimization

sum: This study addresses the challenge of reconstructing long-term volcanic records in glaciated regions by analyzing 70 marine core tephras from the Gulf of Alaska, spanning from the mid-Pleistocene to the present. The authors employ compositional data analysis to quantify 37 eruptions across eight cores, and apply machine learning classification and conformal prediction algorithms to identify volcanic sources. For cases where ML is unsuitable, multivariate distance-based metrics are used. The results identify the Mount Katmai magmatic system as the primary source, showing that large volcanic centers (Katmai, Fisher, Emmons Lake) produced highly consistent incompatible trace element ratios over time. This work demonstrates the power of combining trace element geochemistry with statistical and machine learning tools for robust tephra correlation.
本研究针对冰川覆盖区域火山记录重建的难题，分析了阿拉斯加湾8个海芯中的70个火山灰样品（记录可追溯至中更新世）。研究采用成分数据分析定量化了37次喷发，并结合机器学习分类与共形预测算法来识别最可能的火山源；在机器学习不适用时，则采用多元距离指标。结果表明，卡特迈山（Mount Katmai）是最主要……

t: Combines compositional data analysis, machine learning classification, and conformal prediction to statistically fingerprint and classify marine tephra sources.
结合成分数据分析、机器学习分类和共形预测，对海洋火山灰源进行统计指纹识别与分类。
Geochemical trace element data from 70 marine core tephras representing 37 eruptions across eight cores in the Gulf of Alaska.
来自阿拉斯加湾8个钻孔的70个海洋核心火山灰样品的地球化学微量元素数据，代表37次喷发。
Identified Mount Katmai as the primary source and showed that major volcanic centers produced nearly invariant incompatible trace element ratios over time.
确定卡特迈山为主要火山源，并表明主要火山中心长期产生几乎不变的不相容微量元素比值岩浆。
Classification accuracy is constrained by the completeness of the reference database for potential source volcanoes.
分类准确性受限于潜在源火山参考数据库的完整性。
First application of conformal prediction and compositional data analysis to long-term marine tephra source attribution in the Gulf of Alaska.
首次将共形预测和成分数据分析应用于阿拉斯加湾长期海洋火山灰源的归属研究。

kc: Analyzed a virtually uninterrupted mid-Pleistocene to present tephra record from 70 marine cores in the Gulf of Alaska.
Developed a workflow combining compositional data analysis, machine learning classification, and conformal prediction to fingerprint volcanic sources.
Identified Mount Katmai, Fisher Caldera, and Emmons Lake as major sources with nearly invariant incompatible trace element ratios over long timescales.

开发了结合成分数据分析、机器学习分类和共形预测的工作流，用于对火山源进行指纹识别。
确定卡特迈山、费希尔破火山口和埃蒙斯湖为主要火山源，并发现它们在长期尺度上产生的不相容微量元素比值几乎保持不变。

Machine learning classification algorithms for source volcano identification.

sum: This paper presents a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) dataset and processing catalog recorded during the April 2024 stimulation operations at the Utah FORGE geothermal site. The DAS data, acquired from three wells during stimulation of well 16A, is accompanied by a calibrated 3D velocity model, microseismic event locations, and moment magnitudes. Comparing the DAS processing results with independent downhole and surface geophone arrays reveals a fourfold increase in reliable event locations and magnitudes. This open dataset and its baseline catalog provide a valuable resource for understanding enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) and developing advanced DAS processing algorithms.
本文展示了2024年4月Utah FORGE地热项目压裂期间的DAS数据集及处理目录。该数据源自三个观测井，包含校准后的三维速度模型、微震定位和矩震级。与传统井下和地表检波器相比，DAS目录中可靠定位的事件数量增加了四倍。该开放数据集为理解增强型地热系统及开发新型DAS处理方法提供了重要资源。

t: Calibration of a 3D velocity model, microseismic event location, and moment magnitude estimation using multi-well DAS data.
利用多井DAS数据进行三维速度模型校准、微震定位和矩震级估算。
DAS dataset recorded from three wells during the April 2024 stimulation of well 16A at the Utah FORGE geothermal site.
2024年4月Utah FORGE地热田16A井压裂期间，通过三口井记录的DAS数据集。
The DAS catalog achieved a fourfold increase in reliable microseismic locations and magnitudes compared to conventional downhole and surface arrays.
与传统井下和地表台网相比，DAS目录中可靠的微震定位和震级数量增加了四倍。
Cable damage and high noise levels prevented the analysis of DAS data during the stimulation of production well 16B.
由于电缆损坏和高噪声水平，无法分析生产井16B压裂期间的DAS数据。
First release of a comprehensive multi-well stimulation DAS dataset and baseline microseismic catalog for the 2024 Utah FORGE EGS campaign.
首次公开发布2024年Utah FORGE EGS项目完整的多井压裂DAS数据集及基准微震目录。

kc: Presents a public, high-quality DAS dataset from the April 2024 stimulation at Utah FORGE.
Provides a processed microseismic catalog including calibrated 3D velocity model, event locations, and moment magnitudes.
Demonstrates a fourfold increase in reliable event detections and locations compared to conventional geophone arrays.
公开了2024年4月Utah FORGE压裂期间的高质量DAS数据集。
提供了一个经过处理的微震目录，包括校准后的三维速度模型、事件定位和矩震级。
证实了与传统检波器台网相比，DAS在可靠事件检测和定位数量上实现了四倍的增长。

sum: This paper presents MEAD-M20, a 3-D crustal and upper-mantle tomographic model of the Middle East, Anatolia, Iran, and the Caucasus constructed via adjoint full-waveform inversion. Starting from GLAD-M25 on a 60°×60° mesh using SPECFEM3D_Globe, the authors perform 20 conjugate-gradient iterations inverting three-component body- (15–50 s) and surface-wave (30–100 s) multitaper traveltime measurements from 210 regional earthquakes recorded at 1,215 stations, notably incorporating 239 Saudi Geological Survey stations. After 12 iterations, the crustal mesh is vertically refined. The resulting transversely isotropic S-wave and isotropic P-wave model reduces waveform misfit by ~50% and passes point-spread function and independent-event tests. Novel findings include sharp imaging of the Arabian shield-platform boundary down to 250 km, localized mantle plumes beneath the Arabian Plate, Jordan, and the Levant linked to intraplate volcanism, Tethys slab remnants shallowing southward along the Bitlis-Zagros suture, and low-velocity anomalies extending to 200 km beneath the North and East Anatolian faults.
本文利用伴随全波形反演方法构建了中东及周边地区（安纳托利亚、伊朗、高加索）的三维地壳与上地幔模型MEAD-M20。研究以GLAD-M25为初始模型，利用210个区域地震在1215个台站（含沙特地质调查局239个台站）的三分量记录，结合15–50秒体波和30–100秒面波多窗走时测量，通过20次共轭梯……

t: Adjoint full-waveform inversion using SPECFEM3D_Globe on a 60°×60° mesh over 20 conjugate-gradient iterations, minimizing multitaper cross-correlation traveltime misfits of 15–50 s body waves and 30–100 s body/surface waves for transversely isotropic Vs and isotropic Vp.
基于SPECFEM3D_Globe在60°×60°网格上进行20次伴随全波形反演迭代，拟合15–100秒体波与面波多窗走…

Broadband three-component waveforms from 210 GCMT earthquakes (Mw 5.0–6.7) recorded by 1,215 stations across the Middle East, including 956 public stations, 239 Saudi Geological Survey stations, 17 Iranian stations, and 3 Iraqi stations.
收集210个区域地震在1215个台站（含239个沙特SGS台站及伊朗、伊拉克台站）的三分量宽频带波形。

Total waveform traveltime misfit decreased by ~50% over 20 iterations (reaching 87,399 windows). The model reveals up to 20% Vs and 15% Vp crustal perturbations, the Arabian shield-platform boundary to 250 km, local mantle plumes, and Tethys slab remnants.
走时残差降低约50%，揭示了延伸至250公里的阿拉伯盾-台边界、局部地幔柱及特提斯板片残留。

P-wave resolution is lower than S-wave resolution due to lower amplitudes, longer wavelengths, and weak surface-wave sensitivity; crustal updates are also limited by the 30 s minimum surface-wave period.
P波分辨率低于S波，且受30秒最短面波周期限制，地壳浅部结构更新有限。

First regional FWI model of the entire Middle East assimilating dense Saudi Geological Survey, Iraqi, and Iranian waveforms to jointly resolve isotropic Vp and radially anisotropic Vs down to the transition zone.
首次融合高密度沙特、伊拉克与伊朗波形数据，联合反演中东全区三维各向同性Vp与径向各向异性Vs结构。

kc: Developed MEAD-M20, a 3-D radially anisotropic S-wave and isotropic P-wave crustal and upper-mantle model of the Middle East using 20 adjoint FWI iterations.

Assimilated previously restricted waveform data from 239 Saudi Geological Survey (SGS) stations alongside Iraqi, Iranian, and public networks (1,215 stations total), markedly improving coverage in the Arabian Peninsula.

Imaged localized low-velocity mantle plumes beneath the Arabian Plate, Jordan, and the Levant, Tethys slab remnants along the Bitlis-Zagros suture zone, and ~200 km deep low-velocity zones beneath the North and East Anatolian faults.
通过20次伴随全波形反演迭代，构建了中东地区三维径向各向异性S波与各向同性P波地壳上地幔模型MEAD-M20。
整合了沙特地质调查局（SGS）239个台站以及伊拉克、伊朗和公开台网共1215个台站的波形数据，显著提升了阿拉伯半岛的分辨率。
清晰成像了阿拉伯板块、约旦和黎凡特下方的局部地幔柱、沿Bitlis-Zagros缝合带分布的特提斯洋板片残留，以及北/东安纳托利亚断层下方延伸至约200公里深的低速异常。
me: 3-D spectral-element forward and adjoint wavefield simulations on a 60°×60° regional chunk using SPECFEM3D_Globe starting from GLAD-M25.
Multitaper frequency-dependent cross-correlation traveltime misfit measurements automated via FLEXWIN across 15–50 s body waves and 30–100 s body and surface waves.

Preconditioned conjugate-gradient optimization over 20 iterations with pseudo-Hessian preconditioning, geographical source/receiver weighting, crustal vertical mesh refinement after iteration 12, and point-spread function resolution analysis.
以GLAD-M25为初始模型，利用SPECFEM3D_Globe在60°×60°区域网格上进行三维谱元正演与伴随波场数值模拟。
使用FLEXWIN自动挑选窗口，在15–50秒体波和30–100秒体波与面波频段计算多窗频变互相关走时残差。
采用伪Hessian预条件共轭梯度法进行20次迭代优化，结合震源/台站空间加权、第12次迭代后地壳垂向网格加密及点扩散函数（PSF）分辨率测试。
de: Three-component broadband waveforms from 210 regional earthquakes (Mw 5.0–6.7) from the GCMT catalog.
1,215 permanent and temporary broadband stations (956 public/EarthScope/Kandilli, 239 SGS, 17 IIES Iran, 3 MSPN Iraq), yielding up to 87,399 measurement windows.
Validation using 30 independent GCMT earthquakes not included in the inversion and point-spread function tests at 150, 400, and 600 km depths.
来自GCMT目录的210个区域地震（Mw 5.0–6.7）的三分量宽频带波形数据。
共计1215个固定与流动宽频带台站（含956个公开台站、239个SGS台站、17个伊朗IIES台站、3个伊拉克MSPN台站），最终迭代提取87,399个测量窗口。
使用未参与反演的30个独立GCMT地震进行走时残差验证，并在150、400和600公里深度开展了点扩散函数测试。
li: P-wave velocity resolution is noticeably lower than S-wave resolution due to smaller P-wave amplitudes, longer wavelengths, and lower surface-wave sensitivity to Vp.
Crustal structure shows limited updates relative to the starting model because the minimum surface-wave period was restricted to 30 s.
Waveform amplitudes and 3-D attenuation were not inverted, leaving amplitude histograms largely unchanged.
由于P波振幅较小、波长较长且面波对Vp敏感度低，P波速度模型的分辨率明显低于S波模型。
受限于面波最短周期仅至30秒，地壳结构相对于初始模型的更新有限。
未反演波形振幅与三维衰减结构，导致振幅残差分布未见显著改善。

tm.why: The paper develops MEAD-M20, a tomographic model of the Middle East using 3-D numerical wavefield simulations and the adjoint method over 20 conjugate gradient iterations.

The model reveals geodynamical features including local mantle plumes beneath the Arabian Plate, remnants of the Tethys Ocean beneath Eastern Anatolia, and lithospheric-scale low-velocity anomalies along major fault zones.
The inversion solves for P- and S-wave velocities with shear-wave transverse isotropy (radial anisotropy) confined to the upper mantle.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete manuscript text (30 pages), abstract, table, and all 18 figures.

sum: This study systematically evaluates seven blind source separation (BSS) methods—and compares them against a dual-decoder autoencoder neural network—for detecting and characterizing weak endogenous Earth interior signals masked by climate variability and noise in geodetic time series. Using 120,000 synthetic realizations combining parametric endogenous signals, climate indices, and white plus power-law noise, the authors distinguish statistical detection (exceeding the 95th percentile null correlation) from faithful characterization (correlation >= 0.8). Classical Principal Component Analysis (PCA), FastICA, and Isomap perform best: PCA excels at detection even at endogenous-to-climate ratios of 1:20, while FastICA improves characterization at intermediate ratios. Applied globally to GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravity data, PCA recovers known hydrological, cryospheric, and megathrust earthquake signatures. Screening 767 earthquakes (Mw >= 6.5) detects ~30% at 95% confidence, including events well below Mw 8.5, though low correlations caution against standalone physical interpretation.
本研究系统评估了七种盲源分离（BSS）方法及双解码器自编码神经网络在气候变化和噪声掩盖的大地测量时间序列中检测和表征微弱地球内部信号的能力。基于12万次包含内源信号、气候指数及白噪声与幂律噪声的合成实验，区分了统计检测（超零假设95%分位数）与高保真表征（相关性≥0.8）。主成分分析（PCA）、Fa……

t: Evaluates seven Blind Source Separation methods (PCA, FastICA, Isomap, Varimax, Factor Analysis, EOT, NMF) and a dual-decoder autoencoder neural network to separate endogenous geophysical signals from climate variability and noise.
评估七种盲源分离方法（PCA、FastICA、Isomap等）及双解码器自编码器，从气候变化和噪声中分离内源信号。

Tests 120 synthetic configurations (1,000 realizations each) of 20-year monthly series with NOAA climate indices and colored noise, plus global JPL/GRGS GRACE gravity data and 767 ISC earthquakes (Mw > 6.5).
测试120种配置共12万次20年合成序列，以及全球JPL/GRGS GRACE重力数据和767个Mw>6.5地震。
PCA, FICA, and Isomap achieve 25%–75% detection at endogenous-to-climate ratios of 1:20 to 1:3, and PCA detects 279 of 767 Mw > 6.5 earthquakes (30%) in GRACE at 95% confidence.
信噪比1:20至1:3时检测率达25%–75%；PCA在GRACE中以95%置信度检出279个地震（30%）。

When endogenous-to-climate ratios are below one, over 40% of simulations fail the 0.8 correlation threshold, and real earthquake-GRACE correlations remain too low (mean 0.15–0.20) for standalone geophysical interpretation.
内源/气候比小于1时超40%模拟相关性低于0.8，实际地震重力相关性过低（均值0.15–0.20）难以直接解释。

First systematic quantitative benchmark separating statistical detectability from reconstruction fidelity across seven BSS methods and deep learning on synthetic and global GRACE satellite gravity datasets.
首次系统量化区分七种BSS与深度学习在合成及全球GRACE重力数据中的统计可检测性与重构保真度。

kc: Systematically benchmarks seven blind source separation (BSS) methods and a deep-learning autoencoder across 120 synthetic geodetic network configurations (1,000 realizations each).
Establishes a formal quantitative distinction between statistical signal detection (95% null-hypothesis threshold) and geophysical characterization (correlation >= 0.8).
Demonstrates that PCA, FastICA, and Isomap consistently outperform Varimax, Factor Analysis, EOT, and NMF due to compatibility with dense, linear, signed geodetic mixtures.
Applies a two-step PCA screening to global GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravimetry data and 767 Mw >= 6.5 earthquakes, detecting ~30% of events including earthquakes below Mw 8.5.
在120种合成大地测量网络配置（每种1000次实现）下，系统评估了七种盲源分离（BSS）方法与深度学习自编码器。
建立了统计信号检测（95%零假设阈值）与地球物理高保真表征（相关性≥0.8）之间的严格定量区分。
证明了由于与密集、线性、有符号的大地测量混合结构兼容，PCA、FastICA和Isomap始终优于Varimax、因子分析、EOT和NMF。
对全球GRACE/GRACE-FO卫星重力数据及767个Mw≥6.5地震应用两步PCA筛查，检测出约30%的事件（含8.5级以下地震）。
me: Seven Blind Source Separation (BSS) algorithms: PCA, FastICA (FICA), Isometric Feature Mapping (Isomap), Varimax-Rotated PCA, Factor Analysis (FA), Empirical Orthogonal Teleconnection (EOT), and Non-Negative Matrix Factorization (NMF).
Dual-decoder autoencoder neural network with ReLU activations and dropout (0.5) trained on 10,000 synthetic mixtures to simultaneously reconstruct source signals and mixing matrices.
Analytical co-seismic gravity and Equivalent Water Height (EWH) forward modeling using Okubo (1992) dislocation theory in a half-space adjusted with load Love numbers.

Gradient Boosting Classifier trained over 25,000 random train/test splits to evaluate feature importance of seismic parameters (rake, strike, Okubo amplitude, magnitude) on GRACE earthquake detection.
七种盲源分离（BSS）算法：PCA、FastICA（FICA）、等距特征映射（Isomap）、Varimax旋转PCA、因子分析（FA）、经验正交遥相关（EOT）和非负矩阵分解（NMF）。
包含ReLU激活函数和Dropout（0.5）的双解码器自编码神经网络，在10,000个合成混合样本上训练以同时重构源信号和混合矩阵。
基于Okubo（1992）半空间位错理论并结合负荷勒夫数校正的同震重力与等效水高（EWH）解析正演模拟。
在25,000次随机训练/测试划分上训练梯度提升分类器，评估地震参数（滑动角、走向、Okubo振幅、震级）对GRACE地震检测的特征重要性。
de: 120,000 synthetic 20-year monthly geodetic datasets varying station count (L = 8, 12, 16, 20), endogenous sources (J = 1, 2), NOAA climate indices (K = 0, 1, 2), white + power-law noise (sigma = 0.1 to 1), and endogenous-to-climate ratio (R = 0.01 to 2.0).
Global GRACE and GRACE-FO Equivalent Water Height (EWH) time series from JPL Mascon and CNES/GRGS solutions interpolated onto equal-area icosahedral grids (16,002 and 36,002 vertices).
ISC earthquake catalogue of source mechanisms and GCMT solutions comprising 767 earthquakes with Mw > 6.5 between 2004 and 2019.
120,000组合成的20年月度大地测量数据集，遍历台站数（L=8,12,16,20）、内源数（J=1,2）、NOAA气候指数（K=0,1,2）、白噪声+幂律噪声（σ=0.1至1）及内源/气候比（R=0.01至2.0）。
来自JPL Mascon和CNES/GRGS解算的全球GRACE和GRACE-FO等效水高（EWH）时间序列，插值到等面积二十面体网格（16,002和36,002个顶点）。
包含2004年至2019年间767个Mw>6.5地震的ISC震源机制目录和GCMT解。
li: Retrieved components rarely reach the 0.8 correlation reliability threshold when the endogenous-to-climate amplitude ratio is below 1.0, limiting direct geophysical interpretation.
Assumes spatial stationarity (time-independent mixing matrix A), so propagating sources are split into stationary quadrature pairs rather than single physical modes.
Even for the largest megathrust earthquakes (Mw > 8.6), correlations between PCA-retrieved GRACE modes and Okubo synthetic gravity signatures remain low (0.055 to 0.162).
当内源与气候信号振幅比低于1.0时，提取的分量很少达到0.8的相关性可靠阈值，限制了直接地球物理解释。
假设空间平稳性（混合矩阵A不随时间变化），因此传播源会被分解为平稳正交对而非单一物理模态。
即使对于最大的巨型逆冲地震（Mw>8.6），PCA提取的GRACE模态与Okubo合成重力特征之间的相关性仍然很低（0.055至0.162）。

tm.why: The paper applies PCA to an ISC earthquake catalogue of 767 M>=6.5 events to detect earthquake-induced gravity signals in GRACE satellite gravimetry data.

The study benchmarks seven statistical blind source separation algorithms against a dual-decoder autoencoder neural network and uses a Gradient Boosting Classifier to rank seismic parameters influencing detection.
The paper investigates the detection and recovery of endogenous solid-Earth mass redistribution signals (coseismic/postseismic deformation, GIA, deep interior processes) in space-based gravimetry.

ev.notes: Full 51-page HAL preprint PDF (accepted in GJI, doi:10.1093/gji/ggag325) was read and analyzed, including all mathematical formulations, synthetic benchmarks, neural network comparisons, GRACE global/earthquake applications, 10 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: This paper introduces VIDEAT, an automated operational system designed for the rapid, time-evolving assessment of earthquake macroseismic intensity in Italy. By integrating diverse real-time data sources—including attenuation models, accelerometric data, crowdsourced reports, and expert field assessments—using a logical decision tree and spatially variable smoothing, the system dynamically updates intensity estimates. Furthermore, VIDEAT provides rapid estimates of fatalities and economic losses to assist emergency response. The system's novelty lies in its structured, time-dependent integration of heterogeneous data types, weighting them by reliability to improve accuracy as an event unfolds.
本文介绍VIDEAT，一个用于意大利地震烈度动态评估的自动化系统。该系统通过逻辑决策树和空间平滑算法，实时整合衰减模型、强震数据、众包报告和现场评估。VIDEAT还能估算人员伤亡和经济损失以辅助应急。其创新点在于对异构数据进行随时间演进的动态整合与加权，在震后持续提高评估精度。

t: A logical decision tree integrates attenuation models, accelerometric data, crowdsourced reports, and field assessments, combined with spatially variable smoothing and reliability-based weighting.
利用逻辑决策树整合衰减、强震、众包和现场数据，并结合空间平滑与加权。
Real-time accelerometric data, crowdsourced intensity reports, field-assessed intensities from trained technicians, and historical/empirical attenuation models for Italian earthquakes.
意大利地震的实时强震加速度数据、众包烈度报告、技术人员现场评估烈度及衰减模型。

The system successfully provides time-evolving macroseismic intensity maps and estimates of fatalities and economic losses, showing progressive improvement in accuracy over the hours following an event.
系统实现了动态烈度图绘制及伤亡与经济损失估算，展示了震后数小时内精度的逐步提升。
The accuracy and speed of the real-time assessments are constrained by the initial availability of crowdsourced reports and field-assessed data.
评估精度与速度受限于震后初期众包和现场数据的获取速度。
An automated, operational decision-tree framework that dynamically updates earthquake impact assessments by weighting and merging heterogeneous instrumental, crowdsourced, and expert data over time.
构建了自动化决策树框架，通过异构数据动态加权融合实现实时更新。

kc: Developed VIDEAT, an operational system for real-time macroseismic intensity and loss estimation in Italy.
Implemented a logical decision tree to dynamically integrate heterogeneous data sources as they become available.
Incorporated a spatially variable smoothing procedure and reliability-based weighting for different data types.
开发了VIDEAT系统，用于意大利地震烈度和损失的实时业务化评估。
实现了逻辑决策树，以动态整合随时间不断增加的异构数据源。
引入了空间可变平滑程序以及基于可靠性的不同数据类型加权机制。
me: Logical decision tree for multi-source data integration.
Spatially variable smoothing procedure.
Reliability-based weighting of instrumental, crowdsourced, and field-assessed data.
用于多源数据整合的逻辑决策树。
空间可变平滑处理程序。
基于可靠性的仪器、众包和现场评估数据加权方法。
de: Real-time accelerometric data.
Crowdsourced earthquake reports and field-assessed intensities.
Case studies of specific Italian earthquakes to demonstrate time-evolving intensity updates.
实时强震加速度数据。
众包地震报告和现场评估的烈度数据。
具体意大利地震案例分析，展示随时间演进的烈度更新过程。
li: System performance depends heavily on the availability and rapid reporting of crowdsourced and field data.
Potential uncertainties in early-stage attenuation models before instrumental data arrives.
系统性能高度依赖于众包和现场数据的可用性及快速上报。
在仪器数据接入前的早期阶段，衰减模型可能存在潜在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper presents VIDEAT, an operational system for rapid assessment of macroseismic intensity, fatalities, and economic losses from earthquakes in Italy.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the abstract and public metadata.

sum: This dataset provides a relocated seismicity catalog of 25,227 earthquakes in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo volcanic region of the Aegean Sea, spanning January 2024 to April 2025. The catalog was generated using waveform cross-correlation relocation to support the study of cascading magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting triggered by elastic stress transfer. It provides high-resolution hypocentral parameters (time, latitude, longitude, depth) to resolve fine-scale fault structures and magma migration pathways, facilitating further research into volcanic-tectonic interactions in the Hellenic Arc.
该数据集包含爱琴海克里斯蒂安娜-圣托里尼-哥伦布火山区2024年1月至2025年4月期间25,227个重定位地震的目录。该目录通过波形互相关重定位技术生成，用于支持关于弹性应力传递触发的级联岩浆活动与无震断层滑动的研究。它提供了高精度的震源位置参数（发震时刻、经纬度、深度），有助于解析微细观断裂结构……

t: Waveform cross-correlation relocation of hypocentral data to achieve high-precision earthquake locations.
利用波形互相关技术对震源数据进行重定位，以获得高精度的地震位置。
A seismicity catalog of 25,227 relocated events in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo region from January 2024 to April 2025.
2024年1月至2025年4月期间爱琴海克里斯蒂安娜-圣托里尼-哥伦布区域的25,227个重定位地震目录。
High-resolution hypocentral parameters resolving fine-scale structures associated with magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting.
高分辨率的震源参数，清晰解析了与岩浆活动和无震滑动相关的微细观结构。
Limited temporal coverage (16 months) and regional focus on the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo volcanic complex.
时间跨度较短（16个月），且空间范围局限于克里斯蒂安娜-圣托里尼-哥伦布火山区。
First high-density, cross-correlation-relocated catalog capturing the 2024-2025 cascading magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting episode in this region.
首次提供该地区2024-2025年级联岩浆活动与无震滑动期间的高密度互相关重定位地震目录。

kc: Provides a high-resolution relocated seismicity catalog of 25,227 events in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo region.
Enables detailed mapping of active fault structures and magmatic pathways in the Aegean Sea.
Supports the analysis of cascading magmatic unrest and aseismic faulting.
提供了克里斯蒂安娜-圣托里尼-哥伦布区域25,227个地震事件的高分辨率重定位地震目录。
能够精细刻画爱琴海活动断裂结构和岩浆运移通道。
支持对级联岩浆活动与无震断层滑动过程的深入分析。
me: Waveform cross-correlation for high-precision hypocenter relocation.
利用波形互相关技术进行高精度震源重定位。
de: Seismicity catalog spanning January 2024 to April 2025, containing event ID, origin time, latitude, longitude, and depth.
时间跨度为2024年1月至2025年4月的地震目录，包含事件ID、发震时刻、纬度、经度和深度。

该数据集局限于特定的空间区域和16个月的时间窗口。

tm.why: The dataset is a relocated seismicity catalog containing hypocentral data for 25,227 events.
The catalog targets the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo volcanic region and records magmatic unrest.
The catalog is used to analyze aseismic faulting and elastic stress relay in the Aegean Sea.

ev.notes: Analyzed Zenodo repository metadata and abstract.

sum: An intense 45-day seismic swarm struck the Santorini-Amorgos region starting 27 January 2025, sparking debate over its tectonic versus volcanic origin. This study performs a combined analysis of earthquakes (using PhaseNet, PyOcto, NonLinLoc, and HypoDD) and continuous seismic tremors (using the network covariance matrix method CovSeisNet with simplified phase coherence normalization) recorded across 35 regional stations. The authors relocate 14,371 earthquakes and identify two distinct tremor families between 7 and 19 February 2025. The first family (112 episodes) comprises broadband signals (up to 10 Hz) generated by densely spaced, overlapping earthquakes that co-locate and migrate with the shallow swarm. The second, newly discovered family (11 episodes) consists of weaker, lower-frequency signals located at 8–25 km depth southeast of Kolumbo volcano, spatially correlating with a tomographically imaged mid-crustal melt reservoir. This provides direct seismic evidence of deep magmatic fluid dynamics feeding the 2025 crisis.
2025年1月圣托里尼-阿莫尔戈斯地区发生强烈地震群，引发构造与火山成因之争。本研究结合深度学习地震目录构建流程（重定位14,371次地震）与基于台网协方差矩阵的CovSeisNet方法，分析了区域台网连续波形。研究识别出两类截然不同的火山颤动：第一类（112个事件）为高频宽频带信号，由密集重叠的浅……

t: Earthquakes are cataloged using PhaseNet, PyOcto, NonLinLoc, and HypoDD. Tremors are detected and located in 3-D using the CovSeisNet network covariance matrix package with simplified phase coherence normalization and cross-correlation envelope back-projection.
用深度学习与HypoDD构建地震目录；用CovSeisNet简化相位相干与包络反投影检测定位颤动。

Continuous seismic waveforms recorded from 23 January to 19 February 2025 at 35 stations (for earthquakes) and 25 stations (for tremors) within a 2° radius of the Santorini-Amorgos swarm center across six seismic networks.
2025年1月23日至2月19日震群中心2°半径内6个台网35个台站的连续地震波形数据。

Detected 16,746 earthquakes (14,371 relocated) and two tremor families: 112 episodes of shallow swarm-related tremor (up to 10 Hz) and 11 episodes of 50x weaker, lower-frequency deep tremor (8–25 km depth) southeast of Kolumbo.
重定位14,371次地震，识别出112个浅部震群相关颤动和11个8–25公里深的科伦坡东南深部颤动。
High-amplitude, densely spaced swarm seismicity likely masks additional deep tremor occurrences, and the tremor analysis cannot distinguish between magma motion, degassing, or pressure transfers.
强震群可能掩盖更多深部颤动，且无法区分岩浆运移、脱气或压力传递等具体机制。

Identifies two distinct tremor families during the 2025 Santorini crisis, uncovering a deep (8–25 km) tremor cluster spatially correlated with a mid-crustal melt reservoir southeast of Kolumbo volcano.
首次在2025圣托里尼危机中发现与中地壳熔体储层吻合的深部（8–25 km）低频火山颤动簇。

kc: Constructed a combined high-resolution catalog of 14,371 relocated earthquakes and 123 30-min tremor episodes during the 2025 Santorini crisis.
Identified two distinct tremor families with different generation mechanisms using simplified phase coherence network covariance analysis.
Discovered a deep tremor cluster (8–25 km depth) southeast of Kolumbo volcano correlating with a mid-crustal melt reservoir, confirming magmatic feeding.
构建了2025年圣托里尼危机期间包含14,371次重定位地震和123个30分钟颤动事件的高分辨率联合目录。
利用简化相位相干台网协方差分析，识别出具有不同发震机制的两类火山颤动。
在科伦坡火山东南8–25公里深处发现深部颤动簇，与中地壳熔体储层吻合，证实了深部岩浆补给。
me: Earthquake cataloging using PhaseNet for phase picking, PyOcto for phase association, NonLinLoc for absolute location, and HypoDD for relocation.
Network covariance matrix analysis (CovSeisNet) with simplified phase coherence pre-processing to suppress impulsive earthquakes with inter-event times > 100 s.
3-D tremor source location via first-eigenvector denoising and 3-D back-projection of inter-station cross-correlation amplitude envelopes (0.5–6.0 Hz).
利用PhaseNet拾取震相、PyOcto关联震相、NonLinLoc绝对定位及HypoDD双差重定位构建地震目录。
采用结合简化相位相干预处理的台网协方差矩阵方法（CovSeisNet），压制发震间隔大于100秒的脉冲型地震。
通过第一特征向量去噪及台站间互相关振幅包络（0.5–6.0 Hz）的三维反投影实现颤动源三维定位。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms from 23 January to 19 February 2025 recorded at 35 stations (25 for tremor) within a 2° radius across six networks (HA, HC, HL, HT, KO, MN).
Spatial comparison of located tremor sources against geodetic inflation/deflation centers and active-source PmP tomographic low-Vp melt anomaly (L4).
2025年1月23日至2月19日期间6个台网（HA、HC、HL、HT、KO、MN）2°半径内35个台站（25个用于颤动）的连续地震波形。
颤动源定位结果与大地测量膨胀/收缩中心及主动源PmP层析成像低Vp熔体异常体（L4）的空间对比。
li: Constrained 3-D tremor locations are limited to 7–19 February 2025 due to insufficient station and azimuthal coverage prior to 7 February.
High-amplitude, densely spaced swarm earthquakes likely mask additional occurrences of the weak deep tremor cluster.
Tremor analysis alone cannot distinguish between specific deep magmatic fluid mechanisms (magma motion, degassing, or pressure transfer).
受限于2月7日前台站数量和方位角覆盖不足，可靠的颤动三维定位仅限于2月7日至19日。
高振幅、时间密集的震群地震可能掩盖了更多微弱的深部颤动事件。
仅靠颤动分析无法区分具体的深部岩浆流体机制（岩浆运移、脱气或压力传递）。

tm.why: The study investigates volcanic seismic tremors and magma feeding dynamics during the 2025 Santorini-Kolumbo seismo-volcanic crisis.
The authors build high-resolution earthquake (14,371 relocated events) and tremor catalogs using deep learning pickers, NonLinLoc, HypoDD, and network covariance methods.
Tremor detection and 3D source location rely on seismic network covariance matrix coherence analysis and envelope back-projection across a multi-station array.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, equations, figures, and references.

sum: Since 2020, shallow seismic activity beneath the Maladeta massif (Central Pyrenees) has markedly increased. Combining permanent and temporary seismic networks with PhaseNet picking, NLL-SSST and HypoDD relocations, FMNEAR focal mechanism inversion, and template matching (TM), this study characterizes three main earthquake clusters (Aneto Glacier, Salenques-Molières, and Gerbosa) totaling over 5,500 detected events. Results show that seismicity aligns mostly with the Coronas normal fault, revealing a shallower dip (45°–60°) than previously assumed (80°) and surrounding a 5–6 km aseismic segment, while the Gerbosa cluster illuminates a previously unmapped parallel fault. Temporal correlations with Garonne River levels, rainfall, and Aneto glacier mass balance indicate that clusters initiate during long-term low groundwater levels, triggered either by seasonal glacier meltwater infiltration (Aneto) or intense rainfall events (>50 mm/day) via rapid karst-assisted pore-pressure diffusion. This highlights a potential climate-seismicity link in the Pyrenees.
2020年以来，比利牛斯山中部Maladeta地块的浅源地震活动显著增加。本研究结合固定与流动台网数据，利用PhaseNet拾取、NLL-SSST和HypoDD重定位、FMNEAR震源机制反演及模板匹配技术，识别出超过5500次地震，归属于三个主要震群。结果表明，地震主要沿Coronas正断层分布，……

t: Automatic PhaseNet picks and manual picks are associated with REAL, relocated via NonLinLoc with 3-D source-specific station traveltime corrections (NLL-SSST) and HypoDD, complemented by FMNEAR focal mechanism inversions and CARA single-station template matching.
结合PhaseNet拾取、REAL关联、NLL-SSST与HypoDD重定位、FMNEAR震源机制反演及单台模板匹配。

Waveforms from permanent Pyrenean stations and temporary deployments (including 25 POCRISC nodes after the August 2023 M4 event), alongside Garonne River water levels and local rain gauge records from 2010 to 2025.
2010–2025年比利牛斯固定与流动台网（含25个POCRISC节点）波形，以及河流水位和降雨记录。

Located 3,529 high-precision NLL-SSST events and detected 5,548 template-matching events in three shallow (2–4 km) clusters; focal mechanisms show normal faulting dipping 45°–60°, with eastern clusters initiating 2–9 days after >50 mm/day rainfalls.
精定位3529次地震，模板匹配检出5548次浅源地震；揭示正断层倾角45°–60°，强降雨后2–9天触发震群。
No clear downward hypocentral migration can be resolved, and lack of stations within 10 km of the Aneto glacier leaves shallow focal depths and western fault orientation uncertain.
未能分辨震源向下迁移，且Aneto冰川10公里内无台站，导致浅部深度和构造走向存疑。

First high-resolution characterization of seismic clusters in the Maladeta massif, revising the Coronas Fault dip to 50°–55°, discovering a parallel fault, and linking Pyrenean seismicity to climate-driven hydrological shifts.
首次精细刻画Maladeta震群，修正Coronas断层倾角，发现隐伏平行断层并提出气候水文触发机制。

kc: Confirmed via template matching from 2014–2024 that the post-2020 surge in Maladeta seismicity is genuine and not an artifact of seismic network densification.
Constrained the geometry of the Coronas Fault at depth, showing a shallower dip (45°–60°) than previously mapped (80°) and identifying a 5–6 km central aseismic gap.
Discovered a previously unmapped north-west dipping secondary fault responsible for the 2022–2024 Gerbosa seismic cluster.
Established a statistically significant temporal correlation (p = 0.2%–1.8%) between intense rainfall/meltwater infiltration during low river baseline levels and shallow cluster activation.
通过2014–2024年的模板匹配证实，2020年后Maladeta地震活动的激增是真实存在的，而非台网加密造成的人为假象。
约束了Coronas断层深部几何形态，发现其倾角（45°–60°）比早期认识（80°）更平缓，并识别出中部5–6公里宽的无震空区。
发现了控制2022–2024年Gerbosa震群的一条此前未测绘的北西倾次级平行断层。
建立了河流低水位背景下强降雨及冰川融水下渗与浅源震群触发之间显著的统计相关性（概率p = 0.2%–1.8%）。

Absolute earthquake location using NonLinLoc with 3-D source-specific station traveltime corrections (NLL-SSST) and relative relocation via HypoDD.
Full-waveform and P-wave polarity focal mechanism inversion using FMNEAR for five M 2.5–4.1 earthquakes.
Single-station waveform template matching (at broadband station CARA) using 29 similar-waveform event families.
2-D Boussinesq elastic half-space Coulomb stress modeling and hydraulic pore-pressure diffusivity estimation.
结合深度学习震相拾取（PhaseNet）与人工目录震相，并利用REAL算法进行三维网格关联。
采用带三维震源特定台站走时校正的NonLinLoc（NLL-SSST）进行绝对定位，并使用HypoDD进行相对重定位。

开展二维Boussinesq弹性半空间库仑应力变化建模及水力孔隙压力扩散系数估算。

Dense temporary deployments including the 25-node POCRISC post-M4 intervention network (2023) and OMP TEMPYR stations.
Hydrological and meteorological time-series: daily Garonne River water levels at Bossòst and daily precipitation records at Benasque and Bagnères de Luchon.
2010至2025年固定台网（EPOS-France, IGN, ICGC）及新建近场加速度计（EXVI3, VIES, VIER, EXBNQ）的连续与事件波形。
密集流动台阵数据，包括2023年M4地震后部署的25个节点的POCRISC应急台网及OMP TEMPYR台站。

li: Absence of seismic stations closer than ~10 km to the Aneto cluster limits depth resolution, leaving structural orientation on the western side uncertain.
Lack of resolved vertical downward hypocentral migration prevents a direct causal proof of surface-to-depth fluid pressure diffusion.
Earthquake migration in the Aneto cluster is evaluated using single-station S-P delay times as an indirect distance proxy rather than 3-D hypocentral distances.
Aneto震群10公里范围内缺乏地震台站，限制了浅源震源深度分辨率，导致西侧构造走向存在不确定性。
未能分辨出清晰的震源由浅入深垂向迁移过程，因此无法直接证明流体压力从地表向深部扩散的因果关系。
Aneto震群的迁移分析仅依赖单台S-P到时差作为距离的间接代理指标，而非真实的三维震源距离。

sum: This Zenodo repository contains processed data products and Python/Jupyter notebooks for the study 'Seismic Evidence for Increasing Unfrozen Pore Water Heterogeneity from Roadside to Coastal Arctic Tundra.' It includes shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles derived from Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) using both Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and conventional geophones. Additionally, it provides temperature- and laboratory-informed reference constraints, joint porosity inversion outputs, and final unfrozen water saturation (Sw) profiles. These resources enable the reproduction of figures showing how unfrozen pore water heterogeneity varies from roadside to coastal environments in the Arctic tundra, offering valuable insights into permafrost degradation and near-surface characterization.
