sum: Based on the 2024 Tibetan Plateau Active Block 2.0 model (24 secondary blocks), this study compiles and deduplicates 7,759 focal mechanism solutions (1975–2024) using Kagan angle and focal mechanism center criteria. Using Vavryčuk's iterative joint stress inversion and a frictional-equilibrium stress scaling approach, the authors determine principal stress orientations, stress shape ratios, tectonic regime indices, and fault slip tendencies along 162 block-bounding fault segments. Results show systematic clockwise rotation of maximum horizontal compressive stress from south to north and west to east, transitioning from E-W extension in central Lhasa to strike-slip and compression in northern and eastern blocks. Comparing slip tendency with geodetic fault coupling identifies 14 fault segments—including the Haiyuan-Tuolaishan and East Kunlun Alahu faults—exhibiting both strong locking and high slip tendency (Ts > 0.8), providing refined constraints on continental deformation and Mw > 7.0 seismic hazard.
本研究基于2024年青藏高原活动块体2.0模型（24个次级块体），整合并筛选了1975–2024年间7759个震源机制解。采用迭代联合反演方法计算了全区格网及各次级块体的应力张量，并基于摩擦平衡假设評估了块体边界162条断层段的滑动趋势。结果表明，高原主压应力方向自南向北、自西向东呈系统性顺时针旋转……

t: Vavryčuk's (2014) iterative joint stress inversion selects fault planes via fault instability (friction 0.4–1.0). Slip tendency is computed on 162 boundary segments using stress ratios normalized under frictional equilibrium.
采用Vavryčuk (2014)迭代联合反演计算应力场，并基于摩擦平衡假设归一化计算162条边界断层段的滑动趋势。
9,551 focal mechanisms (1975–2024) from public datasets and literature were deduplicated via Kagan angle criteria into 7,759 unique events (depths 0–20 km, magnitudes 3–6) across 24 active blocks.
收集1975–2024年9551个震源机制解，通过Kagan角筛选出7759个独立事件（主深度0–20 km，震级3–6…

Stress rotates clockwise from N-S compression in southern Tibet to NE and E-W along eastern margins. Comparing slip tendency (149 segments) with geodetic coupling identifies 14 high-hazard faults with Ts > 0.8.
揭示了24个次级块体的应力顺时针旋转与分区特征，结合大地测量闭锁识别出14条Ts>0.8的高危断层段。
Slip tendency assumes uniform pore pressure, lacks data on 13 segments, and is sensitive to fault dip complexity where strongly locked faults show low Ts.
假设孔隙压力均匀，部分断层缺震源机制数据，且断层倾角复杂性导致部分强闭锁段Ts偏低。
First comprehensive stress and slip-tendency evaluation under the 2024 Tibetan Plateau Active Block 2.0 framework (24 secondary blocks) using an expanded 7,759-event focal mechanism database.

kc: Compiled and quality-controlled a comprehensive catalog of 7,759 focal mechanism solutions (1975–2024) across the Tibetan Plateau using Kagan-angle consistency and focal mechanism center methods.
Characterized the 3D stress state and regime partitioning across 24 secondary blocks of the new Active Block 2.0 framework and on a 1.0° × 1.0° grid.
Evaluated fault slip tendency along 149 block-bounding fault segments and combined it with geodetic coupling to highlight 14 high-hazard segments capable of Mw > 7.0 earthquakes.
利用Kagan角一致性检验和震源机制中心解方法，整合并质控了1975–2024年青藏高原及邻区7759个震源机制解目录。
揭示了青藏高原活动块体2.0框架下24个次级块体及1.0°×1.0°格网的应力场旋转特征与应力体制分区。
计算了149条块体边界断层段的滑动趋势，结合大地测量耦合系数识别出14条具有Mw>7.0强震潜力的危险断层段。
me: Catalog deduplication and optimal focal mechanism selection using Kagan angle thresholds (<30°, 30°–50°, >50°) and Wan's (2019) iterative focal mechanism center algorithm.
Iterative joint stress inversion (Vavryčuk, 2014) incorporating fault instability constraints with friction swept from 0.4 to 1.0, plus 1,000 Gaussian noise realizations for uncertainty.
Normalized fault slip tendency calculation based on the frictional failure equilibrium hypothesis without requiring explicit pore fluid pressure values.
基于Kagan角阈值（<30°、30°–50°、>50°）及Wan (2019)震源机制中心解算法进行目录去重与最优解优选。
应用结合断层不稳定性约束的Vavryčuk (2014)迭代联合应力反演方法（摩擦系数0.4–1.0扫描）及1000次高斯噪声扰动不确定度评估。

By combining high slip tendency (Ts > 0.8) with strong geodetic fault coupling, the authors identify 14 fault segments with high potential to generate Mw > 7.0 earthquakes.

sum: This study utilizes a decommissioned submarine fiber-optic cable as a Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) array to monitor temporal seismic velocity variations in shallow marine sediments. By analyzing ambient noise cross-correlations, the authors detect hourly and periodic velocity changes. This application highlights the potential of repurposing dark fibers for high-resolution, continuous environmental and structural monitoring of the seafloor, providing insights into ocean-solid Earth interactions.
本研究利用退役的海底光缆作为分布式光纤声波传感（DAS）阵列，监测浅海沉积物中的地震波速度随时间的变化。通过分析环境噪声互相关函数，研究人员成功检测到了小时级和周期性的速度变化。该应用突出了将退役光缆重新用于高分辨率、连续的海底环境与结构监测的潜力，为研究海洋与固体地球的相互作用提供了新视角。

sum: The 2022 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai submarine eruption generated complex tsunamis coupled with atmospheric Lamb waves, hindering source-time function estimation below 5 mHz. To overcome this, the authors analyze dispersive ocean surface gravity waves (OSWs) between 15 and 40 mHz recorded by ocean-bottom pressure gauges (S-net, DONET, NEPTUNE) and island broadband seismometers. Because their slower phase velocities decouple them from atmospheric waves and make them insensitive to deep bathymetry, these OSWs can be modeled simply by deconvolving a WKBJ ray-theoretical vertical single-force Green's function. Results show excitation starting at 4:00 UTC with a peak force of ~2×10^10 N (three orders of magnitude smaller than the 10^13 N seismic Rayleigh wave force), lasting half a day, with a major sub-event at 8:40 UTC. A 2-hour delayed excitation in the 6–15 mHz band suggests initial summit seawater blowout followed by seawater inflow into the collapsed crater.
2022年汤加海底火山喷发激发了与大气兰姆波耦合的复杂海啸，阻碍了低频震源时间函数的反演。为此，本研究利用日本S-net、DONET及加拿大NEPTUNE海底压力计和岛屿宽频带地震仪数据，分析了15-40 mHz频段的频散海洋表面重力波（OSW）。该频段波速较慢，与大气波解耦且对深海地形不敏感。作者……

t: The authors deconvolve observed ocean-bottom pressure spectra between 15 and 40 mHz with a ray-theoretical WKBJ Green's function for a vertical single-force, then low-pass filter and stack the source-time function envelopes across unblocked array paths.
利用垂直单力WKBJ射线理论格林函数对15-40 mHz海底压力谱反褶积，并对无岛屿遮挡路径包络进行低通滤波与叠加。

Data comprise ocean-bottom pressure gauge records from Japan (S-net, DONET) and Canada (NEPTUNE), island broadband seismometers recording OSW loading, and 19 on-land broadband seismic stations used for Rayleigh wave source inversion.
包含日本S-net、DONET和加拿大NEPTUNE海底压力计、岛屿宽频带地震仪记录以及19个陆地远震宽频带台站波形。

OSW forcing (15–40 mHz) began at 4:00 UTC, peaked at ~2×10^10 N around 4:45 UTC (vs. ~10^13 N for Rayleigh waves), lasted half a day, featured an ~1×10^10 N sub-event at 8:40 UTC, and showed a 2-hr delay at 6–15 mHz.
15-40 mHz激发始于4:00 UTC，峰值约2×10^10 N，持续半天；8:40 UTC有1×10^10 N子事…
Shallow bathymetry around Fiji causes ray bending (up to 30 min delay at DONET) and scattering codas, preventing phase matching and requiring envelope stacking over island-free ray paths.
斐济群岛浅水区引起射线弯曲（达30分钟延迟）和散射尾波，难以匹配相位，且深水台站高频衰减严重。
First quantitative estimation of the Hunga Tonga eruption's hydrodynamic force history using deep-water dispersive OSWs (15–40 mHz) that are naturally decoupled from atmospheric Lamb wave forcing.
首次利用与大气兰姆波解耦的深水频散海洋表面重力波（15-40 mHz）定量反演了汤加火山喷发的水动力源时间函数。

kc: Extracted the vertical single-force source-time function of the 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption using 15–40 mHz ocean surface gravity waves (OSWs) decoupled from atmospheric Lamb waves.

Demonstrated that the OSW single-force amplitude (~2×10^10 N) is three orders of magnitude smaller than the seismic Rayleigh wave single-force (~10^13 N), but lasted much longer (half a day vs. ~2 hours).
Identified a major sub-event at 8:40 UTC exhibiting resonant spectral peaks at 10, 20, and 30 mHz, indicative of trapped OSW modal oscillations above the submerged caldera.

Discovered a 2-hour delay in 6–15 mHz OSW excitation relative to 15–40 mHz, proposing a multi-stage physical model of initial summit seawater blowout, internal wall expansion, and subsequent seawater inflow into the crater.
利用与大气兰姆波解耦的15–40 mHz海洋表面重力波（OSW），提取了2022年汤加火山喷发的垂直单力源时间函数。
证明了激发OSW的单力幅值（约2×10^10 N）比激发地震瑞利波的单力（约10^13 N）小三个数量级，但持续时间更长（长达半天）。
识别出8:40 UTC的显著子事件，其在10、20和30 mHz处表现出共振谱峰，指示了火山口上方水体中捕获的OSW模态振荡。
发现6–15 mHz频段OSW比15–40 mHz频段延迟2小时激发，提出了火山顶部海水初始喷出、内壁扩张及随后海水向火山口回流的多阶段物理模型。
me: Frequency-domain deconvolution of ocean-bottom pressure spectra with a vertical single-force Green's function from 15 to 40 mHz.
Ray-theoretical Green's function calculation using the WKBJ approximation over ETOPO1 bathymetry and straight-ray paths validated by an Eikonal solver.
Envelope stacking with a 2 mHz low-pass filter across dense array stations (selecting island-free ray paths) to suppress scattering codas and phase errors.
Cross-component multiplication and stacking of radial and vertical broadband seismic records to isolate Rayleigh wave source-time functions from body waves and noise.
在15至40 mHz频段内，将海底压力谱与垂直单力格林函数进行频域反褶积。
基于ETOPO1地形和WKBJ近似计算射线理论格林函数，并利用程函方程求解器验证直线射线假设。
对密集台阵（筛选无岛屿遮挡路径）的包络进行2 mHz低通滤波与叠加，以压制散射尾波和相位误差。
对宽频带地震仪径向和垂直分量反演结果进行互乘与叠加，凸显瑞利波椭圆极化特征并压制体波与噪声。
de: Ocean-bottom pressure gauge records from S-net and DONET arrays in Japan and NEPTUNE network in Canada.
Vertical-component broadband seismic data from island stations (e.g., FUNA, WAKE, RAR, VA02, NFK, AIS, AOGF) recording OSW loading deformation.
Radial and vertical broadband seismic waveforms from 19 teleseismic on-land stations (GSN, GEOSCOPE, etc.) for Rayleigh wave source inversion.
ETOPO1 1-arc-minute global relief model for local wavenumber and ray travel-time calculations.
日本S-net和DONET台阵以及加拿大NEPTUNE网络的海底压力计记录。
记录了OSW载荷形变的多个岛屿宽频带地震台站（如FUNA、WAKE、RAR等）垂直分量数据。
用于瑞利波震源时间函数反演的19个陆地远震宽频带地震台站的径向和垂直分量波形。
用于计算局部波数和射线走时的ETOPO1全球1弧分地形模型。
li: Straight-ray assumption causes travel-time anomalies up to 30 min at DONET stations due to ray bending and shallow scattering around the Fiji islands, preventing coherent phase matching across stations.
High-frequency OSW signals (>20 mHz), including the 8:40 UTC sub-event, are strongly attenuated at deeper ocean-bottom gauges (>1,000 m) such as DONET.

Amplitudes of OSW source-time functions cannot be quantitatively inferred from island seismic stations because high-frequency island elastic deformation from ocean wave loading is too complex to model.
由于斐济群岛浅水区的射线弯曲和散射，直线射线假设在DONET台站产生高达30分钟的走时异常，无法直接匹配不同台站的相位。
高频OSW信号（>20 mHz，包括8:40 UTC的子事件）在深度超过1000米的深水海底压力计（如DONET）处受到强烈衰减。
由于高频海浪载荷引起的岛屿弹性形变过于复杂，无法利用岛屿地震台站定量反演OSW震源时间函数的绝对幅值。

tm.why: The study investigates the volcanic eruption processes and source-time function of the 2022 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai submarine eruption using ocean surface gravity waves and seismic Rayleigh waves.
The primary dataset consists of dense ocean-bottom pressure gauge arrays (S-net, DONET, NEPTUNE) and island broadband seismic stations.
The authors estimate the vertical single-force source-time function of the eruption by deconvolving theoretical Green's functions from both ocean bottom pressure and seismic Rayleigh wave data.

ev.notes: Full 10-page Geophysical Research Letters PDF (published 2024, doi:10.1029/2024GL111983) was read and analyzed, including all equations, figures, and appendix.

sum: The 29 July 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka earthquake generated a tsunami imaged ~70 minutes later by the SWOT wide-swath satellite mission as a leading crest followed by short-wavelength dispersive waves. Prior studies debated whether this trailing wave train reflected shallow near-trench coseismic slip or en-route bathymetric effects. Here, the authors introduce a source-model-free back-projection method (tsbp) coupled with a spherical dispersive ray-tracing engine (TsunamiTrace) that exploits travel-time reciprocity and SWOT's per-pixel acquisition times to jointly estimate origin location and emission time for individual band-passed wavefronts. While back-projecting the leading front successfully recovers the known coseismic source region, ten robustly resolved trailing fronts (30–60 km wavelengths) locate outside the coseismic zone with emission times delayed by 24–52 minutes, increasing monotonically with distance. Furthermore, the trailing train arrives too late to have been radiated dispersively from the source, demonstrating progressive en-route generation via rough seafloor interaction.
2025年7月29日堪察加M8.8地震引发的海啸在约70分钟后被SWOT宽幅卫星捕获，表现为主波峰后尾随的短波长频散波列。针对该尾波是源于近海沟浅部同震滑移还是传播路径海底效应的争议，本文提出了无需先验震源模型的波前反投影方法（tsbp）及球面频散射线追踪程序（TsunamiTrace）。利用走时互……

t: Exploits travel-time reciprocity and a spherical dispersive ray-tracing engine (TsunamiTrace) to back-project digitized, band-passed SWOT wavefronts over true bathymetry, jointly searching over candidate source grids and emission times without a prior source model.
利用走时互易性和球面频散射线追踪（TsunamiTrace），在真实水深上反投影SWOT带通波前，联合搜索源位置与发射时…
SWOT KaRIn sea-surface height anomaly data from ascending pass 267 over the northwest Pacific, acquired 69–73 minutes after the 29 July 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka earthquake across a ~120 km swath.
2025年7月29日堪察加M8.8地震后69–73分钟，SWOT卫星267升轨在西北太平洋获取的约120 km宽幅海面高…

Ten of 28 trailing fronts are robustly localized outside the coseismic source region with emission times of 24–52 minutes post-origin that correlate with source distance (r = 0.90) and exceed shallow-water arrival times by 12–25 minutes.
28个尾波前中有10个稳健定位于同震源区外，发射时间为震后24–52分钟，随距离单调增加（相关性0.90），比最早能量到…
A single wavefront trades source distance against emission time along the ray path, leaving over half of the digitized trailing fronts elongated and unlocalizable.
单波前在射线方向存在距离与发射时间的折衷，导致超过一半的尾随波前置信区拉长而无法唯一定位。
First source-model-free dispersive wavefront back-projection of 2D wide-swath satellite tsunami altimetry, jointly resolving individual wave origins and emission times.
首次对二维宽幅卫星海啸测高数据开展无源模型频散波前反投影，联合测定单波起源位置与激发时间。

kc: Developed an open-source dispersive tsunami ray-tracing code (TsunamiTrace) accounting for phase-slowness refraction and group-speed energy transport, paired with a wavefront back-projection tool (tsbp).
Demonstrated source-model-free localization and emission timing of individual tsunami wavefronts using SWOT wide-swath radar interferometry and calibrated bootstrap uncertainty analysis.

Proved that ten well-resolved trailing dispersive wavefronts from the 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka tsunami originated outside the coseismic source region and were progressively delayed along the propagation corridor.
开发了开源球面频散海啸射线追踪程序（TsunamiTrace，区分相慢度折射与群速度能量传播）及波前反投影工具（tsbp）。
利用SWOT宽幅雷达干涉测高数据和校准自助法（bootstrap）不确定度分析，实现了无震源模型假设的单波前定位与激发时间测定。
证明2025年堪察加M8.8海啸中10个高分辨率尾随频散波前起源于同震源区外，并在传播路径上经历了随距离累积的渐进延迟。
me: Track-aligned Hotine Oblique Mercator projection, Thomson multitaper wavenumber spectral estimation, and 2D radial Butterworth band-pass filtering (30–40, 40–50, 50–60, 60–70, and 80–300 km).

Dispersive spherical ray tracing (TsunamiTrace) solving the linear Airy dispersion relation via Newton-Raphson iteration, advancing rays at group speed while refracting along phase-slowness gradients.
Reciprocal travel-time grid search and stacking over candidate source locations and emission times (0–60 min) using per-pixel SWOT observation timestamps.
Bootstrap uncertainty quantification (200 realizations per crest) incorporating independent normal picking errors and coherent rigid polyline shifts and rotations.
沿轨Hotine斜轴墨卡托投影、Thomson多窗口波数谱估计及二维径向Butterworth带通滤波（30–40、40–50、50–60、60–70及80–300 km频带）。
球面频散射线追踪（TsunamiTrace）：通过Newton-Raphson迭代求解线性Airy频散关系，以群速度推进射线并按相慢度梯度计算折射。
利用走时互易性和SWOT逐像素观测时间戳，在候选源区网格和发射时间（0–60分钟）上进行网格搜索与叠加。
自助法（Bootstrap）不确定度量化（每个波峰200次实现），同时包含独立法向拾取误差及整条折线的相干刚体平移与旋转。
de: SWOT Ka-band Radar Interferometer (KaRIn) Level-3 sea-surface height anomaly (SSHA) from ascending pass 267 (~120 km wide swath, captured 69–73 minutes post-origin, ~600 km from source).
SRTM15+ global bathymetry grid used to construct dispersive phase and group slowness fields across the northwest Pacific.
Validation experiment on the non-dispersive leading tsunami front (α0) and wavelength-recovery sweeps (20–70 km) on an example dispersive trailing front (α1).
SWOT卫星Ka波段雷达干涉仪（KaRIn）第267升轨L3级海面高度异常（SSHA）数据（宽约120 km，震后69–73分钟在距震源约600 km处获取）。
用于构建西北太平洋频散相慢度与群慢度场的SRTM15+全球水深网格数据。
针对非频散主波前（α0）的方法验证实验，以及针对典型频散尾波前（α1）的波长恢复扫描实验（20–70 km）。
li: Single-front distance vs. emission-time trade-off along the propagation ray leaves 18 of 28 trailing fronts with elongated confidence regions that cannot be uniquely localized.

Ray theory and back-projection only identify where and when a wavefront began propagating freely, unable to distinguish specific physical generation mechanisms (e.g., abyssal-hill scattering vs. mode conversion).
Omits elastic Earth loading, seawater compressibility, and gravitational potential variations (~1 min delay at 600 km range) and uses a single representative wavelength per band.
单波前在传播方向上存在距离与发射时间的折衷退化，导致28个尾随波前中有18个置信区域呈长条状，无法唯一定位。
射线理论和反投影仅能恢复波前开始自由传播的时空位置，无法区分具体的物理产生机制（如深海丘陵散射与模态转换）。
忽略了地球弹性负载、海水压缩性和重力位变化（600 km处约1分钟延迟），且每个频带仅使用单一代表性波长。

tm.why: The paper investigates whether short-wavelength dispersive tsunami waves imaged after the 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka earthquake originated from near-trench coseismic slip or from bathymetric interaction during propagation.
The study focuses on ocean surface gravity wave (tsunami) propagation, dispersion, and bathymetric scattering using wide-swath satellite radar altimetry.
The authors formulate a source-model-free wavefront back-projection and bootstrap uncertainty quantification framework based on dispersive ray-tracing reciprocity.

ev.notes: Full 31-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all equations, 10 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: This paper presents the Unified Theory of Lithosphere-Atmosphere-Ionosphere Coupling via Acoustic-Gravity Waves (LAIC-AGW v3.2). Using real-time data (pressure, temperature, humidity) from an ultra-dense Netatmo IoT weather station array in Japan, the author detects pre-seismic thermodynamic anomalies and post-seismic atmospheric wave propagation. By interpolating raw data to 1-minute intervals and applying Bolton's thermodynamic equations, the equivalent potential temperature is derived. A Two-Stage Spatial Residual and Local Peak Anomaly Ratio are formulated to filter weather noise. Tested on four major Japanese earthquakes and a control typhoon, the method achieved high precision and recall, offering a proactive early mitigation framework with 2 to 6 hours of lead time.
本文提出基于声重力波的岩石圈-大气-电离层耦合统一理论。利用日本超密集Netatmo物联网气象站的实时气压、温湿度数据，捕捉震前热力学与微气压异常及震后大气波传播。通过插值与热力学方程计算等效位温，并构建空间残差消除天气噪声。在四个大地震盲测中实现高精度预测，为防灾提供2至6小时前置时间。

t: Resampling IoT weather data to 1-minute intervals, calculating equivalent potential temperature via Bolton's equations, and applying Two-Stage Spatial Residual and Local Peak Anomaly Ratio to filter synoptic noise.
利用等间隔插值、Bolton热力学方程计算等效位温，并构建空间残差消除天气噪声。
Real-time time-series data (28,879 records of pressure, temperature, humidity) from Japan's ultra-dense Netatmo IoT weather station array, covering four major earthquakes and one typhoon control.
日本超密集Netatmo物联网气象站的实时气压、温度和湿度观测数据。
Achieving 100% precision and recall with zero false positives in blind predictions 1 hour before rupture across four major earthquakes, providing 2 to 6 hours of lead time.
在四个大地震的盲测中实现了极高的预测准确率，提供2至6小时的预警前置时间。
Dependence on ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT sensor networks and the challenge of physically validating complex radon-ionization-driven thermodynamic pathways.
高度依赖高密度众包物联网传感器的连续数据流，且震前异常物理机制仍具争议。
Unifying LAIC-AGW theory with real-time, ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT meteorological big data to quantitatively verify pre-seismic and post-seismic anomalies with high statistical rigor.
首次将声重力波耦合理论与超密集众包物联网气象大数据相结合进行定量验证。

kc: Formulates the Unified Theory of Lithosphere-Atmosphere-Ionosphere Coupling via Acoustic-Gravity Waves (LAIC-AGW v3.2).
Utilizes an ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT weather station array (Netatmo) to capture real-time pre- and post-seismic atmospheric anomalies.
Develops a noise-filtering workflow using equivalent potential temperature, Two-Stage Spatial Residual, and Local Peak Anomaly Ratio (LPAR).
Demonstrates high precision and recall in blind predictions of four major earthquakes in Japan.
构建了基于声重力波的岩石圈-大气圈-电离层耦合统一理论（LAIC-AGW v3.2）。
利用超密集的众包物联网气象站阵列（Netatmo）实时捕捉震前和震后的大气异常。
开发了利用等效位温、双阶段空间残差和局部峰值异常比（LPAR）的噪声过滤工作流。
在日本四个大地震的盲测评估中展示了极高的预测准确率与召回率。
me: Cubic spline interpolation to resample raw IoT weather data onto a uniform 1-minute grid.
Bolton's (1980) thermodynamic state equations to derive equivalent potential temperature.
Two-Stage Spatial Residual formulation to eliminate synoptic-scale weather noise.
Local Peak Anomaly Ratio (LPAR) for quantitative anomaly detection.
采用三次样条插值将原始物联网气象数据重采样至1分钟等间隔网格。
应用Bolton (1980)热力学状态方程推导等效位温。
构建双阶段空间残差公式以消除天气尺度（如台风、锋面）的背景噪声。
利用局部峰值异常比（LPAR）进行定量异常检测。
de: 28,879 records of barometric pressure, temperature, and relative humidity from Netatmo IoT weather stations across Japan.
Four major earthquake events: 2016 Fukushima M7.4, 2018 Osaka M6.1, 2018 Hokkaido M6.7, and 2026 Kumamoto M7.1.
Control scenario: Typhoon 18 to test false positive rates.
来自日本各地Netatmo物联网气象站的28,879条气压、温度和相对湿度实时时间序列数据。
四个主要地震事件：2016年福岛M7.4、2018年大阪M6.1、2018年北海道M6.7和2026年熊本M7.1地震。
对照场景：利用18号台风测试算法的虚警率。
li: Relies heavily on the density and continuous data streaming of crowdsourced IoT weather networks, which may have variable quality or gaps.
Pre-seismic anomaly detection mechanisms (e.g., radon ionization) remain physically complex and subject to debate in the broader scientific community.
高度依赖众包物联网气象网络的部署密度和持续数据流，这些数据可能存在质量波动或缺失。
震前异常检测的物理机制（如氡气电离）在更广泛的科学界中仍存在争议且物理过程极其复杂。

tm.why: The paper investigates lithosphere-atmosphere-ionosphere coupling and acoustic-gravity waves, which fall under environmental and atmospheric wave propagation seismology.
The study utilizes an ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT weather station array (Netatmo) to capture high-resolution spatial and temporal anomalies.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract from Crossref.

sum: This study investigates the deep structure and tectonic controls of the Majiaoba area in the northwestern Sichuan Basin using high-precision gravity and magnetic profiles. The authors apply a minimum-support, adaptive iterative focusing inversion algorithm, optimized via multi-criteria evaluation, to independently invert gravity and magnetic datasets. Combined with rock-magnetic measurements of the Lower Triassic Feixianguan Formation, the inversion resolves a closed high-susceptibility body at 400–600 m depth along profile L2. This anomaly is interpreted as mafic (diabase) intrusions rather than shallow sedimentary sources. The findings suggest that the deep magnetic source represents sustained magmatic activity along the western margin of the Yangtze Block, extending from the Late Permian into the Early Triassic. This work provides new insights into the lateral continuity and driving mechanisms of regional magmatism.
本研究利用高精度重力与磁力剖面数据，探讨了四川盆地西北缘马角坝地区的深部结构与构造控制。研究采用多准则评估驱动的最小支撑自适应迭代聚焦反演算法，对重磁数据进行了独立反演。结合下三叠统飞仙关组样品的岩石磁性测量，反演结果在L2剖面深约400-600米处解析出一个闭合的高磁化率体。该异常被解释为基性（辉……

t: Minimum-support, adaptive iterative focusing inversion algorithm selected under multi-criteria evaluation to independently invert gravity and magnetic datasets.
采用基于多准则评估选择的最小支撑自适应迭代聚焦反演算法，对重磁数据进行独立反演。
Two high-precision gravity and magnetic profiles across the Majiaoba area, combined with rock-magnetic measurements on Lower Triassic Feixianguan Formation samples.
横跨马角坝地区的两条高精度重磁剖面，以及下三叠统飞仙关组样品的岩石磁性测量。
Resolution of a closed high-susceptibility body at ~400–600 m depth, interpreted as mafic (diabase) intrusions linked to Late Permian-Early Triassic magmatism.
在约400-600米深度解析出闭合高磁化率体，解释为与晚二叠-早三叠世岩浆作用相关的基性侵入体。
Potential non-uniqueness of gravity-magnetic joint interpretation and lack of direct borehole calibration for the resolved subsurface intrusions.
重磁联合解释潜在的多解性，且解析出的地下侵入体缺乏直接的钻孔校准。
First high-resolution gravity-magnetic focusing inversion in Majiaoba revealing that high-amplitude anomalies stem from deep mafic intrusions rather than shallow sedimentary units.
首次在马角坝进行高分辨率重磁聚焦反演，揭示高幅值异常源于深部基性侵入体而非浅部沉积单元。

kc: Applied a multi-criteria-evaluation-driven adaptive focusing inversion to gravity and magnetic data in the Majiaoba area.
Identified a deep high-susceptibility body (400–600 m depth) interpreted as mafic (diabase) intrusions.
Linked the magnetic anomalies to sustained Late Permian to Early Triassic magmatism along the western margin of the Yangtze Block.
将多准则评估驱动的自适应聚焦反演方法应用于马角坝地区的重磁数据。
识别出深部（400-600米深度）高磁化率体，并将其解释为基性（辉绿岩）侵入体。
将该磁异常与扬子地块西缘晚二叠世至早三叠世持续的岩浆活动联系起来。
me: Minimum-support, adaptive iterative focusing inversion algorithm.
Multi-criteria evaluation for inversion algorithm selection.
Rock-magnetic measurements on rock samples.
最小支撑自适应迭代聚焦反演算法。
用于反演算法选择的多准则评估方法。
岩石样品的岩石磁性测量。

Rock-magnetic measurements of Lower Triassic Feixianguan Formation samples.

sum: This study investigates how fault-zone fluids, specifically through thermal pressurization, shear-induced dilatancy, and fluid diffusion, control the rupture dynamics of fast and slow earthquakes. By combining theoretical analysis with dynamic rupture simulations on finite-width faults, the authors derive closed-form expressions for strength evolution, fracture energy, and energy release rate to formulate a rupture-tip equation of motion. They identify a critical dilatancy threshold: below this value, ruptures accelerate to high speeds (fast earthquakes), whereas above it, they propagate slowly and steadily. This model successfully explains slow-to-fast rupture transitions observed in subduction zones based on spatial variations in hydraulic and mechanical properties.
本研究结合理论分析与动态破裂模拟，探讨了断层流体（热加压、剪切胀缩和扩散）对快慢地震破裂的控制。作者推导了包含流体效应的破裂前端运动方程，发现存在临界胀缩值：低于该值破裂加速至极速（快地震），高于该值则维持稳定慢速传播。该模型成功解释了俯冲带中由水力与力学性质空间变化引起的慢-快破裂转换。

t: Theoretical derivation of a rupture-tip equation of motion combined with dynamic rupture simulations incorporating thermal pressurization and shear-induced dilatancy.
结合热加压与剪切胀缩，进行破裂前端运动方程的理论推导与动态破裂数值模拟。
Synthetic data generated from numerical dynamic rupture simulations on finite-width faults.
在有限宽度断层上进行数值动态破裂模拟所生成的合成数据。
Discovery of a critical dilatancy threshold that determines whether a rupture accelerates to high speeds or propagates as a steady slow slip event.
发现临界胀缩阈值，该值决定了破裂是加速至极速还是以稳定慢滑移传播。
Simplified fault geometry and idealized fluid-fault interaction parameters that need real-world calibration.

推导了包含流体效应的有限宽度断层破裂前端理论运动方程。

sum: Thermal pressurization in wet faults theoretically prevents frictional melting by rapidly reducing effective normal stress, yet pseudotachylytes occur in some fluid-rich exhumed faults. This study investigates a pseudotachylyte-bearing thrust hosted in cherts of the Jurassic accretionary complex in Inuyama, Japan. Using optical and scanning electron microscopy, energy dispersive spectroscopy, and 1D implicit finite-difference simulations of coseismic temperature and pore pressure evolution, the authors document thermally corroded clasts alongside goethite-cemented dilatant breccias and pyrite oxidation halos. These features record a two-stage, serial dynamic weakening process: initial thermal pressurization induces wall-rock dilatant fracturing, which increases permeability, drains fault fluids, and causes transient restrengthening that drives rapid frictional heating to melting (~1100 °C). Energy budget calculations estimate ~2 MJ/m² consumed during thermal pressurization and ~5 MJ/m² during melting, demonstrating that overcoming dilatant hardening requires substantial excess elastic strain energy.
本研究结合显微构造分析（SEM-BSE、EDS）与一维隐式有限差分热增压数值模拟，研究了日本犬山侏罗纪增生杂岩硅质岩中的含假玄武玻璃逆冲断层。研究发现假玄武玻璃边缘发育针铁矿胶结的扩容角砾岩及黄铁矿氧化晕，揭示了同震两阶段串联动态弱化机制：初始热增压诱发围岩扩容破裂并提升渗透率，流体排出导致孔隙压下……

t: Combined optical/SEM-BSE microstructural and EDS geochemical analyses of exhumed fault rocks with 1D implicit finite-difference numerical simulations of coupled coseismic temperature and fluid pressure evolution.
结合断层岩光学/扫描电镜显微构造与能谱地球化学分析，以及同震温度和流体压力演化的一维隐式有限差分数值模拟。

Polished thin sections of a 1–3 mm thick pseudotachylyte fault vein and brecciated chert/mudstone wall rocks from an out-of-sequence thrust in the Jurassic Inuyama accretionary complex, central Japan.
日本中部犬山侏罗纪增生杂岩顺序外逆冲断层中1–3 mm厚假玄武玻璃脉及角砾化硅质岩/泥岩围岩抛光薄片。

A two-order-of-magnitude coseismic permeability increase drops fluid pressure from >295 to ~270 MPa, raising shear stress to 4–5 MPa and reaching 1100 °C in <0.1 s, consuming ~2 and ~5 MJ/m² in thermal pressurization and melting.
同震渗透率增加两个数量级使流体压力从>295降至~270 MPa，剪应力升至4–5 MPa并在<0.1 s内达1100 …

Simulations assume constant slip velocity (1 m/s), constant dynamic friction (0.15), and instantaneous permeability steps, while energy budget calculations neglect illite dehydroxylation and heat diffusion.
模拟假设恒定滑移速率与摩擦系数及瞬时渗透率跃变，能量估算忽略了伊利石脱羟基反应和热扩散。
First natural geological evidence demonstrating a coseismic serial switch from thermal pressurization to dilatant hardening and frictional melting in wet subduction-accretionary fault rocks.
首次提供了含水俯冲增生断层岩中同震弱化由热增压向扩容硬化和摩擦熔融串联转变的自然地质证据。

kc: Provides natural microstructural evidence for a coseismic transition from thermal pressurization to frictional melting in a fluid-rich accretionary thrust.
Demonstrates through 1D numerical modeling that damage-induced wall-rock permeability increase (>1-2 orders of magnitude) drops fluid pressure and triggers melting in thin (<1 cm) slip zones.

Quantifies the on-fault coseismic thermal energy budget into ~2 MJ/m² for thermal pressurization and ~5 MJ/m² for frictional melting, linking melt lubrication in wet rocks to host rock shear modulus and slip deficit.
提供了富流体增生逆冲断层中同震弱化机制从热增压向摩擦熔融动态转变的自然显微构造证据。
通过一维数值模拟证实，损伤引起的围岩渗透率增加（1-2个数量级）会导致流体压力骤降，并在薄滑移带（<1 cm）中触发摩擦熔融。
量化了断层同震热能预算（热增压阶段约2 MJ/m²，摩擦熔融阶段约5 MJ/m²），并将含水岩石中的熔融润滑与围岩剪切模量及滑移亏损联系起来。
me: Optical microscopy, SEM backscattered electron (BSE) imaging, and EDS chemical mapping of polished fault rock thin sections.
Clast size distribution and fractal dimension (D-value) analysis using ImageJ on high-resolution BSE images.
1D implicit finite-difference numerical modeling of coupled temperature and pore fluid pressure diffusion equations during constant-velocity seismic slip.
Analytical thermodynamic calculation of on-fault frictional heat energy density and elastic strain slip deficit.
对抛光断层岩薄片进行光学显微镜、扫描电镜背散射电子（BSE）成像及能谱（EDS）化学元素面扫描分析。
基于高分辨率BSE图像，利用ImageJ进行碎屑粒径分布及分形维数（D值）统计分析。
建立恒定滑移速率下温度与孔隙流体压力耦合扩散方程的一维隐式有限差分数值模型。
开展断层摩擦热能密度与围岩弹性应变滑移亏损的解析热力学计算。
de: Natural pseudotachylyte fault vein and brecciated chert/mudstone wall-rock samples from the Sakahogi synform, Inuyama sequence (Mino-Tamba Belt, central Japan).

Numerical parameter sensitivity experiments testing slip zone thickness (10 µm to 1 cm), dynamic permeability enhancement (10⁻²⁰ to 10⁻¹⁸ m²), initial pore pressure ratio (0.5–0.8), and pore space compressibility.
采自日本中部美浓-丹波带犬山层序坂祝向斜（Sakahogi synform）的天然假玄武玻璃断层脉及角砾化硅质岩/泥岩围岩样品。
测试滑移带厚度（10 µm至1 cm）、动态渗透率增强（10⁻²⁰至10⁻¹⁸ m²）、初始孔隙压力比（0.5–0.8）及孔隙空间压缩性的数值参数敏感性实验。
li: Numerical simulations assume a constant slip velocity (1 m/s) and constant dynamic friction coefficient (0.15) rather than fully coupled rate-and-state or melt-lubrication rheology.
Damage-induced permeability enhancement is imposed instantaneously at a threshold pore pressure rather than evolving gradually with micromechanical fracture growth.
Energy budget estimates rely on simplified constant heat capacity, neglect endothermic illite dehydroxylation and heat advection by fluid expulsion, providing only order-of-magnitude accuracy.
数值模拟假设恒定滑移速率（1 m/s）和恒定动态摩擦系数（0.15），未采用全耦合的速率-状态摩擦或熔体润滑流变学。

The study quantifies on-fault earthquake energy partitioning (frictional heat vs. strain energy) and models coseismic stress evolution and dynamic weakening during seismic slip.

sum: This Zenodo repository presents an earthquake catalog for the Coso geothermal field, California, accompanied by declustering results. Created by Yu-Fang Hsu, Xiaofeng Meng, and Yehuda Ben-Zion, the dataset supports studies on reservoir seismicity, fault mechanics, and background earthquake rates in highly active geothermal systems. Declustering is crucial for separating induced or triggered earthquake clusters from background tectonic events, enabling more accurate seismic hazard assessment and physical modeling of the Coso reservoir.

sum: This paper presents coseismic deformation observations of the 10 August 2026 Mw 7.4 Chocó, Colombia earthquake using L-band NISAR and C-band Sentinel-1 InSAR data. The author highlights critical data-quality challenges, showing that an initial NISAR orbit-ephemeris mismatch severely degraded coherence, which was partially resolved using a Medium-precision Orbit Ephemeris (MOE) product. Sentinel-1 data achieved higher coherence, revealing up to ~9 cm of eastward motion and ~11 cm of uplift along the Cauca-Romeral fault system, consistent with an oblique reverse-left-lateral mechanism. A secondary signal near Tuluá failed consistency checks, serving as a methodological warning. The study demonstrates the value and challenges of multi-sensor InSAR integration for rapid disaster response.

sum: This study investigates the Mesozoic breakup of northernmost Pangea and the opening of the Canada Basin using 3D numerical geodynamic modeling. The authors test the hypothesis that inherited structures from the Paleozoic assemblage of Arctic Pangea and late Proterozoic large igneous provinces influenced rift initiation. They evaluate four inherited structure scenarios under both rotational and translational extensional regimes. The results indicate that a translational opening style in the presence of a relict transform fault (the Canadian Arctic transform system) provides the best fit to geological and geophysical observations, although rotational kinematics cannot be entirely ruled out. This work highlights the critical role of pre-existing lithospheric weaknesses and deformational history in controlling continental rifting and basin evolution.
本研究利用三维数值模拟探讨了中生代加拿大海盆的打开机制。作者测试了古生代和晚元古代继承性结构对裂谷启动的影响，在旋转和平移拉张模式下模拟了四种继承结构情景。结果表明，在存在残余转换断层的情况下，平移打开模式最符合地质与地球物理观测。该研究强调了前寒武纪/古生代岩石圈软弱带对大陆裂解的控制作用。

t: 3D numerical geodynamic modeling of continental rifting under rotational and translational extensional regimes.
在旋转和平移拉张机制下进行大陆裂谷作用的三维地球动力学数值模拟。
Synthetic 3D lithospheric models incorporating four scenarios of Paleozoic and Proterozoic inherited structures.
包含四种古生代和元古代继承结构情景的合成三维岩石圈模型。
A translational opening style with a relict transform fault provides the best fit to geological and geophysical observations.
存在残余转换断层的平移打开模式最符合地质和地球物理观测。
The models cannot completely rule out rotational kinematics and simplify complex lithospheric rheologies.
模型无法完全排除旋转运动学，且简化了复杂的岩石圈流变学。
First 3D numerical models testing the influence of pre-rift inherited structures on Canada Basin opening.

sum: Standard earthquake catalogs list events throughout the crust and uppermost mantle in both Tibet and the Himalayas, suffering from high location uncertainties due to sparse station coverage. Here, the authors manually pick P and S phases and use Hypoinverse2000 to relocate 147 local earthquakes recorded by the dense Hi-CLIMB broadband array, compute 33 focal mechanisms using gcap3D, and compile a regional database of 1371 relocated hypocenters. They demonstrate that seismicity within the Tibetan Plateau is strictly confined to the upper crust (<25 km depth), whereas Himalayan earthquakes extend down to ~100 km across the whole crust and uppermost mantle, including a 300–350 km segment of steep Indian plate subduction between ~85°E and ~88.5°E. This first plateau-wide relocated depth compilation resolves long-standing geodynamic debates: Tibet has a weak, ductile mid-lower crust supporting crustal flow or magmatic inflation, whereas the Himalayas deform via rigid, cold, dry lithosphere.
针对国际地震目录在青藏高原定位精度低的问题，本研究利用Hi-CLIMB密集台阵数据，通过手动拾取震相与Hypoinverse2000重定位了147个地方震，利用gcap3D反演了33个震源机制解，并整编了包含1371个重定位震源的区域数据库。结果表明，青藏高原内部地震严格局限于25公里以上的上地壳，……

t: Manual P/S phase picking on raw seismograms followed by Hypoinverse2000 relocation in a local 1D refraction-derived velocity model, plus gcap3D waveform inversion (with fk3.2 Green's functions) for 33 focal mechanisms.
在原始波形上手动拾取震相，结合局部一维速度模型用Hypoinverse2000重定位，并用gcap3D反演震源机制。

Local earthquakes (M > 3.0) recorded by the ~800-km Hi-CLIMB broadband array (2002–2005), one PASSCAL event, and a regional compilation totaling 1371 relocated hypocenters across Tibet and the Himalayas.
Hi-CLIMB台阵（2002–2005）记录的M>3.0地方震、1个PASSCAL事件及1371个区域重定位震源数据库…

All relocated earthquakes within the Tibetan Plateau are shallower than 25 km (except three <30 km), whereas Himalayan seismicity extends to ~100 km depth, including a 300–350 km steep subduction segment.
青藏高原内部重定位地震均浅于25公里，而喜马拉雅地震深达100公里，含一段300–350公里陡俯冲带。
Relocation uncertainties cannot be precisely determined, and about one-third of the 147 retained events have vertical location uncertainties exceeding 20 km (up to 40 km).
重定位绝对不确定性难以精确测定，约三分之一保留事件的垂向误差超过20公里。

First plateau-wide compilation of 1371 relocated hypocenters proving deep Tibetan catalog earthquakes are mislocations and establishing contrasting lithospheric strength profiles and uplift mechanisms between Tibet and the Himalayas.
首次建立全高原重定位深度库，证实高原深震实为定位偏差，揭示藏喜两地截然不同的流变与隆升机制。

kc: Relocated 147 local earthquakes (retained from 200) recorded by the Hi-CLIMB array and determined 33 focal mechanisms in southern Tibet and the Himalayas.
Compiled the first comprehensive regional database of 1371 relocated earthquake hypocenters covering the entire Himalayan-Tibetan orogen.
Demonstrated that Tibetan Plateau seismicity is restricted to <25 km depth, refuting catalog-based claims of widespread lower-crustal and mantle earthquakes in Tibet.
Identified a 300–350 km segment of localized steep subduction of the Indian plate beneath the Himalayas between ~85°E and ~88.5°E.
Established fundamentally contrasting lithospheric strength profiles and uplift mechanisms between the weak, ductile Tibetan mid-lower crust and the strong, brittle Himalayan lithosphere.
利用Hi-CLIMB台阵数据重定位了147个地方震（从200个事件中筛选），并测定了藏南和喜马拉雅地区33个地震的震源机制解。
整编了首个覆盖整个喜马拉雅-青藏高原造山带的1371个重定位地震震源深度数据库。
证实青藏高原内部地震局限于25公里深度以内，推翻了基于常规地震目录认为高原广泛存在下地壳和地幔地震的认识。
识别出喜马拉雅下方约85°E至88.5°E之间一段长300–350公里的印度板块局部陡角度俯冲带。
确立了青藏高原软弱塑性中下地壳与喜马拉雅强脆性岩石圈之间截然不同的岩石圈强度剖面及隆升机制。
me: Manual P and S phase picking on raw seismograms (or 0.1–5 Hz bandpass filtered for low-quality waveforms) using SAC.
Hypocenter relocation using Hypoinverse2000 with a local 1D velocity model derived from a colinear wide-angle reflection/refraction profile.
Sensitivity testing comparing 1D regional vs. global (CRUST1.0) velocity models and 1.5D linear vs. 2D areal array geometries.
Waveform inversion for focal mechanisms using gcap3D and fk3.2 Green's functions (0.05–0.5 Hz for body waves, 0.05–0.25 Hz for surface waves).
Synthesis and spatial interpolation of maximum seismogenic depth across 1371 relocated events coupled with thermal-rheological strength modeling.
使用SAC在原始地震图（低信噪比波形采用0.1–5 Hz带通滤波）上手动拾取P波和S波初至。
基于共线深地震宽角反射/折射剖面建立的局部一维速度模型，使用Hypoinverse2000程序进行震源重定位。
开展区域一维模型与全球CRUST1.0模型对比，以及1.5维线性台阵与二维面状台阵几何效应的稳健性测试。
利用fk3.2计算格林函数，结合gcap3D程序对体波（0.05–0.5 Hz）和面波（0.05–0.25 Hz）进行波形反演以获取震源机制解。
整合1371个重定位事件进行最大发震深度空间插值，并结合地温线开展岩石圈流变强度剖面建模。
de: Broadband waveforms of local earthquakes (M > 3.0) from 2002 to 2005 recorded by the ~800 km long temporary Hi-CLIMB array (80°–90°E, 25°–36°N).
Waveform data from the 1991–1992 PASSCAL Tibetan Plateau Passive-Source Experiment used to relocate a previously mislocated upper-mantle event in the Lhasa Block.
Compilation of published relocated earthquake catalogs across the Himalayas and Tibetan Plateau totaling 1371 events.
2002至2005年由长约800公里的Hi-CLIMB临时宽频带台阵在研究区（80°–90°E，25°–36°N）记录的M > 3.0地方震波形数据。
1991–1992年PASSCAL青藏高原被动源实验波形数据，用于重定位拉萨地块一个此前被误判为上地幔的地震事件。
汇总已发表文献中喜马拉雅和青藏高原地区的重定位地震目录，共计1371个重定位震源条目。
li: Absolute relocation uncertainties cannot be exactly determined; Hypoinverse2000 only provides rough covariance-based estimates, and about one-third of events have vertical uncertainties >20 km.
Relocations rely on simple 1D velocity models, though sensitivity tests show general stability across different 1D models.
Many historical catalog events (>30 km depth) could not be relocated due to lack of local station data and had to be excluded.
重定位的绝对误差无法精确测定，Hypoinverse2000仅提供基于反演矩阵的粗略估计，约三分之一事件的垂向误差大于20公里。
重定位依赖于简化的一维速度模型，尽管敏感性测试表明不同区域一维模型结果总体稳定。
许多目录中深度大于30公里的历史地震因缺乏近台数据无法重定位，只能从分析中剔除。

tm.why: The paper uses relocated earthquake depths to constrain lithospheric rheology, thermal structure, and uplift mechanisms in the Tibetan Plateau and Himalayas.
The core analysis relies on relocating local earthquakes from the Hi-CLIMB array using Hypoinverse2000 and compiling a comprehensive database of 1371 relocated hypocenters.
The authors invert waveforms for 33 focal mechanisms using gcap3D to link seismicity with regional normal, strike-slip, and thrust faulting.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF evaluated, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), and all 8 figures.

sum: High event rates during the 2004–2008 Mount St. Helens eruption challenged traditional seismic processing. This study presents a modular workflow for bulk detection, cluster picking, 3D location, and full-waveform source-mechanism inversion of repetitive long-period (LP) volcanic seismicity without requiring a priori templates. Using broadband and short-period crater data from 29 June to 31 July 2005, spectral summation detects 52,141 triggers, of which ~40% (20,561 events) group into 17 multiplets (≥300 events each). Combining cross-correlation cluster picking with finite-difference 3D travel-time tables (accounting for topography and 3D velocity models), 20,076 events are located into compact, connected clusters ~775 m beneath the crater floor directly under the extruding dacite spine. Full-waveform moment-tensor and single-force inversions constrained to these travel-time hypocenters show mechanisms dominated by volumetric sub-horizontal cracks with minor sub-vertical crack components, indicating a shallow plexus of hydrofractures extending from the solidifying conduit margins.
针对圣海伦斯火山2004-2008年喷发期间高频次长周期（LP）地震处理难题，本文提出无需先验模板的批量检测、聚类拾取、三维定位及全波形震源机制反演新流程。利用2005年7月宽频带和短周期台网数据，通过频谱累加检测出52,141个触发事件，其中约40%（20,561个）归入17个多重震群。结合互相关……

t: The workflow combines single-station spectral summation triggering, cross-correlation multiplet clustering, manual stack picking, finite-difference 3D travel-time grid-search location with station terms, and frequency-domain full-waveform moment-tensor and single-force inversion.
结合单台频谱累加触发、互相关多重震群聚类、叠加拾取、三维有限差分走时定位和全波形矩张量反演。

Continuous 100-Hz seismic waveforms from 19 temporary broadband stations and 4 short-period crater accelerometer ('spider') stations recorded at Mount St. Helens primarily between 29 June and 31 July 2005.
圣海伦斯火山2005年6月29日至7月31日19个宽频带台站和4个火山口短周期台站连续波形。

Out of 52,141 triggers, 20,561 repeating events form 17 multiplets. 3D locations of 20,076 events cluster ~775 m beneath the crater floor under the extruding spine, with mechanisms dominated by volumetric sub-horizontal cracks.
40%事件归入17个震群；20,076个事件定位于熔岩脊下方约775米深度，机制由近水平裂隙体积分量主导。

Constrained crack-geometry inversions were unstable and distant-station waveform fits were degraded (E2 > 100%) due to inadequate knowledge of the shallow 3D velocity structure in the upper few hundred meters.
受浅表数百米速度结构未知及台网几何限制，约束裂隙几何反演不稳定且远台波形拟合误差较大。

Introduces a template-free bulk workflow that integrates finite-difference 3D travel-time location directly with full-waveform source-mechanism inversion, expanding Mount St. Helens LP mechanism characterization from 2 event types to 17 multiplets.
提出无先验模板批量处理流程，将有限差分三维走时定位与全波形震源反演无缝结合。

kc: Developed a template-free bulk workflow combining spectral summation triggering, cross-correlation multiplet clustering, manual stack picking, 3D finite-difference travel-time location, and full-waveform mechanism inversion.
Detected 52,141 candidate LP triggers in July 2005 at Mount St. Helens and classified 20,561 repeating events (~40%) into 17 major multiplets of at least 300 events.

Located 20,076 LP events in 3D using finite-difference elastodynamic Green's functions and static station terms, resolving a compact cluster ~775 m beneath the 1980s crater floor directly under the extruding spine.

Performed full-waveform moment-tensor and single-force inversions for all 17 multiplet stacks at their travel-time-constrained hypocenters, showing dominance of volumetric sub-horizontal crack mechanisms (49%–66% volume change).
开发了无需先验模板的批量处理流程，集成了频谱累加触发、互相关多重震群聚类、叠加手动拾取、三维有限差分走时定位和全波形震源机制反演。
在圣海伦斯火山2005年7月数据中检测出52,141个候选事件，并将20,561个重复事件（约40%）归类为17个包含至少300个事件的主要多重震群。
利用有限差分弹性动力学格林函数和静态台站校正对20,076个LP事件进行了三维定位，发现震源紧密聚集在挤压熔岩脊正下方约775米深度处。
在走时约束的震源位置上对17个多重震群叠加波形进行了全波形矩张量和单力反演，表明震源机制由近水平张裂隙体积分量主导（占体积变化的49%–66%）。
me: Spectral summation event detection summing power spectral density between 0.39 and 20.12 Hz over 5.12-s windows with peak detection.
Single-station cross-correlation (0.5–10 Hz) and multiplet grouping using a correlation coefficient threshold of >= 0.65 and minimum population of 300.
Cluster picking of peak first-motion dilatation on aligned vertical-component waveform stacks coupled with cross-correlation lag extraction.

3D travel-time table generation via 3D finite-difference simulation of isotropic point sources using source-receiver reciprocity, followed by 3-stage grid-search and shrinking-box L1/L2 location with iterative static station terms and bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Frequency-domain full-waveform inversion (0.5–2 Hz) of 3-component median-stacked waveforms for 6 moment-tensor and 3 single-force components, followed by orthogonal 3-crack eigenvalue decomposition.
频谱累加事件检测：在5.12秒窗口内累加0.39至20.12 Hz频段的功率谱密度并进行峰值检测。
单台波形互相关（0.5–10 Hz）与多重震群划分（相关系数阈值≥0.65，最小事件数300）。
垂直分量对齐波形叠加初动膨胀峰值的聚类拾取及互相关时延提取。
基于震源-接收点互易定理的三维有限差分模拟生成三维走时表，结合三阶段网格搜索与收缩盒L1/L2范数定位、迭代静态台站校正及自助法误差估计。
三分量中值叠加波形的频域全波形反演（0.5–2 Hz），求解6个矩张量和3个单力分量，并进行正交三裂隙特征值分解。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms (100 Hz sampling) from 19 temporary broadband stations (YB network) and 4 short-period USGS accelerometer 'spider' stations (CC network) at Mount St. Helens, focusing on 29 June to 31 July 2005 plus a 6-month single-station context analysis.
3D velocity models of Mount St. Helens from Waite & Moran (2009) and Ulberg et al. (2020) (iMUSH), plus a homogeneous reference model (Vp=3.5 km/s, Vs=2.0 km/s), combined with a 20-m discretized DEM.
圣海伦斯火山19个临时宽频带台站（YB台网）和4个USGS短周期“蜘蛛”加速度计台站（CC台网）的100 Hz连续波形数据（重点分析2005年6月29日至7月31日，辅以6个月单台背景分析）。
Waite & Moran (2009) 和 Ulberg et al. (2020) (iMUSH) 的圣海伦斯火山三维速度模型、均匀参考模型（Vp=3.5 km/s, Vs=2.0 km/s）以及20米网格地形数据（DEM）。
li: Approximately 60% of detected triggers (30,790 unassigned events) in July 2005 were not repetitive enough to form large multiplets (>=300 events) and were excluded from location and mechanism inversion.

Full-waveform inversions fixed at travel-time hypocenters yielded higher waveform residual errors (E2 often >100%) and more complex mechanisms than open grid-searches due to unmodeled shallow 3D velocity structure.

Constrained volumetric crack-geometry inversions (single-crack, dual-crack, pipe-crack) were unstable due to inadequate knowledge of the upper few hundred meters velocity structure and network geometry.
2005年7月约60%的触发事件（30,790个未分配事件）重复性不足以归入大震群（≥300个事件），未被纳入定位和机制反演。
受未建模浅部三维速度结构影响，固定在走时震源位置的全波形反演相比开放网格搜索具有更高的波形残差（E2常大于100%）和更复杂的机制。
由于浅表几百米速度结构认识不足及台网几何限制，约束裂隙几何（单裂隙、双裂隙、管状裂隙）的反演结果不稳定。

tm.why: The study investigates repetitive long-period (LP) volcanic seismicity during the 2004-2008 dome-building eruption of Mount St. Helens.
The authors develop a bulk processing workflow for spectral summation event triggering, multiplet cluster picking, and 3D travel-time location of over 20,000 volcanic events.
Full-waveform moment-tensor and single-force inversions are performed on 17 multiplet stacks to determine volumetric crack source mechanisms.

ev.notes: Full 92-page manuscript PDF (including main text, Appendix A, 15 figures, and 3 tables) was analyzed directly.

sum: Earthquakes disrupt bedrock aquifers by altering permeability, yet distinguishing between driving mechanisms has remained challenging. This study jointly analyzes borehole piezometric records (via Earth tide and barometric transfer function inversion for transmissivity) and ambient seismic noise interferometry (dv/v) in Taroko National Park, Taiwan, spanning the 2022 M6.9 Taitung and 2024 M7.2 Hualien earthquakes. Results reveal two distinct permeability modification regimes. Coseismic shaking causes immediate transmissivity increases (~80% for Hualien) that co-evolve and recover alongside substrate seismic wavespeed decreases, indicating coupled rock-mechanical changes in fracture aperture and grain contact area. Conversely, two post-Hualien typhoons (Gaemi and Kong-Rey) triggered abrupt, non-recovering transmissivity drops (-55% and -25%) without affecting substrate wavespeed. This demonstrates that large earthquakes prime steep landscapes via landsliding and macrofracturing, enabling subsequent typhoon overland flow to flush sediment into aquifers and clog fractures.
本研究联合分析了台湾太鲁阁国家公园的钻孔水位记录（通过固体潮与气压传递函数反演导水系数）和背景噪声干涉测量的地震波速变化（δv/v），涵盖2022年台东M6.9和2024年花莲M7.2地震。研究揭示了两种截然不同的渗透率改变机制：同震摇晃引起导水系数立即增加（花莲地震约80%），并与基底波速下降共同……

t: Inverts semi-diurnal solid Earth tidal and barometric groundwater transfer functions for leaky-aquifer transmissivity, and compares pore-pressure-corrected transmissivity with ambient noise coda wave stretching velocity changes (dv/v).
利用半日潮和气压传递函数反演越流含水层导水系数，并与背景噪声尾波拉伸法测得的波速变化（δv/v）进行对比。

Analyzes groundwater records from four boreholes, ambient noise from seismic network stations, weather records, and strong-motion accelerometers in Taroko National Park, Taiwan, from July 2021 to November 2025.
分析2021年7月至2025年11月台湾太鲁阁国家公园四个钻孔水位、地震台网背景噪声、气象及强震数据。

Pore pressure-corrected transmissivity increased by ~80% after the 2024 M7.2 Hualien earthquake, co-evolving with low-frequency dv/v recovery, but dropped by ~55% and ~25% during subsequent typhoons Gaemi and Kong-Rey.
2024年花莲M7.2震后导水系数增加约80%且与低频δv/v协同恢复，但在随后的凯米和康芮台风期间分别骤降约55%和2…
Only well EHW-02 provided reliable tidal transfer functions for inversion, and high-frequency water level noise obscured transmissivity estimates for two weeks after the M7.2 earthquake.
仅EHW-02井能可靠反演导水系数，且高频水位噪声导致M7.2震后两周内的导水系数估计存在较大不确定性。

Jointly tracks aquifer transmissivity and substrate seismic wavespeed to separate rock-mechanical damage from fracture clogging, discovering that large earthquakes prime landscapes for delayed typhoon-induced permeability loss.
联合追踪导水系数与地震波速以区分岩石力学损伤与裂隙堵塞，发现大地震使地貌易受台风引发的延迟渗透率损失。

kc: Demonstrated co-evolution of coseismic aquifer transmissivity increases and substrate seismic wavespeed decreases, pointing to coupled rock-mechanical changes.
Observed delayed, abrupt, and lasting permeability decreases (-55% and -25%) triggered by postseismic typhoons without corresponding seismic wavespeed changes.
Established seismic wavespeed monitoring (dv/v) alongside groundwater tidal analysis as a diagnostic discriminator between rock-mechanical and fracture-clogging permeability changes.
证明了同震含水层导水系数增加与基底地震波速下降的共同演化，表明存在耦合的岩石力学变化。
观测到震后台风触发的延迟、急剧且持久的渗透率下降（-55%和-25%），且无相应的地震波速变化。
确立了将地震波速监测（δv/v）与地下水潮汐分析结合作为区分岩石力学变化与裂隙堵塞机制的诊断工具。
me: Tidal and barometric transfer function inversion in semi-diurnal bands (M2, N2, S2) assuming a two-layer leaky-aquifer model to estimate time-dependent transmissivity.
Pore-pressure correction of transmissivity using an effective-stress fracture aperture model.
Single-station cross-component ambient noise interferometry and coda wave stretching across octave frequency bands (0.5-16 Hz) to measure relative seismic velocity changes (dv/v).
基于双层越流含水层模型，利用半日潮频段（M2、N2、S2）的固体潮和气压传递函数反演时变导水系数。
使用有效应力裂隙开度模型对导水系数进行孔隙压力校正。
利用单台三分量背景噪声互相关及尾波拉伸法，在多个倍频程频段（0.5-16 Hz）测量相对地震波速变化（δv/v）。
de: Piezometric groundwater level records (2021-2025) from four boreholes (EHW-01, EHW-02, EHW-03, EH-04) in Taroko National Park, eastern Taiwan.
Continuous three-component seismic records from the TQ network (specifically station TQ01 and surrounding stations) and strong-motion PGA data from TSMIP stations F072 and F026.
Barometric pressure and precipitation records from weather station C0T820 and historical 2013 hydraulic pump test data.
台湾东部太鲁阁国家公园四个钻孔（EHW-01、EHW-02、EHW-03、EH-04）2021至2025年的测压地下水位记录。
TQ台网（特别是TQ01台站及周边台站）的连续三分量地震记录，以及TSMIP强震台站F072和F026的峰值地面加速度（PGA）数据。
C0T820气象站的气压和降水记录，以及2013年水力抽水试验历史数据。
li: Only one borehole (EHW-02) yielded robust semi-diurnal tidal transfer functions suitable for transmissivity inversion; the other three were unconfined or had too low permeability.
High-frequency water level noise prevented reliable interpretation of transmissivity during the first two weeks immediately following the M7.2 Hualien earthquake.
Strong correlation between tidal gain and water level precluded interpretation of the inverted aquifer shear modulus G(t).
仅有一个钻孔（EHW-02）提供了适用于导水系数反演的可靠半日潮传递函数，其余三个为非承压井或渗透率过低。
高频水位噪声阻碍了对M7.2花莲地震后最初两周内导水系数即时响应的可靠解释。
潮汐增益与水位之间的强相关性使得无法解释反演得到的含水层剪切模量G(t)。

tm.why: The paper extracts relative seismic wavespeed changes (dv/v) from ambient seismic noise cross-correlations using the stretching method to track substrate properties.
The study focuses on earthquake hydrology, aquifer permeability changes, coseismic landsliding, and typhoon-induced sediment clogging in eastern Taiwan.

ev.notes: Full preprint text (pages 1-25) and attached supplementary material (pages 26-34) were read and analyzed.

sum: This paper presents a quantum algorithm for simulating classical coupled oscillator networks with non-Markovian dissipation, external sources, and time-varying material properties, extending quantum wave simulation to viscoacoustic and viscoelastic media. By approximating hereditary memory kernels via a Prony series (generalized Maxwell model), the history-dependent dynamics are embedded into an augmented Markovian state space governed by a non-Hermitian generator. Using block encodings and Linear Combination of Hamiltonian Simulation (LCHS), the algorithm estimates subsystem energies at time t within error epsilon with query complexity scaling linearly in t and polylogarithmically in system size. The authors prove this task is BQP-complete even under strong localized dissipation. However, by deriving novel Lieb-Robinson-like information locality bounds for inhomogeneous differential equations, they prove exponential quantum speedups are infeasible on finite-dimensional local lattices, reducing the advantage to a polynomial (quartic in 3D) speedup when weakly damped modes exist.
本文提出一种模拟具有非马尔可夫耗散、外源和时变材料特性的经典耦合振子网络的量子算法，将量子波场模拟推广至粘声和粘弹性介质。通过Prony级数（广义Maxwell模型）近似记忆核，将历史依赖动力学嵌入由非厄米算子主导的增广马尔可夫状态空间，并结合块编码与线性组合哈密顿量模拟（LCHS）估算子系统能量。……

t: Embeds non-Markovian viscoelastic oscillator networks into an augmented Markovian state space via a Prony series of generalized Maxwell bodies, then simulates the resulting non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation using block encodings and Linear Combination of Hamiltonian Simulation (LCHS).
用Prony级数将非马尔可夫振子网络嵌入马尔可夫空间，结合块编码与LCHS模拟非厄米演化。
Purely theoretical and analytical study evaluating graph-coupled classical oscillator networks, fractional constant-Q and logarithmic creep kernels, and D-dimensional lattice topologies.
纯理论分析，研究图耦合振子网络、分数阶常Q与对数蠕变核以及D维晶格拓扑。

Estimates subsystem energies within error epsilon using O_tilde(T(alpha_L + alpha_H)/epsilon) oracle queries; proves BQP-completeness under strong localized damping and bounds quantum speedup on 3D local lattices to quartic O(t^4) vs O(t).
查询复杂度关于时间线性、自由度多对数缩放；证明强局部阻尼下BQP完全性及3D晶格四次加速。

Framework cannot capture non-linear dynamics, rotating reference frames (e.g., Coriolis forces), or non-monotonic oscillatory memory kernels, and loses polynomial runtime advantage when all modes have constant lower-bounded damping.
无法处理非线性动力学、旋转参考系及振荡记忆核，全模态强阻尼时失去多项式时间优势。

First unified quantum simulation framework for classical oscillators with non-Markovian memory and time-dependent materials, paired with novel Lieb-Robinson-like locality bounds for inhomogeneous dissipative differential equations.
首次统一非马尔可夫与时变介质经典振子量子模拟，并提出非齐次耗散方程信息局域界限。

kc: Formulated a Markovian embedding for non-Markovian viscoelastic oscillator networks via Prony series (generalized Maxwell bodies) and mapped it to a Schrödinger-form non-unitary evolution.
Constructed explicit quantum block-encoding circuits and applied LCHS to simulate time-independent, time-dependent, active, and probabilistic dissipative oscillator systems.
Proved that subsystem energy estimation remains BQP-complete even in the presence of strong localized dissipation.
Derived Lieb-Robinson-like information locality bounds for source-driven dissipative differential equations, proving that local 3D lattice simulations yield at most a quartic quantum speedup.
通过Prony级数（广义Maxwell体）构建了非马尔可夫粘弹性振子网络的马尔可夫嵌入，并将其映射为薛定谔形式的非幺正演化。
构建了显式量子块编码电路并应用LCHS框架，模拟了时不变、时变、主动及概率耗散振子系统。

Similarity transformation mapping physical kinetic and potential energy to the squared Euclidean norm of the quantum state.
Quantum block-encoding of graph topology, Hamiltonian, and positive semi-definite dissipator matrices coupled with Linear Combination of Hamiltonian Simulation (LCHS).
Classical local Taylor-series simulation algorithm based on causal light-cone and dissipative temporal horizon truncation bounds.

对图拓扑、哈密顿量和半正定耗散矩阵进行量子块编码，并结合线性组合哈密顿量模拟（LCHS）。

de: Theoretical complexity and asymptotic runtime analyses comparing quantum LCHS simulation against classical light-cone truncated solvers.
Analytical kernel approximation convergence analysis for fractional (constant-Q attenuation) and logarithmic creep memory kernels.
对比量子LCHS模拟与经典光锥截断求解器的理论复杂度和渐近运行时间分析。
针对分数阶（常Q衰减）和对数蠕变记忆核的解析核近似收敛性分析。

Exponential quantum runtime advantage is unreachable for locally coupled finite-dimensional meshes/lattices, and polynomial advantages vanish if all modes are strongly damped.
High-frequency wavefield components in homogeneous constant-Q media decay exponentially with system size, inducing exponential quantum sampling/amplification overhead.
仅限于线性动力学、无局部振荡的完全单调松弛核以及非旋转参考系（无法嵌入科里奥利力）。

均匀常Q介质中的高频波场分量随系统规模呈指数衰减，会导致指数级的量子采样或振幅放大开销。

tm.why: The paper develops a quantum algorithm for simulating classical oscillator networks with non-Markovian dissipation and time-varying properties, directly modeling discretized viscoacoustic and viscoelastic wave equations.
The study explicitly models intrinsic attenuation, constant-Q fractional kernels, and viscoelastic relaxation spectra via generalized Maxwell bodies and Prony series.

sum: Ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA) is widely used for solving nonlinear Bayesian inverse problems and quantifying uncertainty in subsurface characterization. However, selecting inflation parameters involves a trade-off between accuracy (many small updates) and computational efficiency (few large updates). This paper unifies existing ES-MDA variants into a three-step framework: inflation proposal, pre-analysis revision, and post-analysis revision. Building on this framework, the authors introduce an 'accuracy-aware' variant, ES-MDA-A2, which requires only two interpretable user inputs: target RMSE and maximum iterations. ES-MDA-A2 proposes small inflation parameters based on RMSE for aggressive initial updates, paired with a 'catch-up' mechanism that increases inflation to allow more iterations if the target accuracy is not yet reached. Tested on a nonlinear toy model, 1D field electromagnetic (DC resistivity and marine magnetotelluric) inversions, and a 2D CO2 reservoir simulation, ES-MDA-A2 consistently achieves high accuracy at reduced computational cost.
多数据同化集合平滑器（ES-MDA）广泛用于求解地球物理非线性贝叶斯反演与不确定性量化，但膨胀参数的选择面临计算效率与精度的权衡。本文提出了统一现有ES-MDA方法的三步框架：膨胀提议、分析前修正和分析后修正。在此基础上，开发了“精度感知”自适应算法ES-MDA-A2，仅需目标均方根误差（RMSE）……

t: ES-MDA-A2 operates in three steps: proposing an inflation parameter proportional to the ensemble average RMSE, revising it pre-analysis via a 'catch-up' mechanism if target accuracy is unmet, and checking convergence post-analysis using the ensemble mean RMSE.
ES-MDA-A2分三步：按集合平均RMSE提议膨胀参数，未达目标精度时通过分析前“追赶”机制调大参数，以及利用集合均值…

Evaluated across four test cases: a synthetic nonlinear BOD toy model, 1D field inversions of Australian shield DC resistivity and offshore New Jersey marine MT data, and a 2D synthetic CO2-brine reservoir simulation using GEOS.
在四个算例上评估：非线性BOD玩具模型、澳大利亚直流电阻率与新泽西海底MT一维实测数据反演，以及基于GEOS的二维CO2…

Across all benchmarks, ES-MDA-A2 matches the accuracy of 8-iteration fixed ES-MDA and EKI-DMC while requiring fewer iterations (e.g., ~4 iterations for DC resistivity and ~6 for BOD and 2D reservoir models), outperforming EKI-DMC in both cost and accuracy on the reservoir problem.
ES-MDA-A2以更少迭代（直流电阻率约4次，BOD和二维储层约6次）达到了8步固定ES-MDA的精度，在储层问题上精…
The default scaling factor (a = 1) may cause overly large early updates in some problems, and covariance localization effects on adaptive inflation scheduling are not explored.
默认比例因子（a=1）可能导致早期更新过大，且未探讨协方差局域化对自适应膨胀调度的影响。
Unifies ES-MDA variants into a three-step framework and introduces an RMSE-based inflation proposal with a 'catch-up' mechanism that increases inflation when target accuracy is not yet achieved.
将ES-MDA统一为三步框架，首次提出基于RMSE的膨胀提议及在未达目标精度时增大膨胀系数的“追赶”机制。

kc: Formulates a unified three-step framework (inflation proposal, pre-analysis revision, post-analysis revision) that encompasses fixed and adaptive ES-MDA algorithms.
Introduces ES-MDA-A2, an accuracy-aware adaptive algorithm controlled by only two interpretable parameters: target RMSE and maximum iterations.
Develops an RMSE-based inflation proposal combined with a pre-analysis 'catch-up' mechanism that increases inflation when initial large updates fail to reach target accuracy.
Demonstrates superior cost-accuracy trade-offs across a toy problem, 1D DC resistivity and marine MT field data inversions, and a 2D CO2 reservoir flow simulation.
提出了涵盖固定和自适应ES-MDA算法的统一三步框架（膨胀提议、分析前修正、分析后修正）。
开发了精度感知的自适应算法ES-MDA-A2，仅由目标RMSE和最大迭代次数两个具可解释性的参数控制。
设计了基于RMSE的膨胀提议与分析前“追赶”机制，当早期大步长更新未能达到目标精度时自动增加膨胀系数。
在玩具模型、一维直流电阻率和海洋大地电磁实测数据反演以及二维CO2储层模拟中验证了该方法优越的成本-精度权衡表现。
me: Unified three-step ES-MDA framework: Step 1 (inflation proposal), Step 2 (pre-analysis revision), and Step 3 (post-analysis revision).
ES-MDA-A2 algorithm proposing inflation proportional to ensemble average RMSE rather than MSE to enable larger early updates.
Pre-analysis catch-up mechanism that doubles reference inflation when cumulative inverse inflation exceeds 1 before reaching the target RMSE.
Post-analysis revision using a single forward simulation of the ensemble mean to check convergence and save computational cost.
统一的三步ES-MDA框架：第一步（膨胀参数提议）、第二步（分析前修正）和第三步（分析后修正）。
ES-MDA-A2算法采用与集合平均RMSE（而非MSE）成正比的膨胀提议，以实现早期大步长更新。
分析前“追赶”机制：当累积逆膨胀系数超过1但未达到目标RMSE时，将参考膨胀系数翻倍以继续迭代。
分析后修正：仅对集合均值进行一次正演模拟来检查收敛性，从而大幅降低计算成本。
de: Synthetic low-dimensional nonlinear Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) toy model (100 trials, ensemble size Ne = 100).
1D field data inversion of Schlumberger DC resistivity sounding from the Australian shield (29 apparent resistivities, 60 layers to ~458 km depth).
1D field data inversion of seafloor magnetotelluric (MT) data offshore New Jersey (10 frequencies, 60 layers of 20 m thickness).
Synthetic 2D two-phase (CO2 and brine) reservoir history matching in GEOS (9-spot well pattern, 10,000 permeability parameters, Ne = 30).
低维非线性生化需氧量（BOD）合成玩具模型实验（100次重复实验，集合大小Ne = 100）。
澳大利亚地盾斯伦贝谢直流电阻率测深一维实测数据反演（29个视电阻率数据，60层网格深达约458公里）。
新泽西近海海底大地电磁（MT）一维实测数据反演（10个频率的视电阻率与相位，60层20米厚网格）。
基于GEOS模拟器的二维两相（CO2和盐水）储层历史拟合合成实验（五点井网扩展的九点井网，10,000个渗透率参数，Ne = 30）。
li: Using the default scaling factor (a = 1) for RMSE inflation proposals may produce overly aggressive early updates in highly nonlinear problems without strong priors.
Does not incorporate covariance localization or subspace methods, nor evaluate their interaction with adaptive inflation scheduling.
With small ensemble sizes, performing too many small updates accumulates sampling error until updates are dominated by noise.
在缺乏强先验的强非线性问题中，使用默认比例因子（a = 1）的RMSE膨胀提议可能导致早期更新步长过大。
未结合协方差局域化或子空间方法，也未评估它们与自适应膨胀调度之间的相互作用。
在小集合规模下，执行过多的小步长更新会累积采样误差，最终导致更新被噪声主导。

tm.why: The paper develops an adaptive ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA) to approximate Bayesian posterior distributions and quantify uncertainties in geophysical inverse problems.
The core focus is a general three-step algorithmic framework and inflation scheduling mechanism for solving nonlinear inverse problems.
The method is directly motivated by and tested on subsurface fluid flow and CO2 injection reservoir characterization, though using pressure/saturation and EM data rather than seismicity.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF (including supplementary figures S1-S4 and algorithms) was read and analyzed.

sum: This paper applies seismic full-waveform inversion (FWI) to map the azimuthal anisotropy of the Australian upper mantle. By accounting for the full physics of wave propagation, the authors construct a high-resolution 3D anisotropic model that constrains mantle flow patterns and lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling beneath the Australian continent. The results provide new insights into the deformation history of the Australian plate and its interaction with the underlying mantle flow, demonstrating the power of anisotropic FWI in resolving complex deep-Earth structures.
本文利用全波形反演（FWI）技术绘制了澳大利亚上地幔的方位各向异性结构。通过构建高分辨率三维各向异性模型，约束了澳大利亚大陆下方的地幔流模式和岩石圈-软流圈耦合特征。研究结果为理解澳大利亚板块的变形历史及其与下覆地幔流的相互作用提供了新见解，展示了各向异性FWI在解析深部地球复杂结构中的关键作用。

t: Seismic full-waveform inversion (FWI) incorporating 3D azimuthal anisotropy to model wave propagation and update anisotropic elastic parameters.
结合三维方位各向异性的地震全波形反演方法，用于模拟波动传播并更新各向异性弹性参数。
Regional earthquake waveform data recorded by seismic networks across the Australian continent.
由澳大利亚大陆地震台网记录的区域地震波形数据。
A high-resolution 3D azimuthal anisotropy model revealing mantle flow directions and lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling beneath Australia.
获得了高分辨率三维方位各向异性模型，揭示了澳大利亚下方的地幔流方向和岩石圈-软流圈耦合特征。
Potential trade-offs between isotropic and anisotropic parameters, and dependency on station distribution.
各向同性与各向异性参数之间可能存在权衡，且依赖于台站分布。
First application of full-waveform inversion to map 3D azimuthal anisotropy and mantle flow across the entire Australian upper mantle.
首次应用全波形反演绘制整个澳大利亚上地幔的三维方位各向异性及地幔流特征。

Mapped mantle flow patterns and investigated lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling beneath Australia.
Demonstrated the capability of anisotropic FWI to resolve complex lithospheric and asthenospheric deformation.
利用全波形反演构建了澳大利亚上地幔的高分辨率三维方位各向异性模型。
绘制了地慢流模式并研究了澳大利亚下方的岩石圈-软流圈耦合特征。
展示了各向异性全波形反演在解析复杂岩石圈和软流圈形变方面的能力。

Adjoint-state method for sensitivity kernel calculation and gradient-based optimization.
结合方位各向异性的地震全波形反演（FWI）方法。
用于敏感核计算的伴随状态法及基于梯度的优化算法。

sum: While ordinary earthquakes follow a constant stress-drop scaling (~3 MPa), slow earthquakes, injection-induced seismicity, and natural earthquake swarms exhibit diffusive migration and bounded slip. By analyzing prolonged earthquake swarms in Northeast Japan (Yamagata–Fukushima and Sendai–Okura) using Isolation Forest outlier removal, HDBSCAN clustering, and maximum-negentropy concave hulls, the authors constrain the spatiotemporal evolution of active seismicity areas and cumulative seismic moments. Although moment-duration trajectories vary widely due to differing diffusion coefficients, plotting cumulative seismic moment against seismicity area collapses trajectories of natural swarms and induced seismicity directly onto those of slow earthquakes (LFEs, VLFEs, SSFs, SSEs). This unified scaling reveals a common upper bound on areal moment density corresponding to a constant average fault slip of ~1 cm. Finite-source collective crack modeling and 2D lattice random-walk simulations demonstrate that a Brownian rupture model universally explains this constant-slip diffusional earthquake class.
本研究探讨了慢地震、注水诱发地震和天然震群的统一标度关系。作者利用孤立森林去噪、HDBSCAN聚类及最大负熵凹包算法，精确约束了日本东北地区震群（山形-福岛和仙台-大仓）的地震活动面积和累积地震矩演化。虽然矩-持续时间轨迹因扩散系数差异而分散，但在地震矩-活动面积空间中，天然震群和诱发地震的轨迹与慢……

t: The authors evaluate swarm active areas using Isolation Forest outlier removal, PCA fault-plane projection, maximum-negentropy concave hulls, and HDBSCAN clustering, then model slip scaling via 3 MPa circular crack superposition and 2D lattice Brownian random-walk simulations.
结合孤立森林去噪、PCA投影、最大负熵凹包和HDBSCAN聚类评估活动面积，并通过圆裂纹叠加和二维布朗随机游走模拟滑移标…

Relocated hypocenter catalogs of the Yamagata–Fukushima (>28,000 events, cumulative Mw 5.1) and Sendai–Okura swarms following the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, compared against compiled global datasets of slow earthquakes, natural swarms, and injection-induced seismicity.
2011年东北冲地震后山形-福岛（>28,000事件）和仙台-大仓震群重定位目录，以及全球慢地震、天然震群和诱发地震汇编…

When plotted against seismicity area, cumulative moment trajectories of swarms and induced seismicity collapse onto slow earthquakes, bounded by an areal moment density of 10^8.5 N/m (average slip ~1 cm) with a characteristic kink at S* ~ 10 km^2.
在矩-面积空间中，震群与慢地震坍缩至同一标度带，受面矩密度上限10^8.5 N/m（平均滑移约1 cm）约束，拐点位于1…

Kinematic circular crack superposition neglects stress interactions among neighboring events, and the simplified 2D lattice Brownian rupture model omits site re-ruptures and breaks down under complex fault geometries.
运动学裂纹叠加忽略了事件间应力相互作用，简化的二维晶格布朗模型未考虑重复破裂及复杂断层几何结构。

Identifies a unified moment-area scaling law and constant-slip upper bound (~1 cm) that bridges slow earthquakes, natural swarms, and induced seismicity into a single class of Brownian diffusional earthquakes.
发现了统一的矩-面积标度律和约1厘米恒定滑移上限，将慢地震、天然震群和诱发地震统一为布朗扩散型地震。

kc: Demonstrated that natural earthquake swarms, injection-induced seismicity, and slow earthquakes collapse onto a single scaling band in the seismic moment versus seismicity area domain.
Established a universal upper bound on areal moment density (10^8.5 N/m) for diffusional earthquakes, corresponding to a constant average slip distance of ~1 cm.
Developed an objective geometric framework using Isolation Forest, HDBSCAN, and maximum-negentropy concave hulls to accurately measure clustered seismicity areas.
Showed through finite-source crack superposition and 2D random-walk simulations that the Brownian rupture model universally explains the moment-area scaling and kink at S* ~ 10 km^2.
证明了天然震群、注水诱发地震和慢地震在地震矩-活动面积域中坍缩到单一标度带上。
确立了扩散型地震的面矩密度通用上限（10^8.5 N/m），对应约1厘米的恒定平均滑移距离。
开发了结合孤立森林、HDBSCAN和最大负熵凹包的客观几何框架，以精确测量丛集地震的活动面积。
通过有限源裂纹叠加和二维随机游走模拟，证明布朗破裂模型能普遍解释矩-面积标度律及S* ~ 10 km^2处的拐点。
me: Geometrical outlier removal (5% contamination ratio) using the Isolation Forest algorithm and principal component analysis (PCA) for fault plane orientation.
Active seismicity area estimation via concave hulls optimized by maximizing second-order Edgeworth negentropy of logarithmic Delaunay edge lengths.
Sub-cluster identification using density-based hierarchical clustering (HDBSCAN) optimized via local-minimum Shannon partition entropy.
Finite-source cumulative slip modeling by superimposing 3 MPa circular cracks on a discretized fault grid (100 m spacing).
2D square-lattice Brownian rupture simulations using 10^5 random walkers to derive analytical moment-area scaling curves.
利用孤立森林算法剔除5%几何离群点，并结合主成分分析（PCA）提取断层主平面方向。
通过最大化Delaunay三角剖分对数边长分布的二阶Edgeworth负熵来优化凹包，以评估有效地震活动面积。
利用基于密度的层次聚类（HDBSCAN）识别子丛集，并通过局部最小香农分割熵优化超参数。
在100米间距的离散断层网格上叠加3 MPa恒定应力降圆裂纹，进行有限源累积滑移建模。
使用10^5个随机游走者进行二维方格布朗破裂模拟，推导解析矩-面积标度曲线。
de: Relocated hypocenter catalogs of the 2011–2013 Yamagata–Fukushima-border swarm (>28,000 events, cumulative Mw 5.1) and the 2011–2015 Sendai–Okura swarm in NE Japan.
Global compilation of published catalogs for natural swarms, injection-induced seismicity, LFEs, VLFEs, secondary slip fronts (SSFs), and slow slip events (SSEs).
Stochastic cellular automaton simulations of 10^5 non-re-rupturing random walkers on a 2D square lattice.

sum: This paper presents the supplementary material and digital archive for a 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines, Italy, integrating geological, geophysical, and petrophysical constraints. The dataset, hosted on Zenodo, is organized into six thematic Supplementary Notes (SN1-SN6). It includes the original 3D P-wave velocity tomography dataset from Magnoni et al. (2022) and a resampled 3D Vp model interpolated onto a regular 5 km x 5 km x 1 km grid down to 50 km depth. This open-access archive facilitates model reproducibility, independent verification, and future geodynamic or seismic hazard studies in the region.

sum: This study investigates the 6-month postseismic deformation following the 2024 Mw 7.5 Noto Peninsula earthquake in central Japan using 3D GEONET GNSS time series from 173 stations. Using the spectral-element code VISCO2.5D for viscoelastic relaxation and simulated annealing inversion with STATIC1D Green's functions for afterslip, the authors systematically evaluate mantle viscosity, vertical-to-horizontal data weighting, and fault geometry. Neither mechanism alone explains the observations; viscoelastic relaxation dominates far-field and near-field vertical signals, while afterslip governs near-field horizontal motions. The preferred model features a 30-km elastic layer over a Burgers asthenosphere with transient and steady-state viscosities of 4.0×10^17 and 4.0×10^18 Pa·s, respectively, and a vertical weighting of 0.9. Afterslip concentrates northeast of the coseismic rupture on a southeast-dipping fault, decaying within 6 months and releasing ~8% additional moment (Mw 6.81). Novel comparison with JMA aftershocks shows temporal correlation with afterslip decay, but spatial correlation with total cumulative slip.
本研究利用日本173个GEONET GNSS台站的6个月三维位移时间序列，研究了2024年Mw 7.5能登半岛地震的震后形变机制。结合谱元程序VISCO2.5D正演粘弹性松弛与模拟退火算法反演震后余滑，系统评估了地幔粘度、垂向数据权重和断层几何的影响。结果表明单一机制无法解释观测：粘弹性松弛主导远场……

t: Forward viscoelastic relaxation modeling via spectral-element code VISCO2.5D is combined with simulated annealing inversion of residual 3D GNSS velocities for fault afterslip using STATIC1D Green's functions, optimizing mantle viscosity and vertical weighting via grid search.
利用VISCO2.5D正演粘弹性松弛，结合STATIC1D格林函数和模拟退火反演余滑，通过网格搜索优化地幔粘度和垂向权重…

Six months of postseismic 3-component daily position time series from 173 GEONET GNSS stations within 250 km of the 2024 Noto earthquake, corrected for common-mode error using 160 far-field stations, plus JMA aftershock catalog data.
震中250 km内173个GEONET台站震后6个月的日均三分量GNSS时间序列（经160个远场站共模误差改正）及JMA…

Optimal model has Maxwell viscosity 4.0×10^18 Pa·s, Kelvin viscosity 4.0×10^17 Pa·s, and vertical weight 0.9, yielding 6-month average RMSEs of 5.4, 5.2, and 12.4 mm/yr (E, N, U) and cumulative afterslip moment Mw 6.81 (~8% of coseismic).

The model assumes a 1D viscoelastic structure, planar faults, and kinematically uncoupled afterslip and relaxation, while omitting poroelastic rebound and 3D lateral viscosity variations.

Systematically evaluates mantle viscosity, vertical-to-horizontal GNSS weighting, and multi-fault geometry in a unified framework, and first compares 6-month spatiotemporal afterslip evolution with on-fault aftershock activity for the 2024 Noto event.
在统一框架下系统评估粘度、垂向权重和断层几何，并首次对比了2024年能登地震余滑与断层余震的6个月时空演化关系。

kc: Demonstrated that integrating viscoelastic relaxation and afterslip is necessary to jointly fit near- and far-field horizontal and vertical postseismic GNSS velocities after the 2024 Mw 7.5 Noto earthquake.
Constrained the regional 1D Burgers rheology beneath central Japan to a 30-km elastic layer over an asthenosphere with Kelvin and Maxwell viscosities of ~4.0×10^17 and ~4.0×10^18 Pa·s.
Revealed that on-fault aftershock density spatially correlates with total cumulative slip (coseismic + afterslip) rather than afterslip alone, while temporally tracking afterslip moment decay.
证明了必须结合粘弹性松弛和震后余滑才能同时拟合2024年能登Mw 7.5地震近场和远场的水平及垂向GNSS速度场。
约束了日本中部下方的1D Burgers流变结构：30 km弹性层下伏瞬态和稳态粘度分别为~4.0×10^17和~4.0×10^18 Pa·s的软流圈。
揭示了断层上余震密度在空间上与总累积滑动（同震+余滑）对应，而在时间演化上与余滑矩释放衰减一致。

sum: This study investigates the relationship between fault permeability evolution and the frequency-magnitude distribution (b-value) of injection-induced seismicity under varying initial stress states. Through laboratory fluid injection experiments on smooth and rough faults with acoustic emission (AE) monitoring, the authors demonstrate that the initial stress state controls the failure mode and seismic response. Crucially, they find an inverse relationship between permeability increments and b-value changes. Based on these observations, they develop a permeability model using the Gutenberg-Richter law and maximum likelihood estimation. This model successfully inverts observed seismicity to track permeability evolution, providing a novel tool to illuminate coupled seismic-hydrological processes in reservoirs.
本文研究了不同初始应力状态下，流体注入诱发地震的震级-频度分布（b值）与断层渗透率演化之间的关系。通过对光滑和粗糙断层进行流体注入及声发射（AE）监测实验，发现初始应力状态控制着断层失稳模式。研究表明，渗透率增量与b值变化呈反比。据此，研究者结合Gutenberg-Richter关系和极大似然估计构……

sum: Following 50 years of subsidence, Askja caldera in Iceland began uplifting rapidly in July 2021. To characterize the subsurface plumbing system and the physical properties of the intruded magma and host mush, the authors jointly inverted GNSS, Sentinel-1 InSAR, and campaign microgravity data from 2022 to 2023. They implemented point and finite pressurized ellipsoidal cavity models (pECMg and fECMg) within a Bayesian inversion framework (GBIS). The results indicate a mass increase of 8.14 × 10^10 kg and a pressure increase of 2.7 MPa within an ellipsoidal mush zone extending from ~0.4 to 4.6 km depth. While a fundamental trade-off between intrusion density and host-mush compressibility prevents uniquely determining magma density from geophysics alone, incorporating petrological density constraints (2290–2890 kg/m^3) yields a bulk mush compressibility of (0.7–1.2) × 10^-10 Pa^-1, confirming a crystal-rich basaltic mush.

sum: Identifying concealed faults in sediment-covered basins is challenging when surface ruptures are absent, as seen in the 2023 Jishishan M6.2 earthquake. This study integrates post-earthquake soil-gas geochemical surveys (measuring Rn, Hg, H2, and CO2 across two profiles) with microtremor surface-wave imaging, shallow seismic reflection, and aftershock relocation to constrain the concealed seismogenic structure. Quantile-quantile plots identified two prominent high-value gas-anomaly segments per profile. Asymmetric anomaly distributions—broader on the western side—combined with 2D S-wave velocity profiles and seismic reflection horizons indicate a NNW-striking, west-dipping concealed reverse fault zone. Notably, Hg and H2 anomalies coincide more closely with the principal fault zone than Rn and CO2, suggesting preferential migration along permeable principal fault pathways. Subsequent fixed-site monitoring showed decreased Rn and H2 levels after one year, highlighting transient post-seismic degassing and demonstrating the value of combining geochemistry with geophysics for concealed fault detection.

sum: Hydrocarbon production and steam-injection enhanced oil recovery (EOR) can alter subsurface stresses and reactivate faults. This study introduces a multi-temporal InSAR framework to assess fault reactivation by analyzing right–left vertical deformation asymmetry across mapped fault traces. Using RADARSAT-2 (2010–2020) and TerraSAR-X (2020–2023) Persistent Scatterer InSAR (PS-InSAR) time series over the Qarn Alam Field in Oman, the authors combine cumulative and incremental differential deformation metrics, Z-score anomaly detection, and a composite reactivation index. Results reveal persistent, localized right–left deformation asymmetry (~4 mm/yr offset rate, 98.19% incremental reactivation index) along a Natih fault segment within a subsidence-dominated zone, indicating sustained fault-controlled motion. Conversely, Shuaiba fault segments in uplift-dominated zones show diffuse strain partitioning rather than discrete slip despite high statistical asymmetry scores. The novelty lies in integrating spatial localization and temporal persistence of cross-fault InSAR differences into an objective, scalable reactivation scoring system for low-seismicity reservoirs.
