sum: Recovering subsurface P-wave velocity and acoustic impedance simultaneously with calibrated uncertainties is a major challenge in exploration geophysics. This paper introduces a multi-parameter simulation-based inference framework using an Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM) conditioned on two complementary Common Image Gathers (CIGs): the Inverse Scattering Imaging Condition (ISIC) CIG, which captures short-wavelength reflectivity amplitude, and the anti-ISIC CIG, which captures kinematic velocity errors. A lightweight summary UNet compresses the 102-channel CIG volume before conditioning the diffusion network. To prevent the network from trivially mapping velocity to impedance via Gardner's relation, training labels are decoupled by lightly smoothing velocity targets while keeping raw sharp impedance targets. Evaluated on the synthetic Compass benchmark, the model achieves a velocity SSIM of 0.967 (RMSE 0.050 km/s) and impedance SSIM of 0.867 (RMSE 0.279 km/s·g/cm³), with physical accuracy validated via improved CIG migration focusing.

The method targets multi-parameter seismic velocity and impedance building by conditioning on extended Born Reverse Time Migration Common Image Gathers.

ev.notes: Full 8-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, experimental setup on Compass benchmark, 11 figures, and conclusions.

sum: Following the Moon-forming giant impact, Earth rotated rapidly with a day length of 2.3 to 5 hours, making it substantially oblate. Using the HERCULES planetary structure code coupled with canonical and high-angular-momentum lunar tidal evolution models, this study investigates how Earth's evolving rotation affected primary crust formation and early tectonics. Lower effective gravity at the equator caused the primary crust to be up to tenfold thicker at the equator than at the poles. As the Moon tidally receded and Earth's rotation slowed, the planet became more spherical, driving polar crustal extension and equatorial convergence at rates comparable to modern plate boundaries or the Himalayan collision. This previously neglected despinning mechanism could have triggered burial and secondary melting of hydrated surface material to form early felsic rocks, mantle outgassing, and eclogite-driven lower crustal delamination that seeded early geochemical mantle heterogeneities.
月球形成大撞击后的早期地球自转极快且呈明显扁球体。本研究结合HERCULES行星结构程序与月球潮汐演化模型，量化了地球自转减慢对原始地壳形成和早期构造的影响。结果显示，赤道处较低的有效重力使原始地壳厚度可达两极的十倍。随着月球退行和地球自转减慢，地球趋于球形，引起两极地壳伸展和赤道汇聚，形变速率堪比……

t: Combined HERCULES potential-field equilibrium planetary structure calculations (forsterite mantle, iron core) with canonical and high-angular-momentum lunar tidal evolution models to compute surface gravity, pressure, and local surface strain rates.
结合HERCULES行星平衡结构计算与月球潮汐演化模型，计算早期地球表面重力、压力及地壳局部应变率。

Simulated Earth-mass planetary structures with core mass fraction 0.323 using ANEOS equations of state, paired with analytical tidal trajectories and numerical orbital simulations from Cuk et al. (2021) and Rufu & Canup (2020).
基于ANEOS状态方程的地球质量数值模型，以及解析与数值月球潮汐轨道演化模拟数据。
Equatorial surface gravity was as low as ~4 m/s^2, causing up to tenfold thicker equatorial crust; subsequent despinning drove >100% area changes and convergence exceeding ~60 mm/yr for tens of Myr.
赤道重力低至~4 m/s²使地壳厚达两极十倍；自转减慢驱动超100%面积变化及超60 mm/yr的汇聚速率。
Assumes negligible crustal strength following an equipotential with local strain accommodation, and relies on uncoupled thermal solidification and tidal evolution timescales.
假设地壳强度可忽略且局部调节应变，未完全耦合岩浆洋热凝固与潮汐演化模型。
First study to quantify early Earth's rotational shape change during lunar recession and its role in primary crustal thickness heterogeneity, early tectonics, and felsic crust generation.
首次量化月球退行期地球自转形状变化对原始地壳厚度不均、早期构造及长英质岩石形成的作用。

kc: Demonstrated that lower equatorial effective gravity on a rapidly rotating early Earth produced a primary crust up to ten times thicker at the equator than at the poles.
Quantified surface deformation rates during lunar tidal recession, showing polar extension and equatorial compression comparable to modern tectonic rates for millions to tens of millions of years.
Proposed a novel rotational despinning mechanism for generating early felsic magmas via burial of hydrated crust and seeding early mantle heterogeneities via pressure-induced eclogite delamination.
证明了快速自转的早期地球赤道有效重力较低，导致赤道原始地壳厚度可达两极的十倍。
量化了月球潮汐退行期间的地表形变速率，表明两极伸展和赤道压缩速率在数百万至数千万年间堪比现代板块构造速率。
提出了一种由自转减慢驱动的新机制，通过水化地壳深埋熔融产生早期长英质岩浆，并通过压力升高诱导榴辉岩拆沉形成早期地幔不均一性。
me: Equilibrium planetary structure modeling across angular momentum steps (0.1 to 3.0 L_EM) using the open-source concentric-layer potential field code HERCULES v1.0 with ANEOS equations of state for forsterite mantle and iron core.
Analytical canonical lunar tidal evolution modeling with constant, linearly increasing, and exponentially increasing tidal dissipation (k2/Q) parameters.

Evaluation of high-angular-momentum tidal evolution trajectories incorporating Laplace plane instability and evection resonance limit cycles to compute latitudinal and longitudinal surface strain rates.
使用开源同心层位场程序HERCULES v1.0及镁橄榄石地幔与纯铁核的ANEOS状态方程，计算不同角动量步长下的平衡行星结构。
建立解析的标准月球潮汐演化模型，测试恒定、线性增加和指数增加的潮汐耗散参数（k2/Q）。
利用包含拉普拉斯平面不稳定性和出差共振极限环的高角动量潮汐演化轨迹，计算纬向与经向地表应变率。
de: Simulated isentropic Hadean Earth models (mantle potential temperature ~1900 K, core fraction 0.323) spanning angular momenta from 0.18 to 3.0 L_EM.
Tidal orbital evolution simulation outputs from Cuk et al. (2021) for high-obliquity Laplace plane instability and Rufu & Canup (2020) for evection resonance limit cycles.
模拟了跨越0.18至3.0 L_EM角动量的等熵冥古宙地球模型（地幔潜温约1900 K，地核质量分数0.323）。
采用Cuk等（2021）的高倾角拉普拉斯平面不稳定性以及Rufu和Canup（2020）的出差共振极限环潮汐轨道演化模拟数据。
li: Assumes zero crustal yield strength so the surface strictly follows a gravitational equipotential and accommodates strain purely locally.
Uncoupled thermal and tidal models create uncertainty in the exact relative timing between magma ocean solidification and rapid lunar orbital recession.
Lacks 3D geodynamic mantle convection modeling on a deforming oblate domain to resolve exact fault localization and tectonic regime.
假设地壳屈服强度可忽略不计，地表严格遵循重力等位面且形变完全在局部调节。
热演化与潮汐演化未完全耦合，导致岩浆洋凝固与月球快速退行之间的相对时间存在不确定性。
缺乏在变形扁球体域上的三维地球动力学地幔对流模拟，无法精确解析断层局部化和具体构造体制。

tm.why: The paper models early Earth's crustal thickness, deformation rates, delamination, and mantle heterogeneity driven by rotational shape changes.
It combines planetary structure modeling (HERCULES) and lunar tidal evolution to study post-Moon-forming impact Earth-Moon system dynamics.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 48-page manuscript PDF including main text, 11 main figures, and Appendices A and B with 4 appendix figures.

sum: To clarify how dynamic stressing weakens gouge-filled faults, this study investigates the hydromechanical response of artificial fractures filled with quartz sand at varied water contents (0% to 23.63%) using an aluminum split Hopkinson pressure bar (SHPB) system. Analytical models based on the propagator matrix method for purely elastic (PEM), Kelvin viscoelastic (KVM), and Maxwell viscoelastic (MVM) behaviors were compared against recorded waveforms and stress-strain curves. Experimental results show significant compression during loading and negligible rebound during unloading—a 'trapped-unloading' behavior with unloading modulus an order of magnitude higher than loading modulus. The MVM best captures both transmitted/reflected waveforms and stress-strain hysteresis. As water content increases, fracture stiffness, viscosity, and transmission coefficients first decrease (minimum at 9.45%) and then increase. The trapped-unloading effect implies that excess pore pressure generated during seismic wave passage cannot rapidly dissipate, reducing effective normal stress and promoting dynamic fault weakening.
为阐明动应力致断层泥弱化的水力力学机制，本研究利用铝合金分离式霍普金森压杆（SHPB）系统，对不同含水率（0%~23.63%）石英砂人工充填裂隙进行了动态冲击实验，并结合传播矩阵法对比了纯弹性（PEM）、开尔文粘弹性（KVM）和麦克斯韦粘弹性（MVM）解析模型。结果表明，充填裂隙在加载期发生显著压缩……

t: The authors sandwich water-bearing quartz sand between 7075 aluminum bars in an SHPB system and forward-fit recorded waveforms using frequency-domain propagator matrix analytical models for Purely Elastic, Kelvin, and Maxwell viscoelastic fracture boundary conditions.
采用铝合金SHPB系统冲击不同含水率石英砂夹层，结合传播矩阵法正演拟合纯弹性、开尔文和麦克斯韦粘弹性模型。

Dynamic impact tests were conducted on 2.5-mm thick compacted quartz sand layers (0.015–0.3 mm grain size) across six gravimetric water contents (0% to 23.63%) using 0.16 MPa gas gun pressure, recording strain waves at 20 MHz.
对6种含水率（0%~23.63%）、厚2.5毫米的压实石英砂层进行0.16 MPa气压冲击，以20 MHz采集入射、反射…

Filled fractures show a trapped-unloading response with unloading moduli ~10 times higher than loading moduli. Stiffness, viscosity, and transmission coefficients reach a minimum at 9.45% water content. The Maxwell model best predicts both reflected and transmitted waves (R² > 0.89).
裂隙呈卸载闭锁响应，卸载模量比加载高约一个数量级；刚度、粘度和透射率在9.45%含水率时最小；MVM拟合精度最高。
Pore pressure was not directly measured due to microsecond loading durations; the confining aluminum sleeve affects stiffness and drainage; initial tectonic stress and shear loading were omitted.
未能直接测量微秒级孔隙水压；铝合金约束套筒影响刚度与排水；忽略了初始构造应力和剪切加载。

Identifies the 'trapped-unloading' phenomenon in dynamically stressed wet granular fractures and resolves prior ambiguity by proving the Maxwell viscoelastic model—unlike Kelvin or elastic models—captures both wave reflection and unloading hysteresis.
揭示了充填裂隙动态“卸载闭锁”现象，证实仅麦克斯韦模型能同时表征反射波形与卸载应力松弛，澄清了模型争议。

kc: Demonstrated experimentally that granular filled fractures exhibit a 'trapped-unloading' response under dynamic stressing, with unloading moduli roughly an order of magnitude higher than loading moduli.

Proved that the Maxwell viscoelastic model (MVM) accurately characterizes both stress wave propagation (transmission and reflection) and dynamic stress-strain hysteresis, outperforming purely elastic and Kelvin models.
Quantified the non-monotonic effect of infill water content (0% to 23.63%), showing that stiffness, viscosity, and wave transmission reach a minimum at 9.45% water content before increasing.
Proposed a mechanistic inference linking stress relaxation and trapped unloading to undissipated excess pore pressure and dynamic fault weakening.
实验证明颗粒充填裂隙在动应力下表现出“卸载闭锁”响应，卸载模量比加载模量高约一个数量级。
证明麦克斯韦粘弹性模型（MVM）能准确表征应力波传播（透射与反射）及动态应力-应变滞回特性，优于纯弹性和开尔文模型。
量化了充填物含水率（0%~23.63%）的非单调影响，表明刚度、粘滞系数和波透射系数在9.45%含水率处达到最小值而后回升。
提出了将应力松弛和卸载闭锁与超孔隙水压难消散及断层动态弱化相联系的力学推论。
me: Dynamic impact testing using a 50-mm diameter 7075 aluminum alloy split Hopkinson pressure bar (SHPB) system with a confining sleeve.
One-dimensional stress wave theory to derive dynamic stress and strain histories within the 2.5-mm thick granular fracture infill.
Frequency-domain analytical wave propagation modeling using the propagator matrix method (PMM) with displacement discontinuity boundary conditions for PEM, KVM, and MVM.
利用带约束套筒的50毫米直径7075铝合金分离式霍普金森压杆（SHPB）系统进行动态冲击测试。
基于一维应力波理论推导2.5毫米厚颗粒充填裂隙内的动态应力与应变时程。
结合位移不连续边界条件与传播矩阵法（PMM），建立PEM、KVM和MVM的频域解析波传播模型进行正演拟合。
de: SHPB impact experiments on quartz sand infills (grain size 0.015–0.3 mm, thickness ~2.5 mm) at six gravimetric water contents: 0%, 4.73%, 9.45%, 14.18%, 18.90%, and 23.63% (saturated).
Incident, reflected, and transmitted strain gauge waveforms recorded at 20 MHz under a fixed gas gun pressure of 0.16 MPa (producing ~9 MPa, ~300 μs incident pulses).
对6种质量含水率（0%、4.73%、9.45%、14.18%、18.90%和23.63%饱和状态）的石英砂充填物（粒径0.015~0.3毫米，厚度约2.5毫米）进行SHPB冲击实验。
在0.16 MPa固定气压（产生约9 MPa、300微秒的入射脉冲）下，以20 MHz采样率记录入射、反射和透射应变波形。
li: Pore water pressure could not be directly measured during the ~300 μs impact duration due to frequency response limits of conventional sensors; pore pressure behavior is inferred.
An aluminum sleeve was required for lateral confinement, which influences measured stiffness and pore-pressure dissipation.
The experiments only considered 1D normal compression and ignored initial tectonic shear stress and loading rate effects.
受常规传感器频率响应限制，无法在数百微秒冲击过程中直接测量孔隙水压，水压演化基于力学推论。
为维持一维压缩而采用的铝合金侧向约束套筒对实测刚度和孔隙水压消散有一定影响。
实验仅考虑了一维法向动态压缩，忽略了初始构造剪应力状态及地质材料的加载速率效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates the hydromechanical weakening mechanism of gouge-filled faults under dynamic stressing using laboratory split Hopkinson pressure bar experiments.
The study models and measures stress wave transmission, reflection, and attenuation across viscoelastic filled fractures.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF examined, including main text, equations, 3 tables, 12 main figures, and Appendix A (Figure A1 and propagator matrix derivations).

sum: The Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model relies on fixed empirical kernel functions that may not capture complex triggering behaviors. This study introduces the Spatio-Temporal Neural Kernel Function (ST-NKF) model, which preserves the interpretable Hawkes process decomposition of ETAS while replacing the productivity, temporal, and spatial kernels with three fully connected neural networks. By constraining network weights to be non-negative and learning cumulative distribution functions via automatic differentiation, ST-NKF avoids numerical integration. Evaluated across seven California earthquake catalogs from the EarthquakeNPP benchmark, ST-NKF achieves marginal temporal and conditional spatial log-likelihoods comparable to limited-history ETAS and outperforms other neural point process baselines in spatial modeling. This represents the first neural point process to match spatiotemporal ETAS. Additionally, the authors show that exact epicentral overlaps in raw catalogs artificially inflate neural spatial likelihoods, recommending random location perturbations within error bounds for robust evaluation.
针对传统ETAS模型固定经验核函数灵活性不足的问题，本文提出了时空神经核函数（ST-NKF）模型。该模型保留了霍克斯过程的可解释分解结构，利用三个全连接神经网络直接从地震目录中学习生产力、时间和空间触发核，并通过非负权重约束与自动微分求取概率密度以避免积分计算。基于加州EarthquakeNPP基准……

t: ST-NKF replaces the ETAS productivity, temporal, and isotropic spatial kernels with three constrained FCNNs that learn cumulative distribution functions and derive probability density functions via automatic differentiation.
用三个受约束的FCNN替代ETAS生产力、时间和空间核，学习累积分布并通过自动微分导出概率密度函数。

Seven preprocessed California earthquake catalogs (1971–2021) from the EarthquakeNPP benchmark (SCEDC, ComCat, QTM Salton Sea/San Jacinto, WHITE), with [-0.5, 0.5] km uniform noise added to overlapping epicenters.
采用EarthquakeNPP基准的7个加州地震目录（1971–2021），并对重合震中添加[-0.5, 0.5] km…

ST-NKF and limited-history ETAS achieve nearly identical total, marginal temporal, and conditional spatial log-likelihoods across all seven catalogs, while ST-NKF outperforms existing NPP baselines in spatial likelihood.
ST-NKF与ETAS在7个目录上的时间和空间对数似然高度一致，且空间似然显著优于其他神经点过程基线。

Embedding flexible neural kernels within a linear Hawkes process still restricts the model from capturing non-linear triggering interactions, spatially varying propagation, or anisotropic fault structures.
受限于线性霍克斯自激框架与各向同性假设，难以捕捉非线性触发交互及空间各向异性特征。
First neural point process model to match spatiotemporal ETAS performance while retaining full kernel interpretability, alongside uncovering catalog overlap artifacts in neural spatial evaluations.
首次实现与时空ETAS性能相当的可解释神经点过程建模，并揭示了震中重叠伪影对评估的影响。

kc: Proposes ST-NKF, replacing ETAS productivity, temporal, and spatial empirical kernels with three constrained fully connected neural networks while maintaining Hawkes process interpretability.
Demonstrates for the first time that a neural point process model can match the spatiotemporal log-likelihood performance of the standard ETAS model on California benchmark catalogs.

Identifies that exact earthquake location overlaps in raw catalogs cause neural spatial kernels to overfit and artificially inflate spatial log-likelihoods, proposing random perturbation within uncertainty bounds as a remedy.
提出了ST-NKF模型，在保持霍克斯过程物理可解释性的同时，用三个受约束的全连接神经网络替代ETAS的生产力、时间和空间经验核函数。
首次证明神经点过程模型在加州基准地震目录上的时空对数似然性能可与标准ETAS模型相媲美。
发现原始地震目录中完全重叠的震中位置会导致神经空间核过拟合从而虚高空间似然得分，并提出在误差范围内添加随机扰动的解决方案。
me: Factorized Hawkes conditional intensity with constant background rate and three FCNNs (5 layers, 32 neurons) parameterizing productivity, temporal CDF, and isotropic radial spatial CDF.
Non-negative network weights, zero bias terms, and tanh/softplus activations with automatic differentiation to obtain valid, normalized probability density functions without numerical integration.
Out-of-sample evaluation via exact decomposition of total log-likelihood into marginal temporal log-likelihood and conditional spatial log-likelihood.
采用分解式霍克斯条件强度函数，结合常数背景率与三个全连接神经网络（5层32神经元）分别参数化生产力、时间累积分布函数和各向同性径向空间累积分布函数。
采用非负网络权重、无偏置项及tanh/softplus激活函数，利用自动微分直接导出有效的概率密度函数，避免数值积分。
将总对数似然精确分解为边缘时间对数似然和条件空间对数似然进行样本外预测性能评估。
de: Evaluated on seven California earthquake catalogs (1971–2021) from the EarthquakeNPP benchmark: ComCat, SCEDC (Mc 2.0, 2.5, 3.0), QTM Salton Sea, QTM San Jacinto, and WHITE.
Chronological split into auxiliary, training, validation, and testing sets, adding uniform random spatial noise in [-0.5, 0.5] km to co-located events to prevent numerical singularities.
Detailed functional comparison against limited-history ETAS on SCEDC_20 and sensitivity analysis on raw versus perturbed catalogs.
在EarthquakeNPP基准的7个加州地震目录（1971–2021，含ComCat、SCEDC、Salton Sea、San Jacinto和WHITE）上进行评估。
按时间顺序划分为辅助集、训练集、验证集和测试集，并对坐标完全重合的事件添加[-0.5, 0.5] km的均匀随机噪声以消除数值奇异性。
在SCEDC_20数据集上与有限历史ETAS进行详细核函数对比，并在原始与扰动目录上进行位置重叠敏感性分析。
li: Assumes a spatially uniform, stationary background seismicity rate and an isotropic radial spatial triggering kernel.
Neglects spatial boundary corrections over the finite observation window when computing the likelihood compensator.
Productivity function saturates above M 4.2 due to sparse high-magnitude training events, and linear Hawkes assumptions restrict non-linear triggering interactions.
假设背景地震活动率在空间上均匀且平稳，且空间触发核采用各向同性径向假设。
计算似然补偿项时忽略了有限观测区域的空间边界校正。
受限于大震样本稀缺，震级大于4.2时生产力函数趋于平缓，且线性霍克斯框架限制了非线性触发交互的表达。

tm.why: The paper develops a spatio-temporal neural kernel function (ST-NKF) model using three fully connected neural networks to learn earthquake triggering components directly from catalogs.
The study models spatiotemporal earthquake clustering directly on curated California earthquake catalogs (EarthquakeNPP benchmark) and analyzes the impact of catalog location overlap artifacts.
The primary goal of extending the Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) point process framework is operational earthquake and aftershock forecasting.

ev.notes: Full 14-page article PDF analyzed, including mathematical formulations, experimental results on 7 California catalogs, 4 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Following the 2004 Sumatra-Andaman earthquake, the ~200 km Mentawai seismic gap offshore Sumatra remains unruptured since 1797. This study presents an updated interseismic coupling model along the Sunda megathrust by inverting continuous and campaign GNSS velocities alongside coral microatoll paleogeodetic vertical rates. Novelty lies in combining updated Sumatran Fault slip rates, Wharton Basin oceanic lithosphere internal deformation, earthquake slip vector azimuths, and non-negative shear stress-rate constraints to account for updip stress shadows. Results show a strongly coupled patch from Siberut to the Pagai Islands extending to the trench updip of Siberut and the 2007 Mw 8.4 rupture, separated by a low-coupling zone offshore Sipora that correlates with structural and bathymetric anomalies. The updip Siberut region has accumulated >11 m of slip deficit since 1797, and the greater Mentawai segment retains moment accumulation equivalent to a Mw ~8.8–8.9 earthquake, indicating persistent high seismic and tsunami hazards.
针对自1797年以来未发生大地震的苏门答腊明打威地震空区，本研究结合连续与流动GNSS速度场及珊瑚微环礁古大地测量垂直形变率，反演了巽他大型逆冲断层的震间耦合分布。研究创新性地综合了苏门答腊断层最新滑动速率、沃顿海盆大洋岩石圈内部形变、地震滑动矢量方向以及考虑倾向浅部应力影区的非负剪切应力率约束。结……

t: Elastic backslip inversion on a Slab2 triangular mesh using corrected GNSS and coral vertical rates, implementing a non-negativity constraint on shear stress-rate to model kinematic coupling in updip stress shadows.
利用改正后的GNSS和珊瑚垂直形变率在Slab2网格上进行带非负剪切应力率约束的弹性回滑反演。
24 continuousSuGAr GNSS velocities, 31 campaign GNSS velocities from Bock et al. (2003) and Lubis et al. (2024b), and 43 coral microatoll paleogeodetic vertical deformation rates.
24个连续GNSS站点、31个流动GNSS站点速度以及43个珊瑚微环礁古大地测量垂直升降速率。

Strong coupling extends from Siberut to the Pagai Islands and reaches the trench updip of Siberut (>11 m slip deficit since 1797), leaving a net moment accumulation equivalent to a Mw ~8.8–8.9 earthquake.
西比路至巴盖群岛强耦合延伸至海沟（累积>11米亏损），全段净矩累积相当于Mw 8.8–8.9地震。

Offshore resolution drops significantly south of South Pagai and near the trench due to lacking seafloor observations, and elastic models neglect viscoelastic deformation and potential slow slip transients.
缺乏海底观测导致远海和南巴盖以南分辨率低，且弹性模型忽略了粘弹性效应与慢滑移干扰。
Integrates updated Sumatran Fault slip rates, internal Wharton Basin deformation, and physical stress-rate constraints into Mentawai megathrust coupling inversions.
首次在明打威耦合反演中综合了苏门答腊断层新滑移率、沃顿海盆内部形变与非负应力率约束。

kc: Developed an updated interseismic coupling model for the Mentawai segment accounting for rigid forearc sliver motion, Wharton Basin deformation, and stress constraints.

sum: This study presents GFAST-NZ, an implementation of the Geodetic First Approximation of Size and Time (G-FAST) algorithm for rapid earthquake characterization in New Zealand. Utilizing continuous GNSS data from the GeoNet network, GFAST-NZ estimates moment magnitude, moment tensor solutions, fault geometry, and slip distribution without the saturation issues of seismic velocity records. The algorithm's performance is evaluated using one historic earthquake and two synthetic scenarios representing major events on the Hikurangi subduction zone and the Alpine fault. While GFAST-NZ successfully characterizes subduction zone events, significant uncertainties remain for the Alpine fault due to sparse station coverage and complex segmentation. The study highlights the value of real-time geodesy for rapid hazard assessment while emphasizing the need for multi-data integration.

sum: The paper presents an automated, data-driven workflow and open-source Python package to optimize seismic station deployment. By integrating recency-weighted seismicity, network geometry, and contextual layers (such as cumulative saltwater disposal volumes), the method calculates grid-based metrics including near-field event coverage and azimuthal-gap improvement. A user-weighted composite index and unsupervised k-means clustering are then used to identify and prioritize high-impact regions for new stations. The workflow was applied to the Midland Basin, Texas, using 2017–2025 TexNet data, successfully identifying four priority regions. This highly transferable framework allows researchers to substitute contextual layers with other spatial data (e.g., fault proximity, GNSS deformation), making it widely applicable for diverse seismic monitoring networks.

sum: This study evaluates the sensitivity of DAS and geophone attributes (amplitude, phase, frequency) to a thin CO2 plume using numerical wave propagation simulations. The authors implement an efficient viscoelastic wave solver based on the spectral element method with memory variables within the GEOS platform to model vertical seismic profile (VSP) acquisitions. Quantitative comparisons of noise-free synthetic VSP records reveal that DAS vertical normal strain exhibits comparable sensitivity to geophone vertical velocity. The primary upgoing waves and PS-converted waves provide distinct footprints of the CO2 plume, though achieving high numerical resolution for S-waves remains challenging. This work highlights the potential of DAS for CCUS monitoring.

sum: This study revisits Holocene marine terraces (MTs) along the Cape Kidnappers coast, New Zealand, to untangle the sources of coseismic coastal uplift above the weakly coupled central Hikurangi subduction margin. By remapping MTs and adding 65 new radiocarbon ages, the authors identify three distinct paleoearthquakes (EQ1: ~6.1 ka, EQ2: ~4.6 ka, EQ3: ~2.0–1.7 ka cal. B.P.). The lack of temporal correlation with subsiding sites in inner Hawke Bay, combined with correlations with uplifted MT sites to the northeast, suggests that these earthquakes originated from upper-plate faults (Waimārama and Kidnappers faults) rather than the subduction interface. Estimated magnitudes range from Mw 6.8 to 7.8 depending on single or multi-fault rupture scenarios. The long interevent times (1.1–3.3 kyr) indicate relatively low recurrence rates for these upper-plate faults, providing crucial constraints for regional seismic and tsunami hazard assessments.

sum: Standard triggered seismicity models like ETAS sum contributions of all past earthquakes into an aggregate conditional intensity, obscuring whether a forecast is driven by a single recent mainshock or many older, diffuse events. This paper introduces the finite-horizon triggering core size N_{p,T}(t), defined as the minimum number of past earthquakes accounting for a fraction p of expected direct triggering over [t, t+T], alongside inverse-participation and entropy-based effective population sizes. Using continuum approximations, exact marked-Poisson representations, cluster generating functionals, and exact Hawkes/ETAS simulations (plus an illustration on the 2016–2017 Central Italy catalog), the authors prove that finite-horizon Omori cores scale as (1-p)^{-1/θ} with a random total-weight amplitude, whereas exponential memory grows logarithmically. They also distinguish annealed, calendar-time occupation, and event-time Palm distributions, showing that Omori memory drives continuous weight redistribution and rank crossings between arrivals. This provides a mathematical diagnostic for forecast attribution, persistence, and uncertainty sensitivity.
传统ETAS模型将历史地震贡献累加为总预测率，无法区分单一近期强震主导与多次旧震弥散主导的状态。本文提出有限时域触发核心规模Np,T(t)及有效群体规模指标，定义为在未来[t,t+T]内贡献比例p预期直接触发所需的最少历史地震数。结合解析推导、标记泊松基准、精确Hawkes/ETAS模拟及意大利中部……

t: Defines finite-horizon triggering weight per past earthquake as expected direct offspring over [t, t+T], ranking weights to find the minimal event count N_{p,T}(t) capturing fraction p of total endogenous potential, complemented by Hill effective numbers.
计算历史地震在未来[t,t+T]内的预期直接余震权重并排序，定义累积占比达p的最少事件数Np,T(t)及有效群体规模。

Exact Poisson-cluster simulations of stationary and transient Hawkes/ETAS catalogs across varied branching ratios, Omori exponents, and horizons, plus 1,298 Mw ≥ 3 events from the 2016–2017 Central Italy CAT5 machine-learning catalog.
不同分支比、Omori指数与时域的精确泊松簇合成目录，以及2016–2017意大利中部CAT5目录的1298个Mw≥3地…

Finite-horizon Omori triggering cores scale as (1-p)^{-1/θ} with random amplitude A_T W_T^{-1/θ} (median empirical-to-theory ratios 0.944–0.998), whereas exponential kernels scale as (λ/ω)log[1/(1-p)] and preserve weight ranks between arrivals.
Omori触发核心按(1-p)^(-1/θ)幂律增长且中位理论比达0.944–0.998；指数核呈对数增长且事件间排序不…

N_{p,T}(t) measures only expected direct offspring rather than full multi-generation cascades, and real-catalog estimates are vulnerable to short-term aftershock incompleteness and unpropagated parameter uncertainties.
仅统计直接余震而非全部多代后代，且实际目录评估易受震后目录不完备性与参数不确定性影响。
Introduces the finite-horizon triggering core observable N_{p,T}(t) that remains integrable for all Omori exponents θ > 0 and separates expected seismicity rate from source concentration.
提出对所有θ>0均适定的有限时域触发核心规模Np,T(t)，将预测地震率与触发源集中度解耦。

kc: Defines the finite-horizon triggering core size N_{p,T}(t) and complementary Hill effective population sizes (N_IPR, N_H), ensuring mathematical integrability for all Omori exponents θ > 0 including the long-memory regime 0 < θ ≤ 1.

Derives continuum mean-field benchmarks, exact marked-Poisson annealed distributions via Laplace transforms, and high-p asymptotic scaling laws ((1-p)^{-1/θ} for Omori vs. logarithmic for exponential memory).
Formulates the joint probability-generating/Laplace functional for thresholded counts and weights in self-exciting Hawkes/ETAS clusters via a nonlinear Volterra equation.
Separates annealed, calendar-time occupation, and event-time Palm sampling laws, proving that event-time bias is a persistent Palm effect rather than ergodicity breaking.

Demonstrates continuous weight relaxation and deterministic rank crossings between earthquake arrivals under Omori memory, plus an illustrative application to the 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia CAT5 catalog.
定义了有限时域触发核心规模Np,T(t)及互补的有效群体规模指标（NIPR、NH），保证了所有Omori指数θ>0（含0<θ≤1长记忆区间）的可积性。
推导了连续介质平均场基准、基于拉普拉斯变换的精确标记泊松退火分布，以及高p渐近标度律（Omori核为(1-p)^(-1/θ)，指数核为对数增长）。
通过非线性Volterra方程建立了自激励Hawkes/ETAS簇中阈值计数与权重的联合概率生成/拉普拉斯泛函。
严格区分了退火分布、日历时间占据分布与事件时间Palm分布，证明事件时间采样偏差属于固有Palm效应而非遍历性破缺。
揭示了Omori记忆下地震间隔期的权重连续弛豫与确定性排序交叉现象，并在2016–2017年意大利中部CAT5地震目录上进行了验证。
me: Mathematical definition of ranked eventwise direct-offspring triggering weights over a finite future horizon [t, t+T] and cumulative share thresholding.
Continuum mean-field thresholding and exact marked-Poisson point-process mapping using conditional Laplace transforms and generalized Dickman/Poisson-Dirichlet laws.
Hawkes-Oakes branching cluster representation and nonlinear Volterra integral equations for joint generating/Laplace functionals.
Exact Poisson-cluster Monte Carlo simulations of stationary and transient Hawkes/ETAS catalogs with cancellation-safe tail integrals and remote prehistory corrections.
构建未来有限时域[t, t+T]内单事件预期直接余震触发权重的排序与累积份额阈值定义。
利用条件拉普拉斯变换及广义Dickman/Poisson-Dirichlet分布，推导连续介质平均场阈值与精确标记泊松点过程映射。
基于Hawkes-Oakes分支簇表示，建立联合生成/拉普拉斯泛函的非线性Volterra积分方程。
开展稳态与瞬态Hawkes/ETAS目录的精确泊松簇蒙特卡洛模拟，结合防抵消尾积分与远古历史解析修正。
de: Synthetic temporal Hawkes and ETAS catalogs generated via exact Poisson-cluster simulation across varying branching ratios (n = 0.4, 0.7, 0.9), Omori exponents (θ = 0.35 to 1.5), Pareto fertility exponents (γ = 1.5, 1.8, 2, 3), and forecast horizons (T = 0.3 to 300).
Occupation and Palm sampling experiments using 600 independent histories and 12 length-4096 catalogs per configuration at fixed stationary rate λ = 0.8.
Transient condensation and no-new-arrivals counterfactual numerical experiments following context-scaled mainshock insertions.
Illustrative real-catalog evaluation on 1,298 Mw ≥ 3 earthquakes from the 354.6-day 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia (Central Italy) CAT5 machine-learning catalog.
通过精确泊松簇模拟生成的合成时间Hawkes与ETAS地震目录，涵盖不同分支比(n=0.4,0.7,0.9)、Omori指数(θ=0.35至1.5)、Pareto生产力指数及预测时域(T=0.3至300)。
在固定稳态率λ=0.8下，利用600个独立历史及每个配置12个长度为4096的目录开展日历占据律与Palm采样实验。
主震插入后的瞬态凝聚实验及无新事件到达的反事实数值对照实验。
基于2016–2017年意大利中部Amatrice–Visso–Norcia序列CAT5机器学习目录（354.6天内1298个Mw≥3事件）的实际序列演示计算。
li: The high-p random-amplitude scaling law is proven analytically for the independent marked-Poisson benchmark, while its extension to self-exciting Hawkes/ETAS histories is established only numerically due to cross-threshold coupling.
Critical whole-line constructions at branching ratio n = 1 require separate existence and ergodicity analyses not covered by the subcritical stationary framework.

N_{p,T}(t) attributes only expected direct offspring over [t, t+T] rather than all multi-generation descendants, and real-catalog evaluations are sensitive to post-mainshock catalog incompleteness and parameter uncertainties.
高p随机振幅标度律仅在独立标记泊松基准下给出了严格解析证明，在自激励Hawkes/ETAS历史下的推广因跨阈值耦合目前仅获数值证实。
分支比n=1的临界全时间轴构造需要独立的存在性与遍历性分析，不在本文亚临界稳态框架范围内。
Np,T(t)仅统计[t,t+T]内的预期直接后代而非所有多代级联后代，且实际目录评估易受大震后目录不完备性及参数不确定性的显著影响。

tm.why: The paper develops theoretical and statistical observables for earthquake catalogs using Hawkes and ETAS point-process models to quantify how future triggering is distributed across past cataloged events.
The framework directly targets earthquake forecasting diagnostics, attribution, persistence, and sensitivity to catalog and parameter uncertainties in operational ETAS seismicity forecasts.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF (including Appendices A–D, Table 1, Figures 1–12, and Figure B1) was read and analyzed.

sum: Recent studies challenged whether the pressure-induced viscosity minimum in basaltic melts—crucial for asthenospheric melt mobility—is real or an experimental artifact. Using density functional theory (SCAN meta-GGA) combined with neural network potentials (DeePMD-kit), the authors perform microsecond-scale equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations on model basalt (Di64An36) with 1–3% statistical uncertainty. Along a 2073 K isotherm, viscosity exhibits a robust U-shaped dependence, dropping ~20% to a minimum at ~3 GPa before rising. Maxwell relaxation and coordination lifetime analyses reveal this anomaly arises not from static Si/Al coordination numbers or elastic softening, but from rapid stress relaxation by transient Al–O coordination environments while Si–O motifs remain rigid. Incorporating an Arrhenius viscosity parameterization into a two-phase Darcy flow model along an oceanic geotherm shows melt mobility peaks near 150 km depth and drops sharply during ascent, explaining melt depletion at the asthenosphere base and melt ponding beneath the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary.
针对玄武质熔体高压粘度极小值是否为实验假象的争议，本研究结合SCAN泛函密度泛函理论与深度势能神经网络，对Di64An36模型玄武岩开展了微秒级平衡分子动力学模拟，将Green-Kubo粘度统计误差控制在1–3%。结果表明，2073 K等温线下熔体粘度在~3 GPa处出现约20%的稳健极小值；微观动……

t: SCAN-trained neural network potentials drive equilibrium LAMMPS MD simulations (150–600 independent 5-ns trajectories per state), computing shear viscosity via Green–Kubo integration and the time decomposition method.
利用SCAN泛函训练神经网络势驱动LAMMPS模拟，结合Green-Kubo公式与时间分解法计算剪切粘度。
Extensive NNP-MD trajectories on a 976-atom Di64An36 model basalt system from 0 to 6 GPa along a 2073 K isotherm and liquidus path, totaling ≥7.5 microseconds of sampling per path.
对976原子Di64An36玄武岩体系在0–6 GPa下沿2073 K等温线和液相线开展模拟，每条路径采样≥7.5微秒。
Along the 2073 K isotherm, viscosity drops from 0.1080 Pa s at 0 GPa to 0.0879 Pa s at 3 GPa before rising to 0.1035 Pa s at 6 GPa, driven by Al–O coordination relaxation.
2073 K等温粘度从0 GPa的0.1080 Pa s降至3 GPa的0.0879 Pa s，随后在6 GPa升至0.…
Simulations use a simplified Fe/Na-free Di64An36 composition with H2O as sole volatile, and Darcy velocity estimates neglect porosity evolution, compaction gradients, and reaction-driven channeling.
采用不含铁钠的简化Di64An36组分与单一H2O挥发分，且达西流计算忽略了压实和通道化效应。

Extends ab initio accuracy MD simulations to microsecond timescales (1–3% viscosity precision), resolving the low-P basalt viscosity minimum and linking it to transient Al coordination lifetimes rather than static structure.
将第一性原理精度模拟扩展至微秒尺度（误差1–3%），证实低压粘度极小值并揭示铝配位动态弛豫机制。

kc: Resolves the basaltic melt viscosity controversy with 1–3% precision using SCAN-based machine learning potentials and microsecond-scale Green–Kubo MD simulations, confirming an isothermal viscosity minimum (~20% drop) at ~3 GPa.

Identifies the microscopic mechanism of the viscosity minimum as accelerated structural relaxation governed by rapidly reconfiguring Al–O coordination species rather than static coordination populations or Si–O polyhedra.

Demonstrates through Darcy two-phase flow modeling that asthenospheric melt mobility peaks near 150 km depth due to P–T competition along the geotherm, driving deep extraction and shallow stagnation beneath the LAB.
利用基于SCAN泛函的机器学习势函数和微秒级Green-Kubo分子动力学模拟，以1–3%的高精度证实玄武质熔体在~3 GPa存在约20%的等温粘度极小值。
揭示了粘度极小值的微观物理机制：由快速重组的Al–O配位基团主导结构弛豫加速，而非静态配位数变化或Si–O多面体软化。
通过达西两相流模型证明沿地温线的温压竞争使软流圈熔体迁移率在~150 km深度达到峰值，导致深部熔体高效抽提并在岩石圈-软流圈边界下方滞留汇聚。
me: Machine-learning-accelerated molecular dynamics (NNP-MD) trained on SCAN meta-GGA DFT data using DeePMD-kit and DP-GEN active learning.
Green–Kubo shear viscosity calculation with the time decomposition method across large ensembles (150–600 trajectories of 5 ns each) to achieve 1–3% statistical uncertainty.
Intermittent coordination autocorrelation function with hysteresis buffer to compute Si–O and Al–O polyhedral lifetimes and compare against Maxwell relaxation times.
Two-phase Darcy flow melt segregation modeling along a 70-Myr oceanic geotherm using MAGEMin thermodynamic densities and an Arrhenius P–T–viscosity parameterization.
基于SCAN meta-GGA密度泛函理论数据，使用DeePMD-kit与DP-GEN主动学习构建神经网络势函数并开展分子动力学模拟。
采用Green-Kubo关系结合时间分解法，对150–600条5 ns独立轨迹进行系综平均，将剪切粘度统计误差降低至1–3%。
引入带迟滞缓冲区的间歇配位自相关函数计算Si–O和Al–O多面体寿命，并与Maxwell模型体弛豫时间进行对比。
结合MAGEMin热力学密度计算与Arrhenius温压粘度参数化方程，建立沿70 Myr大洋地温线的达西两相流熔体分离速度模型。
de: NNP-MD simulations of a 976-atom Di64An36 eutectic basalt system across 0–6 GPa and 1619–2223 K (isothermal 2073 K path and near-liquidus path), plus hydrous melts (0, 0.68, 1.35 wt% H2O).
Density benchmarking against 10 crystalline CMAS minerals and MAGEMin thermodynamic reference equations of state.
Comparison with published high-P–T viscometry experiments, magma equilibration depth histograms, and seismic discontinuity depths (LAB and ~150 km).
对包含976个原子的Di64An36共晶玄武岩体系在0–6 GPa和1619–2223 K（2073 K等温路径和近液相线路径）以及含水体系（0、0.68、1.35 wt% H2O）开展分子动力学模拟。
利用10种CMAS矿物晶体实验密度和MAGEMin热力学状态方程对势函数密度与压力进行基准校验。
与已发表的高温高压粘度实验数据、全球原生岩浆平衡深度统计及地震学不连续面深度（LAB及~150 km）进行对比。
li: Uses a simplified Fe- and Na-free model basalt composition (Di64An36) with H2O as the sole volatile, which limits full chemical and redox realism.
Melt segregation velocity calculations assume a fixed porosity, idealized grain-size profile, and permeability law, neglecting compaction, porosity evolution, and reaction-driven channeling.
采用不含铁和钠的简化Di64An36模型玄武岩组分且仅考虑H2O单一挥发分，限制了自然界复杂化学成分与氧化还原状态的真实性。
熔体分离速度计算假设孔隙度恒定并采用理想化的晶粒尺寸和渗透率模型，忽略了孔隙度演化、压实驱动压力梯度和反应驱动的通道化效应。

tm.why: The paper models basaltic melt viscosity and migration in the upper mantle to explain melt accumulation at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and asthenospheric seismic discontinuities.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page arXiv PDF manuscript including main text, equations, and Figures 1 and 2.

sum: Existing cryospheric reanalyses either treat water years independently (no pooling), which fails under sparse data, or calibrate static parameters across all years (complete pooling), ignoring inter-annual variability. This paper introduces 'climate-informed' cryospheric reanalysis via hierarchical Bayesian data assimilation with partial pooling. Using a tractable nested hybrid particle smoothing workflow—combining Multiple Adaptively Guided Particle-adjusted Iterative Ensemble Smoother (MAGPIES), expectation maximization (EM), Laplace approximation, and an amortized Adaptive Particle Batch Smoother (AdaPBS)—the method jointly infers daily state trajectories, annual parameters, and climatological hyperparameters. Tested across four snow sites and four glaciers from the Swiss Alps to Svalbard assimilating in situ snow water equivalent (SWE), MODIS fractional snow-covered area (FSCA), and glacier mass balance into a degree-day model, partial pooling yields a 51% overall improvement in Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) over the prior, outperforming no pooling (38%) and complete pooling (19%), while reducing computational cost by four orders of magnitude compared to...
现有冰冻圈再分析通常独立处理各水文年（无池化）或采用静态参数（完全池化）。本文提出基于部分池化的“气候知情”分层贝叶斯数据同化框架，结合MAGPIES、期望最大化（EM）、拉普拉斯近似与摊销自适应粒子批平滑器（AdaPBS），联合推断状态轨迹、年度参数和气候超参数。在阿尔卑斯山至斯瓦尔巴群岛的8个雪……

t: A nested hybrid particle smoothing workflow combining iterative ensemble Kalman-particle smoothing (MAGPIES), expectation maximization (EM), Laplace approximation, and adaptive importance sampling (AdaPBS) with particle recycling for hierarchical Bayesian partial pooling.
结合MAGPIES、期望最大化、拉普拉斯近似与粒子回收摊销AdaPBS的嵌套混合粒子平滑分层贝叶斯工作流。

Multi-decadal (1941–2024) in situ SWE, MODIS Snow_cci FSCA (2000–2023), and WGMS glacier-wide mass balance records across four snow sites and four glaciers from the Swiss Alps to Svalbard, forced by downscaled ERA5.
阿尔卑斯至斯瓦尔巴4个雪场和4个冰川的1941–2024现场SWE、MODIS积雪面积和冰川物质平衡及ERA5强迫。

Partial pooling achieves a 65% CRPS improvement in calibration, 36% in validation, and 51% overall relative to the hierarchical prior, outperforming no pooling (38%) and complete pooling (19%) while requiring ~10^4 vs 10^8 forward runs for PMCMC.
部分池化总体CRPS提升51%（率定期65%，验证期36%），优于无池化（38%）和完全池化（19%），计算量比PMCM…
Assumes stationary climatological hyperparameters over multi-decadal timescales and requires manual derivation of analytical gradients and Hessians for the particle EM optimization step.
假设气候超参数平稳，且粒子EM步骤需手动推导解析雅可比和海森矩阵。

Introduces hierarchical Bayesian partial pooling ('climate-informed' reanalysis) to cryospheric data assimilation, solved via a novel amortized nested particle smoother that recycles ensemble Kalman-particle generations.
首次将分层贝叶斯部分池化引入冰冻圈再分析，并提出高效粒子回收的嵌套平滑算法。

kc: Formulates 'climate-informed' cryospheric reanalysis using hierarchical Bayesian partial pooling to simultaneously capture inter-annual variability and learn background parameter climatology.
Develops a computationally tractable nested hybrid particle smoothing workflow (MAGPIES + EM + Laplace approximation + amortized AdaPBS) that recycles forward model evaluations.

Demonstrates a 51% overall CRPS improvement across multi-decadal snow and glacier experiments, outperforming no pooling (38%) and complete pooling (19%) at four orders of magnitude lower cost than PMCMC.
提出基于分层贝叶斯部分池化的“气候知情”冰冻圈再分析理论，同时捕捉年际变化并学习背景参数气候态。
开发了结合MAGPIES、期望最大化、拉普拉斯近似和摊销AdaPBS的嵌套混合粒子平滑工作流，通过粒子回收大幅减少正演模型运行次数。
在数十年的积雪和冰川同化实验中实现51%的总体CRPS提升，全面优于无池化（38%）和完全池化（19%），且计算成本比PMCMC低四个数量级。
me: Hierarchical Bayesian data assimilation with temporal partial pooling across water years.
Multiple Adaptively Guided Particle-adjusted Iterative Ensemble Smoother (MAGPIES) for inner-loop annual parameter and evidence estimation.
Particle Expectation Maximization (EM) with Levenberg-Marquardt optimization to find type-II MAP hyperparameter estimates and Hessian-based Laplace approximations.
Amortized Adaptive Particle Batch Smoother (AdaPBS) using Adaptive Multiple Importance Sampling (AMIS) and recycled MAGPIES particles for outer-loop hyperposterior inference.
Benchmarking against complete pooling, no pooling, type-II MAP plug-in approximation, and Particle Markov Chain Monte Carlo (PMCMC).
跨水文年时间部分池化的分层贝叶斯数据同化。
多重自适应引导粒子调整迭代集合平滑器（MAGPIES），用于内循环年度参数推断和证据（边缘似然）估计。
结合Levenberg-Marquardt优化的粒子期望最大化（EM）算法，用于求解II型最大后验（MAP）超参数点估计及拉普拉斯近似。
基于自适应多重重要性抽样（AMIS）和MAGPIES回收粒子的摊销自适应粒子批平滑器（AdaPBS），用于外循环超后验推断。
与完全池化、无池化、II型MAP插件近似以及粒子马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（PMCMC）基准进行对比评估。
de: Multi-decadal (1941–2024) in situ Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) records at four snow sites (Hornsund, Abisko, Filefjell, Weissfluhjoch).
Daily 0.01° MODIS Snow_cci Fractional Snow-Covered Area (FSCA) satellite retrievals (2000–2023) assimilated at the four snow sites and evaluated against independent in situ SWE.
Long-term (1941–2024) glacier-wide winter and annual mass balance records from WGMS at four glaciers (Austre Brøggerbreen, Storglaciären, Storbrean, Claridenfirn).
Topographically downscaled ERA5 hourly 2 m air temperature and total precipitation reanalysis data (1940–2024) driving a daily degree-day forward model.
四个积雪站点（Hornsund、Abisko、Filefjell、Weissfluhjoch）1941–2024年长达数十年的现场雪水当量（SWE）观测记录。
四个积雪站点2000–2023年每日0.01°分辨率的MODIS Snow_cci积雪面积比例（FSCA）卫星反演数据同化实验，并使用独立现场SWE数据进行验证。
四个冰川（Austre Brøggerbreen、Storglaciären、Storbrean、Claridenfirn）1941–2024年的WGMS冬季和年度全冰川物质平衡长期记录。
经地形降尺度的ERA5（1940–2024年）2米气温和总降水再分析气象强迫数据，用于驱动每日分辨率度日正演模型。
li: Assumes stationary climatological hyperparameters over multi-decadal periods, which may not fully hold under accelerated contemporary climate warming.
Requires manual derivation and coding of analytical Jacobian and Hessian matrices for the EM maximization step, complicating adaptation to complex multi-layer models.
Evaluates purely temporal ('1D') point/lumped data assimilation without explicitly modeling spatial correlations across grid cells.
假设数十年的气候超参数具有平稳性，在当前加速变暖的气候变化背景下可能存在偏差。
期望最大化（EM）步骤需要手动推导和编写解析雅可比向量与海森矩阵，较难直接迁移至高复杂度多层物理模型。
仅进行了纯时间维度（1D点尺度/集总式）的数据同化，未显式建模空间网格间的相关性。

tm.why: The paper develops a novel hierarchical Bayesian data assimilation framework using nested hybrid particle smoothers, expectation maximization, and Laplace approximations to quantify state, parameter, and hyperparameter uncertainties.
Cryospheric reanalysis is explicitly cast and solved as a dynamical Bayesian inverse problem to infer multi-level model parameters from sparse and noisy observations.

ev.notes: Full 80-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including main text, mathematical derivations, tables, figures, and appendices.

sum: A longstanding ~30% discrepancy exists between first-principles predictions and experimental measurements of the shear modulus of davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite), a major lower-mantle mineral linked to large low shear-velocity provinces (LLSVPs). Using million-atom molecular dynamics simulations driven by neuroevolution machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained on SCAN-DFT data, this study explicitly resolves grain-boundary (GB) networks in polycrystalline davemaoite at 50 GPa and 2,142 K. Results show that introducing 5.8 vol% nanoscale GB disorder—invisible to conventional x-ray diffraction—reduces the shear modulus by 37% and bulk modulus by 12%, lowering shear velocity by 19.3% and reconciling theory with experiments. Aggregate elastic properties follow Hashin-Shtrikman lower bounds governed by compliant GB networks. Combining this disorder-elasticity scaling with seismic velocity anomaly constraints from LLSVPs yields a minimum lower-mantle davemaoite grain size of ~100 nm, consistent with geodynamic grain-growth models and normal-mode attenuation observations.

sum: Resolving focal depths of low-frequency tremors (LFTs) is challenging due to emergent waveforms. This study relocates shallow LFTs in the Hyuga-nada region (Nankai Trough) using long-term broadband ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data from three periods (2015, 2017–2018, 2022–2023). By converting envelope cross-correlation differential times into station-based S-wave pseudo-arrival times via a reference-station approach, LFTs are located without a priori depth assumptions. A multistage procedure combines maximum-likelihood initial location (with Bayesian uncertainty screening) and 3-D double-difference relocation (tomoDD-SE) with jackknife error estimation. Of 19,824 target tremors, 519 well-constrained events are relocated with mean depth errors of ~0.74 km. Results show 73.2% of tremors occur at 7–13 km depth (mean 10.23 km), consistently shallower than fast earthquakes (14–20 km), and 95% lie within ±5 km of the plate boundary. Tremors correlate spatially with strong seismic reflectors (fluid-rich layers/diapirs) and the downdip flank of a subducted seamount.

sum: Understanding background deformation at dormant volcanoes is vital for hazard assessment. Using Sentinel-1 Persistent Scatterer InSAR time series from June 2015 to December 2020, this study detects persistent linear subsidence of up to 3.5 mm/yr on the eastern summit flank of Changbaishan volcano prior to its December 2020 seismic unrest, superimposed with ~25 mm seasonal oscillations. Bayesian Mogi inversion locates a compact deformation source at 2.7 ± 0.3 km depth. To establish a physical mechanism, the authors couple a layered poroelastic model (POEL) with H2O–CO2 equation-of-state (EOS) constraints and independent CO2 flux estimates (~4.2 × 10^5 t/yr). The novelty lies in quantitatively demonstrating that sustained H2O–CO2 mixture discharge and vapor–liquid separation drive poroelastic compaction, explaining the localized, linear subsidence without invoking deep magmatic cooling or viscoelastic relaxation.
