sum: On-site earthquake early warning (EEW) requires reliable uncertainty quantification from short initial P-wave windows. This study evaluates Split Conformal Prediction (Split CP) and Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) for single-station log10(PGA) prediction using 268,109 three-component K-NET strong-motion records partitioned by event. A CNN–Transformer processes 3-s component-normalized waveforms alongside three retained pre-normalization log-amplitude scales. Retaining amplitude information raises point R2 from 0.2950 to 0.6710 and reduces CQR interval width by 32.9% compared to a waveform-only ablation. At the 90% nominal level, CQR achieves 90.03% empirical coverage with narrower intervals and single-pass ~1.4 ms GPU latency compared to conservative, wider heteroscedastic Deep Ensemble and MC-Dropout baselines. While event-cluster bootstrap and resplits confirm marginal coverage stability, conditional coverage degrades for rare M >= 6 earthquakes and distant stations, making conformal intervals best suited as a screening layer rather than a standalone alert rule.
单台地震预警需从短初始P波窗获得可靠的不确定性估计。本研究利用按事件划分的268,109条日本K-NET三分量强震记录，评估了分裂保形预测（Split CP）与保形化分位数回归（CQR）对峰值地面加速度（PGA）的区间预测性能。研究提出保幅CNN–Transformer模型，融合3秒归一化波形与归一……

t: A two-branch CNN-Transformer takes 3-s component-normalized P-waveforms and pre-normalization log-amplitude scales to predict point and quantile log10(PGA), calibrated post-hoc via Split Conformal Prediction and Conformalized Quantile Regression.
双分支CNN–Transformer融合3秒归一化P波与对数振幅尺度，结合Split CP和CQR校准预测区间。

268,109 three-component strong-motion waveforms from 16,325 earthquakes (M 3.0-9.0, R <= 300 km) recorded by Japan's K-NET (2000-2025), partitioned into event-disjoint train, validation, calibration, and test splits.
日本K-NET台网16,325次地震的268,109条三分量强震记录，按事件无重叠划分为四部分。
Retaining amplitude scales raises point R2 from 0.2950 to 0.6710 and cuts CQR width by 32.9%; at 90% nominal level, CQR achieves 90.03% coverage and 0.7690 mean width in 1.416 ms.
保留振幅使R2从0.2950升至0.6710，CQR区间缩窄32.9%，在90%目标下达90.03%覆盖率。
Event-clustered station records violate exact record-level exchangeability, and conditional coverage drops to 75.02% (Split CP) and 86.78% (CQR) for rare M >= 6 earthquakes.
事件内记录聚类不满足严格可交换性，且M≥6大震下CQR覆盖率降至86.78%。
First evaluation of Split CP and CQR for continuous on-site PGA prediction from early P-waves using an amplitude-preserving CNN-Transformer on event-disjoint strong-motion records.
首次将保形预测与保幅CNN–Transformer结合用于单台早期P波连续PGA区间预测。

kc: Developed an amplitude-preserving on-site PGA prediction pipeline combining 3-s normalized P-waveforms with pre-normalization log-amplitude scales using CNN and CNN-Transformer architectures.
Benchmarked Split CP and CQR against raw quantile regression, heteroscedastic MC-Dropout, and Deep Ensembles on 268,109 event-disjoint K-NET records.
Evaluated empirical reliability under event clustering, magnitude/distance stratification, P-onset timing perturbations, threshold screening, and real-time inference latency.
开发了结合3秒归一化P波波形与归一化前对数振幅尺度的保幅单台PGA预测流程，并对比了CNN与CNN–Transformer架构。
在按事件划分的268,109条K-NET强震记录上，系统对比了Split CP、CQR与原始分位数回归、异方差MC-Dropout及深度集成基线。
全面评估了事件聚类、震级/距离分层、P波初至扰动、阈值超限筛查及实时推理延迟下的经验可靠性。
me: Two-branch CNN and CNN-Transformer deep learning models processing 3-s component-normalized waveforms (3x300) and standardized log-amplitude features.
Split Conformal Prediction (Split CP) calibrating absolute point-prediction residuals and Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) calibrating pinball-loss quantile exceedance scores.
Heteroscedastic Gaussian NLL Deep Ensemble (5 members) and MC-Dropout (50 passes) baselines combining aleatoric and epistemic variance.
Event-cluster bootstrap (5,000 replicates), 50 calibration-test event resplits, and magnitude-stratified Mondrian conformal calibration.
构建双分支CNN与CNN–Transformer模型，同时处理3秒分量归一化波形（3×300）与标准化对数振幅特征。
采用校准点预测绝对残差的分裂保形预测（Split CP）与校准分位数超越分数的保形化分位数回归（CQR）。
构建结合偶然与认知不确定性的异方差高斯负对数似然深度集成（5个成员）和MC-Dropout（50次前向传播）基线。
利用5000次事件聚类自助法、50次事件级重划分及按震级分层的Mondrian保形校准评估稳定性。
de: 268,109 three-component strong-motion records from 16,325 earthquakes (2000-2025, M 3.0-9.0, distance <= 300 km, PGA >= 0.5 Gal, SNR >= 5.0) from Japan's K-NET network.
Event-disjoint 50/10/20/20% split into training (134,600 records), validation (25,963), calibration (54,111), and testing (53,435).
Ablation experiments comparing amplitude-preserving input, waveform-only input, and global-RMS-scaled waveforms.
Onset-timing perturbation tests shifting the 3-s P-wave window by -0.3 to +0.3 s and threshold-exceedance screening at 25, 80, and 250 Gal.
采用日本K-NET台网2000–2025年间16,325次地震的268,109条三分量强震记录（M 3.0–9.0，震中距≤300 km，PGA≥0.5 Gal，信噪比≥5.0）。
开展输入表征消融实验，对比保幅双分支输入、纯归一化波形输入及全局RMS缩放波形。
进行P波初至时间扰动测试（-0.3至+0.3秒偏移）以及25、80和250 Gal阈值超限筛查实验。
li: Station records are clustered by earthquake, so exact record-level exchangeability is not established and event-conditional coverage is not guaranteed.
Coverage degrades significantly for scarce large earthquakes (M >= 6: 75.02% for Split CP, 86.78% for CQR) and long epicentral distances (200-300 km).
Evaluated on a single network (K-NET) using offline zero-phase filtering and full-record mean removal rather than causal streaming preprocessing.
Upper-bound threshold screening increases recall at the cost of high false-alarm rates (27.34% FAR at 25 Gal), preventing standalone alerting use.
台站记录按地震事件聚类，无法严格满足记录级可交换性假设，也不保证单次事件条件覆盖率。
稀缺大震（M≥6时Split CP为75.02%，CQR为86.78%）及远场（200–300 km）子集上的覆盖率明显下降。
仅在单一K-NET台网验证，且使用了非因果的零相位滤波和全记录去均值，尚未实现全因果实时流式预处理。
利用区间上界进行阈值筛查虽提高了召回率，但伴随较高的误报率（25 Gal下误报率达27.34%），不能作为独立警报规则。

tm.why: The paper predicts single-station peak ground acceleration (PGA) for on-site earthquake early warning using K-NET strong-motion records.
The authors employ CNN and CNN-Transformer architectures alongside deep ensembles and MC-Dropout to predict PGA from 3-s P-wave windows.
The study focuses on calibrated uncertainty quantification for PGA predictions using Split Conformal Prediction, Conformalized Quantile Regression, and Bayesian/ensemble baselines.

ev.notes: Full 33-page GJI manuscript PDF (including all text, equations, 7 figures, and 11 tables) was analyzed in detail.

sum: This study integrates seismic-reflection data, growth strata analysis, geomorphic surveys, OSL dating, and area-depth-strain analysis to reconstruct the structural evolution of the active Hutubi anticline in the northern Tian Shan. The anticline is a detachment fold above an 8–9 km-deep detachment, showing a marked acceleration in shortening (from ~0.06 to ~1.1 mm/yr) and uplift (from ~0.03 to ~1.3 mm/yr) since ~0.4 Ma. Coulomb stress modeling demonstrates that tectonic deformation drives secondary faults to their seismic triggering thresholds within a decade, controlling rupture nucleation and propagation. Combined with industrial perturbations from the Hutubi underground gas storage facility, these active faults pose a significant hazard for moderate-to-strong earthquakes (Mw 5.3–7.0). The findings highlight the necessity of incorporating tectonic deformation rates into seismic hazard assessments for active reservoir regions.
本研究整合反射地震、地貌调查与测年，重建了北天山呼图壁背斜的结构与演化。该背斜为深8-9 km的滑脱褶皱，约0.4 Ma以来缩短与抬升速率显著加速。库仑应力模拟表明，构造变形在十年内即可将次级断层推至触发阈值。结合储气库注采扰动，该区存在发生Mw 5.3-7.0地震的风险，强调了评估中引入构造变形速……

t: Integration of seismic-reflection interpretation, growth strata analysis, geomorphic surveys, OSL dating, and Coulomb stress modeling.
整合反射地震解释、生长地层分析、地貌调查、光释光测年及库仑应力数值模拟。
Seismic reflection profiles, geomorphic surface data, OSL dating samples, and historical relocated seismicity catalogs from the Hutubi anticline.
跨呼图壁背斜的反射地震剖面、地貌面测量、光释光测年样本及历史重定位地震目录。
Shortening and uplift rates accelerated to ~1.1 and ~1.3 mm/yr since ~0.4 Ma; tectonic stress drives secondary faults to triggering thresholds within a decade.
约0.4 Ma以来缩短与抬升速率分别加速至~1.1和~1.3 mm/yr；构造应力在十年内即可使次级断层达到触发阈值。
Simplified fault geometries and lack of direct in-situ pore pressure and stress measurements to constrain the Coulomb stress model.
库仑应力模拟中简化了断层几何结构，且缺乏直接的原位孔隙压力与应力测量约束。
Quantifying the late Quaternary deformation acceleration of the Hutubi anticline and linking tectonic stress loading with industrial injection-induced seismicity.
定量揭示了呼图壁背斜晚第四纪变形加速特征，并将构造应力加载与工业注采诱发地震联系起来。

kc: Reconstructed the structural geometry and growth history of the active Hutubi anticline.
Quantified a significant late Quaternary acceleration in shortening (~1.1 mm/yr) and uplift (~1.3 mm/yr) since ~0.4 Ma.
Modeled tectonic-driven Coulomb stress evolution to explain the nucleation and propagation of seismicity on secondary faults.
Highlighted the joint impact of tectonic loading and industrial gas injection/extraction on seismic hazard (potential Mw 5.3–7.0).
重建了活动呼图壁背斜的结构几何形态和生长历史。
定量揭示了自约0.4 Ma以来，晚第四纪缩短率（~1.1 mm/yr）和抬升率（~1.3 mm/yr）的显著加速。
模拟了构造驱动的库仑应力演化，解释了次级断层上地震的成核与传播。
强调了构造加载与工业注采扰动对地震危险性（潜在Mw 5.3-7.0地震）的共同影响。
me: Seismic-reflection interpretation and growth strata analysis.
Geomorphic surface survey and Optically Stimulated Luminescence (OSL) dating.
Area-depth-strain analysis for detachment fold reconstruction.
Coulomb stress evolution modeling on secondary faults.
反射地震解释与生长地层分析。
地貌面调查与光释光（OSL）测年。
用于滑脱褶皱重建的面积-深度-应变分析。
次级断层上的库仑应力演化模拟。
de: Seismic reflection profiles across the Hutubi anticline.
Geomorphic surface measurements and OSL dating samples.
Relocated seismicity catalog data from previous studies for model comparison.
横跨呼图壁背斜的反射地震剖面。
地貌面测量数据与光释光测年样本。
用于模型对比的前人研究中重定位地震目录数据。
li: Lack of direct, real-time in-situ stress and pore pressure measurements to calibrate the Coulomb stress model.
Simplified geometry of secondary faults used in the stress modeling.
缺乏直接、实时的原位应力和孔隙压力测量来校准库仑应力模型。
应力模拟中使用的次级断层几何结构较为简化。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the structure, shortening, and uplift history of the active Hutubi anticline in the northern Tian Shan.
It evaluates the potential for moderate-to-strong earthquakes (Mw 5.3-7.0) on secondary faults within the anticline.
It addresses the impact of gas injection and extraction at the Hutubi underground gas storage facility on fault stability.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the nucleation mechanism of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake using a 3D elastic-plastic finite-element model. By testing different fault geometries, the authors demonstrate that the depth-dependent curvature (listric geometry) of the Nurdağı splay fault causes nonlinear stress redistribution, lowering the instability threshold and promoting early nucleation compared to planar models. Calibrated against the ~6 m average coseismic slip, the listric model successfully reproduces slip distributions and hanging-wall subsidence patterns consistent with seismic and geodetic observations. The findings suggest that listric fault geometry provides a plausible mechanical explanation for splay fault rupture initiation in continental transform systems.
本研究利用三维弹塑性有限元模型，探讨了2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震的成核机制。结果表明，努尔达伊分支断层的深部变倾角（铲状）几何导致了应力非线性重分布，降低了失稳阈值，比平直断层更易促进早期成核。该铲状模型产生的位移分布和挂壁沉降模式与观测高度吻合，为分支断层破裂启动提供了合理的力学解释。

t: 3D elastic-plastic finite-element modeling of fault systems with planar and listric geometries.
基于三维弹塑性有限元方法，模拟不同断层几何下的应力演化。
Synthetic modeling calibrated with the ~6 m average coseismic slip and geodetic/seismic observations of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake.
使用2023年土耳其地震的同震位移及地表变形观测数据进行模型校准。
Listric geometry of the Nurdağı fault lowers the instability threshold, promoting earlier nucleation and matching observed slip and subsidence patterns.
铲状几何降低了分支断层失稳阈值，促进早期成核，且模拟结果更符合观测。
Simplified model that does not definitively prove the listric nature of the fault, omitting complex dynamic rupture processes.
模型进行了简化，且无法绝对证实该断层在实际中具有铲状几何。
First 3D finite-element study demonstrating how depth-dependent curvature of a splay fault mechanically controls earthquake nucleation in the 2023 Kahramanmaraş event.
首次阐明深部变倾角几何对分支断层地震成核与破裂启动的力学控制作用。

kc: Demonstrated that depth-dependent curvature (listric geometry) of splay faults lowers the instability threshold and promotes earthquake nucleation.
Provided a plausible mechanical explanation for the rupture initiation of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake on the Nurdağı splay fault.
Showed that listric fault models yield slip and subsidence patterns more consistent with geodetic and seismic observations than planar models.
证明了分支断层的深部变倾角（铲状）几何结构能够降低失稳阈值并促进地震成核。
为2023年Mw 7.8卡赫拉曼马拉什地震在努尔达伊分支断层上的破裂启动提供了合理的力学解释。
表明相比于平直断层模型，铲状断层模型产生的同震位移和沉降模式与大地测量及地震观测更一致。
me: 3D elastic-plastic finite-element modeling of the East Anatolian fault zone.
Comparison of planar versus listric (depth-dependent curvature) fault geometries.
Calibration of boundary conditions using observed coseismic slip (~6 m).
东安纳托利亚断裂带的三维弹塑性有限元数值模拟。
对比平直断层与铲状（深部变倾角）断层几何结构的影响。
利用观测到的约6米同震位移对边界条件进行校准。
de: Numerical simulations of stress redistribution and fault nucleation.
Comparison of simulated slip and hanging-wall subsidence with seismic and geodetic observations of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake.
应力重分布与断层成核过程的数值模拟。
将模拟的同震位移及挂壁沉降与2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震的地震学和大地测量观测数据进行对比。
li: The model is a simplified 3D elastic-plastic representation and may omit complex dynamic rupture effects or fluid pressure variations.
The results demonstrate mechanical plausibility but do not definitively prove that the Nurdağı fault is listric.
该模型是简化的三维弹塑性表示，可能忽略了复杂的动态破裂效应或流体压力变化。
研究结果仅证明了力学上的合理性，并不能绝对证实努尔达伊断层在实际中就是铲状的。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D finite-element modeling to investigate the nucleation and rupture initiation mechanisms of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake.
The study focuses on how splay fault geometry (listric vs. planar) and stress redistribution control fault instability and nucleation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and metadata from Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study reconstructs the complete tectonic evolution of the Mariana Trough by compiling basin-wide multibeam bathymetry, acoustic backscatter, shipboard vector magnetic anomalies, and satellite-derived gravity data. The authors subdivide the spreading axis into 18 second-order segments and identify 13 oceanic core complex-like structures. Forward and inverse magnetic modeling yields a 1-arc-minute seafloor age grid, showing rifting began around 8.5 Ma and seafloor spreading initiated at 6.3 Ma in the central basin. Residual mantle Bouguer anomalies indicate anomalously thick (~8–9 km) oceanic crust during the initial stage (6.3–4 Ma), attributed to slab-derived fluids near the volcanic arc. Between 4 and 3 Ma, the spreading direction rotated clockwise from NE-SW to nearly E-W. After 3 Ma, full spreading rates increased southward (25 to 45 km/Myr) with faster western half-rates, and Euler pole residuals demonstrate arc-parallel extension and non-rigid behavior of the Mariana Plate.
本研究汇编了覆盖整个马里亚纳海槽的多波束测深、声学背散射、船载三分量磁异常和卫星重力数据，重建了该弧后盆地的完整构造演化史。研究将扩张轴划分为18个二级段，识别出13个近似大洋核杂岩构造，并构建了1角分高分辨率洋底年龄网格。结果表明裂谷作用始于约8.5 Ma，海底扩张于6.3 Ma在盆地中部启动。残……

t: The authors invert vertical-component magnetic anomalies for equivalent magnetization and perform 2D across-axis forward modeling to build a 1-arc-minute seafloor age grid, which is then used to compute thermal gravity corrections (RMBA) and crustal thickness.
通过垂直分量磁异常等效磁化反演和二维正演构建1角分洋底年龄网格，进而计算热校正残余地幔布格重力异常（RMBA）和地壳厚度…

The compilation integrates 32 Japanese and 11 US multibeam bathymetry cruises gridded at 0.001° (~100 m), 12 backscatter cruises, 16 shipboard three-component magnetometer cruises, and 1-arc-minute satellite free-air gravity data across the entire Mariana Trough.
整合了覆盖整个马里亚纳海槽的43个航次100米分辨率多波束测深、12个航次背散射、16个航次船载三分量磁异常及1角分卫星…

Seafloor spreading initiated at 6.3 Ma in segment 8 forming ~8–9 km thick crust, rotated clockwise by up to 30° between 4 and 3 Ma, and subsequently spread asymmetrically at 25–45 km/Myr with non-rigid arc-parallel extension.
海底扩张于6.3 Ma在第8段启动并形成8–9 km厚洋壳，4–3 Ma间顺时针旋转达30°，3 Ma后以25–45 k…

Rifting initiation ages rely on unverified constant extension rate assumptions, eastern conjugate chrons are obscured by arc volcanism, and gravity-derived crustal thicknesses cannot fully capture localized near-axis thermal anomalies.
东缘老磁条带被火山覆盖，裂谷年龄依赖恒定伸展率假设，且重力地壳厚度模型难以捕捉轴部局部热异常。

Provides the first complete, basin-wide high-resolution seafloor age grid, off-axis crustal thickness map, and kinematic reconstruction of the entire Mariana Trough from rifting initiation to the present.
首次提供了覆盖整个马里亚纳海槽的高分辨率洋底年龄网格、离轴地壳厚度分布图以及从裂谷启动至今的完整运动学重建。

kc: Compiled basin-wide high-resolution bathymetry (100 m), backscatter, magnetic, and gravity datasets across the entire Mariana Trough, identifying 18 spreading segments and 13 oceanic core complex-like structures.

Constructed a 1-arc-minute seafloor age grid showing rifting initiated at ~8.5 Ma, seafloor spreading started at 6.3 Ma in the central basin, and spreading direction rotated clockwise by up to 30° between 4 and 3 Ma.

Demonstrated from residual mantle Bouguer anomalies that early-stage (6.3–4 Ma) oceanic crust was anomalously thick (~8–9 km) due to slab-derived fluids, and quantified post-3 Ma asymmetric spreading and non-rigid arc-parallel plate extension.
汇编了覆盖整个马里亚纳海槽的高分辨率测深（100米）、背散射、磁异常和重力数据集，划分出18个扩张段并识别出13个类大洋核杂岩构造。
构建了1角分分辨率的洋底年龄网格，揭示裂谷始于约8.5 Ma，海底扩张于6.3 Ma在中部启动，且扩张方向在4至3 Ma间顺时针旋转达30°。
利用残余地幔布格重力异常证明早期（6.3–4 Ma）洋壳因俯冲板片流体影响而异常增厚（约8–9 km），并量化了3 Ma以来的不对称扩张及平行岛弧的非刚性伸展。
me: Multibeam bathymetry and sonar backscatter compilation and gridding at 0.001° (~100 m) resolution using GMT6.
3D FFT inversion for equivalent seafloor magnetization and 2D across-axis forward modeling of vertical-component shipboard three-component magnetometer (STCM) profiles.
Mantle Bouguer anomaly (MBA) and residual MBA (RMBA) calculation using Parker's FFT method and a semi-infinite plate cooling model to invert for crustal thickness.
Euler vector estimation using the Euler Pole Calculator (EPC) and plate kinematic reconstruction in GPlates.
使用GMT6对多波束测深和声呐背散射数据进行汇编与0.001°（约100米）分辨率网格化。
基于船载三分量磁力仪（STCM）垂直分量剖面的三维FFT等效海底磁化强度反演与二维跨轴正演模拟。
结合Parker快速傅里叶变换方法与半无限板冷却模型计算地幔布格重力异常（MBA）和残余MBA（RMBA），进而反演地壳厚度。
利用欧拉极计算器（EPC）估算欧拉旋转矢量，并在GPlates中进行板块运动学重建。
de: Multibeam bathymetry from 32 Japanese cruises, 11 US cruises (NOAA), CCOM/JHC 100-m grids, GMRT, and GEBCO 2024.
Acoustic backscatter intensity compilations from 12 research cruises.
Shipboard three-component magnetometer (STCM) vector geomagnetic anomaly data from 16 cruises.
Satellite-derived 1-arc-minute free-air gravity anomaly grid (Sandwell et al., 2014) and published OBS seismic refraction profiles for comparison.
来自32个日本航次、11个美国NOAA航次、CCOM/JHC 100米网格、GMRT及GEBCO 2024的多波束测深数据。
来自12个科考航次的声学背散射强度数据汇编。
来自16个航次的船载三分量磁力仪（STCM）矢量地磁异常数据。
1角分卫星自由空气重力异常网格（Sandwell et al., 2014）以及用于对比的已发表OBS地震折射剖面。
li: Rifting-spreading boundaries and conjugate old magnetic chrons on the eastern basin margin cannot be identified due to thick sediment cover and overprinting by active arc volcanism.
Rifting initiation ages (~8.5 Ma) carry significant uncertainty because rifting extension rates were assumed equal to subsequent western half-spreading rates.
RMBA-derived crustal thickness estimates rely on a semi-infinite plate cooling model with uniform density assumptions, failing to capture localized thermal anomalies near the ridge axis.
由于巨厚沉积物覆盖及活动岛弧火山侵入改造，无法在盆地东缘识别裂谷-扩张边界及共轭的老磁异常条带。
裂谷启动年龄（约8.5 Ma）的估算假设裂谷伸展速率等于随后的西侧半扩张速率，因此存在较大不确定性。
基于RMBA的地壳厚度估算依赖均一密度假设和半无限板冷却模型，难以完全捕捉洋脊轴附近的局部热异常。

tm.why: The study reconstructs the full tectonic evolution, seafloor age, spreading kinematics, non-rigid plate deformation, and crustal thickness variations of the Mariana Trough back-arc basin.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF from Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth (Ono et al., 2026) analyzed in detail, including all text sections, Table 1, and Figures 1–14.

sum: Determining rate-and-state friction parameters for fine-grained fault gouge close to instability is challenging due to post-step oscillations and non-linear parameter sensitivity. This study develops a Bayesian inversion framework using Markov-chain Monte-Carlo (MCMC) sampling and a dynamic spring-slider model to invert stable velocity-step experiments on ultrafine (1.9 μm) quartz gouge. Crucially, sampling the characteristic slip distance (D_RS) in logarithmic space resolves high sensitivity at small D_RS values, outperforming conventional non-linear least-squares methods in both accuracy and uncertainty quantification. Applying the method to triaxial direct-shear experiments at 40 MPa effective normal stress under room-dry (0 MPa pore pressure) and wet (20 MPa pore pressure) conditions reveals that pressurized fluids increase parameters a, b, and D_RS by ~40% beyond Terzaghi's effective stress principle. Although long-term evolution of steady-state friction (a-b) introduces additional uncertainty, the fluid-induced parameter contrast remains robust across both slip and aging laws.
针对近失稳超细（1.9微米）石英断层泥在速度阶跃实验中表现出的振荡和强非线性敏感性，本文提出了一种结合动态弹簧-滑块模型与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样的贝叶斯反演框架。研究表明，在对数空间对特征滑移距离（D_RS）进行采样是实现精确反演的关键，其精度和不确定性量化均显著优于传统非线性最小二乘法……

t: A Bayesian MCMC inversion framework (using emcee) coupled with a single-degree-of-freedom dynamic spring-slider model infers rate-and-state parameters by sampling ln(a) and ln(D_RS) while constraining a-b and reference friction from steady-state windows.
结合单自由度动态弹簧-滑块模型与贝叶斯MCMC采样，通过约束a-b并对ln(a)和ln(D_RS)采样反演摩擦参数。

Triaxial direct-shear velocity-stepping experiments (0.3 to 3 μm/s) on 1.9-μm ultrafine quartz gouge (Min-U-Sil 5) at 40 MPa effective normal stress under room-dry (p=0 MPa) and pressurized deionized water (p=20 MPa) conditions.
在40 MPa有效正应力下，对1.9微米超细石英断层泥开展干燥（0 MPa）与加压水（20 MPa）三轴直剪速度阶跃实验…
Synthetic inversions recover parameters within 10% error. In experiments, pressurized pore fluids increase a, b, and D_RS by ~40% (e.g., slip law a from 0.0081 to 0.0113, D_RS from 2.28 to 3.13 μm).
合成反演误差小于10%；实验表明加压孔隙水使a、b和D_RS增加约40%（滑移律D_RS从2.28增至3.13微米）。
Inferred parameters depend on the assumed steady-state value of a-b because the localized shear layer evolves during slip, and physical mechanisms for fluid effects remain unclear.
断层泥随滑移持续演化使结果依赖于a-b的稳态假设值，且流体改变摩擦参数的物理机制尚待明确。

Demonstrates why logarithmic sampling of D_RS is critical near frictional instability, tests realistic 1.9-μm ultrafine quartz gouge, and reveals direct pore-fluid modification of rate-and-state parameters beyond effective stress.
阐明了近失稳下对数采样D_RS的物理机制，测试了真实超细断层泥并发现超越有效应力原理的流体效应。

kc: Developed a Bayesian MCMC inversion framework incorporating a dynamic spring-slider model with independently measured machine stiffness to infer rate-and-state parameters near instability.
Demonstrated that logarithmic sampling of characteristic slip D_RS is essential for accurate convergence and smaller uncertainty compared to standard uniform-sampling non-linear least squares.

Quantified rate-and-state parameters for realistic ultrafine (1.9 μm) quartz gouge, finding micron-scale D_RS values and ~40% higher a, b, and D_RS in the presence of pressurized pore water (20 MPa) at constant effective normal stress.
Evaluated uncertainty from long-term microstructural evolution of steady-state friction (a-b), showing transient evolution toward velocity-neutral/weakening behavior.
开发了结合动态弹簧-滑块模型和独立测定仪器刚度的贝叶斯MCMC反演框架，用于反演近失稳状态下的速率-状态摩擦参数。
证明了对特征滑移D_RS进行对数采样对于准确收敛至关重要，相比传统均匀采样非线性最小二乘法具有更高的精度和更小的不确定性。
测定了真实超细（1.9微米）石英断层泥的摩擦参数，发现微米级的D_RS值，且在相同有效正应力下，20 MPa加压孔隙水使a、b和D_RS增大约40%。
评估了稳态摩擦（a-b）长期演化带来的不确定性，揭示了剪切界面从轻微速度强化向速度中性/弱化演化的瞬态过程。
me: Single-degree-of-freedom dynamic spring-slider modeling with rate-and-state friction (both slip and aging laws) solved via a 4th-order implicit Runge-Kutta solver (Rodas4 in Julia).
Affine-invariant Markov-chain Monte-Carlo (MCMC) ensemble sampling (emcee) with logarithmic priors on a and D_RS, fixing a-b and reference friction from steady-state windows.
Analytical first-order estimation of initial MCMC starting points from peak direct-effect friction and post-peak exponential decay.
Moving-average detrending of long-term friction evolution and sensitivity testing across assumed values of steady-state parameter a-b.
Benchmarking against Levenberg-Marquardt (RSFit3000) and trust-region reflective non-linear least-squares minimizers with uniform versus logarithmic sampling.
建立包含速率-状态摩擦定律（滑移律和老化律）及惯性项的单自由度弹簧-滑块模型，使用Julia的Rodas4四阶隐式龙格-库塔求解器求解。
采用仿射不变马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）集成采样器（emcee），对a和D_RS施加对数均匀先验，并由稳态窗口约束a-b和参考摩擦系数。
利用直接效应峰值摩擦和峰后指数衰减解析推导MCMC采样的初始起始点。
采用滑动平均去除长期摩擦演化趋势，并针对不同稳态参数a-b假设开展敏感性测试。
与RSFit3000及信赖域反射非线性最小二乘优化算法进行对比，评估对数采样与均匀采样的收敛性能。
de: Triaxial direct-shear velocity-stepping experiments (0.3 to 3 μm/s) on ultrafine quartz gouge (Min-U-Sil 5, median grain diameter 1.9 μm, 1.3 mm thick) logged at 10 Hz.

Comparison of 'dry' (40 MPa confining stress, 0 MPa pore pressure, room humidity) and 'wet' (60 MPa confining stress, 20 MPa deionized water pore pressure) experiments at 40 MPa effective normal stress.
Synthetic spring-slider velocity-step datasets spanning a in [0.006, 0.015], D_RS in [1, 100] μm, and a-b in [-0.002, 0.002] with added Gaussian noise.
对超细石英断层泥（Min-U-Sil 5，中值粒径1.9微米，厚1.3毫米）开展三轴直剪速度阶跃实验（0.3至3微米/秒），采样率10 Hz。
在相同40 MPa有效正应力下对比“干燥”（40 MPa围压，0 MPa孔隙压）与“含水”（60 MPa围压，20 MPa去离子水孔隙压）实验。
生成涵盖不同a（0.006~0.015）、D_RS（1~100微米）和a-b（-0.002~0.002）范围并叠加高斯噪声的弹簧-滑块合成速度阶跃数据集。
li: Only stable velocity steps are inverted in this study; unstable stick-slip phases require dynamic inversions where inertia is critical (deferred to a follow-up paper).
Inversion results are sensitive to the assumed steady-state value of a-b and detrending window because the gouge microstructure evolves continuously with slip.
Analytical starting-point approximations for the aging law are strictly accurate only for small velocity jumps.
Physical mechanisms driving the ~40% increase in a, b, and D_RS under pore fluid pressure remain unresolved and require experiments across additional pore pressures.
本研究仅反演了稳定速度阶跃阶段，后续非稳定粘滑阶段的反演需在后续工作中考虑关键的惯性效应。
由于断层泥微结构随滑移持续演化，反演结果对去趋势处理和稳态参数a-b的假设值较为敏感。
老化律的MCMC初始点解析近似严格意义上仅适用于小幅度的速度阶跃。
加压孔隙流体导致摩擦参数a、b和D_RS增加约40%的具体物理机制尚不明确，需在更多孔隙压力下开展实验。

tm.why: The paper investigates rate-and-state friction parameters and stability transitions of simulated ultrafine quartz fault gouge under dry and pressurized pore-fluid conditions.
The authors develop a Markov-chain Monte-Carlo Bayesian inversion framework with logarithmic parameter sampling to estimate friction parameters and quantify their posterior uncertainties.
Accurate laboratory inference of rate-and-state frictional parameters under realistic grain sizes and fluid pressures directly informs physics-based earthquake source and rupture modeling.

ev.notes: Full 18-page manuscript PDF (including Appendix A and all 15 figures + 1 table) was read and analyzed.

sum: Imaging fossilized plumbing systems beneath ancient silicic large igneous provinces (SLIPs) is challenging due to thermal decay and sedimentary cover. This study presents the first 3D crustal isotropic shear-wave velocity and radial anisotropy models beneath the Neoproterozoic (~780–750 Ma) Malani SLIP and Cretaceous Barmer rift in northwestern India using ambient noise tomography. Rayleigh (Z–Z) and Love (T–T) wave group velocity dispersion curves (4–30 s) were extracted from 29 broadband stations via time-frequency phase-weighted stacking and inverted using continuous regionalization followed by transdimensional Markov chain Monte Carlo Bayesian inversion (BayHunter). The model reveals low upper-crustal velocities (2.8–3.1 km/s) delineating 4–6 km thick sediments in the Barmer rift. Strong positive radial anisotropy (up to +8%) in the mid-to-lower crust beneath the Siwana caldera and Barmer rift indicates horizontal mafic sill complexes, whereas cylindrical zones of negative anisotropy (down to -8%) mark vertical magma conduits later rejuvenated by Deccan-related magmatism.
本研究利用背景噪声层析成像首次构建了印度西北部新元古代Malani硅质大火成岩省（SLIP）及Barmer裂谷下方的三维地壳各向同性剪切波速度与径向各向异性模型。通过29个宽频带台站数据的时频相位加权叠加提取4–30 s瑞利波和勒夫波群速度频散曲线，结合连续区域化与跨维贝叶斯反演（BayHunter……

t: Two-step ambient noise tomography: continuous least-squares regionalization of Rayleigh and Love group velocities (4–30 s) onto a 0.1° grid, followed by 1D transdimensional McMC Bayesian inversion (BayHunter) for VSV, VSH, Voigt VS, and radial anisotropy.
两步法背景噪声成像：先对4–30 s群速度进行连续区域化，再用跨维McMC贝叶斯方法反演三维VSV、VSH及径向各向异性…
Continuous ambient seismic noise recorded from 2009 to 2018 at 29 broadband seismic stations deployed across a 225 km × 225 km region in northwestern India with ~50 km average inter-station spacing.
2009–2018年印度西北部225×225 km区域内29个宽频带地震台站（平均间距约50 km）的连续背景噪声记录。

Upper crustal low VS (2.8–3.1 km/s) maps 4–6 km thick Barmer rift sediments. Mid-to-lower crust shows +6% to +8% radial anisotropy (horizontal sills) beneath Siwana caldera and -6% to -8% cylindrical conduits.
浅部低速勾勒出4–6 km厚的Barmer裂谷沉积；中下地壳揭示+6%至+8%水平岩床及-6%至-8%的40 km宽垂直…
Posterior uncertainties increase at longer periods (25–30 s) and toward the periphery of the study region due to reduced ray-path coverage.
受射线路径减少影响，长周期（25–30 s）及研究区边缘的后验误差有所增大。
First 3D crustal isotropic shear velocity and radially anisotropic models beneath northwestern India, imaging the fossilized Neoproterozoic Malani SLIP magma plumbing system.
首次获得印度西北部三维地壳剪切波速度与径向各向异性模型，揭示新元古代SLIP古岩浆管道系统。

kc: First 3D crustal isotropic shear-wave velocity and radial anisotropy model beneath northwestern India covering the Neoproterozoic Malani SLIP and Cretaceous Barmer rift.

Identification of strong mid-to-lower crustal positive radial anisotropy (+6% to +8%) beneath the Siwana caldera and Barmer rift, interpreted as fossilized horizontal mafic sill complexes and magmatic underplating.

Delineation of ~40 km wide cylindrical zones of negative radial anisotropy (-6% to -8%) correlating with Malani outcrops and Cretaceous alkaline complexes, indicating vertical magma conduits rejuvenated by Deccan-related volcanism.
Geophysical validation that mantle-derived lower crustal mafic sills drove crustal partial melting to form shallow horizontally layered silicic reservoirs in an ancient SLIP.
首次构建了印度西北部新元古代Malani硅质大火成岩省（SLIP）和白垩纪Barmer裂谷下方的三维地壳各向同性剪切波速度和径向各向异性模型。
在Siwana破火山口和Barmer裂谷下方的中下地壳发现了强烈的正径向各向异性（+6%至+8%），解释为冻结的水平镁铁质岩床复合体和岩浆底辟。
圈定了直径约40公里的柱状负径向各向异性带（-6%至-8%），与Malani露头和白垩纪碱性杂岩体相对应，表明垂直岩浆通道在德干相关火山活动中复活。
提供了地球物理证据，证实地幔来源的下地壳镁铁质岩床诱发地壳部分熔融，从而在古老SLIP浅部地壳中形成水平层状硅质岩浆储层。
me: Time-frequency phase-weighted stacking (tf-PWS) of daily instantaneous phase cross-correlations for Z–Z (Rayleigh) and T–T (Love) components.
Fundamental-mode group velocity dispersion extraction (4–30 s) using frequency-time analysis (FTAN).
2D continuous regionalization with a Gaussian spatial covariance function (Lcorr = 25 km, 0.1° × 0.1° grid) to obtain local dispersion curves.

1D transdimensional Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) Bayesian inversion (BayHunter + SURF96) at each grid node (60 chains, 0.9M iterations each) to derive VSV, VSH, Voigt-averaged VS, and radial anisotropy ξ.
利用时频相位加权叠加（tf-PWS）对Z–Z（瑞利波）和T–T（勒夫波）分量的日瞬时相位互相关进行叠加。
使用频时分析（FTAN）提取4–30 s周期的基阶群速度频散曲线。
采用高斯空间协方差函数（相关长度25 km，网格0.1° × 0.1°）进行二维连续区域化，获取局部频散曲线。
在每个网格节点应用一维跨维马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（McMC）贝叶斯反演（BayHunter + SURF96，60条链，每条90万次迭代），计算VSV、VSH、Voigt平均VS和径向各向异性ξ。
de: Continuous ambient seismic noise recorded between 2009 and 2018 at 29 broadband seismic stations across a 225 km × 225 km array in Rajasthan, northwestern India (average spacing ~50 km).
Checkerboard resolution tests with 0.5° × 0.5° blocks (±6% amplitude) for both Rayleigh and Love waves from 4 s to 30 s.
Synthetic McMC depth inversion tests and Mineos forward modeling sensitivity tests demonstrating weak cross-term coupling (<0.5% dispersion variation for 2–8% velocity perturbation).
2009年至2018年间在印度西北部拉贾斯坦邦225 km × 225 km区域内29个宽频带地震台站记录的连续背景噪声数据（平均台间距约50 km）。
针对4 s至30 s周期的瑞利波和勒夫波开展0.5° × 0.5°网格（±6%扰动幅值）的检测板分辨率测试。
合成McMC深度反演测试及Mineos正演敏感性测试，证明交叉项耦合较弱（2–8%的速度扰动引起的频散变化小于0.5%）。
li: Ray-path coverage decreases at longer periods (25–30 s) and toward the periphery of the array, leading to higher posterior uncertainties (~0.1 km/s) at the study boundaries.
Relies solely on group velocity dispersion (4–30 s) without phase velocity or joint receiver function inversion, limiting resolution of sharp velocity discontinuities.
VSV and VSH are inverted independently rather than jointly, assuming negligible cross-term sensitivity and isotropic VP/VS scaling.
在长周期（25–30 s）及台阵边缘区域射线路径覆盖减少，导致研究区边缘的后验不确定性较高（约0.1 km/s）。
仅依赖群速度频散（4–30 s），未结合相速度或接收函数联合反演，对尖锐速度间断面的分辨率有限。
VSV与VSH采用独立反演而非联合反演，假设交叉项敏感性可忽略且采用各向同性VP/VS经验比例关系。

tm.why: The study uses time-frequency phase-weighted stacking of ambient noise cross-correlations from 29 broadband seismic stations to extract Rayleigh and Love wave group velocity dispersion curves.
The core objective is constructing a 3D crustal radial anisotropy model from VSV and VSH inversions to distinguish horizontal sill complexes (+8%) from vertical dyke/conduit structures (-8%).
The model images the fossilized crustal magma plumbing system beneath the Neoproterozoic Malani silicic large igneous province and the Cretaceous Barmer rift.

ev.notes: Full 20-page Scientific Reports Article-in-Press PDF analyzed, including all 10 figures, 1 table, equations, methodology, and references.

sum: Standard seismic source-type classification relies on single point-estimate moment tensors and deterministic rules, ignoring waveform inversion uncertainty. This study introduces a probabilistic classification framework operating directly on empirical posterior probability density functions p(v,w) mapped onto a uniform (v,w) source-type domain. Five canonical and calibrated source hypotheses (±ISO_CAL, DC, ±CLVD) are encoded as 2D isotropic Gaussian membership kernels, alongside a sixth flat residual kernel that captures diffuse or poorly fitted posteriors. Integrating p(v,w) against these kernels yields explicit hypothesis probabilities, complemented by Kullback-Leibler divergence and support mass ratio diagnostics. Applied to regional moment tensor posteriors for 32 events—including 23 underground nuclear explosions at NNSS and DPRK, plus nearby earthquakes and collapses—the method cleanly separates well-recorded shaft explosions (+ISO_CAL > 0.91) from collapses (–ISO_CAL) and tectonic earthquakes (DC/CLVD), while flagging sparse-network or complex-path events via elevated residual probabilities.
传统震源分类依赖单一最佳拟合矩张量，忽略了反演不确定性。本研究在均匀(v,w)震源类型域中构建经验后验概率密度函数p(v,w)，利用五个二维各向同性高斯核（校准的±ISO_CAL、DC、±CLVD）及第六个平坦残差核进行积分，计算各震源假设的概率、KL散度和支持质量比。应用于美国内华达和朝鲜丰溪里2……

t: Empirical moment tensor posteriors p(v,w) on the uniform (v,w) rectangle are integrated against five 2D isotropic Gaussian kernels (±ISO_CAL, DC, ±CLVD) and a sixth flat residual kernel to compute normalized source-type probabilities.
将均匀(v,w)域上的经验后验p(v,w)与五个二维高斯核及平坦残差核积分，计算震源类型归一化概率。
Regional full moment tensor posterior ensembles for 32 events: 17 NNSS and 6 DPRK underground nuclear explosions, 4 collapses, and 5 regional tectonic earthquakes.
32个事件的区域全矩张量后验集合：17次NNSS和6次朝鲜地下核试验、4次塌陷及5次区域构造地震。

Twelve well-recorded NNSS tests yield P(+ISO_CAL) of 0.91–0.98 with low residuals (0.02–0.05); collapses show P(–ISO_CAL) of 0.50–0.84; DPRK tests show 0.47–0.94 depending on yield, coverage, and polarity constraints.
12次NNSS核爆P(+ISO_CAL)达0.91–0.98且残差低(0.02–0.05)；塌陷P(–ISO_CAL)为…
Posteriors are evaluated at a fixed best-fitting magnitude, orientation is excluded from the probabilistic kernel framework, and kernel covariance is held isotropic and identical across hypotheses.
未考虑震级不确定性的传播，未联合纳入震源方向参数，且各假设共用固定的各向同性高斯协方差。
Replaces deterministic point-estimate moment tensor classification with posterior probability integration over calibrated Gaussian kernels and a residual misfit baseline in uniform (v,w) space.
利用均匀(v,w)空间中的校准高斯核积分与残差基线替代传统的单点矩张量确定性分类。

kc: Formulates seismic source-type classification directly from full moment tensor posterior distributions p(v,w) in a uniform parameterization rather than single point estimates.
Defines five Gaussian membership kernels centered on canonical (DC, ±CLVD) and empirically calibrated explosion/implosion (±ISO_CAL) points, plus a sixth baseline residual model.

Demonstrates clear probabilistic discrimination across 32 events (NNSS and DPRK nuclear tests, collapses, and regional tectonic earthquakes) and outlines integration into operational decision pipelines.
直接基于均匀参数化域中的全矩张量后验分布p(v,w)建立震源类型概率分类框架，替代单一最佳点估计。
定义了以标准点（DC、±CLVD）和经验校准爆炸/内爆点（±ISO_CAL）为中心的五个高斯隶属核，以及第六个残差基线模型。
在32个事件（美朝核试验、塌陷和区域构造地震）上验证了良好的概率区分能力，并提出了在监测决策流水线中的应用方案。
me: Mapping normalized moment tensor ensembles from the fundamental lune onto the uniform (v,w) rectangle corresponding to a homogeneous prior on S^5.
Encoding five source-type hypotheses (±ISO_CAL, DC, ±CLVD) as truncated, normalized 2D isotropic Gaussian kernels with widths set by a Rayleigh-type FWHM separation criterion.
Integrating empirical posteriors p(v,w) against hypothesis kernels and a flat footprint residual kernel K_res, evaluated alongside Kullback-Leibler divergence and support mass ratios.
将基本月牙图（lune）上的归一化矩张量集合映射到对应于S^5均匀先验的(v,w)矩形域。
采用瑞利型半高全宽（FWHM）分离准则设定宽度，将五种震源假设编码为截断并归一化的二维各向同性高斯核。
将经验后验p(v,w)与假设核及平坦残差核K_res进行积分以计算归一化概率，并结合KL散度和支持质量比进行评估。
de: Published regional full moment tensor posterior ensembles for 32 events from Alvizuri et al. (2018) and Alvizuri & Tape (2018).
17 underground nuclear explosions, 3 cavity/mine collapses, and 3 tectonic earthquakes in the Nevada National Security Site (NNSS) and western US region.

6 declared underground nuclear tests (2006–2017), 1 post-test collapse, and 2 regional earthquakes (Gyeongju and Pohang) in the Korean Peninsula, plus station/polarity subset sensitivity tests for the 2017 NK6 test.

li: The posterior distributions p(v,w) are computed at a fixed best-fitting magnitude, so magnitude uncertainty is not propagated into source-type space.
Classification operates over source type (eigenvalues) only, treating source orientation (strike, dip, rake) separately rather than jointly on S^5.
All hypotheses share a common, fixed isotropic Gaussian covariance Σ, without separating source process spread from network coverage and Earth model errors.
后验分布p(v,w)是在固定的最佳拟合震级下计算的，震级不确定性未传播到震源类型空间中。

tm.why: The paper develops a probabilistic framework for seismic source-type classification directly from full moment tensor posterior ensembles.
The study propagates posterior uncertainty from moment tensor waveform inversions into hypothesis classification probabilities, KL divergences, and residual diagnostics.
It frames seismic source classification as probabilistic inference over parameter space starting from a homogeneous prior on the 5-sphere and integrating empirical posterior PDFs.

sum: This study presents a comprehensive, multiparameter geochemical, geophysical, and geological monitoring record of over a year of episodic lava fountaining at Kīlauea's summit crater, Halemaʻumaʻu, starting in December 2024. By analyzing 54 fountaining episodes, the authors identified systematic correlations between fountaining events and summit inflation. This relationship allowed for unprecedented quantitative forecasting of fountaining onset. The findings provide critical constraints on the physical mechanisms driving episodic fountaining, including magma reservoir pressure, conduit permeability, and volatile exsolution, establishing Kīlauea as a key natural laboratory for global volcanic processes.
本研究利用现代地球化学、地球物理和地质监测手段，记录了基拉韦厄火山哈雷茂茂火山口自2024年12月开始的、持续一年多的54次周期性熔岩喷泉事件。观测揭示了熔岩喷泉与山顶膨胀之间的系统相关性，从而实现了前所未有的定量喷发预测。该研究为全球周期性熔岩喷泉的动力学机制（如岩浆房压力、通道渗透率和挥发分脱气……

sum: This study challenges the assumption that mechanically stored potential energy is irrelevant to long-term geological processes like metamorphism. Using time-resolved deformation experiments on crustal and mantle materials, the authors isolate changes in stored energy during metamorphic reactions. They demonstrate that increased stored energy causes reactions to occur sooner and faster, increases nucleation density, and reduces product grain size. These findings establish stored energy as a first-order driver of metamorphic change and material instabilities, comparable to the role of water, despite its small contribution to the overall energy budget.
本研究挑战了机械储存势能对变质作用等长期地质过程无影响的传统假设。通过对地壳和地幔材料进行时间分辨变形实验，作者分离了变质反应过程中储存能的变化。结果表明，储存能的增加使反应发生得更早、更快，提高了成核密度并减小了产物粒径。这些发现表明，尽管储存能在总能量预算中占比很小，但它是变质变化和材料不稳定的……

t: Time-resolved deformation experiments designed to isolate and control changes in mechanically stored potential energy during metamorphic reactions.
时间分辨变形实验，旨在隔离和控制变质反应过程中机械储存势能的变化。
Experimental deformation data from crustal and mantle rock materials undergoing metamorphic reactions under controlled laboratory conditions.
在受控实验室条件下经历变质反应的地壳和地幔岩石材料的实验变形数据。
Increased stored energy accelerates metamorphic reactions, increases nucleation density, and reduces product grain size across different deformation regimes.
增加的储存能加速了变质反应，提高了成核密度，并减小了不同变形机制下的产物粒径。
Extrapolating short-term laboratory deformation experiments to geological timescales and complex, heterogeneous natural systems remains challenging.
将短期实验室变形实验外推到地质时间尺度和复杂的自然系统仍具挑战性。
Directly demonstrating that mechanically stored energy exerts a first-order control on metamorphic reactions, challenging the assumption of its irrelevance.
直接证明了机械储存能对变质反应具有首要控制作用，挑战了其无关紧要的传统假设。

kc: Demonstrated experimentally that mechanically stored energy accelerates metamorphic reactions and reduces product grain size.
Showed that this influence of stored energy persists across different reactions and deformation regimes in crustal and mantle materials.
Established stored energy as a first-order driver of geological transformation and material instabilities, alongside water.
实验证明了机械储存能可以加速变质反应并减小产物晶粒尺寸。
表明储存能的这种影响在壳幔材料的不同反应和变形机制中普遍存在。
将储存能确立为与水并列的、驱动地质转变和材料不稳定的首要因素。

时间分辨变形实验，用于在变质反应过程中隔离储存能的变化。

tm.why: The paper investigates how stored energy affects metamorphic reactions in crustal and mantle materials, influencing long-term geodynamic processes.
The study links stored energy and Helmholtz energy changes to the emergence of material instabilities in rocks.

sum: This study investigates multiphase and polymineralic inclusions from the high-temperature metamorphic sole of the Semail ophiolite (Oman–United Arab Emirates) to understand fluid-melt processes during subduction infancy. The authors find that these inclusions trapped COH fluids and hydrous silicate melts derived from both mafic and sedimentary slab components. During exhumation, these inclusions acted as micro-reactors, driving the abiotic synthesis of solid organic compounds, including nanodiamond-like structures. This provides direct evidence that nascent subduction zones can generate prebiotic molecules. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that COH fluids and melts refertilize the mantle wedge from the very onset of subduction, promoting deep carbonation, hydration, and the generation of proto-arc magmas. This work highlights the critical role of early-stage subduction fluids in global volatile cycling and prebiotic chemistry.
本研究通过分析Semail蛇绿岩包裹体，发现其捕获了新生俯冲带的COH流体与含水熔体。这些包裹体在折返中作为微反应器，驱动了类纳米金刚石等有机物的非生物合成，证实俯冲带可产生生命前分子。同时，这些流体在俯冲初期即对地幔楔进行再富集，促进深部碳化与水化，揭示了早期俯冲在挥发分循环中的关键作用。

t: Analysis of multiphase and polymineralic inclusions in the metamorphic sole of the Semail ophiolite using petrological and geochemical techniques.
利用岩石学和地球化学技术对Semail蛇绿岩变质底部的多相和多矿物包裹体进行分析。
Rock samples from the high-temperature metamorphic sole of the Semail ophiolite (Oman–United Arab Emirates) containing multiphase and polymineralic inclusions.
来自阿曼-阿联酋Semail蛇绿岩高温变质底部的、含有多相和多矿物包裹体的岩石样品。

Identification of trapped COH fluids and hydrous silicate melts driving abiotic synthesis of solid organic compounds (including nanodiamond-like structures) and mantle refertilization during subduction infancy.
发现捕获的COH流体和含水硅酸盐熔体在俯冲初期驱动了非生物有机物合成及地幔再富集。
The study is based on ophiolite samples, which may have undergone complex post-subduction exhumation and alteration processes.

First direct evidence of COH fluids and hydrous silicate melts driving both mantle refertilization and abiotic organic synthesis in nascent subduction zones.

sum: This repository contains the dataset and code associated with a study revisiting marsquake magnitude scaling and its implications for marsquakes and meteoroid impacts. It includes source parameterization files, synthetic-source generation scripts, spectral-fitting and waveform-analysis codes, and magnitude-scaling results. The resources support the analysis of InSight waveform data and Martian interior models, utilizing tools like Instaseis and SPECFEM3D_GLOBE to model planetary seismic sources and wave propagation.
该Figshare仓库提供了关于重新评估火星地震震级标度及其对火星地震和陨石撞击启示研究的数据集与代码。内容包括震源参数化文件、合成震源生成脚本、谱拟合与波形分析代码以及震级标度结果。这些资源支持对InSight波形数据和火星内部模型的研究，利用Instaseis和SPECFEM3D_GLOBE等工……

sum: Tectonic deformation studies in Hispaniola have long been limited by sparse GNSS coverage. This paper presents a high-resolution 3D velocity field by integrating 112 GNSS station velocities with Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series processed via the FRInGE phase-linking framework. To mitigate spatially correlated tropospheric noise without filtering out long-wavelength tectonic signals, the authors incorporate a full spatial covariance matrix directly into the weighted least-squares velocity inversion. They compute ensemble surface strain rates and invert them directly for fault backslip and moment deficit rates using SliDeFS, avoiding block-model boundary assumptions. Results reveal transpressional strain partitioning with high locking on the Septentrional-Oriente Fault Zone (moment accumulation of ~2.7×10^18 N m/yr, equivalent to a Mw 7.91 earthquake every 300 years) and active contraction in the southern Haiti Fold-and-Thrust Belt. Conversely, the Enriquillo-Plantain Garden Fault exhibits very low slip deficit and is nearly fully creeping at its western end.
本研究结合112个GNSS站点与Sentinel-1 InSAR数据，构建了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛高分辨率三维速度场。方法上采用FRInGE相位链接技术处理InSAR数据，并在加权最小二乘反演中直接引入对流层噪声全空间协方差矩阵，在抑制噪声的同时保留长波长构造信号；随后利用应变率直接反演断层滑动亏损率，避免……

t: Two-part inversion: weighted least-squares integration of GNSS and FRInGE-processed InSAR velocities using full spatial covariance matrices for tropospheric noise, followed by ensemble strain-rate estimation and direct strain-rate-to-backslip inversion using SliDeFS.
采用含对流层噪声全协方差矩阵的加权最小二乘联合反演GNSS与InSAR速度，并由应变率直接反演断层滑动亏损。
112 GNSS stations (31 continuous, 81 campaign) combined with three ascending and three descending Sentinel-1 TOPS SAR tracks (~111 acquisitions per track after 2018) across Hispaniola.
整合伊斯帕尼奥拉岛112个GNSS站（31连续、81流动）与6个升降轨Sentinel-1 SAR时间序列数据。

Gridded velocities match GNSS with ~1.0 mm/yr RMSE. The SOFZ is strongly locked, accumulating ~2.7×10^18 N m/yr (Mw 7.91 over 300 years), whereas the EPGFZ accumulates ~0.46×10^18 N m/yr and creeps in the west.
SOFZ强闭锁，矩积累率达2.7×10^18 N m/yr（300年Mw 7.91）；EPGFZ仅0.46×10^18 …
Fault dips in the HFTB are poorly constrained beyond surface mapping, and reported earthquake potentials do not incorporate frequency-magnitude statistical distributions.
HFTB断层倾角缺乏深部约束，且震级潜力估算未考虑震级-频度统计分布。
Incorporates full spatial covariance of tropospheric noise into joint GNSS-InSAR velocity inversion across Hispaniola and directly inverts strain rates for fault locking without block models.
在联合反演中引入对流层噪声全空间协方差矩阵，无需块体假设直接由应变率反演伊斯帕尼奥拉岛断层闭锁。

kc: Generated the first high-resolution 3D interseismic surface velocity and strain rate fields across Hispaniola by integrating 112 GNSS stations and 6 Sentinel-1 InSAR tracks.
Implemented a full variance-covariance weighting framework using variogram analysis in the joint GNSS-InSAR inversion to suppress spatially correlated tropospheric noise without spatial filtering.

Quantified fault slip deficit and moment accumulation rates directly from strain rates without relying on rigid block assumptions, revealing high seismic hazard on the SOFZ and southern HFTB but low strike-slip locking on the western EPGFZ.
通过整合112个GNSS测站和6个轨道的Sentinel-1 InSAR数据，生成了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛首个高分辨率三维震间地表速度场和应变率场。
在GNSS-InSAR联合反演中利用变异函数分析实现了全方差-协方差加权框架，无需空间滤波即可有效抑制空间相关的对流层噪声。
直接由应变率反演断层滑动亏损率与地震矩积累率而无需刚性块体假设，揭示了SOFZ和南部HFTB的高地震危险性以及EPGFZ西端的低走滑闭锁特征。
me: InSAR time-series estimation using Fine-resolution InSAR with Generalized Eigenvectors (FRInGE) combining persistent and distributed scatterers, post-processed with MintPy and ERA5 corrections.
Weighted linear least-squares joint inversion of GNSS and InSAR line-of-sight velocities incorporating full exponential variogram covariance matrices for InSAR tropospheric error.
Ensemble 2D strain rate calculation averaging four methods (gpsgridder, local average gradient, wavelets, kriging) in Strain_2D, followed by direct strain-rate-to-backslip inversion using SliDeFS.
使用广义特征向量高分辨率InSAR（FRInGE）结合永久散射体和分布式散射体进行时间序列估计，并利用MintPy和ERA5模型进行后处理和大气校正。
包含InSAR对流层误差全指数变异函数协方差矩阵的GNSS与InSAR视线向速度加权线性最小二乘联合反演。
使用Strain_2D综合四种方法（gpsgridder、局部平均梯度、小波、克里金）计算集合二维应变率，并利用SliDeFS直接由应变率反演断层回滑（滑动亏损）。
de: 112 GNSS stations across Hispaniola (31 continuous up to October 2025, 81 campaign stations from Benford et al. 2012 and Calais et al. 2022) aligned to a Caribbean-fixed reference frame.
Sentinel-1 C-band TOPS SAR SLC imagery across 3 ascending tracks (AT04, AT106, AT33) and 3 descending tracks (DT142, DT69, DT171), averaging ~111 acquisitions per track after post-2018 filtering.
Fault trace geometries simplified from the Active Faults of Central America and the Caribbean (CCAF-DB) open repository.
伊斯帕尼奥拉岛112个GNSS测站（31个连续站数据至2025年10月，81个流动站来自既往研究），统一转换至加勒比板块固定参考框架。
覆盖3个升轨（AT04、AT106、AT33）和3个降轨（DT142、DT69、DT171）的Sentinel-1 C波段TOPS模式SAR图像，经2018年后时间滤波平均每轨保留约111景。
简化自“中美洲和加勒比地区活动断层（CCAF-DB）”开源数据库的断层迹线与几何模型。
li: Fault dip angles in the Haiti Fold-and-Thrust Belt (HFTB) are estimated and not well constrained beyond general geological mapping.
Reported earthquake magnitude potentials are derived from total moment accumulation rates without incorporating frequency-magnitude statistical distributions.

Slightly elevated chi-square misfit in the northing velocity component (2.40) and smoother modeled dilatation rates compared to observations suggest residual unmodeled or off-fault deformation processes.
海地褶皱冲断带（HFTB）的断层倾角仅基于一般地质填图进行估计，缺乏精确约束。

It investigates transpressive plate boundary deformation, strain rate partitioning, and regional tectonics between the Caribbean and North American plates.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from ill-conditioning and high computational costs when incorporating curvature information. This study investigates reusing a neural operator trained on reverse-time-migration (RTM) images as a learned preconditioner for projected FWI. At each iteration, the true adjoint-state gradient computed via Devito is preconditioned by solving a damped linear system with the normal operator of a learned RTM map, comparing a standard Fourier neural operator (FNO) against a Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO). Tested on a 2D synthetic slice of the BG Compass velocity model, JI-FNO preconditioning achieves the lowest relative model error (17.37% vs. 18.27% for baseline FWI) and better preserves deep velocity structures, whereas standard FNO preconditioning is unstable and degrades recovery. The work also identifies why a nonlinear RTM-matching inner solve fails due to objective-space mismatch, proving that derivative supervision is essential when neural operators are used to precondition inverse updates.
针对全波形反演（FWI）病态性强及曲率计算昂贵的问题，本文提出利用在逆时偏移（RTM）图像上训练的神经算子作为学习预条件子。该方法结合Devito计算的真实伴随梯度，利用学习到的RTM映射的正规算子修正更新方向，对比了标准傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与雅可比信息引导FNO（JI-FNO）。在二维BG C……

在TV约束投影FWI每步迭代中，利用自动微分构建神经RTM正规算子，求解阻尼线性系统以预处理真实伴随梯度。
Experiments use a 2D sliced BG Compass synthetic velocity model on a 256 x 256 grid (12.5 m spacing, 1.5–4.5 km/s) with 32 shots simulated in Devito using a 15 Hz Ricker wavelet.
采用256×256网格（间距12.5m）的BG Compass二维速度模型，用Devito模拟32炮15Hz子波数据。
After 40 iterations, FWI with JI-FNO preconditioning lowers the relative model error to 17.3743% compared to 18.2669% for baseline FWI and 19.0320% for unstable standard FNO preconditioning.
40次迭代后，JI-FNO预条件将相对模型误差从基线FWI的18.27%降至17.37%，而标准FNO升至19.03%。
Because derivative supervision only covers a low-dimensional subspace, direct Jacobian CG is unstable, requiring a normal operator that costs 1h35m vs. 35m for baseline FWI.

kc: Formulates a learned normal-operator preconditioner for projected FWI using automatic differentiation of an RTM neural operator.
Demonstrates that Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO) preconditioning reduces FWI relative model error from 18.27% to 17.37% on the BG Compass model, whereas standard FNO preconditioning becomes unstable.
Explains why positive semidefinite normal-operator preconditioning is required when Jacobian supervision is restricted to a low-dimensional subspace.
Analyzes a failure mode of nonlinear neural Gauss-Newton-type inner solves caused by mismatch between image-domain RTM matching and waveform-domain FWI objectives.
基于RTM神经算子的自动微分，提出了一种用于投影全波形反演（FWI）的学习正规算子预条件方法。

Comparison between forward-only trained FNO and derivative-supervised JI-FNO (supervised along dominant eigendirections of an averaged GN operator).

sum: Lower Carboniferous Limestone (LCL) in Britain is a promising deep geothermal target, but permeability and structural uncertainties limit resource assessment. Focusing on the Welton area in the East Midlands, this study integrates legacy 3D seismic reflection, 11 exploration wells, gravity, and aeromagnetic datasets with 3D gravity forward/inverse modelling and Euler deconvolution. The results reveal an asymmetric NW-SE graben partitioned into a western rift-bounding fault corridor, an eastern relay system, and a northern fault-intersection zone. Seismic stratigraphy documents episodic late Carboniferous inversion, uplift, and erosion, favouring localized fracturing and palaeokarst development. Gravity inversions show that LCL density variations alone cannot explain regional anomalies (reducing RMS misfit from 4.92 to 4.02 mGal), whereas basement density inversion reduces misfit by 90.1% to 0.49 mGal. The authors establish a novel conceptual framework of three structural geothermal plays (fault-damage-zone, relay/linkage, and fault-intersection) to guide future geothermal targeting in complex carbonates.
英国下石炭统灰岩（LCL）是极具潜力的深部地热目标，但构造和渗透率的不确定性限制了评估。本研究针对东米德兰兹Welton地区，综合了三维地震反射、11口探井及重磁数据，结合三维重力正反演与欧拉反褶积方法。研究揭示了一个不对称的NW-SE向地堑，划分为西部边界断层走廊、东部转换系统和北部断层交汇区，并……

t: Integrates 3D seismic interpretation and Dix velocity depth-conversion with 3D density-constrained gravity forward/inverse modelling, wavelength filtering, phase-based lineament extraction, and source-depth estimation via tilt-derivative and Euler deconvolution.
结合三维地震解释、时深转换、三维密度约束重力正反演、波长滤波、线性构造提取及欧拉反褶积深度估算。

Uses a merged legacy 3D seismic reflection survey (Welton-96, Fiskerton-98, Branston-00), 11 hydrocarbon exploration wells from UKOGL, and BGS regional land-gravity (~1.6 stations/km²) and aeromagnetic datasets.
使用合并的三维地震反射数据体、11口油气探井资料，以及BGS区域陆地重力（约1.6站/km²）和航磁数据集。

Seismic mapping reveals an asymmetric NW-SE graben with LCL thickness from 200 m to 1.4 km. Gravity inversion within LCL reduces RMS misfit by 18.3% (to 4.02 mGal), whereas basement density inversion reduces misfit by 90.1% (to 0.49 mGal).

Present-day hydraulic transmissivity and fracture connectivity remain unproven, seismic resolution degrades near base LCL, and potential-field inversions suffer from non-uniqueness and unmodelled volcanic rocks.

将基底构造继承与多期反转结合，首次为下石炭统碳酸盐岩定义了三种概念性构造地热藏评估框架。

kc: Mapped the 3D structural and stratigraphic architecture of the Lower Carboniferous Limestone (LCL) in the Welton area using merged legacy 3D seismic and well data.

Demonstrated via 3D gravity inversion and Euler deconvolution that Carboniferous fault networks are localized above deeper basement fabrics and require significant sub-LCL density heterogeneity (reducing RMS misfit by 90.1%).

Defined three conceptual structural geothermal plays (fault-damage-zone, relay/linkage, and fault-intersection plays) linking tectonic inheritance, polyphase inversion, and potential palaeokarst to secondary permeability.
利用合并的历史三维地震和测井数据，绘制了Welton地区下石炭统灰岩（LCL）的三维构造和地层格架。
通过三维重力反演和欧拉反褶积证明，石炭纪断层网络定位于更深的基底构造之上，且需要显著的LCL下伏密度非均质性（将RMS误差降低90.1%）。
定义了三种概念性构造地热藏类型（断层破碎带型、转换/连接型和断层交汇型），将构造继承、多期反转和潜在古岩溶与次生渗透率联系起来。

Potential-field wavelength filtering, tilt-derivative analysis, Euler deconvolution (structural index 0.5), and phase-based automated lineament extraction (CET Grid Analysis).

Stratigraphic markers and wireline logs (sonic transit time and bulk density) from 11 hydrocarbon exploration and appraisal wells.
Regional BGS land Bouguer gravity data (~1.6 stations/km²) and legacy aeromagnetic data (1955–1965 surveys processed with Differential Reduction to the Magnetic Pole).

Seismic resolution deteriorates near the base LCL, and unmodelled Lower Carboniferous volcanic rocks introduce non-uniqueness into basement gravity inversions.

sum: This study applies active-source multichannel analysis of surface waves (MASW) using a long-term distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) cable and conventional geophones along a 2 km transect in Utqiagvik, Alaska. By converting shear-wave velocity profiles to unfrozen pore water content (Sw) via a load-bearing effective-medium framework, the authors compare seismic observations against a reference model built from borehole temperatures and laboratory freezing curves. They find significant, spatially organized departures from the reference model, particularly near the coastal end of the transect (Tundra 4 site), where Sw remains elevated at depth. This demonstrates that temperature and shallow lab measurements alone cannot fully capture permafrost heterogeneity, highlighting the value of integrating seismic, thermal, and laboratory data.
本研究在阿拉斯加利用DAS和检波器开展主动源MASW探测。通过等效介质框架将剪切波速度转换为未冻水含量，并与温度及实验室参考模型对比。结果表明，实测数据与参考模型存在显著空间偏差，尤其在海岸附近深部未冻水含量偏高。这证明仅凭温度和实验室测量无法完全解释复杂的冻土结构。
