sum: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and integrated fibre-optic sensing (IFOS) measure integrated axial strain along fibre paths that frequently curve and loop. Separating integrated strain into endpoint and curvature contributions, this study derives the exact monochromatic plane-wave response of a planar circular-arc fibre as a closed-form Bessel series. In the long-wavelength limit, response depends purely on path shape via a geometrical tensor: bending fills the broadside P-wave blind spot of straight fibres while suppressing SH sensitivity. For smooth single-apex bends, the height-to-chord ratio controls P-wave directivity, becoming nearly omnidirectional above 0.46, while a closed loop acts as an SH-blind areal dilatometer. At finite wavelengths, opening angles filter Bessel orders, transforming straight-fibre gauge-length notches into concentric Bessel rings. Relaxing the plane-wave assumption yields a Fibre Fresnel Number criterion for spherical wavefronts. These dimensionless criteria are condensed into a practical Decision Map evaluated across eight real-world DAS/IFOS deployment regimes.
分布式声学传感（DAS）和集成光纤传感（IFOS）测量沿弯曲光纤路径积分的轴向应变。本研究将积分应变分解为端点项与曲率项，推导出平面圆弧光纤在平面波下的精确贝塞尔级数解析解。长波长极限下，响应由仅取决于形状的几何张量决定：弯曲填补了直光纤对P波的侧向盲区并削弱SH波灵敏度。单顶点平滑弯曲的高弦比大于……

t: Decomposes integrated axial strain into endpoint and curvature terms, applying the Jacobi-Anger expansion to derive an exact Bessel-series solution for planar circular-arc fibres, alongside a general geometrical tensor formulation.
将积分轴向应变分解为端点项和曲率项，利用Jacobi-Anger展开推导圆弧光纤精确贝塞尔级数解及几何张量公式。

No new observational data were collected; analytical derivations and numerical evaluations are applied to eight published DAS and IFOS deployment scenarios spanning roadside, borehole, glacier, volcano, and trans-oceanic settings.
无新观测数据；基于解析推导与数值模拟，评估了涵盖路边、井中、冰川、火山及跨洋的八个DAS/IFOS部署场景。

For smooth symmetric bends, P-wave response is dipole-like for height-to-chord ratios below 0.13 and nearly omnidirectional above 0.46; closed loops are omnidirectional P-wave sensors with J1(kR sin θ) dependence and complete SH blindness.
平滑对称弯曲高弦比小于0.13时P波呈偶极响应，大于0.46时近全向；闭合环对P波全向敏感且对SH波完全盲区。
Assumes ideal shear-lag axial dominance (neglecting transverse strain in stiff/armoured cables), perfect ground-cable coupling, zero torsion planar paths, and far-field point sources (kd >> 1).
假设轴向应变主导（忽略刚性铠装缆横向应变）、完全耦合、零挠率平面路径及点源远场条件（kd >> 1）。

First exact analytical Bessel-series solution for curved fibre-optic phase response across all wavelengths, introducing geometric filtering, the Fibre Fresnel Number, and a unified deployment Decision Map.
首次推导出全波长弯曲光纤精确贝塞尔级数解，提出几何滤波概念、光纤菲涅尔数及统一部署决策图。

kc: Derived the exact closed-form Bessel-series plane-wave response for a 2D circular-arc fibre segment at arbitrary wavelength and opening angle.
Formulated a general geometrical tensor representation for arbitrary 3D fibre paths in the long-wavelength limit and established height-to-chord engineering rules of thumb.
Identified the Fibre Fresnel Number and two geometric distance ratios that govern when spherical-wave kernels are required over plane-wave approximations.
Constructed a practical Decision Map linking deployment parameters to the appropriate forward response model, demonstrated across eight DAS and IFOS scenarios.
推导了任意波长和张角下二维圆弧光纤段平面波响应的精确闭式贝塞尔级数解。
建立了长波长极限下任意三维光纤路径的几何张量表征，并给出了高弦比工程经验法则。
提出了光纤菲涅尔数及两个几何距离比判据，界定了何时必须使用球面波核代替平面波近似。
构建了将部署参数映射到适当正演响应模型的实用决策图，并在八个DAS和IFOS场景中进行了验证。
me: Endpoint-curvature decomposition of integrated optical phase and axial strain under the shear-lag approximation.
Jacobi-Anger Fourier-Bessel series expansion for monochromatic plane-wave steady response (MPWSR).
Geometrical tensor and spatial moment expansion of the tangent dyad for general curved fibre trajectories.
Point-source spherical-wave probing and Taylor expansion of wavefront sagitta to define the Fibre Fresnel Number.
剪滞近似下积分光学相位与轴向应变的端点-曲率分解。
利用Jacobi-Anger傅里叶-贝塞尔级数展开求解单色平面波稳态响应（MPWSR）。
针对一般弯曲光纤轨迹的切向并矢几何张量与空间矩展开。
利用点源球面波探测与波前矢高泰勒展开定义光纤菲涅尔数。
de: Analytical and numerical evaluation of circular-arc, parabolic, and cosine planar bend geometries across varying opening angles and wavenumbers.
Regime classification of eight published DAS and IFOS field deployments (roadside, borehole, glacier, volcano, submarine/terrestrial loops) using literature parameters.
对不同张角和波数下的圆弧、抛物线和余弦平面弯曲几何结构进行解析与数值评估。
利用文献参数对八个已发表的DAS和IFOS野外部署场景（路边、井中、冰川、火山、海底/陆地环路）进行机制分类。
li: Relies on the axial-dominance (shear-lag) approximation, neglecting transverse strain transfer which may be significant in stiffly jacketed or steel-armoured cables.
Assumes perfect mechanical coupling between the fibre, cable, and surrounding medium, ignoring buffer slip.
Restricts exact closed-form analytical kernels to planar bends with zero torsion (3D helices are deferred to Part II) and far-field point-source terms (kd >> 1).
依赖轴向主导（剪滞）近似，忽略了在刚性护套或钢铠装光缆中可能显著的横向应变传递。
假设光纤、光缆与周围介质之间完全机械耦合，忽略了缓冲层滑移。
精确闭式解析核仅限于零挠率平面弯曲（三维螺旋留待第II部分）及远场点源项（kd >> 1）。

tm.why: The paper derives exact analytical instrument response models and a deployment decision map for curved Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and integrated fibre-optic sensing (IFOS) cables.
It establishes the theoretical instrument response, directional sensitivity, and aperture-antenna behaviour of curved fibre-optic seismic sensors.

ev.notes: Full 30-page PDF manuscript including main text, 14 figures, 6 tables, and Appendices A–C was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the origin of a >1000 km-long slab gap at 200–500 km depth beneath southwest Alaska and the eastern Aleutians, identified in high-resolution P-wave tomography. By unfolding the Pacific slab and integrating it into a quantitative plate-reconstruction model, the authors demonstrate that this gap aligns with the extinct Kula-Pacific mid-ocean ridge (inactive since ~40 Ma) which subducted after ~8 Ma. This subduction correlates with late Miocene-Pliocene exhumation, basin uplift, slab-edge magmatism, and intraplate volcanism. The slab gap also explains the limit of deep Benioff seismicity and a previously recognized slab 'portal' in the western Aleutians. This provides a premier example of extinct spreading-ridge subduction, distinct from active ridge subduction.
本研究结合高分辨率P波断层成像与定量板块重建，探讨了阿拉斯加西南部和东阿留申下方深200-500千米、长逾1000千米的板块空隙成因。该空隙与约40 Ma熄灭的Kula-Pacific洋中脊相吻合，于约8 Ma开始俯冲。该过程解释了区域隆升、板缘与板内岩浆作用及深部地震分布。这为熄灭洋中脊俯冲提供了……

t: Quantitative plate-reconstruction modeling combined with slab unfolding based on published high-resolution P-wave seismic tomography.
基于已发表的地震断层成像，进行定量板块重建模拟与板块去折叠分析。
Published P-wave tomography models of southwest Alaska and the eastern Aleutians, along with regional geological and geophysical datasets.
阿拉斯加西南部和东阿留申已发表的P波断层成像模型及区域地质数据集。
The >1000 km-long slab gap at 200-500 km depth aligns with the extinct Kula-Pacific ridge, explaining late Miocene exhumation, volcanism, and seismicity limits.
深200-500千米、长逾1000千米的板块空隙与熄灭的Kula-Pacific洋中脊吻合。
Lower tomographic resolution in the central-western Aleutians limits direct imaging of the westward continuation of the slab gap.
中西阿留申地区较低的断层成像分辨率限制了对板块空隙西延的直接成像。
Provides the first definitive, quantitative reconstruction of an extinct (rather than active) spreading-ridge subduction forming a slab gap.
首次对熄灭（而非活跃）洋中脊俯冲形成板块空隙进行了定量重建。

kc: Identified that the >1000 km-long Alaskan-Aleutian slab gap aligns with the extinct Kula-Pacific spreading ridge.
Quantitatively reconstructed the subduction of an extinct spreading ridge starting at ~8 Ma.
Linked the slab gap to regional tectonic events, including basin uplift, volcanism, and Benioff zone seismicity limits.
确定了长逾1000千米的阿拉斯加-阿留申板块空隙与已熄灭的Kula-Pacific洋中脊相吻合。
定量重建了约8 Ma开始的熄灭洋中脊俯冲过程。
将板块空隙与区域构造事件（包括盆地隆升、火山活动及贝尼奥夫带地震极限）联系起来。
me: Slab unfolding and quantitative plate-reconstruction modeling.
Synthesis of published high-resolution P-wave seismic tomography.
板块去折叠与定量板块重建模拟。
综合分析已发表的高分辨率P波地震断层成像。
de: Published P-wave tomography models of southwest Alaska and the eastern Aleutians.
Plate tectonic reconstruction datasets and geological constraints (exhumation, magmatism, seismicity).
已发表的阿拉斯加西南部和东阿留申地区P波断层成像模型。
板块构造重建数据集及地质约束（剥露、岩浆作用、地震活动性）。
li: Relies on the resolution of published seismic tomography models, which may be less resolved in the central-western Aleutians.
依赖于已发表地震断层成像模型的分辨率，在中西阿留申地区的解析度可能较低。

tm.why: The paper reconstructs the subduction of the Kula-Pacific ridge and its relation to a >1000 km-long slab gap beneath Alaska-Aleutians.
The study integrates published high-resolution P-wave tomography to identify and unfold the subducted Pacific slab gap.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Trailing seismicity following fluid injection shut-in poses significant hazards in Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS). This study analyzes seven EGS operations with abrupt shut-ins (five at Soultz-sous-Forêts, one at Cooper Basin, and one at Basel) to investigate the empirical link between wellhead pressure relaxation and seismicity rate decay. By evaluating five statistical seismicity decay models via AIC/BIC and fitting an exponential model to late-stage pressure decay, the authors introduce a 'time-to-fraction' (TTF) metric—the time to reach a specified fraction of the shut-in value—to enable direct cross-model comparison. They find that seismicity decay is best described by a Modified Omori law and consistently relaxes faster than wellhead pressure, yet their TTFs are strongly correlated (Pearson/Spearman > 0.9). Neither decay correlates with operational parameters like injected volume, pressure, or duration, indicating that reservoir-specific hydro-mechanical properties, rather than operational controls, govern post-injection seismicity relaxation.
本研究分析了7个增强型地热系统（EGS）项目（包括Soultz-sous-Forêts、Cooper盆地和Basel）在突然关井后的井口压力与尾随地震目录数据。通过最大似然估计、AIC/BIC准则评估五种地震衰减统计模型及压力指数衰减模型，创新性地引入“达到特定比例时间”（TTF）指标以实现跨模型对……

t: Evaluates five statistical seismicity decay models using maximum likelihood, AIC/BIC, and parametric bootstrap KS tests, comparing them against exponential wellhead pressure decay via a Time-to-Fraction (TTF) metric.
利用最大似然、AIC/BIC和KS检验评估五种地震衰减模型，并通过TTF指标与井口压力指数衰减对比。

Seismic catalogs (filtered above completeness Mc) and wellhead pressure records from seven EGS injection operations featuring abrupt shut-ins at Soultz-sous-Forêts (1993–2005), Cooper Basin (2003), and Basel (2006).
来自Soultz、Cooper盆地和Basel共7个突然关井的EGS激发阶段的完备地震目录与井口压力记录。
Modified Omori best fits seismicity decay (lowest BIC in 6/7 sites). Seismicity and pressure TTFs strongly correlate (Pearson and Spearman > 0.9), with seismicity decaying faster than pressure.
修正大森公式拟合最优；地震与压力TTF强正相关（相关系数>0.9），且地震比压力衰减更快。

Individual Omori parameters have high uncertainties and trade-offs, failing to correlate with pressure decay; furthermore, the correlation requires strict operational conditions like abrupt shut-in without prior injection stages.
大森模型单参数不确定性大且相互耦合；该相关性严格依赖于无前期注入且突然关井的条件。

Establishes a direct empirical correlation between post-injection wellhead pressure relaxation and trailing seismicity decay across multiple EGS sites using the model-independent Time-to-Fraction (TTF) metric.
利用独立于模型的TTF指标，首次在多个EGS场地建立了关井后井口压力松弛与尾随地震衰减的直接经验关联。

kc: Demonstrates that post-injection seismicity decay in fractured EGS reservoirs is best fitted by a Modified Omori power-law, whereas wellhead pressure follows an exponential decay.
Introduces the Time-to-Fraction (TTF) metric to bypass individual parameter trade-offs and directly compare decay timescales across different empirical models.
Reveals a strong positive correlation (r > 0.9) between seismicity TTF and pressure TTF, with seismicity consistently decaying faster than wellhead pressure.
Shows that post-injection decay timescales do not correlate with operational parameters (injected volume, pressure, duration), highlighting the dominance of intrinsic reservoir properties.
证明裂隙型EGS储层关井后地震活动率衰减最符合修正大森幂律模型，而井口压力呈指数衰减。
引入“达到特定比例时间”（TTF）指标，克服了单一模型参数耦合问题，实现了不同经验模型衰减时间尺度的直接对比。
揭示了地震TTF与压力TTF之间的强正相关性（相关系数>0.9），且地震活动率衰减始终快于井口压力。
表明关井后衰减时间尺度与注入体积、压力和持续时间等操作参数无关，凸显了储层固有水力力学性质的主导作用。
me: Maximum likelihood estimation to fit five candidate statistical decay models (Modified Omori, Cut-off Omori, Exponential, Stretched Exponential, Gamma) to post-injection seismicity catalogs.
Model selection and goodness-of-fit evaluation using Akaike/Bayesian Information Criteria (AIC/BIC) weights and parametric bootstrap Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) tests.
Least-squares exponential fitting to the late-stage tail of post-injection wellhead pressure time series, excluding early localized wellbore drops and late abrupt anomalies.
Computation of Time-to-Fraction (TTF) metrics and uncertainty quantification via 3,000 parametric bootstrap and multivariate normal realizations to evaluate Pearson and Spearman correlations.
采用最大似然估计将五种候选统计衰减模型（修正大森、截断大森、指数、拉伸指数、伽马模型）拟合至关井后地震目录。
利用赤池/贝叶斯信息准则（AIC/BIC）权重以及参数化自助法Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验进行模型优选与拟合优度评估。
剔除早期井筒局部压降和晚期突变异常后，对关井后井口压力时间序列尾部进行最小二乘指数拟合。
计算“达到特定比例时间”（TTF）指标，并通过3000次参数化自助法和多元正态抽样量化不确定性，评估Pearson与Spearman相关系数。
de: Seismic catalogs and wellhead pressure histories from seven EGS stimulation episodes with abrupt shut-ins: Soultz-sous-Forêts (1993, 2000, 2003, 2004, 2005), Cooper Basin (2003), and Basel (2006).
Catalogs filtered above the magnitude of completeness (Mc ranging from -1.72 to 0.1) estimated via the maximum curvature method, yielding 2,352 to 167,000 events per episode.
来自7个具有突然关井特征的EGS水力激发阶段的地震目录和井口压力记录：Soultz-sous-Forêts（1993、2000、2003、2004、2005年）、Cooper盆地（2003年）和Basel（2006年）。
采用最大曲率法估计完备震级（Mc在-1.72至0.1之间）并对目录进行筛选，各阶段包含2,352至167,000个地震事件。
li: Individual fitted decay parameters (such as Omori c and p values) suffer from large uncertainties and strong trade-offs, preventing direct correlation with pressure decay.
In three of the seven episodes, bootstrap KS tests yield p-values < 0.05, indicating simple statistical models cannot capture detailed decay fluctuations caused by local geological complexity.
Findings apply strictly to initial or single-stage injections with abrupt shut-ins; multi-stage injections (Kaiser effect) or gradual flow reductions may break the observed correlation.
单个拟合衰减参数（如大森公式的c值和p值）存在较大不确定性和强耦合，无法直接与压力衰减建立相关性。
在7个案例中有3个案例的自助法KS检验p值<0.05，表明简单统计模型难以捕捉局部地质复杂性引起的精细衰减波动。
结论严格适用于首次或单阶段注入且突然关井的情况；多阶段注入（凯撒效应）或阶梯式减流可能会破坏观测到的相关性。

tm.why: The paper investigates trailing seismicity and wellhead pressure decay following fluid injection shut-in across seven Enhanced Geothermal Systems operations.
The study addresses post-injection earthquake occurrence and statistical decay forecasting, which is directly relevant to managing seismic risks in deep geothermal projects.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§7), Table 1, and Figures 1–3.

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms of ground-motion amplification and spatially heterogeneous building damage during the January 26, 2026, Diebu Ms5.5 shallow earthquake in Gansu, China. Integrating field damage surveys across 12 sites in Dianga Town, strong-motion records from 13 stations, and 3D explicit finite-difference numerical simulations (FLAC3D) with a Mohr-Coulomb elastoplastic model, the authors evaluate how alpine-gorge topography and local site conditions control seismic hazard. Results show near-field stations recorded anomalously high PGAs (up to 6.87 m/s²) far exceeding empirical attenuation predictions. Simulations confirm that PGA amplification factors approach 2.0 at scarp crests and high-elevation slope shoulders, matching severe field-observed damage over 100 m spatial scales. Furthermore, seismic loading caused slope shear strain bands to widen and migrate toward downslope residential areas. The novelty lies in establishing fine-scale quantitative causal chains linking topographic/excavation amplification to both structural damage and plastic slope deformation.
本研究结合现场震害调查、13个强震动台站记录及FLAC3D三维有限差分动力数值模拟，系统分析了2026年甘肃迭部5.5级浅源地震在电尕镇高山峡谷区的地面运动放大效应及建筑震害特征。结果显示近场PGA高达6.87 m/s²，显著超出经验衰减模型预测；陡坎顶部与高海拔坡肩处的PGA放大系数接近2.0，导……

t: Integrates field damage reconnaissance, strong-motion attenuation comparisons, and 3D explicit finite-difference dynamic simulations (FLAC3D) using a Mohr-Coulomb elastoplastic constitutive model, hierarchical meshing (1 m soil, 5 m bedrock), and basal stress input.
结合现场震害调查、经验衰减模型对比及基于Mohr-Coulomb本构与自由场边界的FLAC3D三维显式有限差分动力模拟。
Uses field damage surveys from 12 sites (232 households) in Dianga Town, 30-m SRTM DEM, and 13 strong-motion station records (epicentral distances 1.85–67.87 km) from the 2026 Diebu Ms5.5 earthquake.
采用电尕镇12个调查点（232户）震害数据、30米DEM及13个强震台站（震中距1.85–67.87 km）记录。

Near-field PGAs reached 6.87 m/s². Simulated horizontal PGA amplification factors reached 1.96 at scarp crest ZK25 (cumulative displacement ~0.06 m) and ~1.8 at slope shoulder PD, while peak shear strain increment dropped from 3.64 to 1.94 and migrated toward residential zones.
近场PGA达6.87 m/s²；陡坎顶部ZK25放大系数达1.96（位移0.06 m），坡肩PD达1.8，剪应变带向居民…
Limited to 12 survey sites and 13 stations for a single earthquake; the 3D model assumes three homogeneous layers without joints, groundwater, dynamic softening, or experimental validation.
仅基于单次地震的12个调查点和13个台站；模型简化为三层均质层，未考虑裂隙、地下水与动力软化。

Reveals ~100 m fine-scale damage heterogeneity in Dianga Town, identifies amplification contrasts at excavated free faces (1.96 vs. 0.75), and establishes two causal chains linking site amplification to building damage and slope strain migration.
揭示百米尺度震害分异与开挖临空面放大对比（1.96 vs. 0.75），建立场地放大至震害与应变迁移的双因果链。

kc: Documented fine-scale (~100 m) spatial variability in building seismic damage across 12 survey sites in Dianga Town following the 2026 Diebu Ms5.5 earthquake.

Analyzed near-field strong-motion records (PGA up to 6.87 m/s²), demonstrating pronounced local site amplification within 10 km epicentral distance compared to western China empirical attenuation models.

Conducted 3D FLAC3D dynamic elastoplastic simulations showing PGA amplification factors up to 1.96 at excavated scarp crests and ~1.8 at slope shoulders, plus shear strain migration toward residential areas.
记录了2026年迭部5.5级地震后电尕镇12个调查点在百米尺度上的建筑震害空间分异特征。
分析了近场强震动记录（PGA最高达6.87 m/s²），揭示了震中距10 km内显著高于中国西部经验衰减模型的局部场地放大效应。
开展了三维FLAC3D弹塑性动力模拟，证实开挖陡坎顶部与坡肩PGA放大系数分别达1.96和约1.8，并揭示了剪应变向居民区迁移的特征。
me: Post-earthquake field reconnaissance and building damage classification across 12 village sites in Dianga Town.
Comparison of observed PGA and PGV from 13 strong-motion stations against the Yu & Wang empirical ground-motion attenuation relationship for western China.

Three-dimensional explicit finite-difference dynamic modeling in FLAC3D using a three-layer geological model (silty clay, gravelly soil, slate/shale bedrock), Mohr-Coulomb elastoplasticity, Rayleigh damping, and free-field boundaries.
对电尕镇12个村落调查点开展震后现场考察与建筑震害等级评估。
将13个强震动台站的观测PGA和PGV与中国西部经验地震动衰减关系（俞言祥和汪素云模型）进行对比分析。
基于FLAC3D开展三维显式有限差分动力模拟，采用三层地质概化模型（粉质黏土、碎石土、板岩/页岩基岩）、Mohr-Coulomb弹塑性本构、瑞利阻尼及自由场边界。
de: Field damage survey data covering 232 households (1,038 residents) across 12 survey sites (~12 km²) in Dianga Town, plus 30-m SRTM DEM.
Strong-motion recordings from 13 seismic stations (epicentral distances 1.85 to 67.87 km) provided by CEA and CENC, including three-component bedrock motions at station TEWDG (1.85 km).
Two 3D numerical slope models (site ZK with a 13-m excavated scarp; sites YA-PD-KZK spanning ~280 m elevation difference) excited by the three-component TEWDG mainshock waveforms.
涵盖电尕镇12个调查点（约12 km²、232户、1038人）的现场震害调查数据及30米分辨率SRTM数字高程模型（DEM）。
中国地震局（CEA）与中国地震台网中心（CENC）提供的13个强震台站记录（震中距1.85–67.87 km），含距离震中1.85 km的TEWDG基岩台三分量波形。
两个三维数值边坡模型（含13米开挖陡坎的ZK场地模型，以及跨越约280米高差的YA-PD-KZK模型），以TEWDG台主震三分量波形作为底部应力输入。
li: Field surveys (12 sites) and strong-motion stations (13 stations) have limited spatial coverage and density across the broader county.
The 3D numerical model simplifies the geology into three homogeneous layers without joints, fissures, groundwater, or dynamic material softening.
Analysis is based on a single Ms5.5 earthquake without independent verification (e.g., shaking table tests) or decoupling of elevation versus scarp excavation effects.
现场调查（12个点）与强震动台站（13个台）的数量和密度有限，难以完全刻画全县及甘川交界区的放大效应分布。
三维数值模型将地层简化为三层均质层，未考虑岩土体节理裂隙、地下水及动力软化效应。
仅基于单次5.5级地震事件分析，缺乏振动台试验等独立验证，且未定量解耦高程效应与开挖临空面效应的相对贡献。

tm.why: The paper investigates strong ground motion records (PGA, PGV), topographic amplification effects, and resulting building seismic damage from the 2026 Diebu Ms5.5 earthquake.
It uses 3D explicit finite-difference dynamic simulations (FLAC3D) with a hierarchical mesh to simulate wave propagation and elastoplastic slope response.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF text, 10 figures, and 3 tables from Scientific Reports (Article in Press, 2026) were analyzed in detail.

sum: This paper introduces SLEvolve v1.0, an open-source solver for Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) that addresses the O(N^2) computational bottleneck of standard 1-D pseudo-spectral solvers. By exploiting the exponential form of the viscoelastic relaxation kernel, the authors reformulate the viscous response as an exact recursive update of a finite set of modal states, reducing the temporal scaling to O(N). Combined with optimized spherical-harmonic transforms, improved file handling, and AI-assisted engineering, SLEvolve v1.0 achieves an end-to-end speed-up of up to 4,000-fold compared to traditional solvers. This allows day-long simulations of Antarctic future sea-level projections to run in under thirty seconds, facilitating large-ensemble and coupled ice-sheet modeling.
本文介绍了开源GIA求解器SLEvolve v1.0。针对传统一维伪光谱求解器中粘弹性响应计算随时间步呈O(N^2)二次方增加的瓶颈，该研究利用粘弹性松弛核的指数形式，将粘性响应重构为有限模态状态的精确递归更新，将计算复杂度降至O(N)。结合优化的球谐变换、改进的文件处理和AI辅助工程，SLEvol……

t: Reformulation of the viscoelastic response in GIA modeling as an exact recursive update of a finite set of modal states, reducing temporal scaling from O(N^2) to O(N).
将GIA模拟中的粘弹性响应重构为有限模态状态的精确递归更新，将时间复杂度从O(N^2)降至O(N)。
A 550-step Antarctic future sea-level projection case study used to benchmark the computational performance and speed-up of the SLEvolve v1.0 solver.
采用包含550个时间步的南极未来海平面投影案例，用于基准测试SLEvolve v1.0求解器的计算性能。

The recursive formulation yields a 20.6-fold speed-up, while the fully optimized SLEvolve v1.0 solver achieves up to a 4,000-fold end-to-end speed-up, running day-long simulations in under 30 seconds.

The current implementation is demonstrated for 1-D GIA solvers, and its extension to 3-D laterally heterogeneous Earth models remains to be fully explored.

Eliminating the need to re-sum the entire load history by using an exact finite-state recursive representation of viscoelastic memory, combined with AI-assisted software engineering.

sum: This study investigates the frictional behavior of simulated quartz gouges under crustal faulting conditions (50 MPa effective normal stress, 100 MPa fluid pressure) using a ring-shear hydrothermal apparatus. By systematically varying temperature (25–650°C) and slip velocity (1 nm/s to 300 μm/s), the authors map rate- and state-dependent friction (RSF) parameters. They observe pervasive velocity-weakening behavior across specific velocity ranges at all tested temperatures. Crucially, they identify three distinct domains of unstable slip (low a-b values) in the temperature-velocity space. One domain at 300–550°C and 0.003–1 μm/s corresponds to conditions for deep earthquake nucleation. These findings provide a comprehensive friction parameter map essential for modeling earthquake nucleation and early acceleration processes in quartz-rich continental crust.
本研究利用旋转剪切温压变形仪，在50 MPa有效法向应力和100 MPa流体压力下，系统开展了模拟石英断层泥在不同温度（25–650°C）和剪切速度（1 nm/s–300 μm/s）下的摩擦实验。结果表明，石英断层泥在所有测试温度的特定速度区间内均表现出广泛的速度减弱行为。在温度-速度空间中存在三个……

t: Hydrothermal ring-shear experiments on simulated quartz gouge to measure rate- and state-dependent friction parameters across a wide range of temperatures and velocities.
利用旋转剪切温压变形仪对模拟石英断层泥进行摩擦实验，测量速率和状态摩擦参数。
Frictional data of simulated quartz gouge sheared at 50 MPa effective normal stress, 100 MPa fluid pressure, 25–650°C, and 1 nm/s–300 μm/s.
在50 MPa有效法向应力和100 MPa流体压力下，25–650°C及不同速度下的石英断层泥摩擦数据。
Pervasive velocity-weakening behavior observed at all temperatures, with three distinct unstable slip domains identified, including one at 300–550°C and 0.003–1 μm/s.
在所有温度下均发现速度减弱行为，并确定了三个不稳定的滑动区域（如300–550°C区间）。
Simplified pure quartz composition and challenges in extrapolating laboratory slip rates and spatial scales to natural fault systems.
采用纯石英单一矿物成分，且实验室尺度与天然断层在时空外推上存在局限。
First comprehensive mapping of quartz gouge RSF parameters over an exceptionally wide temperature-velocity space, identifying three distinct unstable slip domains.
首次在极宽的温度-速度空间内系统绘制了石英断层泥的摩擦参数图，发现三个不稳定滑动域。

kc: Conducted systematic hydrothermal ring-shear experiments on simulated quartz gouge across a wide temperature (25–650°C) and velocity (1 nm/s–300 μm/s) range.
Mapped rate- and state-dependent friction (RSF) parameters as a function of temperature and velocity, revealing pervasive velocity-weakening behavior.
Identified three distinct unstable slip domains in the temperature-velocity space, including a deep domain (300–550°C) relevant to natural earthquake nucleation.
在宽温度（25–650°C）和速度（1 nm/s–300 μm/s）范围内对模拟石英断层泥进行了系统的水热旋转剪切实验。
绘制了作为温度和速度函数的速率和状态摩擦（RSF）参数图，揭示了广泛的速度减弱行为。
在温度-速度空间中确定了三个独特的不稳定滑动域，包括一个与天然地震成核相关的深部区域（300–550°C）。
me: Hydrothermal ring-shear deformation experiments.
Rate- and state-dependent friction (RSF) modeling to extract constitutive parameters.
水热旋转剪切变形实验。
速率和状态摩擦（RSF）建模以提取本构参数。
de: Frictional data of simulated quartz gouge sheared at 50 MPa effective normal stress and 100 MPa fluid pressure, spanning temperatures of 25–650°C and sliding velocities of 1 nm/s to 300 μm/s.
在50 MPa有效法向应力和100 MPa流体压力下剪切的模拟石英断层泥摩擦数据，温度跨度为25–650°C，滑动速度为1 nm/s至300 μm/s。
li: The experiments are conducted on pure quartz gouge, whereas natural fault zones often contain mixed mineralogies (e.g., clays, micas, feldspars).
Extrapolation of laboratory slip rates to geological timescales and natural tectonic loading rates remains challenging.
实验是在纯石英断层泥上进行的，而天然断层带通常包含混合矿物成分（如粘土、云母、长石）。
将实验室滑动速率外推到地质时间尺度和天然构造加载速率仍具有挑战性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the rate- and state-dependent friction behavior and velocity-weakening of simulated quartz gouge under hydrothermal conditions to understand earthquake nucleation.

sum: Uniform continent-scale interpretation of magnetotelluric (MT) data is hindered by variable data quality and heavy computational demands of 3D inversion. This study introduces CURIE (continental U.S. 1D resistivity inference ensemble), a probabilistic reference model generated by independently inverting the Zxy and Zyx components from 1,773 USArray, USMTArray, and USGS-GEOMAG stations using unsupervised, physics-driven normalizing flows (NFs). Completed in 5.91 hours on 10 GPUs, CURIE provides posterior resistivity distributions, uncertainties, and predicted MT responses down to ~415 km depth. Most stations yield filtered misfits below 4, coinciding with low phase-tensor skew and ellipticity in the Interior Plains and Intermontane Plateaus. CURIE resolves shallow geological provinces and mid-lithospheric tectonic contrasts between the active western U.S. and stable eastern craton. Mode differences highlight 3D structures and coast effects, establishing a baseline for data quality screening and 3D inversion initialization.
本文针对大地电磁（MT）三维反演计算量大及数据质量参差不齐的问题，利用无监督物理驱动的归一化流（Normalizing Flows）贝叶斯反演方法，对覆盖美国本土1773个MT台站的Zxy和Zyx分量进行了独立一维概率反演，构建了大陆尺度一维电阻率参考模型集CURIE。反演在10块GPU上仅耗时5.……

t: Unsupervised, physics-driven normalizing flows (eight affine coupling blocks) perform variational Bayesian 1D inversion independently on Zxy and Zyx MT responses across 52 depth layers down to ~415 km.
采用包含8个仿射耦合块的无监督物理驱动归一化流，对52层深度网格的Zxy和Zyx响应独立进行一维变分贝叶斯反演。
1,773 MT stations spanning the contiguous U.S. from USArray (1,111), USMTArray (640), and USGS-GEOMAG (22) archived at the IRIS Data Management Center.
来自IRIS数据中心的1773个美国本土MT台站数据，涵盖USArray、USMTArray和USGS-GEOMAG三个…

All 1,773 stations were inverted in 5.91 hours across 10 GPUs (~150 s/station). Most stations achieve filtered misfits < 4, resolving shallow geologic provinces and western-versus-eastern U.S. lithospheric contrasts.
利用10块GPU在5.91小时内完成全部台站反演，多数台站滤波拟合差小于4，清晰揭示浅部盆地与深部东西部岩石圈电性对比。
The 1D assumption projects 3D lateral variations into artificial vertical layers, and the lack of explicit static-shift correction can bias absolute resistivity values.
一维假设会将三维异常投影为虚假垂向分层，且未做显式静位移校正可能导致局部绝对电阻率偏差。
First continental-scale probabilistic 1D MT reference ensemble (CURIE) across the contiguous U.S. generated via training-free, physics-driven normalizing flows.
首次利用无需训练数据的物理驱动归一化流构建了覆盖美国本土的大陆尺度概率大地电磁一维参考模型集CURIE。

kc: Developed CURIE, a continental-scale 1D probabilistic electrical resistivity reference model and predicted response dataset across 1,773 MT stations in the contiguous U.S.
Applied unsupervised, physics-driven normalizing flows to invert both Zxy and Zyx impedance modes in 5.91 wall-clock hours using 10 GPUs.
Established a joint misfit and phase-tensor dimensionality framework to systematically screen data quality, noise, and 3D conductivity effects across the USArray MT network.
构建了覆盖美国本土1773个MT台站的大陆尺度一维概率电阻率参考模型及预测响应数据集（CURIE）。
应用无监督物理驱动的归一化流方法，利用10块GPU在5.91小时内完成了Zxy和Zyx双模式的快速贝叶斯反演。
建立了结合数据拟合差与相位张量维数指标的评估框架，系统筛查了USArray大地电磁网的数据质量、噪声和三维电性效应。
me: Unsupervised physics-driven Normalizing Flows (NFs) with eight affine coupling blocks for variational Bayesian 1D MT inversion.
Independent 52-layer logarithmic depth parameterization (surface to ~415 km) for Zxy and Zyx apparent resistivity and phase components.
Data quality and dimensionality diagnostics combining filtered misfit, full-minus-filtered misfit difference (ΔMisfit), phase-tensor skew (|β|), and ellipticity (λ).
采用包含8个仿射耦合块的无监督物理驱动归一化流（NFs）进行一维大地电磁变分贝叶斯反演。
采用52层对数递增深度参数化（地表至约415 km），对Zxy和Zyx视电阻率与相位分量进行独立反演。
结合滤波拟合差、全数据与滤波拟合差之差（ΔMisfit）、相位张量偏度（|β|）和椭率（λ）进行数据质量与维数诊断。
de: 1,773 magnetotelluric transfer functions across the contiguous U.S. from IRIS DMC, combining USArray (1,111 stations), USMTArray (640 stations), and USGS-GEOMAG (22 stations).
Comparisons of horizontal depth slices (~600 m, ~55 km, ~220 km) against 3D continental models MECMUS and CONUS-MT-2023.
Detailed posterior profile and dimensionality analyses at representative stations (e.g., ORG06, OHM49, MNC37, TTY52, REC26, WYYS3, FL017).
来自IRIS DMC覆盖美国本土的1773个MT台站传递函数，包含USArray（1111个）、USMTArray（640个）和USGS-GEOMAG（22个）。
将不同深度切片（约600 m、55 km、220 km）与三维大陆模型MECMUS和CONUS-MT-2023进行对比验证。
对代表性台站（如ORG06、OHM49、MNC37、TTY52、REC26、WYYS3、FL017）进行了详细的后验剖面与维数特征分析。
li: 1D inversion assumption cannot resolve complex 3D lateral variations or coast effects, projecting 3D anomalies into artificial vertical layering.
No explicit static-shift correction is applied, which can bias absolute resistivity values and elevate misfits at galvanic-distorted sites.
Fixed empirical error floors (5% for apparent resistivity, 2° for phase) are used instead of original observation uncertainties, and deep (>200 km) uncertainties understate 3D modeling errors.
一维反演假设无法解析复杂的三维横向变化或海岸效应，会将三维异常投影为虚假的垂向分层。
未进行显式的静位移校正，可能导致受电流畸变影响台站的绝对电阻率值产生偏差并增大拟合差。
使用了固定的经验误差下限（视电阻率5%，相位2°）而非原始观测误差，且深部（>200 km）不确定性低估了三维建模误差。

tm.why: The paper develops a continental-scale probabilistic 1D magnetotelluric reference model using Bayesian variational inference with normalizing flows to estimate posterior resistivity distributions and uncertainties.
The resulting CURIE resistivity ensemble images lithospheric and upper-mantle electrical conductivity structures and tectonic contrasts across the contiguous United States.
It formulates an unsupervised, physics-driven generative deep learning framework (normalizing flows) to solve geophysical inverse problems rapidly across 1,773 MT stations.

ev.notes: Full 62-page GJI manuscript PDF (unedited advance article) including all text, equations, 13 figures, and 3 tables was analyzed.

sum: This study presents 2D compressional-wave velocity models of the Cascadia margin offshore Oregon using wide-angle seismic traveltime data from three profiles. The tomographic imaging reveals a porous, hydrated upper crust and dry lower crust/uppermost mantle of the subducting Juan de Fuca (JdF) plate, alongside the accretionary prism and the high-velocity Siletzia block. As the JdF plate subducts beneath Siletzia, fracturing releases pore water into the overlying wedge at 12-15 km depth, leaving the plate mostly dry as it enters the deeper mantle. Localized slow-velocity anomalies suggest deeper, localized hydration.
本研究利用俄勒冈近海三条剖面的宽角地震走时数据，构建了卡斯卡迪亚边缘的二维纵波速度模型。断层成像揭示了俯冲胡安·德富卡（JdF）板块多孔、水化的上地壳以及干燥的下地壳和最上地幔，同时清晰刻画了增生棱柱和高速度的Siletzia地块。结果表明，随着JdF板块在Siletzia下方俯冲，板块破裂并在12……

t: 2D compressional-wave velocity tomographic imaging using wide-angle seismic traveltime data.
基于宽角地震走时数据的二维纵波速度断层成像。
Wide-angle seismic traveltime data collected along three profiles offshore Oregon.
沿俄勒冈近海三条剖面采集的宽角地震走时数据。
Imaged a hydrated upper crust and dry lower crust of the JdF plate, with localized dewatering at 12-15 km depth.
成像了JdF板块的水化上地壳和干燥下地壳，并在12-15 km深度处发现局部脱水。
The study is limited to 2D profiles and cannot fully resolve 3D structural variations.
研究局限于二维剖面，无法完全解析三维结构变化。
Provides direct seismic evidence of shallow slab dehydration and fracturing at 12-15 km depth beneath Siletzia.
提供了Siletzia下方12-15 km深度处浅部板块脱水和破裂的直接地震学证据。

kc: Constructed 2D compressional-wave velocity models across three wide-angle seismic profiles offshore Oregon.
Imaged the porous, hydrated upper crust of the Juan de Fuca plate and the high-velocity Siletzia block.
Identified a localized dewatering zone at 12-15 km depth where the subducting plate fractures and releases pore water.
构建了跨越俄勒冈近海三条宽角地震剖面的二维纵波速度模型。

识别出12-15 km深度处的局部脱水带，该处俯冲板块发生破裂并释放孔隙水。

基于宽角地震数据的二维走时断层成像。

tm.why: The study performs 2D tomographic imaging of the Cascadia margin using wide-angle seismic traveltime data.
The paper investigates the crustal structure, hydration, and dehydration processes of the subducting Juan de Fuca slab.

sum: This paper presents Fourier-enhanced dynamics FWI (FED-FWI), a framework integrating three key components to address cycle skipping, initial model sensitivity, and high computational costs in full-waveform inversion. First, it applies Fourier feature mapping to coordinate inputs of an MLP parameterizing the velocity model, enriching the neural tangent kernel spectrum for sharp contrasts. Second, it uses a composite misfit coupling optimal transport and wavelet-domain terms, adaptively balanced via exponential-moving-average weighting. Third, a cosine-similarity-based optimizer stabilizes convergence by modulating update magnitudes. Implemented with automatic differentiation, FED-FWI successfully reconstructs the Marmousi II and salt models from a linear initial velocity model, outperforming optimal-transport and Sobolev-norm FWI in accuracy and convergence speed with minimal GPU memory overhead.
本文提出傅里叶增强动力学全波形反演（FED-FWI）框架。该方法利用傅里叶特征映射MLP刻画尖锐速度界面，结合最优传输与小波域多尺度混合损失，并采用余弦相似度优化器稳定收敛。在Marmousi II和盐丘模型测试中，该方法仅需线性初始模型即可实现高精度重建，收敛速度和精度均优于传统方法，且GPU显存……

t: Integrates Fourier feature mapping in coordinate MLPs, a composite optimal-transport/wavelet loss balanced by exponential moving average, and a cosine-similarity gradient optimizer.
结合坐标MLP傅里叶映射、自适应最优传输/小波混合损失与余弦相似度梯度优化器。
Synthetic 2D seismic datasets including the Marmousi II model and two salt models with strong velocity contrasts, initialized with a linear velocity gradient.
包含Marmousi II和两个强对比盐丘模型的二维合成地震数据集，采用线性速度初始化。
FED-FWI reconstructed the Marmousi II model with an SSIM of 0.804 and MSE of 0.075, outperforming optimal-transport and Sobolev-norm FWI with faster convergence.
FED-FWI重建Marmousi II的SSIM达0.804，收敛速度和精度均优于对比方法。
The method's performance and computational efficiency have only been demonstrated on synthetic 2D models, leaving its applicability to real 3D field data unverified.
方法仅在二维合成模型上进行了验证，尚未在真实三维野外数据中测试。
Synergistically combines Fourier MLP coordinate networks, adaptive composite OT-wavelet loss, and cosine-similarity optimization within an automatic-differentiation-based FWI framework.
协同结合了傅里叶MLP、自适应复合损失与余弦相似度优化。

kc: Proposed FED-FWI, a novel FWI framework integrating Fourier MLP, composite optimal-transport/wavelet loss, and cosine-similarity optimization.
Demonstrated robust reconstruction of complex velocity models (Marmousi II, salt models) starting from a simple linear initial model without assuming a known water layer.
Achieved faster convergence and higher structural similarity (SSIM of 0.804) compared to optimal-transport and Sobolev-norm FWI with minimal GPU memory overhead.
提出了FED-FWI框架，将傅里叶MLP、复合最优传输/小波损失以及余弦相似度优化有机结合。
实现了在无已知水层假设下，仅从简单线性初始模型出发对复杂速度模型（Marmousi II和盐丘模型）的鲁棒重建。
相比于最优传输和Sobolev范数FWI，在极低的GPU显存开销下实现了更快的收敛速度和更高的结构相似度（SSIM达0.804）。
me: Fourier feature mapping applied to MLP coordinate inputs to enrich the neural tangent kernel (NTK) spectrum.
Composite misfit function combining optimal transport (OT) and wavelet-domain terms, balanced dynamically using exponential moving average (EMA).
Gradient update modulation based on cosine similarity between successive gradients.
Automatic differentiation for adjoint-free gradient computation within an RNN-based forward modeling formulation.
对MLP坐标输入应用傅里叶特征映射，以丰富神经切线核（NTK）频谱。
结合最优传输（OT）与小波域多尺度损失的复合目标函数，并利用指数移动平均（EMA）进行动态平衡。
基于相邻两次梯度之间的余弦相似度来调制梯度更新幅度。
在基于循环神经网络（RNN）的前向建模公式中，利用自动微分实现无伴随方程推导的梯度计算。
de: Synthetic inversion of the Marmousi II model starting from a linear initial velocity model (1200 to 4800 m/s).
Synthetic inversion of two salt models featuring strong velocity contrasts.
Ablation studies evaluating the individual contributions of the Fourier MLP, composite loss, and cosine-similarity optimizer.
从线性初始速度模型（1200至4800 m/s）出发，对Marmousi II模型进行合成数据反演。
对两个具有强速度对比特征的盐丘模型进行合成数据反演。
通过消融实验评估傅里叶MLP、复合损失函数和余弦相似度优化器各自的贡献。
li: Evaluated only on synthetic 2D datasets (Marmousi II and salt models); performance on real-world field data remains untested.
Relies on neural network parameterization (MLP), which may scale poorly or require tuning for large-scale 3D field applications.
仅在二维合成数据集（Marmousi II和盐丘模型）上进行了评估，在真实野外数据上的表现尚未测试。
依赖于神经网络参数化（MLP），在面对大规模三维野外应用时可能存在扩展性差或调参困难的问题。

tm.why: The paper presents a new full-waveform inversion (FWI) framework designed to address cycle skipping and improve convergence.
The framework utilizes a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with Fourier feature mapping and is implemented using automatic differentiation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata retrieved from Crossref and Google search results, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This study investigates the tectonic structure and rupture kinematics of the 2021 Mw 7.2 Haiti earthquake along the transpressional Enriquillo-Plantain Garden fault zone (EPGFZ). Integrating 1.5 m resolution DEM geomorphic analysis, relocated aftershock 3D kernel densities, focal mechanisms, and ALOS-2/Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS coseismic displacements, the authors construct and compare two finite fault slip models (with and without the curved EPGFZ segments). Results show up to 1.95 m of slip along a 65°–77° N-dipping secondary fault system (the Ravine du Sud bypass fault zone), initiating with oblique thrusting in the east (87% thrust moment) and propagating westward as left-lateral strike-slip (75% strike-slip moment). Omitting the main EPGFZ bend segments degrades the data variance fit by less than 1.5%, demonstrating that the rupture bypassed the 60-km-long paired restraining-releasing bend on the EPGFZ via a fault-straightening sidewall ripout process.
本研究探讨了2021年海地Mw 7.2地震的构造模式与破裂运动学。结合1.5米高精度DEM地貌分析、余震三维核密度以及ALOS-2/Sentinel-1 InSAR和GNSS同震位移数据，作者反演并对比了包含与排除主断层（EPGFZ）弯曲段的两个有限断层滑动模型。结果表明，破裂主要发生在北倾65°–……

t: Constructed 3D fault geometries from aftershock kernel densities and performed joint InSAR/GNSS finite-fault kinematic slip inversions comparing models with and without the curved EPGFZ segments.
基于余震三维核密度构建断层几何，开展包含与排除EPGFZ弯曲段的InSAR与GNSS联合有限断层滑动反演。
Used a 1.5 m Haiti DEM, Comcat focal mechanisms, relocated aftershocks from citizen seismology and local surveys, and ALOS-2/Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS coseismic displacements.
使用海地1.5米DEM、震源机制解、重定位余震数据以及ALOS-2/Sentinel-1 InSAR和GNSS同震位移数…
North-dipping secondary faults slipped up to 1.95 m. Model B (excluding the EPGFZ bend) explains 94.2% of InSAR and 96% of GNSS variance (Mw 7.06), nearly matching Model A (95.7% and 96%).
北倾次级断层滑动达1.95米；不含EPGFZ弯曲段的模型B解释了94.2%的InSAR和96%的GNSS方差（Mw 7.…
Apparent surface rupture on Segment B is compensated by downward motion on the nearby EPGFZ, indicating a likely inversion artifact near the eastern segment.
反演中东部B段的地表破裂被邻近EPGFZ的向下滑动所补偿，表明存在反演假象。
Proposes a strike-slip bypass fault model showing the 2021 rupture circumvented a 60-km-long paired restraining-releasing bend on the main EPGFZ via sidewall ripout.
提出走滑旁路断层模型，证明2021年地震绕过了EPGFZ上60公里长的挤压-拉张双弯曲段。

kc: Identified a 2.5-km-wide zone of 65°–77° N-dipping secondary faults (Ravine du Sud bypass fault zone) using 3D aftershock kernel densities and 1.5 m DEM geomorphic mapping.
Performed joint InSAR and GNSS finite fault slip inversions comparing models with and without the main EPGFZ restraining-releasing bend segments.
Demonstrated that the 2021 Mw 7.2 Haiti earthquake bypassed the 60-km-long paired bend on the EPGFZ, acting as a sidewall ripout fault-straightening process.
利用余震三维核密度和1.5米DEM地貌测绘，识别出宽2.5公里、北倾65°–77°的次级断层带（Ravine du Sud旁路断层带）。
开展了联合InSAR与GNSS的有限断层滑动反演，对比了包含与不包含EPGFZ主断层挤压-拉张双弯曲段的模型。
证实2021年海地Mw 7.2地震绕过了EPGFZ上60公里长的双弯曲段，代表了走滑断层系统的截弯取直演化过程。
me: Tectonic geomorphology analysis and stream network offset extraction using a 1.5 m digital elevation model (DEM) resampled to 6 m.
3D kernel density estimation of relocated aftershocks to fit five rectangular cuboidal fault planes in 3D space.
Joint geodetic finite fault kinematic slip inversion using quad-tree subsampled ALOS-2 and Sentinel-1 InSAR data and GNSS coseismic displacements.
利用1.5米数字高程模型（重采样至6米）开展构造地貌分析与水系错断提取。
对重定位余震进行三维核密度估计，在三维空间中拟合五个矩形断层面。
利用四叉树降采样的ALOS-2和Sentinel-1 InSAR数据及GNSS同震位移进行联合大地测量有限断层运动学滑动反演。
de: 1.5 m raster resolution Digital Elevation Model (DEM) of Haiti.
Relocated aftershock catalogs from local seismic deployments and citizen seismology, plus Comcat focal mechanism solutions.
Coseismic InSAR displacement maps from ALOS-2 (3 tracks) and Sentinel-1 (2 tracks) and coseismic GNSS displacement vectors.
海地1.5米分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）。
来自局部地震台阵和公民地震学的重定位余震目录，以及Comcat震源机制解。
ALOS-2（3个轨道）和Sentinel-1（2个轨道）的InSAR同震位移图以及GNSS同震位移矢量。
li: Apparent surface rupture on eastern Segment B in the geodetic inversion is compensated by downward motion on the nearby EPGFZ, indicating a likely inversion artifact.
Lack of existing geological offset data along the EPGFZ prevents confirming whether the northward convex geometry originates from eastward ripout lens translation.
大地测量反演中东部B段明显的地表破裂被邻近EPGFZ的向下运动所补偿，表明这可能是反演假象。
缺乏研究区EPGFZ现有的地质错断数据，难以确认向北凸出的断层几何形态是否源于透镜体向东平移。

tm.why: The paper constructs finite fault kinematic slip models for the 2021 Mw 7.2 Haiti earthquake using InSAR, GNSS, and aftershock data.
It investigates strike-slip fault straightening processes and proposes a newly-formed bypass fault model across a paired restraining-releasing bend.
It analyzes tectonic geomorphology, transpressional plate boundary deformation, and active fault evolution in southern Haiti.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations/parameters, and all 8 figures.

sum: This paper addresses the challenges of managing and processing massive datasets from dense seismic arrays. The authors present a novel algorithm that utilizes QR decomposition to efficiently approximate array coherence. This approach enhances the time resolution of detected signals and provides robust, precise seismic signal detection in noisy environments. By identifying candidate seismic events and regions of interest, the method significantly reduces the volume of data requiring transfer and detailed analysis. The utility and computational efficiency of the algorithm are demonstrated using continuous data from a dense seismic array, offering a scalable solution for modern large-scale seismological datasets.
本文针对密集台阵海量数据处理难题，提出一种基于QR分解的高效近似台阵相干性算法。该方法能在高噪声中增强微弱信号检测，并提高时间分辨率。通过快速识别候选地震事件，该算法有效减少了需传输和分析的数据量。作者在连续记录的密集台阵数据上验证了其高效性，为大规模地震数据处理提供了实用方案。

t: A novel algorithm employing QR decomposition to efficiently approximate array coherence and enhance the time resolution of detected signals.
一种利用QR分解高效近似台阵相干性并提高检测信号时间分辨率的新算法。
Continuous seismic waveforms recorded by a dense seismic array used to identify candidate seismic events.
由密集地震台阵记录的连续地震波形数据，用于识别候选地震事件。
Efficient approximation of array coherence enabling precise signal detection and significant reduction of data transfer and analysis requirements.
高效近似台阵相干性，实现了精确的信号检测，并显著减少了数据传输与分析需求。
The detection performance and approximation accuracy may vary depending on array geometry and noise characteristics.
检测性能和近似精度可能会因台阵几何形状和噪声特性而异。
Introduction of QR decomposition to accelerate array coherence estimation, specifically tailored for big data challenges in dense arrays.
引入QR分解来加速台阵相干性估计，专门针对密集台阵中的大数据挑战。

kc: Developed a novel, computationally efficient algorithm using QR decomposition to approximate array coherence.
Improved the temporal resolution of seismic signal detection in dense arrays.
Provided a practical framework for data reduction and event screening in large-scale seismic networks.
开发了一种利用QR分解近似台阵相干性的新型高效计算算法。
提高了密集台阵中地震信号检测的时间分辨率。
为大规模地震网络中的数据缩减和事件筛选提供了实用框架。
me: QR decomposition for low-rank approximation of the array covariance/coherence matrix.
Array coherence analysis for multi-channel signal detection.
用于台阵协方差/相干矩阵低秩近似的QR分解。
用于多通道信号检测的台阵相干性分析。
de: Continuous seismic data recorded by a dense seismic array to detect candidate seismic events.
使用密集地震台阵记录的连续地震数据进行候选地震事件检测。
li: Performance and approximation accuracy may depend on the spatial density and geometry of the array.
算法性能和近似精度可能依赖于台阵的空间密度和几何分布。

tm.why: The paper focuses on leveraging array coherence in dense seismic arrays to manage large datasets and detect signals.
The primary application of the proposed QR-based coherence algorithm is seismic signal detection and identifying candidate events.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and Crossref metadata.

sum: This study performs 3D inversions of airborne magnetic and full tensor gravity gradiometry (FTGG) data (including Tz and Tz residual) over the Paleoproterozoic Yaouré Greenstone Belt in Ivory Coast using the Tomofast-x 2.0 code. Despite low magnetic inclination (-13°) and scarce outcrop data, the inversions recover 3D density contrast and magnetic susceptibility distributions using Haar wavelet compression, distance weighting, and ADMM disjoint interval bound positivity constraints. Isosurface analysis and 2D vertical slices across the Koudougou-Benou and Tokorossou-Benou faults divide the belt into a high-susceptibility northern domain and a high-density-contrast southern domain. Sedimentary and volcano-sedimentary rocks unexpectedly exhibit higher magnetic susceptibility than some intrusions and basalts. The novelty lies in systematically ranking unit physical properties and extracting magnetic anomaly dips to build an artificial structural map, providing a quantitative first-order framework to constrain implicit geological models and subsequent geophysical inversions.
本研究利用Tomofast-x 2.0对科特迪瓦Yaouré绿岩带的航空磁测和全张量重力梯度（FTGG、Tz及Tz残差）数据进行三维反演。针对低磁倾角和露头匮乏的挑战，采用小波压缩、距离加权和ADMM正值约束恢复了地下密度与磁化率分布。通过等值面和跨越主断层的二维剖面分析，识别出北部高磁化率域和南部……

t: 3D potential field inversions were conducted using Tomofast-x 2.0 with distance weighting, Haar wavelet sensitivity matrix compression (0.05 rate), and ADMM disjoint interval bound constraints (0 to 1 SI positivity) for magnetics.
使用Tomofast-x 2.0进行三维位场反演，结合距离加权、Haar小波矩阵压缩（0.05比率）及ADMM正值边界约…
Airborne magnetic (TMA) and full tensor gravity gradiometry (FTGG, Tz, and Tz residual) data acquired in 2021 over 468 km² with 100 m line spacing and 80 m clearance, downsampled to 49,735 points.
2021年采集的468平方公里航空磁测（TMA）和全张量重力梯度（FTGG、Tz、Tz残差）数据，降采样至49,735点…

Inverted magnetic susceptibility ranged from 0 to 0.24 SI, while density contrasts spanned -295 to 299 kg/m³ (FTGG), revealing a magnetic northern domain and a dense southern domain separated by the KB fault.
反演磁化率范围0–0.24 SI，FTGG密度反差-295至299 kg/m³，揭示了以KB断层为界的北磁南密两个区域。
The inversions lack local petrophysical constraints and use a 100 m cell size that cannot resolve deposit-scale anomalies or small intrusions, leaving inherent non-uniqueness and dip ambiguities.
缺乏实地物性约束，且100米网格无法分辨矿体尺度异常或小型侵入体，存在多解性与倾角不确定性。

Quantifies 3D unconstrained inversions into a relative petrophysical ranking table and an artificial structural dip map to serve as prior constraints for implicit geological modeling and subsequent inversions.
将三维反演结果量化为岩性物性相对排序表和人工构造倾角图，作为后续隐式建模和反演的先验约束。

kc: Recovered 3D magnetic susceptibility and density contrast models of the Yaouré Greenstone Belt from airborne magnetic and FTGG data at low magnetic latitude.
Identified two distinct geophysical domains separated by the Koudougou-Benou fault and validated a buried granodiorite intrusion east of the Yaouré gold deposit.
Established a relative petrophysical ranking table for seven mapped lithotypes and constructed an artificial structural dip map from 2D susceptibility slices.
利用低磁纬度航空磁测和全张量重力梯度数据，恢复了Yaouré绿岩带的三维磁化率和密度反差模型。
识别出以Koudougou-Benou断层为界的两个地球物理域，并验证了Yaouré金矿东侧的隐伏花岗闪长岩体。
建立了研究区七种岩性的相对岩石物理性质排序表，并由二维磁化率剖面提取异常倾角构建了人工构造图。
me: 3D potential-field inversion using Tomofast-x 2.0 on a 269 x 301 x 38 grid (100 m core cells) incorporating ALOS PALSAR topography.
Haar wavelet sensitivity matrix compression (5% retention rate) and distance weighting (cubic for FTGG and magnetics).
Disjoint interval bound constraint (DIBC) via ADMM to enforce magnetic susceptibility positivity between 0 and 1 SI.
Extraction of 97.5th/2.5th percentile isosurfaces and Euclidean geometry dip calculations with uncertainty propagation along 2D vertical slices.
使用Tomofast-x 2.0在结合ALOS PALSAR地形的269 x 301 x 38网格（核心网格100米）上进行三维位场反演。
采用Haar小波灵敏度矩阵压缩（保留5%）和距离加权约束（FTGG和磁法采用三次方衰减）。
通过ADMM算法应用不相交区间边界约束（DIBC），将磁化率强制约束在0到1 SI的正值区间。
提取97.5%和2.5%分位数等值面，并在二维垂直剖面上利用欧氏几何与误差传播公式计算磁异常倾向和倾角。
de: 2021 Bell Geospace airborne survey over a 468 km² area in central Ivory Coast with 100 m line spacing and 80 m terrain clearance.
Total Magnetic Anomaly (TMA) data downsampled to 49,735 points at 100 m spacing.
Full Tensor Gravity Gradiometry (FTGG) six tensor components, derived vertical gravity (Tz), and high-pass filtered residual (Tz Res, 10 km cutoff) downsampled to 49,735 points.
2021年Bell Geospace在科特迪瓦中部468平方公里区域采集的航空测量数据（测线间距100米，平均离地高度80米）。
降采样至100米网格间距（共49,735个数据点）的总磁异常（TMA）数据。
降采样至49,735个点的全张量重力梯度（FTGG）六个分量、导出的垂直重力异常（Tz）及10公里高通滤波残差（Tz Res）。
li: Inversions are largely unconstrained petrophysically due to lack of local rock property measurements, leading to non-uniqueness and interpretation ambiguity.
The 100 m core cell size cannot resolve mine-scale features around the Yaouré deposit or small late calc-alkaline intrusions.
Magnetic inversions assume induced magnetization only, ignoring potential remanent magnetization.
由于缺乏研究区实测岩石物理数据，反演在岩石物理上基本无约束，存在多解性和解释模糊性。
100米的核心网格尺寸无法分辨Yaouré矿区尺度的精细构造或小型晚期钙碱性侵入体。
磁法反演仅假设感应磁化，未考虑潜在的剩余磁化影响。

tm.why: The paper characterizes the subsurface 3D density and magnetic susceptibility distributions and structural geometry of the Paleoproterozoic Yaouré Greenstone Belt in the West African Craton.
The study applies 3D potential field inverse modeling using wavelet compression, distance weighting, and alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) disjoint interval bound constraints.

ev.notes: Full 60-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including all text, equations, Appendices A and B, 11 figures, and 3 tables was analyzed.

sum: This study investigates strain localization and lithospheric thinning across the East African Rift System (EARS) by combining a high-resolution full-waveform tomography model of Africa with a comprehensive compilation of active- and passive-source crustal and lithospheric structure models. The authors convert vertically polarized shear-wave speeds (VSV) to mantle temperatures, fit steady-state geotherms to map the 1300 °C thermal lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB), and calculate integrated lithospheric yield strength, crustal and mantle thinning factors, and a new deformation decoupling parameter (ratio of mantle to crustal thinning). They find widespread lithospheric mantle necking across both branches that reduces lithospheric strength to the level of far-field tectonic stresses (~5 TN/m). While the magma-rich eastern branch shows coupled crustal and mantle thinning, the magma-poor western branch exhibits segments with anomalously high decoupling (up to 21.3), driven by structural inheritance, lithospheric foundering/delamination along mid-lithospheric discontinuities, and deep melt lubrication.
本研究结合非洲高分辨率全波形层析成像模型及主、被动源地震地壳与岩石圈结构汇编数据，探究了东非裂谷系（EARS）的岩石圈减薄机制。通过将垂直极化横波速度（VSV）转换为地幔温度并拟合稳态地温线，确定了1300 °C热岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）、岩石圈屈服强度、壳幔减薄因子及新定义的变形解耦参数。研究……

t: VSV wave speeds are converted to mantle temperatures via Newton optimization, fitted with steady-state geotherms (30–90 mW/m²) to find the 1300 °C thermal LAB, and used to compute integrated yield strength and thinning decoupling factors.
通过牛顿优化将VSV转换为地幔温度，拟合稳态地温线确定1300 °C热LAB，进而计算岩石圈屈服强度及壳幔减薄解耦因子。

Combines the van Herwaarden et al. (2023) anisotropic full-waveform tomography model of Africa (minimum period 35 s) with compiled active- and passive-source seismic models of sediment thickness, Moho depth, Vp/Vs, and NVGs.
结合非洲板块各向异性全波形反演模型（最短周期35秒）与汇编的主、被动源沉积层厚度、莫霍面、Vp/Vs和NVG数据。

Crustal thinning factors reach ~3 in Urema Graben and Turkana, while lithospheric mantle thinning reaches ~22 and deformation decoupling reaches 21.3 in the Rungwe Volcanic Province, reducing rift lithospheric strength to ~5 TN/m.
地壳减薄因子最高达~3，而西支Rungwe火山省岩石圈地幔减薄达~22、解耦因子达21.3，裂谷岩石圈强度降至~5 TN…

Pre-rift thicknesses are uncertain due to complex tectonic inheritance and unmodeled magmatic underplating, while LAB depths are artificially bounded between 56.8 and 250 km using uniform thermo-rheological parameters.
裂谷前厚度受构造继承性和未建模岩浆底垫影响存在不确定性，且采用统一热流变参数将LAB限制在56.8至250 km之间。

Introduces the quantitative deformation decoupling factor across the entire EARS, demonstrating that lithospheric mantle necking precedes crustal necking and highlighting widespread decoupled thinning in magma-poor rifts.
首次在全东非裂谷系引入定量变形解耦因子，证实岩石圈地幔颈缩先于地壳颈缩，揭示贫岩浆裂谷广泛的解耦减薄机制。

kc: Compiled a comprehensive dataset of sediment thickness, Moho depth, crustal Vp/Vs, and mantle negative velocity gradients (NVGs) from active and passive seismic studies across the EARS.
Derived high-resolution mantle temperature, thermal LAB (1300 °C isotherm), and integrated lithospheric yield strength maps for the EARS from an anisotropic FWI tomography model.
Introduced a quantitative deformation decoupling parameter (ratio of lithospheric mantle to crustal thinning factors) and demonstrated that lithospheric mantle necking precedes crustal necking.
Revealed strong decoupled thinning along segments of the magma-poor western branch, attributing it to inheritance, lithospheric foundering/delamination, and melt-induced shear lubrication.
汇编了东非裂谷系（EARS）主、被动源地震研究的沉积物厚度、莫霍面深度、地壳Vp/Vs及地幔负速度梯度（NVG）综合数据集。
基于各向异性全波形反演层析成像模型，推导了高分辨率地幔温度、热LAB（1300 °C等温线）和积分岩石圈屈服强度图。
提出了定量的变形解耦参数（岩石圈地幔与地壳减薄因子之比），证明了演化裂谷中岩石圈地幔颈缩先于地壳颈缩。
揭示了贫岩浆西支部分裂谷段存在强烈的解耦减薄，将其归因于先存构造继承性、岩石圈拆沉/滴落以及熔体诱导的剪切润滑。
me: Empirical conversion of vertically polarized shear wave speeds (VSV) to mantle temperature using Newton-Raphson optimization.
Steady-state continental geotherm fitting via directed grid search over surface heat flow (30–90 mW/m²) to map the thermal LAB at the 1300 °C isotherm.
Calculation of 1D yield stress envelopes and depth-integrated lithospheric yield strength using brittle and ductile creep rheology.
Estimation of crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors and inverse-uncertainty-weighted deformation decoupling factors across rift segments.
利用牛顿-拉夫逊优化方法将垂直极化横波速度（VSV）经验转换为地幔温度。
通过在30–90 mW/m²地表热流范围内进行定向网格搜索拟合稳态大陆地温线，以1300 °C等温线确定热LAB。
基于脆性和韧性蠕变流变学计算一维屈服应力包络线及深度积分的岩石圈屈服强度。
估算各裂谷段的地壳与岩石圈地幔减薄因子，以及基于逆不确定度加权的变形解耦因子。
de: Anisotropic full-waveform tomography model of the African Plate (van Herwaarden et al., 2023) using minimum waveform periods of 35 s.
Compilation of passive-source receiver function models (Moho depths, crustal Vp/Vs, and Sp/Ps negative velocity gradients) and AFROMOHO grid.
Digitized 2D wide-angle seismic reflection/refraction profiles (e.g., KRISP, EAGLE, PAMELA) and active-source sediment thickness maps, supplemented by CRUST1.0.
最小波形周期为35秒的非洲板块各向异性全波形层析成像模型（van Herwaarden et al., 2023）。
被动源接收函数模型汇编（莫霍面深度、地壳Vp/Vs及Sp/Ps负速度梯度）与AFROMOHO网格数据。
数字化二维广角地震反射/折射剖面（如KRISP、EAGLE、PAMELA）及主动源沉积物厚度图，并由CRUST1.0补充。
li: Pre-rift crustal and lithospheric mantle thicknesses are estimated from maximum flanking values, which may overestimate thinning factors if cratonic thicknesses are applied to mobile belts or if magmatic underplating is present.
Steady-state geotherm and strength calculations rely on uniform, standard thermo-rheological parameters across the EARS, imposing hard LAB bounds of 56.8 km and 250 km.
Active-source sediment thickness coverage is sparse outside major western branch basins, requiring fallback to coarser CRUST1.0 estimates.
裂谷前地壳和岩石圈地幔厚度由裂谷侧翼最大值估算，若将克拉通厚度用于活动带或存在岩浆底垫，可能会高估减薄因子。
稳态地温线和强度计算在整个东非裂谷系采用了统一的标准热-流变参数，并设定了56.8 km和250 km的LAB硬性上下限。
主动源沉积物厚度数据在西支主要盆地外较为稀疏，需依赖分辨率较低的CRUST1.0模型进行补充。

tm.why: The study investigates crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning, thermal LAB, and integrated lithospheric yield strength across the East African Rift System to understand continental rifting geodynamics.
The paper extensively compiles and analyzes Moho depths, crustal Vp/Vs ratios, and negative velocity gradients (LAB/MLDs) derived from passive-source receiver function studies.
The core mantle temperature and thermal LAB models are derived directly from a high-resolution regional full-waveform inversion shear-wave speed model of the African Plate.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF from ETH Zurich Research Collection / Geoscience Frontiers was read and analyzed, including all equations, 12 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This report evaluates deterministic machine learning models for predicting explosion yield (W) and height of burst (HOB) by fusing seismic ground-motion (displacement, velocity) and acoustic overpressure (impulse, duration) observations alongside range and categorical rock type. Using a dataset of 34 independent explosions (392 seismic and 411 acoustic records), the authors implement strict shot-grouped five-fold cross-validation to prevent station-level data leakage. They compare four non-neural baselines (linear, ridge, random forest, gradient boosting), a collocated-pair multilayer perceptron (Model 1), and a shot-level set-fusion neural network (Model 2) capable of handling variable observation counts and missing modalities. Seismic-acoustic fusion consistently improves yield estimation: the complete Model 2 with log10(W) parameterization achieves the lowest out-of-fold yield RMSE of 2,724 kg (R² = 0.970), outperforming the best ridge baseline (3,832 kg). For HOB, gradient boosting with fused features performs best (2.667 m RMSE, R² = 0.470).
本报告评估了融合地震动（位移、速度）与声超压（冲量、持续时间）观测、传播距离及分类岩性来确定性预测爆炸当量（W）和爆高（HOB）的机器学习方法。基于34次独立爆炸的803条记录，作者采用严格按爆炸事件分组的五折交叉验证防止数据泄露，对比了四种非神经网络基线、同址配对多层感知机（Model 1）及处理……

t: Compares four non-neural baselines, a collocated-pair MLP (Model 1), and a shot-level set-fusion network (Model 2) using separate modality encoders and mean pooling under shot-grouped five-fold cross-validation.
在按事件分组的五折交叉验证下，对比四种非神经基线、配对MLP（Model 1）及集合融合网络（Model 2）。
Uses 34 independent explosions comprising 392 seismic and 411 acoustic records (803 total), with displacement, velocity, impulse, duration, range, and categorical rock type (Soft, Hard, Wet).
使用34次独立爆炸的392条地震和411条声学记录，包含位移、速度、冲量、持续时间、距离和分类岩性。
Seismic-acoustic fusion lowers ridge yield RMSE from 12,239 kg to 3,832 kg; Model 2 with log10(W) achieves 2,724 kg RMSE (R² = 0.970), while gradient boosting reaches 2.667 m HOB RMSE.
Model 2结合log10(W)取得最佳当量预测（RMSE 2,724 kg，R²=0.970）；梯度提升树取得最佳爆…
Constrained by only 34 independent shots, skewed yield distribution toward <1000 kg, sparse coverage at extreme HOB, missing acoustic data for four shots, and no uncertainty quantification.
受限于仅34个独立样本、高当量及极端爆高样本稀疏、4次事件缺失声学数据且未量化不确定性。

Introduces strict shot-grouped validation, a pairing audit avoiding artificial joins, categorical rock type, missing-modality handling, and a shot-level set-fusion neural network retaining all unmatched observations.
引入事件分组交叉验证、配对审计、分类岩性、缺失模态处理以及保留全部非配对记录的集合融合网络。

Developed a shot-level set-fusion neural network (Model 2) that accommodates variable station counts, unmatched records, and missing modalities.
Demonstrated that seismic-acoustic fusion reduces ridge regression yield RMSE by 66% compared to single-modality inputs, with Model 2 achieving 2,724 kg RMSE (R² = 0.970).
Showed that categorical rock type and target parameterizations (W, W^1/3, log10(W)) distinctly impact yield versus HOB prediction accuracy.
审计了震声数据配对逻辑，并在34次爆炸上实施严格的事件分组交叉验证，防止同事件多台站记录引起的数据泄露。
开发了事件级集合融合神经网络（Model 2），能够处理可变台站数量、未配对记录和缺失模态。
证明震声融合使岭回归当量预测RMSE较单模态降低66%，且Model 2取得2,724 kg的最低RMSE（R² = 0.970）。
揭示了分类岩性特征和目标参数化方式（W、W^1/3、log10(W)）对当量和爆高预测精度的差异化影响。

Non-neural baseline regressors: ordinary least squares, L2 ridge regression, random forest, and gradient boosting.
Compact multilayer perceptron (Model 1, 8->16->8->2 architecture) trained on 105 exact one-to-one collocated seismoacoustic pairs.
Shot-level set-fusion network (Model 2) using separate modality encoders, mean pooling, observation counts, availability flags, and one-hot rock type.
Comparison of three physics-guided yield target transformations: raw W, cube-root W^1/3, and log10(W).
按爆炸事件分组的五折交叉验证，在折内独立进行数值插补、特征缩放和目标z-score标准化。
非神经网络基线回归器：普通最小二乘法、L2岭回归、随机森林和梯度提升树。
紧凑型多层感知机（Model 1，8->16->8->2架构），基于105对严格同址的震声观测数据进行训练。
事件级集合融合网络（Model 2），采用独立模态编码器、均值池化，并拼接观测数量、模态可用性标志和独热编码岩性。
对比三种物理引导的当量目标变换：原始W、立方根W^1/3和对数log10(W)。

Seismic features (displacement, velocity), acoustic features (impulse, duration), sensor range (km/m), and categorical rock type (Soft, Hard, Wet).
Representation A subset containing 105 unambiguous one-to-one collocated seismic-acoustic pairs across 21 shots.

Strong skewness toward low-yield shots (<1000 kg) and sparse coverage at extreme buried or elevated HOB values.

sum: This study maps the water content at the base of the mantle transition zone (MTZ) by combining mineral physics constraints on hydrous pyrolite with global seismic observations of velocity structure and 660-km discontinuity topography. The authors find an average global MTZ base water content of ~0.14 wt%, with significant hydration anomalies (>0.5 wt%) beneath parts of Asia, including the Mongol–Okhotsk suture zone, the Central Asian Orogenic Belt, and the Tethyan orogenic domain. By linking these anomalies to plate reconstructions since 410 Ma, the study demonstrates that ancient subduction processes have actively delivered water to the deep mantle, providing a direct link between historical plate tectonics and present-day deep mantle hydration.
本研究结合含水地幔岩的矿物物理约束与全球地震学观测（速度结构和660千米不连续面地形），绘制了地幔过渡带（MTZ）底部的含水量分布。结果显示全球平均含水量约为0.14 wt%，但在亚洲部分地区（如蒙古-鄂霍茨克缝合带、中亚造山带和特提斯造山域）存在显著的高含水异常（>0.5 wt%）。结合410 M……

结合含水地幔岩矿物物理约束与全球地震速度结构及660千米不连续面地形绘制含水量。
Global seismic velocity models, 660-km discontinuity topography data, and tectonic reconstructions of Asian subduction zones since 410 Ma.
全球地震速度模型、660千米不连续面地形数据以及410 Ma以来亚洲俯冲带板块重建。
Reveals an average global MTZ base water content of ~0.14 wt%, with localized anomalies exceeding 0.5 wt% beneath ancient Asian subduction zones.

Relies on the resolution of global seismic models and potential uncertainties in mineral physics parameters of hydrous phases at high pressures.

Identified pronounced hydration anomalies (>0.5 wt%) beneath major Asian orogenic belts.

sum: Traditional landslide area–volume scaling relations often suffer from order-of-magnitude errors because they conflate erosional and depositional domains and ignore planform geometry. This study introduces a morphology-informed framework using neural-guided symbolic regression (PySR) coupled with a residual multi-layer perceptron to estimate volumetric erosion from 2D landslide polygons. By separating source areas (A_S) from total footprints, the authors discover a dimensionally consistent scaling law incorporating dimensionless relative width (W_T). Trained on a 20% spatial hold-out from the 2016 Mw 7.8 Kaikōura earthquake inventory (~10,000 landslides), the model achieves R² = 0.932 on unseen basins and estimates 54.9 Mm³ cumulative erosion versus 56.5 Mm³ measured. Applied without recalibration to the 2018 Mw 6.6 Hokkaidō earthquake (~600 landslides), it achieves R² = 0.925, and provides low-uncertainty blind inference (1.95 Mm³) for 32 landslides from the 2013 Lushan earthquake, remaining robust across polygon simplifications up to 50 m.
传统滑坡面积-体积标度律常因混淆侵蚀与堆积区而产生巨大误差。本研究提出结合符号回归（PySR）与残差神经网络的形态感知框架，利用二维滑坡多边形估算侵蚀体积。通过分离源区面积（A_S）与总迹线，发现了引入无量纲相对宽度（W_T）的量纲一致标度律。模型仅用2016年凯库拉7.8级地震20%空间样本训练，……

t: Evolutionary symbolic regression discovers a low-complexity equation relating source volume to source area and dimensionless total-footprint width, which serves as a symbolic backbone anchored to a small residual neural network.
利用进化符号回归发现关联源区面积与无量纲相对宽度的低复杂度公式，作为残差神经网络的符号骨干。

Evaluated on ~10,000 co-seismic landslides from the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake, ~600 landslides from the 2018 Hokkaidō earthquake, and 32 hand-mapped landslides from the 2013 Lushan earthquake, with separated source and runout polygons.
采用2016凯库拉（约1万处）、2018北海道（约600处）和2013芦山地震（32处）分离源区与堆积区的同震滑坡数据。
Achieved R² = 0.932 on the 80% unseen Kaikōura test set (predicting 54.9 Mm³ vs. 56.5 Mm³ measured), R² = 0.925 in zero-shot transfer to Hokkaidō, and 1.95 Mm³ cumulative volume for Lushan.
凯库拉未知测试集R²达0.932（估算54.9 Mm³，实测56.5 Mm³），零样本迁移至北海道R²达0.925，芦山…
Performance drops for massive crystalline plutonic rocks (R² ≈ 0.63) and very shallow slides (<1 m), and transfer to rainfall-induced flow-type landslides requires caution.
块状深成岩（R²≈0.63）与小于1米极浅滑坡性能下降，且难以直接迁移至降雨流动型滑坡。

Introduces a dimensionless total-footprint relative width descriptor via neural-guided symbolic regression to correct first-order source area–volume scaling without requiring external environmental or DEM datasets.
通过神经引导符号回归引入无量纲总迹线相对宽度，无需外部环境数据即可修正传统面积-体积标度律。

kc: Discovered a parsimonious, dimensionally consistent symbolic scaling relation combining source area (A_S) and dimensionless total-footprint relative width (W_T).
Developed a hybrid symbolic-neural architecture that anchors predictions to first-order geomorphic scaling while learning local residuals.
Demonstrated high zero-shot transferability from the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake (R² = 0.932) to the 2018 Hokkaidō earthquake (R² = 0.925) and blind inference on the 2013 Lushan earthquake.
Showed via polygon-generalization and SHAP/permutation analyses that the A_S and W_T formulation remains stable up to 50 m resolution and adapts across failure depths.
发现了结合滑坡源区面积（A_S）和总迹线无量纲相对宽度（W_T）的简洁且量纲一致的符号标度关系。
开发了混合符号-神经网络架构，将预测锚定于一阶地貌标度律并同时学习局部残差。
验证了模型从2016年凯库拉地震（R² = 0.932）到2018年北海道地震（R² = 0.925）的高零样本迁移能力，并应用于2013年芦山地震盲推断。
通过多边形简化和SHAP/置换分析证明，A_S与W_T公式在50米分辨率内保持稳定，并能适应不同破坏深度。
me: Delineated mapped landslide polygons into source planform (head scarp) and total planform (source + runout) to extract candidate morphometric indices.
Applied evolutionary symbolic regression (PySR) with minimalist grammar and L0 sparsity penalty to identify the optimal Pareto-front volume expression.
Attached a residual multi-layer perceptron (MLP) with a symbolic parameter anchor loss to refine predictions without unconstrained drift.
Used 5-model bootstrap ensembles for epistemic uncertainty quantification and SHAP / permutation importance to evaluate depth-dependent feature attributions.
将测绘滑坡多边形划分为源区平面（后缘陡坎）和总平面（源区+运动堆积区），提取候选形态测量指标。
应用具有极简语法和L0稀疏惩罚的进化符号回归（PySR），识别帕累托前沿上的最优体积表达式。
附加带有符号参数锚定损失的残差多层感知机（MLP），在避免无约束参数漂移的同时微调预测。
使用5模型自助集成量化认知不确定性，并利用SHAP和置换重要性评估随深度变化的特征贡献。
de: 2016 Mw 7.8 Kaikōura, New Zealand co-seismic inventory (~10,000 non-coalescent polygons with DEM-of-Difference volumes; 20% basin hold-out for training, 80% for testing).
2018 Mw 6.6 Eastern Iburi Hokkaidō, Japan inventory (~600 non-coalescent tephra landslides with DEM difference volumes) for zero-shot transfer evaluation.
2013 Mw 6.6 Lushan, China earthquake catalog (32 hand-mapped landslides without ground-truth volumes) for blind volumetric inference.
Polygon boundary simplification experiments at 0, 5, 10, 20, and 50 m resolutions to test robustness against mapping resolution disparities.
2016年新西兰凯库拉Mw 7.8级同震滑坡目录（约10,000个非合并多边形及高程差体积；20%流域用于训练，80%用于测试）。
2018年日本北海道胆振东部Mw 6.6级地震目录（约600个火山碎屑滑坡及DEM差分体积），用于零样本迁移评估。
2013年中国芦山Mw 6.6级地震目录（32个手绘滑坡，无真实体积观测），用于盲体积推断。
在0、5、10、20和50米分辨率下进行多边形边界简化实验，测试对测绘分辨率差异的稳健性。
li: Predictive performance noticeably diminishes (R² ≈ 0.63) for massive, crystalline basic plutonic rocks where 2D footprints decouple from deep structural failure depths.
Predictive skill decreases for very shallow slides (h < 1 m) due to DEM resolution limits.
Calibrated exclusively on co-seismic landslides; transfer to rainfall-induced flow-type landslides requires caution due to pore pressure and fluid entrainment effects.
对于块状结晶基性深成岩，由于二维迹线与受深部结构控制的破坏深度脱钩，预测性能明显下降（R² ≈ 0.63）。
受数字高程模型（DEM）分辨率限制，对极浅层滑坡（h < 1 m）的预测能力有所下降。
模型仅在同震滑坡上校准，由于孔隙水压力和流体夹带效应，迁移至降雨诱发的流动型滑坡需谨慎。

tm.why: The paper investigates surface mass-wasting processes and volumetric erosion from earthquake-triggered landslides across multiple co-seismic inventories.
The study focuses on constraining regional sediment budgets and post-disaster geohazard assessments for co-seismic landslides triggered by major earthquakes.
It develops a neural-guided symbolic regression and residual MLP framework to model co-seismic landslide volumes.

sum: This paper presents a hybrid uncertainty quantification (UQ) strategy for array-based surface wave tomography, addressing the underestimation of posterior uncertainty in data-sparse regions caused by regularization. The method integrates data-driven bootstrap resampling with model-based resolution matrix correction to debias bootstrap variance. Applied to ambient noise data from the ChinArray-Himalaya project, multimodal dispersion curves were extracted using the frequency-Bessel (F-J) transform. Semi-synthetic tests show that this hybrid approach successfully distinguishes between data gaps (null-spaces) and data conflicts, unlike conventional raw bootstrap or analytical methods. Using this resolution-corrected uncertainty to weight subsequent 1D shear-wave velocity inversions suppresses regularization artifacts, providing a robust statistical foundation for 3D crustal structural modeling.
本文提出一种针对阵列面波断层成像的混合不确定性量化（UQ）策略，解决了正则化导致数据稀疏区后验不确定性被低估的问题。该方法将数据驱动的自助法（Bootstrap）重采样与基于模型的断层成像分辨率矩阵相结合，对自助法方差进行去偏差修正。该工作利用频率-贝塞尔（F-J）变换提取ChinArray-喜马拉……

t: A hybrid uncertainty quantification strategy integrating data-driven bootstrap resampling with model-based resolution matrix correction to debias bootstrap variance in regularized surface wave tomography.
结合数据驱动的自助法重采样与基于模型的断层成像分辨率矩阵修正的混合不确定性量化方法。
Ambient noise data from the ChinArray-Himalaya project and semi-synthetic datasets used to test the robustness of the uncertainty quantification workflow.
来自ChinArray-喜马拉雅项目的背景噪声数据以及用于测试不确定性量化工作流鲁棒性的半合成数据集。
The hybrid strategy successfully distinguishes data gaps from data conflicts, and weighting subsequent 1D S-wave velocity inversions with this uncertainty suppresses regularization artifacts.
混合策略成功区分了数据缺失与数据冲突，利用该不确定性约束后续一维剪切波速度反演显著抑制了正则化伪影。
The method relies on linearized resolution matrix approximations, which may not fully account for strong non-linearities in complex velocity inversions.

sum: Following the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake on the Sagaing Fault, minute-scale monitoring at the Xiaguan thermal spring on the Red River Fault (~600 km away) recorded a transition from intermittent preseismic fluctuations to a sustained multi-month helium concentration increase (>1400 ppm vs. ~550 ppm baseline). Hydrometeorological controls (rainfall, barometric pressure, groundwater level) and instrumental drift fail to explain this trend. Complementary He–Ne isotope measurements at the nearby Lanxiang spring (~0.1 Ra) demonstrate that the added helium is predominantly radiogenic and crustal, without resolvable mantle input. Layered viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress modeling using Burgers rheology reveals positive coseismic and time-dependent postseismic stress loading (~3 kPa coseismic; ~5.5 kPa over 20 years) on the Red River Fault. This prolonged viscoelastic stress transfer, combined with permeability maintenance from local M4.9–5.3 earthquakes, explains the sustained far-field mobilisation of stored crustal helium.
本研究结合分钟级高分辨率泉气氦浓度监测、稀有气体He-Ne同位素分析、STL与连续小波变换及Burgers流变分层粘弹性库仑应力建模，研究了2025年缅甸Mw 7.7级地震对约600公里外红河断裂带流体地球化学的远场影响。下关温泉氦浓度在震前呈间歇性高频波动，震后则持续数月上升（从约550 ppm升……

t: Applied Seasonal-Trend Decomposition (STL) and Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) to 1-min helium records, combined with He–Ne isotope mixing analysis and Burgers-rheology viscoelastic Coulomb failure stress modeling (PSGRN/PSCMP).
对分钟级氦记录应用STL和连续小波变换，结合He-Ne同位素分析与Burgers粘弹性库仑应力建模。

Minute-scale gas-phase helium and groundwater records at Xiaguan spring, meteorological records, regional seismicity catalog, and discrete pre/post-earthquake He–Ne isotope samples from Lanxiang spring.

震后氦从~550升至>1400 ppm（保持~0.1 Ra壳源比值），红河断裂同震及20年震后库仑应力加载达~3和~5.…
Continuous monitoring was restricted to helium concentration at one spring, lacking co-located multi-component gas records (e.g., CO2, Rn, He/Ar) or continuous in situ isotope measurements.

Provides a unified framework linking sustained far-field radiogenic crustal helium enrichment (600 km away) to prolonged postseismic viscoelastic relaxation and local earthquake permeability maintenance.

Constrained the helium provenance using He–Ne isotopes (~0.1 Ra), proving selective mobilisation of stored radiogenic crustal helium without new mantle input.
Demonstrated via layered viscoelastic Coulomb stress modeling that lower-crustal relaxation plus local M4.9–5.3 earthquakes sustain far-field fault loading and permeability.
记录了距2025年缅甸Mw 7.7级地震约600公里的下关温泉在震后数月持续的氦浓度升高（从~550 ppm升至>1400 ppm）。
利用He-Ne同位素（~0.1 Ra）约束了氦来源，证明其为既有放射性壳源氦的选择性活化，无明显地幔输入增加。
通过分层粘弹性库仑应力建模证明，下地壳松弛与局部M4.9–5.3地震共同维持了远场断层加载与渗透率。

Hydrometeorological cross-correlation, Theil–Sen slope estimation, and out-of-sample nonlinear regression to rule out barometric, rainfall, groundwater, and drift artefacts.
Noble gas (He–Ne) isotopic mass spectrometry and gas chromatography to discriminate crustal, mantle, and atmospheric end-members.
Viscoelastic-gravitational dislocation modeling (PSGRN/PSCMP) with Burgers body rheology to compute coseismic and decadal postseismic Coulomb failure stress changes (ΔCFS).
对1分钟采样率的氦浓度时间序列应用季节-趋势分解（STL）和连续小波变换（CWT），以分离基线趋势与瞬态频谱闪烁。
采用水文气象互相关、Theil–Sen斜率估计及样本外非线性回归，排除气压、降雨、地下水位及仪器漂移伪影。

兰香（LX）温泉震前和震后的离散气体组分（CO2、N2、O2、He）及He-Ne同位素比值。

The work links coseismic slip and supershear dynamic stresses from the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake to regional Coulomb stress perturbations and triggered seismicity.

sum: This study analyzes seismic recordings spaced every 100–200 m along Tahoma Creek at Mount Rainier to capture the evolution of a debris flow triggered by a glacial outburst on 15 August 2023. As the flow deposited ~24,000 m³ of material, the seismic signal onset elongated (delay to peak amplitude increased from 100 to 300 s), the peak frequency increased by over 20 Hz, and energy below 20 Hz faded. These spectral and temporal changes indicate a transition from a debris flow to a hyperconcentrated flow due to the deposition of larger particles and changes in sediment concentration. The findings demonstrate that seismic frequency content is highly sensitive to grain size and sediment concentration, challenging assumptions in existing physical models of debris flows.
本研究利用雷尼尔山沿线密集地震台网，记录了2023年8月15日冰川溃决引发的泥石流演化。随着泥石流沿途堆积，地震信号起至峰值时间从100秒延至300秒，主频升高超20 Hz，低频能量衰减。这些特征反映了泥石流向超高浓度流的转变。研究表明地震频率受粒径和浓度强烈影响，挑战了现有物理模型的简化假设。

沿流道的密集地震台阵监测，结合泥石流信号的时域包络与频谱分析。
Seismic recordings of a glacial outburst-triggered debris flow on 15 August 2023 at Tahoma Creek, Mount Rainier, depositing ~24,000 m³ of material.

As the flow deposited material, the onset-to-peak delay elongated from 100 to 300 s, peak frequency increased by >20 Hz, and low-frequency (<20 Hz) energy faded.

The findings complicate starting assumptions of existing physical models, which do not easily account for grain size and concentration effects on frequency.
研究结果使现有物理模型的初始假设复杂化，这些模型难以考虑粒径和浓度对频率的影响。

sum: This study investigates the deformation mechanisms of the Hulw Shear Zone in the Oman Mountains to understand strain localization and weakening during the exhumation of subducted continental crust. Using microstructural analysis, the authors document coeval brittle fracturing and ductile deformation under epidote-blueschist to low-greenschist facies conditions. They observe that S-C-C' fabric development and the interconnectivity of muscovite and pyrophyllite facilitate fluid flow and localized recrystallization of quartz. Preferential grain boundary sliding and dissolution-precipitation mechanisms further weaken the shear zone. Crucially, diffuse microfracturing perpendicular to shear planes transiently enhances permeability, allowing fluids to bypass barriers. The authors propose that these cyclic brittle-ductile processes drive strain localization and exhumation, potentially representing the geological record of slow earthquakes in subducting continental crust.
本研究通过阿曼Hulw剪切带微观结构分析，探讨地壳折返中的应变局部化与软化机制。在蓝闪石至绿片岩相下，脆性破裂与塑性变形协同。S-C-C'构造及片状硅酸盐互联促进了流体流动与石英重结晶。晶界滑动与溶解-沉淀机制削弱了岩石强度。微裂隙循环提高了渗透率，这些脆-塑性机制促进了折返，可能记录了慢地震。

t: Microstructural and mineralogical analysis of natural shear zone samples to characterize deformation fabrics, mineral interconnectivity, and fluid-rock interactions.
对天然剪切带样品进行微观结构和矿物学分析，表征变形组构、矿物互联性及流体作用。
Natural rock samples exhibiting S-C-C' fabrics, veins, and mylonitic foliation from the Hulw Shear Zone, Oman Mountains.

Interconnected phyllosilicates and quartz recrystallization localize strain, while diffuse microfracturing cyclically enhances permeability, potentially recording slow earthquakes.
互联的片状硅酸盐与石英重结晶使应变局部化，而弥散微裂隙循环提高渗透率，可能记录了慢地震。
The proposed link between the observed microstructures and active geophysical slow earthquakes remains interpretive and indirect.

Analysis of fluid inclusion bands and microfractures.
剪切带样品的微观结构分析（S-C-C'构造、脉体网络）。
