sum: This paper presents a practical deep neural network (DNN) framework to estimate high-frequency (HF) ground-motion Fourier amplitude spectra (FAS) from low-frequency (LF) inputs, extending the usable frequency range of deterministic simulations. Addressing common pitfalls in strong-motion machine learning, the authors design two tasks: station generalization and magnitude extrapolation. They implement leakage-free partitioning to prevent information leakage and use dedicated parameter encoders. Evaluated on Japan's Kiban-Kyoshin network (KiK-net) dataset, the model achieves high goodness-of-fit (GOF) scores (average ~4.95) for both tasks, significantly outperforming previous methods on unseen stations. The study also systematically evaluates how training set size, input frequency bandwidth, and magnitude distribution affect performance, highlighting key limitations and providing a practical roadmap for DNN-based seismic hazard applications.
本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络（DNN）的框架，用于从低频输入估算高频地震动傅里叶振幅谱（FAS），以扩展确定性模拟的可用频率范围。针对强震动机器学习中常见的源/台站信息泄露和强震数据稀缺问题，研究设计了台站泛化与震级外推两项任务。该框架采用无泄露数据划分和专用参数编码器。在KiK-net强震台网数……

t: A deep neural network framework incorporating leakage-free partitioning and dedicated parameter encoders to map low-frequency ground-motion inputs to high-frequency Fourier amplitude spectra.

Strong-motion records from the Kiban-Kyoshin network (KiK-net) dataset, partitioned to test station generalization and magnitude extrapolation.

Model performance exhibits strong dependence on training dataset size, the upper limit of the input low-frequency band, and the magnitude distribution of training data.

Leakage-free data partitioning based on event-station relational structures.
Goodness-of-fit (GOF) metric for quantitative performance evaluation.
具有专用参数编码器的深度神经网络（DNN）架构。
基于事件-台站关联结构的无泄露数据划分方法。
用于定量性能评估的拟合优度（GOF）指标。
de: Evaluated using the Kiban-Kyoshin network (KiK-net) strong-motion dataset from Japan.
Tested on station generalization (unseen stations) and magnitude extrapolation (larger magnitudes) tasks.
使用日本Kiban-Kyoshin台网（KiK-net）的强震动数据集进行评估。
在台站泛化（未见台站）和震级外推（更大震级）任务上进行了测试。

Sensitivity to the upper limit of the input low-frequency band of the FAS.
模型性能高度依赖于训练集的大小和训练数据的震级分布。
对输入低频段傅里叶振幅谱（FAS）的上限较为敏感。

sum: The Seismogeodetic Early Warning System (SEWS) is a real-time operational framework designed for local tsunami early warning. By combining high-rate (1–5 Hz) GNSS observations with collocated (100–200 Hz) accelerometer measurements, SEWS generates unclipped broadband displacement and velocity waveforms. It estimates seismic moment directly from the maximum absolute value of integrated displacement, bypassing empirical regressions and overcoming magnitude saturation. Tested at Chile's Centro Sismológico Nacional (CSN) and the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (PTWC) using 85 collocated stations, SEWS was evaluated via end-to-end replays of three great Chilean subduction earthquakes (Mw 8.1–8.8). The system's magnitude estimates converged to within 0.1–0.2 magnitude units of GCMT values within 2–3 minutes of origin time, demonstrating its capability to provide rapid, reliable, and non-saturating source characterization for near-field tsunami mitigation.
本文介绍实时地震大地测量预警系统（SEWS）。该系统结合高频GNSS与同址加速度计数据，生成无剪幅宽频位移波形，直接从积分位移最大值估算地震矩，克服了震级饱和问题。在智利俯冲带3次大地震（Mw 8.1-8.8）的回放测试中，SEWS在震后2-3分钟内将震级估算收敛至GCMT的0.1-0.2个单位内，……

结合高频GNSS与同址加速度计数据生成无剪幅宽频位移，直接从积分位移最大绝对值估算地震矩。
Real-time data from Chile's CSN network of 85 collocated stations, and replay datasets of three great Chilean subduction earthquakes (Mw 8.1-8.8).
智利CSN网络85个同址台站的实时数据，以及三次智利大地震（Mw 8.1-8.8）的回放数据集。
Network magnitude estimates (Mwg) converged to within 0.1-0.2 magnitude units of GCMT values within 2-3 minutes of earthquake origin time.
网络震级估算（Mwg）在地震发生后2-3分钟内收敛至与GCMT矩震级相差0.1-0.2个单位以内。
Requires dense, real-time collocated GNSS and accelerometer instrumentation along the active margin to ensure rapid and reliable magnitude convergence.
需要沿活动边缘分布密集的实时同址GNSS和加速度计仪器，以确保快速可靠的震级收敛。
Eliminates empirical regressions and magnitude saturation by directly integrating combined GNSS-seismic displacement waveforms in an operational, real-time tsunami early warning framework.
在实时海啸预警框架中，通过直接积分融合的GNSS-地震位移波形，消除了经验回归和震级饱和。

kc: Developed SEWS, a real-time operational seismogeodetic framework for rapid, non-saturating earthquake magnitude estimation.
Demonstrated successful end-to-end replay of three major Chilean subduction earthquakes (Mw 8.1–8.8) with magnitude convergence within 2–3 minutes.
Implemented and tested the system in operational environments at CSN (Chile) and PTWC (NOAA).
开发了SEWS，这是一种用于快速、不饱和地震震级估算的实时运行地震大地测量框架。
通过对智利俯冲带三次大地震（Mw 8.1-8.8）的端到端回放，展示了在2-3分钟内震级收敛的成功应用。
在智利CSN和美国NOAA的PTWC等业务化环境中部署并测试了该系统。
me: Seismogeodetic data fusion combining high-rate (1–5 Hz) GNSS and collocated (100–200 Hz) accelerometer data.
Direct estimation of seismic moment from the maximum absolute value of integrated broadband displacement waveforms.
结合高频（1-5 Hz）GNSS和同址（100-200 Hz）加速度计数据的地震大地测量数据融合方法。
直接从积分宽频位移波形的最大绝对值估算地震矩，无需经验回归关系。
de: Real-time testing using Chile's CSN network of 85 collocated GNSS and accelerometer stations.
End-to-end replay of three great Chilean subduction earthquakes (Mw 8.1–8.8).
利用智利CSN由85个同址GNSS和加速度计台站组成的网络进行实时测试。
对智利俯冲带发生的三次大地震（Mw 8.1-8.8）进行端到端回放实验。
li: Relies on the density and real-time availability of collocated GNSS and accelerometer stations near the rupture zone.
Performance is optimized for large subduction zone earthquakes and may have different sensitivity for smaller or complex inland events.
依赖于破裂区附近同址GNSS和加速度计台站的密度及实时数据可用性。
该方法针对大型俯冲带地震进行了优化，对较小或复杂的陆内地震的敏感性可能有所不同。

The primary application of the system is local tsunami early warning and rapid magnitude estimation.

sum: Peak ground acceleration (PGA) and velocity (PGV) are conventionally linked to distinct high and intermediate frequency bands. This study tests common strong-motion aphorisms by directly measuring instantaneous frequencies at the exact times of PGA and PGV across 6,415 records (M 2–9.1, distances 4–1,000 km) in California, Japan, and Mexico. Using Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and the Hilbert-Huang transform, the authors compute the amplitude-weighted mean frequency (f_mean) and frequency spread (f_spread) of active modes. Across all data, median f_mean is 6.71 Hz for PGA and 3.20 Hz for PGV, with broadly overlapping distributions. Only 31% of PGA and 15% of PGV peaks are frequency-coherent. Furthermore, frequency decay with distance reflects transitions to Moho-reflected (SmS) or Lg arrivals alongside attenuation, magnitude scaling is shallower than constant-stress-drop corner-frequency predictions, and basin PGV frequencies reflect either incident wavefield bands or local resonance.
本研究利用自适应噪声完备集合经验模态分解（CEEMDAN）与希尔伯特-黄变换（HHT），直接测量了加州、日本和墨西哥6415条强震记录（震级2–9.1，距离4–1000公里）在PGA和PGV时刻的振幅加权平均瞬时频率与频率展布。结果显示PGA和PGV的中位频率分别为6.71 Hz和3.20 Hz，分……

t: Applies Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and the Hilbert transform to 40 s windows around PGA and PGV to measure amplitude-weighted mean instantaneous frequency (f_mean), dominant-mode frequency (f_dom), and frequency spread (f_spread).
对PGA和PGV周围40秒窗口应用CEEMDAN和希尔伯特变换，测量振幅加权平均瞬时频率与频率展布。

Analyzes 6,415 strong-motion and broadband records spanning M 2–9.1 and distances of 4–1,000 km across six regional earthquakes in California and Japan, seven California single-station magnitude ladders, and 16 Mexico City stations.
分析了加州、日本和墨西哥6415条强震记录（震级2–9.1，距离4–1000公里），涵盖距离、震级和场地实验。
Across all 6,415 records, median f_mean is 6.71 Hz (IQR 3.7–10.8 Hz) at PGA and 3.20 Hz (IQR 1.05–5.88 Hz) at PGV; only 31% of PGA and 15% of PGV peaks are frequency-coherent.
PGA和PGV的中位平均频率分别为6.71 Hz和3.20 Hz，分布广泛重叠；仅31%和15%的峰值具有频率相干性。
IMF envelope weights do not represent signed contributions or orthogonal energy partitioning, and numerical sifting degrades when peaks occur within 2 s of truncated record boundaries.
IMF包络权重不代表正交能量分配或带符号贡献，且窗口边界2秒内的数值筛分估计会退化。
First large-scale empirical measurement of simultaneous mode frequencies and their spread directly at the exact instants of PGA and PGV, testing long-held strong-motion seismology aphorisms.
首次在大规模数据集上直接测量PGA和PGV精确时刻的同时模态频率及其展布，检验了传统强震学格言。

kc: Measured instantaneous frequencies and frequency spreads at the exact instants of PGA and PGV across 6,415 records using CEEMDAN and the Hilbert-Huang transform.
Demonstrated that PGA (median 6.71 Hz) and PGV (median 3.20 Hz) span broad, overlapping frequency ranges, with 69% of PGA and 85% of PGV peaks comprising mixed multi-scale oscillations.
Showed that far-field peak frequency reductions accompany arrival transitions from direct S (Sg) to Moho-reflected (SmS) or crustally guided (Lg) waves.
Found that peak frequencies at fixed stations decrease with magnitude (-0.06 to -0.20 dex/M) much more slowly than constant-stress-drop Brune corner-frequency scaling (-0.5 dex/M).
Distinguished two basin mechanisms for low-frequency PGV peaks: preferential amplification of a low-frequency band already in the incident wavefield versus concentration near local site resonance.
利用CEEMDAN和希尔伯特-黄变换，测量了6415条地震记录在PGA和PGV精确时刻的瞬时频率及频率展布。
证明了PGA（中位数6.71 Hz）和PGV（中位数3.20 Hz）跨越广泛且重叠的频率范围，69%的PGA和85%的PGV峰值包含混合的多尺度振荡。
揭示了远场峰值频率随距离下降不仅源于衰减，还伴随着携带峰值的震相从直达S波（Sg）向莫霍面反射波（SmS）或地壳导波（Lg）的转换。
发现固定台站的峰值频率随震级下降的斜率（-0.06至-0.20 dex/M）远比恒定应力降Brune模型拐角频率预测（-0.5 dex/M）平缓。
区分了沉积盆地低频PGV峰值的两种机制：对入射波场既有低频带的优先放大，或局部场地共振引起的频率集中。
me: Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) using 200 noise realizations (amplitude 0.15 of record standard deviation) on 40 s windows centered at PGA and PGV.
Hilbert transform applied to intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) to extract instantaneous amplitude envelopes and phase derivatives (instantaneous frequencies) at the peak sample.
Calculation of amplitude-weighted mean frequency (f_mean), dominant-mode frequency (f_dom), and frequency spread (f_spread) retaining IMFs with >=5% of dominant mode amplitude.
Classification of peaks into 'coherent' versus 'mixed' based on f_spread/f_dom > 0.3 or >1 octave difference between f_dom and zero-crossing frequency (f_zc).
Travel-time modeling using 1D layered crustal velocity models to compare PGA and PGV timing against Sg, SmS, and Lg phase windows.
以PGA和PGV为中心截取40秒窗口，使用200次噪声实现（振幅为记录标准差的0.15倍）进行自适应噪声完备集合经验模态分解（CEEMDAN）。
对本征模态函数（IMF）应用希尔伯特变换，提取峰值采样点处的瞬时振幅包络和相位导数（瞬时频率）。
保留振幅至少为主导模态5%的IMF，计算振幅加权平均频率（f_mean）、主导模态频率（f_dom）和频率展布（f_spread）。
基于f_spread/f_dom > 0.3或f_dom与过零频率（f_zc）相差超过1个倍频程的标准，将峰值分类为“相干”或“混合”。
使用一维分层地壳速度模型进行走时正演，将PGA和PGV出现时间与Sg、SmS和Lg震相窗口进行对比。
de: 6,415 strong-motion and broadband records spanning M 2–9.1 and distances of ~4–1,000 km across California, Japan, and Mexico.

Distance-dependence experiments using five crustal earthquakes (2014 M 5.1 La Habra, 2014 M 6.0 South Napa, 2018 M 5.5 Osaka, 2013 M 5.8 Tochigi, 2011 M 6.0 Shizuoka) and the 2011 M 9.1 Tohoku-oki megathrust earthquake.
Magnitude-ladder experiments analyzing 3,681 local earthquake records (M 2.0–7.1) at seven fixed stations in California within narrow hypocentral distance bands.
Site and basin effect analyses comparing Japanese far-field records against the J-SHIS V4 basement-depth model and 16 Mexico City stations recording the 2017 M 7.1 Puebla earthquake.
来自加州、日本和墨西哥的6415条强震及宽频带记录，涵盖震级M 2–9.1、震源距约4–1000公里。
距离依赖性实验：包含5次地壳地震（La Habra、South Napa、大阪、枥木、静冈）及2011年M 9.1东北冲大地震。
震级阶梯实验：分析了加州7个固定台站在狭窄震源距范围内记录的3681条地方震事件（M 2.0–7.1）。
场地与盆地效应分析：将日本远场记录与J-SHIS V4基底深度模型进行对比，并分析了记录2017年M 7.1普埃布拉地震的16个墨西哥城台站。
li: Empirical mode decomposition IMFs are not orthogonal and weights reflect instantaneous envelopes rather than signed contributions or conserved energy partitioning.
Numerical sifting and Hilbert transform estimates degrade near analysis-window boundaries, affecting ~1% of velocity records (flagged when within 2 s of a truncated edge).
Peak timing comparisons cannot uniquely distinguish between Moho-reflected SmS and crustally guided Lg waves at regional distances due to arrival window overlap and scatter.
In single-station magnitude ladders, high-pass filter corners vary with magnitude and one station (CI.WBM) suffers from 100 Hz Nyquist bandwidth limitations at small magnitudes.
经验模态分解得到的IMF并非正交，权重反映的是瞬时包络而非带符号的波形贡献或守恒的能量分配。
数值筛分过程和希尔伯特变换估计在分析窗口边界附近会退化，影响约1%的速度记录（距截断边缘2秒以内的峰值被标记）。
由于区域距离上预测到时窗口重叠且数据离散，峰值时间对比无法唯一区分莫霍面反射波（SmS）和地壳导波（Lg）。
在单台震级阶梯实验中，高通滤波拐角频率随震级变化，且CI.WBM台站在小震级时受限于100 Hz采样率的带宽限制。

tm.why: The paper systematically analyzes the instantaneous frequencies present at the instants of peak ground acceleration (PGA) and peak ground velocity (PGV) across 6,415 strong-motion records.
The study investigates how anelastic attenuation, site attenuation (kappa), and regional crustal wave propagation (SmS and Lg arrivals) alter peak ground motion frequencies with distance.

ev.notes: Full 26-page preprint PDF including all 11 figures and 2 tables was read and analyzed.

sum: This study models synthetic seismic and tsunami waveforms along the planned TamTam SMART subsea cable connecting Vanuatu and New Caledonia across the Vanuatu subduction zone. Using finite-fault models for three recent large earthquakes (2013 Mw 8.0, 2021 and 2023 Mw 7.7) and UNESCO maximum-considered scenarios (five Mw 8.33 subevents and a combined Mw 8.8 event), the authors compute tsunami generation and propagation with the nonhydrostatic NEOWAVE code and long-period (>20 s) seismic displacements with SYNGINE using a 1D Earth model (PREM). Spectral analysis reveals multi-scale shelf and basin tsunami oscillations (periods from 7 to 86 min). Because the four planned cable sensors lie seaward of insular shelves and outside energetic resonance antinodes, they record direct source-representative tsunami signals with minimal landmass interference. The novelty lies in pre-deployment joint characterization of seismic and tsunami signals to guide sensor engineering, bottom-pressure correction, and regional early warning.
本研究针对连接瓦努阿图与新喀里多尼亚的TamTam SMART海底电缆，模拟了区域强震的地震与海啸波形。基于3次近期强震（Mw 7.7–8.0）的有限断层模型及UNESCO最大设防情景（Mw 8.33–8.8），利用非静压NEOWAVE程序计算海啸传播，并结合SYNGINE与一维PREM模型模拟长周……

t: Tsunami generation and propagation are modeled using the nonhydrostatic NEOWAVE code on two-way nested grids forced by Okada finite-fault seafloor deformation, while long-period (>20 s) seismic waveforms are simulated using SYNGINE with point-source moment tensors in 1D PREM.
利用有限断层海底形变驱动嵌套网格NEOWAVE模拟海啸，结合SYNGINE与一维PREM计算长周期地震波。

Three historical finite-fault models (2013 Mw 8.0, 2021 and 2023 Mw 7.7), UNESCO maximum-considered scenarios (five Mw 8.33 subevents and combined Mw 8.8), GEBCO14 30-arcsec bathymetry, DART tsunami records, and regional broadband seismic stations.
3次近期强震（Mw 7.7–8.0）有限断层模型、UNESCO Mw 8.33–8.8设防情景、GEBCO地形及DART…

Recent events produce 3–4 cm vertical and up to 9 cm transverse seismic displacements at sensor 2 with ~1 h tsunami arrival; the Mw 8.8 scenario generates 2.5 m tsunami elevation at sensor 2, >11 m coastal surges, and 1.4 m vertical / 3.2 m horizontal ground motion.
近期强震在传感器2产生3–9 cm位移；Mw 8.8情景在传感器2产生2.5 m海啸波高和3.2 m水平地面运动。

Unconstrained short-period source complexity and 3D propagation structures restrict seismic modeling to 1D point-source approximations at periods longer than ~20–40 s, which also omit static vertical offsets near the source.
缺乏三维速度结构和短周期震源约束，仅限>20–40 s一维点源模拟，无法重现近场静态垂直位移。

First comprehensive pre-deployment modeling of both tsunami and seismic waveforms along the TamTam SMART cable route to evaluate resonance exposure, sensor placement, and regional early warning capabilities.
首次在部署前联合模拟TamTam海缆的海啸与地震响应，评估共振影响并指导传感器布设与区域预警。

kc: Simulated synthetic tsunami and long-period (>20 s) seismic waveforms at planned TamTam SMART cable sensor locations for recent Mw 7.7–8.0 events and Mw 8.33–8.8 maximum-considered scenarios.
Identified multi-scale bathymetric resonance modes (7 to 86 min periods) along the Vanuatu Trench and showed that cable sensors are positioned outside energetic antinodes.
Provided operational and engineering insights for SMART cable deployment, including cable slack requirements (2%–5%), coseismic bottom-pressure corrections, and early warning timelines.
模拟了近期Mw 7.7–8.0地震和Mw 8.33–8.8最大设防情景在规划TamTam SMART海缆传感器处的合成海啸和长周期（>20 s）地震波形。
识别了瓦努阿图海沟沿线多尺度海底地形共振模态（周期7至86分钟），证明规划传感器位置避开了高能共振波腹。
提供了SMART海缆部署的工程与业务化见解，包括海缆余长设计（2%–5%）、同震海底压力校正及早期预警时间线。
me: Finite-fault coseismic seafloor vertical displacement modeling using Okada (1985) half-space solutions with Tanioka and Satake (1996) horizontal slope translation corrections.
Two-level nested nonhydrostatic tsunami modeling (NEOWAVE) at 2 arcmin and 30 arcsec resolutions, paired with spectral analysis for resonance modes.
Long-period (>20 s, low-pass filtered at 40 s) synthetic seismogram computation using SYNGINE with point-source moment tensors in a 1D anisotropic PREM velocity model.
利用Okada (1985)半空间解和Tanioka and Satake (1996)水平海底坡度平移校正计算有限断层同震海底垂直位移。
采用两层嵌套网格（2角分和30角秒分辨率）的非静压海啸数值模拟（NEOWAVE），并结合频谱分析提取共振模态。
使用SYNGINE和一维各向异性PREM速度模型中的点源矩张量计算长周期（>20 s，40 s低通滤波）合成地震图。
de: Validated finite-fault slip models for the 2013 Mw 8.0 Santa Cruz Islands, 2021 Mw 7.7 megathrust, and 2023 Mw 7.7 outer-rise Loyalty Islands earthquakes.
UNESCO-IOC maximum-considered earthquake scenario (Mw 8.8 with 10 m uniform slip over 500 km x 100 km) and five constituent Mw 8.33 subevents.
GEBCO14 30-arcsec bathymetry, regional DART buoy records, teleseismic broadband P-wave records, and regional ORSNET broadband seismic waveforms (SANVU, NOUC, KOUNC).
经验证的2013年Mw 8.0圣克鲁斯群岛地震、2021年Mw 7.7板块界面逆冲地震和2023年Mw 7.7外隆起正断层地震的有限断层滑动模型。
UNESCO-IOC最大设防地震情景（500 km × 100 km断层上10 m均匀滑动的Mw 8.8情景）及其5个Mw 8.33子事件。
GEBCO14 30角秒水深地形数据、区域DART浮标记录、远震宽频带P波记录以及区域ORSNET宽频带地震台站（SANVU、NOUC、KOUNC）波形。
li: Seismic wave simulations use simplified point-source representations and a 1D Earth model (PREM), limiting accuracy to periods longer than ~20–40 s.
Short-period ground motions, velocities, and accelerations cannot be reliably constrained due to unmodeled source complexities and 3D island-arc propagation structures.
Point-source approximation within the rupture zone of subevent B does not reproduce the static vertical displacement predicted by the finite-fault model.
地震波模拟采用了简化的点源表示和一维地球模型（PREM），将有效周期限制在20–40秒以上。
由于缺乏震源复杂性和三维岛弧传播结构的约束，无法可靠评估短周期地面运动、速度和加速度。
在子事件B破裂区内部，点源近似无法重现有限断层模型预测的静态垂直位移。

tm.why: The paper evaluates synthetic seismic and tsunami signals at the planned TamTam SMART subsea cable sensor nodes on the seafloor.
The study models regional ground displacements and tsunami impacts from historical Mw 7.7–8.0 earthquakes and maximum-considered Mw 8.33–8.8 scenarios to support hazard warning.
The authors perform numerical wave simulations using the nonhydrostatic NEOWAVE code for tsunamis and SYNGINE (1D PREM) for synthetic seismic waveforms.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF (including Appendix A and Figures 1–10, A1–A3) was analyzed directly.
